description:
Flannels is the UK's largest independent luxury retail group, specialising in contemporary men's and women's designer clothing, footwear and accessories.

Customer Service Opening Hours

Monday to Friday 08:00 - 20:00
Saturday & Sunday 08:00 - 18:00
(All Times are GMT)
Contact us via Customer Care

records.title: Outstanding
records.text: All good , present for Christmas didn’t think it was gonna make it  , due to me leaving it so late & Wow Ordered on the Sunday and here late Monday afternoon Brilliant .      The Earrings my daughter loves them couldn’t ask for much more thankyou !

records.title: I booked next day delivery on 23rd…
records.text: I booked next day delivery on 23rd December expecting there to be no chance of delivery but the item arrived early on 24th December. Really well packaged and very happy with the product

records.title: I have made 2 visits with things…
records.text: I have made 2 visits with things brought online and in store. I was attended by the same young lady each time. She was lovely. Explained the options and sorted out everything effortlessly. Very happy customer

records.title: It was my first time ordering through…
records.text: It was my first time ordering through flannels and it was a great experience. They had excellent deals on during Boxing Day and their customer service (spoke to Vanya) was truly excellent and resolved my issue straight away. Will deffo come back to shop at flannels.

records.title: The lady I spoke to at customer service…
records.text: The lady I spoke to at customer service was amazing, so friendly and helpful, she understood my urgency to get my product before Christmas. She went above and beyond for me.

records.title: Exceptional
records.text: Few times I used Flannels and I must say I’ve been impressed each time by the quality of their products and most importantly by the speed of their deliveries. The only thing I regret is that they don’t have credit facilities such as Clearpay or Klarna.

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: Fast delivery, arrived next day on 16th Dec. I made a second order on the 17th and this was with me 4 days later but very speedy response, great customer service just before Christmas!Would always recommend flannels for those gift giving moments- especially last minute gifts!!

records.title: Fab customer service team
records.text: I ordered a product and it unfortunately arrived with a small fault. I phoned up customer services and Stephen was incredibly helpful, processing an exchange for me within a matter of minutes. I'm incredibly impressive with the level of customer service he has provided and has restored my faith in shopping at Flannels after receiving a faulty item.

records.title: Delivered as promised at Christmas
records.text: Despite ordering on 23 December, the item arrived next day as promised. Can’t fault the service, so often companies promise delivery dates they have no intention of meeting so it was refreshing to receive it on time. Delivery was expensive but worth it for the convenience and relative to the price of the item.

records.title: After choosing ‘collect from store’ it…
records.text: After choosing ‘collect from store’ it became apparent my gift wouldn’t be available until after Christmas so I called the customer services and a delightful lady (Caroline) was so very helpful & provided a great resolution to the situation & I received my goods via the post. Best customer service support I’ve received for a very long time do thank you. Kind regards

records.title: Don’t pay for overnight delivery!
records.text: Paid for overnight delivery, this did not happen! Never happens if they use DPD, who are rubbish in this area!BEWARE as this is not the first time this has happened to me. Scruffy packaging again, stuffed inside a plastic bag. Product nice and as expected.

records.title: Damage item
records.text: Ordered some trainers they came damaged had to return but they was very helpful in returning item.i will be ordering some more as never had a problem before

records.title: Pleased with the item it is as shown on…
records.text: Pleased with the item it is as shown on the website fast delivery as always from Flannels, however I feel slightly let down by my order being delivered out in the Brands own box which was quite damaged (ripped on all four corners of the lid) Not good when I’m big on presentation.

records.title: Delivery was exceptional
records.text: Delivery was exceptional But was a very expensive top and came rolled up in a plastic bag

records.title: One of the best customer service calls I've ever had.
records.text: The only reason it's not 5* is because you cannot return web orders in store. The customer service I received from Kurt over the phone was excellent. Really cared and listened and resolved my issue very quickly. Thank you again and Kurt hope you get a Christmas bonus as you deserve it pal. 👍🏽

records.title: Very quick good service would recommend…
records.text: Very quick good service would recommend 👍🏻However only reason I did not give 5 stars is because for the money you are spending postage is charged on top

records.title: Good company
records.text: Have seen mixed reviews but have to say I ordered a couple of times before Christmas and I got a good delivery and happy with the products

records.title: Everything is normally very good with…
records.text: Everything is normally very good with Flannels.Unfortunately , the return system when you have a problem is not very helpful.

records.title: Excellent Service
records.text: Orders are sent and delivered really quickly. Packed well and don’t arrived creased like many other websites. I gave 4 stars because postage and returns are far too expensive. Otherwise brilliant service

records.title: Delivery was quick although some items…
records.text: Delivery was quick although some items was not boxed with its proper designer box which i expected like my gucci bag, it was not on its proper gucci box, just an ordinary brown box which i didn’t expect.

records.title: Did not receive a nice flannels bag or…
records.text: Did not receive a nice flannels bag or box. This used to happen. Now your competitors packaging is better and flannels is not set apart.

records.title: Lack of communication !
records.text: Sadly I ordered a gift receipt for my brother for christmas & was shocked to learn it was delivered to him & not me !!

records.title: It all went quite smoothly
records.text: It all went quite smoothly. My only problem is that I ordered a Flannels gift voucher as a Secret Santa gift. I could have done with an email from Flannels just to confirm that the recipient had been sent the voucher, in the end I had to check with them, which kind of defeated the object of Secret Santa!

records.title: I was a bit disappointed my shoes…
records.text: I was a bit disappointed my shoes didn’t come in the fabric flannels bag that you get when purchasing in store. Didn’t really feel like buying from a luxury brand. Felt cheap

records.title: No gift wrap!
records.text: Products - they are what they are. Yes, delivery is very expensive, but expected due to high value product I guess. No gift wrap anymore though? Not even a bag? Disappointed by that.

records.title: Lovely clothes and packaging but…
records.text: Lovely clothes and packaging but expensive for delivery and returns even for expensive items.

records.title: Fast and professional , but item not pristine.
records.text: I ordered a McQueen handbag which was dispatched at lightening fast speed (arrived the next day). However considering this was a big investment for me, the cloth bag was extremely creased up and the beautiful metal work piece on the front of the bag didn't have protective plastic seals on it, it had a tiny scrape in the metal and looked like a return that had possibly been used. I didn't feel like I was unboxing a pristine new designer bag. I returned it, and bought the same bag from another designer outlet who sent the bag as I imagined it would - factory plastic seals on the metalwork and everything perfect. So personally I won't buy from Flannels again for super special items. Maybe it was a one off , but it put me off. I got a fast refund though, so the experience was fine.

records.title: Easy to order
records.text: Easy to order, good filters when searching but charging for delivery and even click and collect orders under £400 is a little much.

records.title: Small details
records.text: Overall great ! delivery was quick items in good order although every package I received had previously been opened, packaging clearly torn with no attempted to reseal them which looked alittle shabby for a store that markets it's self on high end merchandise,  in my opinion if your buying something from flannels then it should be packaged as though it was bought from flannels not in a way that looked as if I'd purchased my items from house of frasier or sports direct which were advertised allover the packaging nothing wrong with either of these stores but can't help feeling I had lost that personal flannels touch. Small things I know but if you market yourself as high end then you should deliver in the same way.

records.title: Good items but delivery too expensive
records.text: Good items, fast delivery but 7.99 delivery is extortionate especially when it’s the same price to be delivered into store

records.title: Awful customer service
records.text: Items arrived quickly and were lovely, however one of the jumpers was a little small and on attempting to return to the store to change for a bigger size, was told this could not be done. I’d have to return to the online shop, wait for return to be processed then order online again. Terrible customer service. I also made a purchase in store and was told it could only be exchanged or a credit note if I was returning it, as it could be tried on, how can I try on a jumper for my husband? Nice clothes, absolutely dire customer service

records.title: Bad experience in store (Kingston upon…
records.text: Bad experience in store (Kingston upon thames) the staff generally were not helpful and especially on the first floor, more concerned with their own conversations. When I asked a young female member about sandals she said well it is not summer and that was it, no solution offered. This would never happen in harrods/ selfridges etc and that is the type of customer service they should be aiming for.Also I paid for NDD online and the shoes arrived after 2 days.Otherwise love the gucci shoes! Good range on the website

records.title: Packaging poor
records.text: Packaging poor. It would be nice if the item came in Flannels bag or packaging, especially if it's a gift. Felt like I'd received something from a basic department store or catalogue

records.title: My item ordered was gorgeous
records.text: My item ordered was gorgeous We’ve had a few flannels delivered lately and the packaging has been horrendous My husband got a £600 jacket and it was as if it was screwed into a ball and put in the post. The bag protector my bag came in also was in a terrible state.

records.title: Saga of the missing voucher
records.text: Liked that 1 voucher of the 2 ordered did arrive, didn't like that the other still hasn't been received! No reply to my contact query about missing item and no reply from your phone number! Case acknowledgment received from my direct email to customer service but no other response yet. Perhaps I should have scored 2 stars not 3! Disappointed!

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Product, when it arrived, was just as advertised. However having ordered this item on the 4th December, with a delivery date of 12th December I am absolutely completely disappointed that my parcel was not delivered until 30th December. Given that the item I ordered was shown as being in stock, this is not acceptable.

records.title: Pain in the arse if you need an exchange...
records.text: Pain in the arse if you need a different size, you have to return for a refund.Then reorder then wait for refund.Then you've to pay for delivery x3, they did eventually pay for the delivery and refunded delivery after a lengthy online chat..Had to wait about 3 weeks for my refund, whole process is a ball ache...

records.title: Expected better packaging
records.text: Whilst goods arrived on time. It was disappointing to find, that the item was sent in a plastic cover; then packed in a Fraser Plus plastic bag. As this was a down jacket. I would have expected much better packaging given the value of the item; as it could have been punctured in transit.

records.title: Postage rip off
records.text: If you buy online you can not return to the shop itself. I spent £11.99 on next day delivery which then came the day after the next day and then had to spend £4.99 to return my item which was too small. I bought from here due to the item being a better price than other shops but after all the delivery charges I should have just purchased elsewhere. I would have thought that a shop like Flannels could offer free delivery to its customers like other like shops.

records.title: Don't do gift cards.
records.text: I tried to order a gift  voucher for my daughter but they don't send them through the post only by email so I was disappointed.

records.title: Ordering process ok but for returns paying postage is not good
records.text: Ordering process ok but Fraser pay is not so good better if you have something like Klarna pay. Return option not great and had to pay for postage which is not good also no option to return to store for online orders.

records.title: Charged for delivery on an item worth…
records.text: Charged for delivery on an item worth €120 and then charged to return them £16 stg . Not being able to return them to a flannels shop is ridiculous I won’t be ordering from flannels again

records.title: As a regular flannels on line customer.
records.text: As a regular flannels on line customer.It would be really nice to see some loyalty benefits.Free postage, money off, previews etc.

records.title: earrings, no returns
records.text: Bought some earrings, my fault really as I assumed they’d be normal size but they’re big. Your policy doesn’t allow me to return them and purchase the others as they’re piercings… despite them not being worn.

records.title: Product received was of good quality…
records.text: Product received was of good quality and reasonably provided with a festive sale.The delivery fee was not justified £8.99 despite paying £75 for a product. I would have expected this to be free hence why the 3 star review.

records.title: There not much stock in store…
records.text: There not much stock in store (Sheffield) so you have to use the online service forcing you to pay the postage price , yes it arrived within 4 days but its even the same for click & collect which I think should be either free or at most £2 That’s why I’ve given 3 stars

records.title: Delivery costs a joke
records.text: The boots were great however massively oversized so had to send them back for a smaller size. All in Paying £6.99 for original delivery and £4.99 to send them back. Then £6.99 for the smaller size. Bit of a piss take not having some sort of return option to exchange for a different size

records.title: Poor Choice of Courier
records.text: Not to do with Flannels as such but placed my order with them on Dec 11th and still have not received my order (Dec 24th). I suspect the issue is their choice of courier (Fastway) who have pretended they’ve attempted delivery twice now. I’ve been home for a week at this point so they haven’t attempted anything. Would suggest a change of courier as this will ultimately damage their business.

records.title: In these days of next day delivery I…
records.text: In these days of next day delivery I was surprised that my items took so long to arrive.£7 delivery charge is excessive plus if I wanted to return the items it would cost another £7

records.title: Better to send your items more protected
records.text: I recieved the box of boss Trunks damaged, not just slightly but the plastic was cracked and sharp and the packaging crushed. Too late to do anything about this as it was for a gift on Christmas day. So had to apologise to the receiver about the state of it.

records.title: Good products
records.text: Good products. However, not happy with the price to have items delivered after online shopping and the charge to return them. So if new items are reordered online there would another delivery charge and charging the same for click and collect as delivery. All big profitable companies generally don’t charge. Especially with the groups profits the last tax year! Disgusting!

records.title: Very hit and miss, mostly miss
records.text: Very hit and miss. The website showed the wrong size, so we wanted to return the items. Returns portal online not working, so had to ring. Then they wouldn't send a returns label without photographic evidence of their online error. Paid next day delivery which wasn't refunded despite the error being theirs. Wouldn't buy online from them again, far too much hassle, and some very basic online/returns functions unavailable.

records.title: They won’t refund you for anything even when in the wrong.
records.text: Paid for next day delivery but it didn’t come next day, offered me a refund or a voucher and I didn’t pick which one but they assumed and then sent the refund to an account that no longer exists ? And I am yet to receive any compensation

records.title: UTTER SHAMBLES
records.text: Where to i start with this review utter shambles from the startOrdered the item 2weeks before Xmas and waited 10 days for delivery which I tracked constantly it showed at the delivery centre for 6 days and didn't move so I contacted the the help chat and was told I had to wait a full 10 days which I did I rang back and was told the item had been lost and was told the item was now sold out!!So we are now less than a week to Christmas and this item was a main present so I look around online and it was sold out all over So I checked the Flannels website and what did I see the item in stock with a message saying few left so I ordered it and paid for NEXT DAY delvery not the standard and guess what it the item arrived the next day So not only was I lied to by the Flannels help team but was forced to pay for NEXT DAY delivery which was doubled the standard one Utter utter shambles poor service and poor attitude from the Flannels help team

records.title: Far from impressed
records.text: I must say I am impressed by the speed of delivery however that's the only positive . This is the second time I have used flannels . The second time I have had to return an item due to damage . I have just ordered a 400 pound coat. It's arrived shoved in a parcel bag but no other bag or protection... Not what I would expect with designer labels . On inspection the coat hood was also damaged . What I also find terribly annoying is that I'm expected to pay for returns ... If I could return it . The return website states my order is recognised and the online chat staff are less than helpful . So now currently stuck with 2 items that' need to be returned and no way of doing it or help .

records.title: Poor communication and arrived late
records.text: Didn’t get any emails to say order was shipped or anything, thought I got scammed so ordered another elsewhere and passed the arrival date it comes with no warning

records.title: I ordered 5 items
records.text: I ordered 5 items .  One of the items was not what I ordered.  So I contacted flannels online because there's no phone number.  They apologised  and said they have sent the information to the relevant department.  And I have to for a investigation.   This was my sons xmas present.    It obvious by the pictures I sent it's the incorrect item. All I want to do is return and order my sons present again. Why does it have to be so hard.

records.title: £20 in postage…
records.text: I recently placed two large orders with Flannels, spending over £500 on Christmas presents, but unfortunately, this may be my last. One of the gifts I purchased for my dad was a Lacoste Polo, clearly shown as 'Regular Fit' in the product photos. However, what arrived was a 'Slim Fit' version, which didn’t fit him.Because of this error, I’ve had to pay £4.99 to return the item, on top of the £6.99 I initially paid for delivery. To make matters worse, I’ll need to pay another £6.99 in postage to reorder the correct item, as Flannels does not offer exchanges. That’s almost £20 in postage fees for an issue caused by misleading product photos.To add insult to injury, the item has now increased in price, despite being listed as part of a sale when I originally purchased it. This entire experience has been frustrating, costly, and avoidable had the correct product details been provided.

records.title: Firstly to order for delivery is…
records.text: Firstly to order for delivery is expensive £7-10 this is understandable as going rates. If the product is no good I have to pay £5 to return. I don't think that is acceptable as most retailers have free returns. So ultimately it's costing me £15 to order an item and if it's not a good fit i return it. Leaving me £15 in debt with no item. For me I'll now purchase from other retailers that have free returns just incase the item is no good.

records.title: I read online that Flannels as a…
records.text: I read online that Flannels as a company do not do anything with returns except landfill, if this is correct, why do you need the item returned and not just passed on to somebody that is in need? Also why charge for returns?

description: The reusable period pad that's good for you and good for the planet - Let's Wear 'em Out not throw 'em out. #anewwaytoperiod

records.title: Love
records.text: Love, love, love. So disappointed that they're closing down, I can't find any others that compare.

records.title: They do exactly what they need to, well!
records.text: A great alternative to disposable pads! Heck, they're also a great alternative to other brands of reusables, because this is the best brand I've found so far. Super secure fasteners on the wings, perfectly absorbant for post-partum incontinence even, and of course a great companion for the menstrual cycle. Also, the option of having a dark absorbant part is just nice, though I appreciate that some people need to see what's going on and might opt for the light gray!

records.title: What’s not to love?
records.text: I discovered this brand during lockdown and so glad I did. They are amazing and so comfortable. I’ve saved so much money on not having to buy disposable pads but also helping reduce my waste and save the planet, which I’m passionate about. I am gutted the store is closing and wish Lauren all the best. Buy these!! You will not be disappointed x

records.title: Extremely effective, incredible quality and good value
records.text: I think Wear ‘em Out’s reusable pads are incredible quality and fairly priced. I’ve been using them for over a year now and absolutely love them. They hold more blood, produce absolutely zero odour and don’t budge, whatever activity you’re doing (especially for us active sleepers!) compared to disposable pads. I switched for environmental reasons and certainly won’t be going back!

records.title: Flawless pads. Flawless service.
records.text: I've been using Wear 'em Out since 2020 and I don't want to use any other brand! I've never been let down by Lauren's product, both during my period and by her excellent customer service. I am so glad I made the switch to reusables for a plethora of reasons, the main being how much better I feel physically for leaving behind the horrid disposables, and of course how much kinder these pads are to the planet! Periods can be bloody awful (pun intended) but Wear 'em Out certainly makes them a whole lot easier.

records.title: Awesome Pads…
records.text: As always quick delivery and a bonus 20% off. These pads are quite frankly a game changer, main reason for purchasing these several years ago was purely environmental however I love that I feel in control of my menstrual bleed I am able to notice changes at 51 years young that’s a bonus. Comfy, leak proof and awesome designs Lauren I will be sad to see you go.

records.title: Love these reusable pads...
records.text: Love these reusable pads since using them my periods are less heavier and less painful.  They are comfortable to wear. Would highly recommend them!

records.title: Great company
records.text: Great company, great products!! 🤩🤩🤩- Quick service and high quality reuseable pads.- I’ve been using them for over a year now and absolutely love them.

records.title: Fantastic product-game changer
records.text: Really happy with my new pads. These have been a game changer for me. SO much more comfortable than disposables, better for your body, better for the environment and no more disposable towel instigated thrush!My teenage daughter has only used thesesince starting her periods and as a result they will always be her first choice over any other options. Cannot recommend highly enough!

records.title: These pads are fantastic!
records.text: These pads are fantastic!! I don’t get any cramps or period pain, after looking into the chemicals and educating myself on disposable period products these pads really have proven to be healthier- better for the environment and more cost effective!!! I also find I don’t need to change as often either. I love not ever needing to think oh dam Iv run out or need to add them to my shopping. My daughter has also just started her period and is using them as-well so we both have our own stash! Thank you Lauren

records.title: Great products!
records.text: These are great products! So good for the environment and really easy to use. My only concern is the lighter grey ones stain more easily which doesn't make them very appealing to put on next time, but I'll definitely still be using them and probably get the dark ones too.

records.title: The products are easy to use and to…
records.text: The products are easy to use and to keep clean.

records.title: Products just work so well
records.text: Lovely colours to choose from, fast despatch, eco-friendly packaging and the products just work so well. I've now got enough pads to see me through a period, with some washing during and it's a great feeling to have no plastic going into the bin.

records.title: Great quality and quick shipping
records.text: Great quality and quick shipping - packaging lost it the extra star. They were literally just thrown into a box, no sleeve that they shown with online and those little things count for me. It's nice to know that products are packed with care and attention to detail.

records.title: Packaging needs a review
records.text: Product is brilliant , is very absorbent and feels good against the skin. I don’t know I’m wearing it. I was however surprised at how they arrived. I ordered two pads and they came rattling around without any additional biodegradable packaging in a cardboard box. For an intimate product I would have expected them to be in some sort of tissue paper before going in the box. A smaller postage box too would have been better. It just didn’t feel very tidy or clean on arrival. 10/10 for the actual product though .

records.title: Lovely and soft
records.text: I wanted some sanitary towels to use along side the periods pants I have. These are lovely quality, nice and soft. I’d like the wings to be slightly longer as the gusset on my knickers seem to be a little bit wider but it doesn’t affect the use. I really love knowing that I’m not contributing to more landfill.

records.title: I was on the fence about using reusable…
records.text: I was on the fence about using reusable pads. For me, it was the thought of washing them out after wearing them. But they’re so comfortable, they don’t smell and they cause zero irritation. I suffer from vulval eczema and these pads are gentle on my skin. I use the grey pads, so I can track my flow intensity, and they don’t stain when washed properly. I find it easiest to hand wash and air dry while on my period, then I’ll throw them all in a delicates bag at the end of the week and just put them in the normal wash load to make sure they’re properly clean and ready for the next month. For days out I will either wear a bigger pad, or take the out and about bag with me.

records.title: I have had these a while now and really…
records.text: I have had these a while now and really like how easy they are to use and wash and are comfortable to wear, but not when I'm walking as the edges cause me irritation, which I get with disposables but not this bad! I really like these but I would like them more if the fabric on the edges were not so rough and I could wear them walking.

records.title: New to reusable pads
records.text: I'd never used re-uasable pads before and was skeptical about them. Having made this step I'm now so happy I did. The pads are comfortable, easy to wear and easy to change. Washing them is something new but we wash our clothes, so it just feels like that. I would recommend this company as I had no issues with delivery or with the product. I can see some wear already after a few washes but perhaps this is normal? It doesn't seem to be a problem. The pads absorb better than disposable ones. They are also thinner and don't crinkle when you move which is definitely a bonus! Last but not least, we are making a positive change for our planet. :)

records.title: Best period purchase ever
records.text: Only hard thing for me is trying to dry them in time to wear them again. No itching down there from pads this month which with disposable ones is a guarantee . So glad I invested

records.title: I chose the mix pack
records.text: I chose the mix pack, likely I will not require one if the sizes but a great idea and price to find out what does work.My 8 year daughter is very impressed with how ‘pretty’ my confetti pattern looks.

records.title: The only time I wished that my period would arrive sooner!
records.text: I ordered my first pads in April, but as the confetti design was a backorder, this was the first chance I’ve had to leave a review based on more than just an impression (my period had just finished when they arrived.) The confetti design looked even better in person than they did online, so for anyone wavering, go for it.The pads are very comfortable to wear and I was disappointed when the last one went into the wash pile and it was back to disposables. Compared to disposables, I don’t even know when I am wearing a mega mega pad. Far, far less trousers etc went in the wash due to leaks, which was what had prompted the original decision to order. I am hopeful of getting this down further now knowing what pads to wear when and also having realised that unlike disposable winged pads, they don’t just have to stay where they naturally fit, they can adjusted to suit your flow.I have messaged Lauren with a few questions and always received responses swiftly. Wear Em Out put larger companies to shame. They also have the occasional free postage offer which is admirable for a small business. Annoyingly my cycle was such that I just missed the Jubilee one, but I ordered another trial pack (all I can afford right now) after using the first pads and the postage was very reasonable. I now plan to assess the pads longer term and then decide on future purchases. They did bobble slightly from the initial pre-wear wash and one seemed to have hitched on something during the production/distribution process, so time will tell how they hold up. I certainly couldn’t feel that they had bobbled while wearing them.

records.title: Good design and appear well made.
records.text: Happy so far. Quick delivery, and the products feel well made and like they will be comfortable. Haven't used them yet, counting down the days until I get to try them 🤣

records.title: Great pads
records.text: Great pads! Thin but really absorbant. Only pads I can wear on my heaviest days and know I won’t leak. Love the design too.

records.title: Great product and very comfortable to…
records.text: Great product and very comfortable to wear! I ordered the mini flo as a trial before ordering the post birth megas, which I will eventually get round to ordering nearer the time. Very happy with the product itself. The only thing (tiny annoyance) I was a little disappointed with, was how they arrived in the packaging. The pads were loose in the box and I’m guessing they should’ve been wrapped in the tissue paper and presented a little better for the initial first impression.

records.title: Comfortable and eco-friendly
records.text: I really like these and really love the concept! They are very comfortable (so much more than disposables) and easy to use. One thing for me was that I’d like them to be longer and they do slide a little, but that could just be me. I will be buying more -and different sizes! Would definitely recommend!

records.title: Fantastic!
records.text: I think these pads are fantastic. I bought one of each size in the fierce print and think they’re one of the easiest eco swaps I’ve made! I will definitely invest in more, when I have the funds to do so!My only critique is that I wish they were a little wider...but I recognise they might be this width to make sure they stay in place in your underwear. It might be something I need to get used to!

records.title: Heavy flow pack
records.text: I bought the heavy flow pack as increasingly I find that the usual sanitary towels irritate my skin, and I thought I would try these.  They are good quality and comfortable to wear, and I certainly do not get irritated skin, however I found they slid backwards and forwards overnight and did not contain my period on its heaviest flow nights. I will use as the comfort value is great, but slightly disappointed with containment.

records.title: Packaging was fab and product is very…
records.text: Packaging was fab and product is very premium! Looking forward to my first period after having a baby to try then out. Only thing is postage to Guernsey was very premium at £12+  Even though the postage stamp said £2.99. I understand cost for box and tissue paper but £10 is quite a bit. Would love to build my stash but that really puts me off.

records.title: Good customer service!
records.text: One of the products I ordered was out of stock and after I had declined alternatives I was offered a refund on that product. Email responses were quick and my remaining products arrived a couple of days later, which was great service. Personally I would have preferred it if the box was sealed with ordinary tape rather than a branded sticker too.

records.title: Not the best I’ve tried sadly
records.text: The pads are too narrow for my underwear.  Could do with a wider wing with 2 sets of poppers to ensure a more universal fit.  Also the pads are way too padded and I don’t find them comfortable because of the bulk.  On the plus side they are absorbent and well made.  Won’t be buying any more for the first reasons though.

records.title: Sadly they aren't for me...
records.text: I bought these as backup for a menstrual cup and really wanted to love them, but unfortunately I found them too uncomfortable to wear (the poppers rubbed  and I was constantly aware of them). Although they moved about less than a different make I have tried that only had a single popper they still slid along my pants as I moved. I am pretty active so maybe they'd be ok for a more sedentary lifestyle. I'll continue to use them at night but will be trying period pants for daytime use.

records.title: Good for lazy days (not running)
records.text: I bought a small and medium pad because I have light periods and wanted a daily liner. I found the pads quite thick and soft, but the poppers are a bit cold on the tops of the legs. The small one is good as a liner, though I would like it to be a bit longer. It shifted about a tiny bit but was pretty good. The medium pad feels sturdier and slips less. I did find that wearing the small pad on a 6k run gave me some really painful chafing on my knicker line, so I'm afraid that's a no go. On a previous 5k it was fine, but not sure I dare do it again.

records.title: Product itself is good.
records.text: Product itself is good.Delivery timescales weren't advised and the wait between ordering and receiving was indeterminable.

records.title: A product that I really wanted to love…
records.text: A product that I really wanted to love as keen to make the change to reusable. Spent a fair bit of money and the pads seem well made. However I am disappointed in the size of the flaps as they are too small to go around the knickers which means that the pad then bunches up. I will be using these pads but won’t be buying any more from this company

records.title: They are comfortable but I do find they…
records.text: They are comfortable but I do find they slip quite a lot.  I think the issue would be resolved if I wore bigger knickers!  Presumably they would stay in place better.  I discovered this is a much bigger issue when running.  Unfortunately the pad moved whilst running and the poppers chaffed which was very uncomfortable.  I will continue to use them but not when running and maybe invest in some bigger knickers!  I love the concept.

records.title: Service good, product so-so
records.text: Can't fault my customer service/delivery experience. That was great.However I found the product so-so. I have been a cloth pad user for a number of years and needed a restock so bought a collection. The construction looks good as was the absorbency. But I had two issues whilst wearing.Firstly the breathable polyester layer that goes against your underwear was too slippery and allowed the pad to gradually work backwards. I had no fear it would slip out thanks to the poppers, but I had less coverage at the front which tends to be my leak area.Secondly the ribbing around the edge initially looked like good robust construction, but is actually quite uncomfortable. Around the house and on lazy days the pads are fine. But I found that on a short walk the ribbing chafed my upper thighs terribly. It took a week to heal. I have an active life and job and wanted to be able to confidently wear these all the time but the discomfort I experienced after an hour of gentle activity has made me nervous about wearing them for my daily activities such as cycling to work or at my job which is moderately active (think nursing, childcare, teaching etc).It should be noted that I have plus sized thighs- skinny legged humans might not find it so irritating. The ribbing may also soften after a few more washes. So my initial assessment may improve.They do the job, so will keep and use around the house and at weekends. But I am not convinced they met my daily needs.

records.title: Not for running
records.text: I ordered a couple of minis and a couple of Medium flow pads. I’m a runner and was looking for an alternative to the traditional single use products. On a day to day use, both seemed fine. A little narrow in the widge that mean it bunched the gusset of my knickers (I tend to wear my Runderwear pants every day), but this didn’t seem to cause any problems. However, when I tried running whilst wearing them, the pads tended to shift backwards and chaff the inside of my thighs at the knicker line, so much so that it drew blood. So for every day, non-running use, they’re seem to do the trick, but for running, it’s a no from me.

records.title: Great idea but look a bit depressing after a single use
records.text: I really liked the idea of these pads as an eco friendly alternative and deliberated for some time before taking the plunge and investing. I think they are really comfortable and feel confident using them for light flow days but am a bit disappointed by how they look after a single use (and wash). I have followed the instructions to the letter but they look stained and a little depressing. Maybe I shouldn’t have gone for the grey version as this shows more but will have to live with it now. The description on the website now helpfully alludes to the fact that the light grey is more likely to stain but it must have been updated since I purchased.

records.title: Undecided
records.text: So so much more comfortable than disposable pads, however they’re bulky and I have had a few leaks.Edit:Thank you for the reply. I used the mega mega and still leaked a little which was a shame as I wanted to love them!

records.title: Great concept
records.text: Great concept. The product is of excellent quality but takes a long time to naturally dry once washed. Also the delivery took a long time, at least a couple of weeks, but was notified of this at time of purchase.

records.title: I love the idea and the pads are of…
records.text: I love the idea and the pads are of good quality. My only issue is chaffing, I find that if I go for a run or walk a lot wearing the medium to larger sized pad it chaffs a lot and can be quite painful.

records.title: Heavier Trial Pack perhaps too bulky
records.text: I bought a Heavier Trial pack and a couple of medium pads to give these pads a good go, I had been looking at alternatives to disposables for a while and decided I liked the familiarity of a pad and being able to wear my usual underwear.  Pros- less bunching than disposables, no sticky wings, they seem breathable and soft against the skin on the non-popper side.  Cons- they are bulky, especially the thick edging and I definitely feel the large metal poppers on the outer side that hold the pad in place so it’s sometimes uncomfortable when I walk.  I’ve tried them with leggings as well as jeans.  I tend to use these overnight and on days when I’m at home due to these factors, and to try and ‘wear them out’ given the investment.  Great that there are trial packs, it was worth a trial and I really wanted these to be my solution but  I think they might suit others more than me.

records.title: Lovely at first but not wearing well with time
records.text: I’m writing this review having used the pads for 3 period cycles now - I have purchased 5 in total. Firstly I want to say I’m very impressed with how the company are making reusable sanitary products cool and more mainstream. Secondly the pads do seem to work, I’ve had leakage a few times but otherwise all good. However whilst the pads were so soft and comfy the first time I used them after 2 months they started to go bobbly and now on month 3 are very bobbly and I think this will only get worse. I do live in south east England where We have hard water And don’t use fabric conditioner on them as this can affect absorption. however this hasn’t been a problem with my other period pants or reusable nappies so seems to be something with the design/ material of the pads maybe. Disappointing as it’s not as nice an experience wearing them now as it first was but I’ll still keep using the ones I’ve got.

records.title: Good delivery
records.text: Good delivery. Far too many emails about updates. Products are lovely but very thick and bulky

records.title: Hi I really like these/ the look/feel…
records.text: Hi I really like these/ the look/feel of them.... but on testing them Im sorry to say there is no way I could wear them out. I paid the little  extra to buy these ones because of the reviews and for me personally I wish they worked as I would have liked. but they A) could do with being longer B) They are no good for Urinary incontinence , one accident and I had to change. I would use them indoors but no way I could trust to use these when out sadly. It is a shame as I really would have liked to. I  have at least cut down using disposable ones indoors and am now using these for just that.

records.title: Not for me
records.text: Bought a few of these pads a few months ago & I really want to like them as I think Lauren is great. I find the edges really uncomfortable & especially when I'm out walking, they really irritate me. I know Lauren suggests that u position them properly to fit in your 'grooves'but it doesn't help. I've also found the medium flow ones leak. I've got other pads from Mama Designs & Cheeky Wipes and find these so much more comfortable & absorbent.

records.title: Ohhh the shrinkage!
records.text: Been using disposable pads for a while and like to try different makes. I was very disappointed with this brand. Lots of shrinkage (yes I followed the wash etc instructions to the letter!). I thought for the price it was at the dearer end of the market for a very plain, basic pad which has not performed as well as others. Shame. I would not buy from this company again.

records.title: A bit disappointed
records.text: Disappointingly, I found the pads to be too narrow and not long enough. Perhaps I’m a strange shape?! I ordered a starter pack but found the mini and medium didn’t sit right in my undies. May try a mega at nighttime so will see how I get on.

records.title: Unusable for me
records.text: I really wanted to love this product. The idea behind it, saving the planet and saving money. But the pads were so uncomfortable. Walking around they are absolutely fine and you barely feel them. However, as soon as you sit down the outer edge of the pad which is a slightly raised fabric, dug into my skin so badly it left a mark for over an hour after i took the pad off. I hope this isn't an experience others have as i love the company and thoughts behind the products but for me personally, they were completely unusable.

records.title: Don’t stay in place
records.text: I so want to love these pads! I bought the mini flow pads to replace the panty liners I wear on a daily basis. The pads look and feel fine, but sadly they don’t stay in place. I have tried with three different types of knickers and yet the result is the same, they eventually slide and ‘hang down’ and therefore feel uncomfortable. I am so disappointed. I really wanted to stop using disposable panty liners, but now I feel that I have to go back to them. The mini flow pads are also quite thick compared to regular panty liners, which is a shame. It may be that the bigger pads stay in place better and I would love to try them when I on my period, but right now I am reluctant to pay more money, in case I don’t like the bigger pads either.

records.title: I loved the idea of these
records.text: I loved the idea of these, but after only 2 washes - following all instructions to the letter - they seem a bit bobbly and lumpy; not as soft at all. Mine also leaked too.

records.title: Expensive for what they are.
records.text: Expensive for what they are.. after the first wash ( in the shower) dye leaked from the outer covering, all in all a lot cheaper alternatives out there.. sorry

records.title: Really disappointed!
records.text: I was really excited to order this product but I was quite disappointed when I used them. I experienced quite a lot of leakage through my period and they did not dry very nicely at all. I also don’t think the pad tags are large enough to fit round standard underwear.I invested quite a significant amount of money into them and felt that it was wasted. Not really sure what to do! Spent £50 and won’t get that back now...

records.title: Alarming approach and response to the BLM movement.
records.text: I approached the founder of this company in June responding to a Newsletter about Black Lives Matter which came 11 days following death of George Floyd and didn't get a response. I received another newsletter this October which prompted me to get in touch re my previous query. I added that I was interested in one of the products too. I received a response asking which email I was referring to, to which I responded, and quoted the part that I said that I did not understand (yet wished to) despite appreciating the honesty. The response (full direct quote) "oh ok it was just me learning about my white privilege" No other words or elaboration.The Black Lives Matter email features a number of things myself and fellow black women felt extremely uncomfortable, confused and offended by. I explain where myself, and other black woman had felt uncomfortable about the email that seemed to mostly be about proving that she is not racist, and also inserting a picture of her with a black person, and making a questionable statements accompanying it. She highlighted that she "never considered herself to be racist", "so nonchalant around race" by opening email highlighting that she supported a (black) friend in childbirth, whilst working in her role as a doula. I, and other black women felt it odd that she would open with this, highlight it (if nonchalant), and why race would matter in her role as doula (must be non-discriminatory) or friend and what about BLM movement connects the moment. You don't become not racist by supporting a black person/your friend in your work so I was unsure about the point of the statement and image, and why BLM provoked memory of this moment.The response to the email I made explaining the feelings it provoked amongst a number of black women was met with a response that we felt this way as we must have misunderstood.As above, I had asked twice for elaboration and clarification of the image and statement that accompanied it  - on the first instance, my email was "lost" (I still have it), and the second enquiry about it failed to elaborate. When I explained my thought and feelings, and how it made me feel as a black woman, feelings shared with other black women, I was told that we feel this way because we “I think you maybe you misunderstood the purpose of the photo and the message I was trying to relay?”Still, no explanation was made to support my understanding, and none of my points as to why it made us *feel* this way were addressed in any part of the email. I am black, the email was titled "Black Lives Matter" and the statements regarding race made me and other black people very very uncomfortable, but we feel this way because of a lack of understanding?Two posts were brought to my attention on the brand social media account, (one less than 15mins after my email) about people making flippant comments, a second – a post titled "on your marks, get set, go f*** yourself", which used phrases such as "be kind", and "online bullying", and spoke about people going out of their way to bring people down, and criticise them. It spoke about the anxiety faced posting things online in fear of unintentionally offending someone. It also said "there are people waiting for you to trip up so they can celebrate in your missteps and apply judgement and intentional offence. Don't ever be that person, don't seek pleasure in bringing down another, life is hard enough without hunting other opportunities to bring people down" This post was followed by a number of women sending well wishes, and "f the haters" etc. I commented on the post - which was then removed. The account was also taken down for 5 hours after I sent a message about the response, and updated post, and I was told that the post was not about me "THIS IS NOT ABOUT YOU", and was met with "sorry you feel that way" comments and "well what can I say?" and "ok thanks for your view, I'm gonna leave this conversation here as I don't feel you'd accept anything I had to say as anything other that what you decided it was" I decided? Black people feel uncomfortable with the peculiar statements in a Black Lives Matter newsletter and its "what you decided it was" Again, not able to explain what is was? Another response "mate I was in the middle of putting my kid to bed after a particularly s***ty day, I opened the email and response how I felt I could at that time, I can't say any more than that" and "well look I'm sorry I don't say the right thing or that it was a cop out, there's nothing more to say so I really am gonna leave this here - I won't be responding again" "Mate"?The post was then deleted, and then shortly business account deactivated for 5 hours after this message was sent, and that was it. I found this considerably unprofessional, and sad to see our thoughts and feelings from the race being discussed not being taken on board.

description:
Leak proof water bottles, BPA free & spill proof drinks bottles, sports water bottles and leak proof travel mugs.

Every bottle has certain core values that makes it an Ion8 . Sealed, simple, secure, safe, spill free, stylish, sustainable and smell fresh. We won't compromise. That's what makes us different.

records.title: Excellent Customer Service
records.text: The seals failed in my son’s water bottle, causing it to leak. I emailed customer services and had a very prompt response from Alice, a couple of emails later and a new set of seals were on their way and they arrived within days.Excellent customer service! Thank you Alice, you are a credit to the company!

records.title: Great bottle and design
records.text: Very easy to navigate website and choosing the right size and design, bought one as a gift then decided to get myself one and there are great! I got a 600ml one and it fits in my car door and the bottles are very easy to use and clean, might buy a straw next time

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: Great customer service, got back to me really quickly following a query & the ordered items were well received as presents. Love the engraving as will not rub off like many transferred ones do. Highly recommend

records.title: Broken bottle
records.text: I emailed the day my sons bottle broke and Alice emailed back promptly and dealt with the situation straight away ordered and new bottle arrived straight away, thanks Alice for saving a happy boy from a nightmare Christmas holidays ,

records.title: Exceptional company with splendid products
records.text: During 2024, have ordered multiple ION8 flasks for family, friends and myself. These are excellent products, robust, well designed and simple to maintain in good condition. Beyond the products, the staff have been fantastic in answering questions, solving issues and ensuring delivery times, even at short notice. Particularly, Zia is outstanding at customer support and patience.

records.title: I bought 4 of these bottles
records.text: I bought 4 of these bottles. Very happy with them. One started leaking; after reading the troubleshooting I realised I was missing a seal. I contacted the company and Alice very helpfully sent me a new one. Great service.

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: My daughter’s bottle had a fault and broke after a couple months of use so I contacted ION8 and Alice was so helpful and arranged for a replacement to be sent to us. It arrived within a few days. 10/10 service and would highly recommend. Thank you Alice!

records.title: The 17-oz water bottle is the perfect…
records.text: The 17-oz water bottle is the perfect size for traveling. The travel mug does keep my coffee much hotter than any other travel mug I’ve had. The spill proof feature really works and makes these great bottles.

records.title: This was a gift for my husband who has…
records.text: This was a gift for my husband who has been carrying a 2 litre metal tin for a water bottle. This was a huge change for him and loves it. Its sleek, slim and a great colour.

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: I contacted ION8 because of a problem with a leaking water bottle.Alice dealt with the issue promptly, professionally and with a nice friendly manner. I received a replacement within a few days.Excellent service, thank you Alice.

records.title: Lovely
records.text: Lovely, light, child's bottle. Delivered swiftly. Only drawback is the clasp does not always release with a spring when pressed.

records.title: Great customer service from Alice
records.text: I bought a new Ion8 bottle for my daughter, and after one wash in the dishwasher, the design had started to peel off. I was really disappointed, as my daughter enjoyed her new bottle and it was improving her intake. I contacted customer service immediately and had a very quick response from Alice, who immediately had a new bottle sent out. She was polite and efficient! The bottle was with me in a few days, and we have started again - this time I'll be handwashing the bottle, but we are pleased with the bottle and straw.

records.title: 4* for bottle, 5* for customer service
records.text: I have four of these bottles. The designs  are really nice, and they are a good size to fit in a bag (the smaller bottles). They certainly are leakproof as described, until they inevitably lose the tiny air vent seals at which point they leak all over your bag unless you notice in time. I bought a pack of replacement seals a while ago but went through the tiny seals very quickly. Alice in customer support was really helpful at this point and arranged to send out some more of the tiny seals as I didn’t need all the seals that come in the full pack.

records.title: It works
records.text: It came as stated.It does exactly as it says .Value for money.Would recommend.

records.title: Great Customer Service
records.text: The bottles are great- lightweight and easy for my kids to use. They did lose the small seals very quickly as they pop out easily meaning they leak. However, when I contacted Ion8, Alice Pratt sorted this out so quickly for me, offering to replace them and sending care instructions to reduce the risk of it happening again. I was really impressed. Thanks Alice.

records.title: Light weight and good choice
records.text: The product has a great choice of design and looks and feels nice, including surprisingly light weight.  I took the opportunity to buy them as replacements for my sen child's drink bottle with the Black Friday offers. A great selling point was Leak Proof and dishwasher safe and the reports of being durable for school.  4 bottles purchased 2 put into use immediately,  an issue with leaking lids when closed was quickly established by Alice as missing seals and replacements being despatched. Then peeling from the patterned bottle which is now also being replaced. Feedback on the lack of care instructions to the neck of the bottle as no mention of temperatures or dishwasher cleaning and were quite hard to read unless looking at specific link on the website.  Just an observation.I am not sure these will be my forever solution for my child's school drink bottle due to the seal issue and their special needs but as an adult who is more careful and responsible I will enjoy using the two remaining bottles.I cannot fault the responsiveness or efforts of Alice in Customer Services despite our issues seemingly to be user related.

records.title: Nice bottle
records.text: Edited (original review below) - Shaista reached out to me following my review, she has been really helpful, even following up when I’ve not responded to emails. The service has been great and the issue is resolved. Only lacking one star as I feel my issue is probably common and it would help if there was a note in the packaging to mention this, and also for the lack of communication details on the website.Nice looking bottle, feels good in the hand and keeps drinks cool. Unfortunately my bottle shoots liquid out like a fountain whenever I open the lid, which is a complete pain. I’ve tried to contact the company but you cannot submit the form with light a photo attached which it doesn’t let you do from a phone. There is no simple contact number or email, so now am stuck with a bottle that I can’t use.

records.title: The bottles look great and is one of…
records.text: The bottles look great and is one of the only premium brands that don't have straws as standard, good!I've used these for years typically, they start out really good but break or leak after a while. I have recently had 2 very different experiences with customer services. Dylan was 5*, perfect. Stewart was blunt and non personable on his correspondence.So, looking below and my own experiences I think the service really depends on who you get through to on the day.Ion8, be more Dylan!

records.title: I l8ve the products
records.text: I l8ve the products. As a family,we all have one the bottles. Thus time, unfortunately, it was addressed wrongly. Royal Mail did make a guess and located me but it was late for Christmas. There were presents.

records.title: Wouldn't recommend
records.text: I purchased two children's bottles in 2024. After a few weeks they started to leak because the seal broke away. I had excellent customer service from Dylan who sent a replacement seal. Some weeks later, the same bottle was leaking again and the other bottles clasp mechanism completely fell apart. Again, Dylan in customer service was amazing and sent two replacement bottles, free of charge. The bottles have started leaking again so I've just decided to try another brand. Overall I wouldn't recommend,  because the quality of the product is not good, however I have had excellent customer service.

records.title: Not the greatest bottles
records.text: Not the greatest bottles! Bought 2 for start of school in September, I have since binned them as all the print had come off and both lids broke. Got three months out of these before they were no good. Won’t buy again.

records.title: These bottles are great in every way…
records.text: These bottles are great in every way except that we have now had to throw away 3 out of the 7 we have purchased, as these 3 have grown rust inside, despite following care instructions. It’s a shame because the company seems lovely and the other bottles aren’t rusty at all.

records.title: These are really poorly made bottles…
records.text: These are really poorly made bottles compared to similar on the market. Customer service is incredibly slow and I had to chase via social media in the end as one bottle I ordered arrived missing the seal. Ordered only in October and one bottle has all the design peeling off (despite taking care of it) and the second has a crack at the bottom so now leaks. Would not buy from this company again.

records.title: Great idea, poor execution
records.text: The actual concept of the bottle has been exactly what I’ve been looking for, unfortunately the execution is pretty poor. I’ve had two ion8 water bottle in the space of the last 4-5 months. The first one leaked everywhere and the mechanism in the lid broke. Then I bought another one, and this one doesn’t leak, but the lid doesn’t come off. I think the bottle itself is expanding as I can put the lid on loosely in the morning, then by the time I come to fill it up I can’t get the lid off. It’s honestly really disappointing as the physical design of the bottle is perfect, but I wouldn’t waste your time or money on this product.

records.title: Bought 4 bottles 1 didn’t break
records.text: Bought 4 bottles, one started leaking. Received a replacement in a couple of weeks. Second bottle broke (images on daughters bottle all fell off) no response, 3rd bottle broke (lid lock snapped through normal use), no response, 1st bottle broke again (lid lock broke through normal use).

records.title: Won’t be using again
records.text: Purchased these pretty expensive bottles after seeing good reviews elsewhere. The bottle itself is good so far, however after 3 days the design started chipping off. Hasn’t been in the dishwasher or anything. Just from use. I’ve sent the company 2 ‘contact us’ forms on the website and have waited the recommended 72hrs to hear back but have heard nothing from either. Very disappointed in the defect of the bottle but also in the customer service of the company. Completely ignored. Will be avoiding in future!ion8 have since been back in touch and offered to send a replacement

records.title: Terrible after sales service
records.text: Bought three bottles for school. One leaks really badly- no reply after two emails to customer service. Very disappointed with the after sales service. Don’t fall for the adverts. They just take your money and don’t care about the customer experience.

records.title: I've had it for about a month and I…
records.text: I've had it for about a month and I liked it until it started leaking everywhere. I think it was a waste of money.

records.title: Poor quality lids
records.text: Poor quality lids, two have broken in different ways after a short period of time. Not value for money.

records.title: Leaking bottle
records.text: Bottle started leaking 1 week after purchase

records.title: Both bottle did break and ion8 does not reply
records.text: I have bought two of the bottles. The cap of the first bottle did break after 3 month and same for the other bottle after 6 month. I had a big issue with the second one: It was in my bagpack with a camera, my whole bagpack was flooded and my camera was destroyed. Nomally in Germany I could claim ion8 to pay for the camera. I have opened a request to ion8 service trough their website form. My hope was actually just to get 2 new caps (hopefully with an improved mechanic of the button to open). They just ghosted me and did not reply at a..

records.title: The boots are great very well made get…

records.title: Great company…

I will certainly buy from them again.

records.title: Pleased with purchase
records.text: Had not heard of this company before so was a bit wary about placing an order. However, my daughter’s Uggs arrived in perfect condition and promptly, with good comms, so was really I pleased with the purchase.

records.title: Quick delivery in time for Christmas…

records.title: Great boots…

records.title: Hard to find item available here!

records.title: All round great

records.title: Timely Christmas Delivery

records.title: This was a gift for my daughter she…
records.text: This was a gift for my daughter she loved the bag! Excellent quality and the bag look exactly like the picture perfect!

records.title: Great product
records.text: Speedy delivery, great price , quality product.  Only very slight negative was packaging slightly damaged ,which isn't great for an Xmas gift .

records.title: Muck Boots
records.text: Bought a pair of Muck Boots at a good price feel the delivery time could have been a little better but overall satisfied

records.title: Only thing wrong was a lack of a care instruction
records.text: Only thing wrong was a lack of a leaflet to explain how to care for my new boots, i.e., even a small cleaning / care kit with them..Due to the cost involved in purchasing them, not much to ask for maybe..

records.title: Great experience goods arrived only a…
records.text: Great experience goods arrived only a few weeks after ordered

records.title: I saved £70 compared to high street prices
records.text: My shoes were £70 cheaper than high street price no shipping costs and fast delivery

records.title: Got my product and it came in good…
records.text: Got my product and it came in good condition. I believe there is room for improvement with the communication about delivery and that is why I gave 4 stars. Will be buying from them again in the future and would definitely recommend to others.

records.title: Great price & fast delivery
records.text: My order arrived timely and I absolutely love my shoes.  The only reason I gave a 4 star is that this is the second time my package was signature required by FedEx without the option to waive.

records.title: Not as bad as expected!
records.text: Reading the reviews (stupidly post purchase!) I got very scared. I tried to contact the company (but their chat bot doesn't work/understand English) so I started emailing daily. Have to say while no response for 3 days, what I ordered has actually turned up on time and as expected. Exactly what I ordered at great price so I'm happy. They also did eventually respond via email but only to tell me I couldn't cancelSo use...but maybe with caution!

records.title: Don’t be put off.
records.text: After seeing some not so good reviews, I was slightly apprehensive about buying my Dr Marten Clarissa sandals, but as this is was the only site advertising in my size I decided to go for it. The sandals turned up on time and brand new shoes without issue. The only reason I have given 4 stars is due to the price, but I couldn’t get them anywhere else and couldn’t live without them ❤️

records.title: The selection of colors availability in…
records.text: The selection of colors availability in the high tops run converses.

records.title: A cut above..
records.text: Very helpful on the telephone - appreciated!

records.title: Speedy refund
records.text: Although the Docs were not a good fit and not a great boot either, not the shops fault at all, that lies with Dr Marten. I sent them back and got my refund within 4 days, which I was happy about after reading reviews I was a bit concerned, but all was well. The only issue, not free to return, and cost £5.09 RM second class signed for, but hey ho maybe they are a small service that cant afford return postage. Would buy from them again though.

records.title: Very good looking boots and really…
records.text: Very good looking boots and really comfortable. However, my pair squeak. Maybe that's just a one off, but a little annoying for me.

records.title: I was thrilled they came so quickly…
records.text: I was thrilled they came so quickly from the UK, but you had to sign for them. Who’s home during the day to sign?  Now I have to figure out what UPS store they’re at and hop they don’t get sent back. More when I actually get them.

records.title: Excellent Service and Great Delivery !!!
records.text: My first review had to be on 4feetshoes as I have always had a great experiences both online and in person. Brilliant service from start to finish. Any small issues is fixed in a minute. i have been really happy with the customer service provided from this company ( not only in one store as they got five different stores around London ). Also , if they did not have any sizes in their specific store then they were very helpful to order from any other stores or head office within one or two days. They are even glad to post the shoes straight to our home if we are based inside the UK. Absolutely delighted with their best service. When I ordered the pairs of buffalo boots, the order arrived a lot quicker than expected , and those boots were amazing. I would definitely recommend to visit their site or the stores. The service was very smooth so I would not hesitate to use this company again.

records.title: Found just want I wanted on this  site…
records.text: Found just want I wanted on this site and delivery and communication very efficient.

records.title: Good next day service
records.text: The item came as expected using the next day service and pleased to have it delivered within the specified time slot.

records.title: One of the shoes was a little dirty…
records.text: One of the shoes was a little dirty which made me wonder. The box was a little beat up but that was probably from shipping.

records.title: The full address wasn’t put on my…
records.text: The full address wasn’t put on my parcel which caused a delay otherwise everything was fine.

records.title: Good quality products and delivery
records.text: The shoes that I have purchased have been of good quality and the delivery has been quick.

records.title: Long delivery even when paying extra
records.text: Paid extra for faster delivery but took a long time to be shipped... but other than that fine

records.title: The quality of shoe is great, Hassle Free Return Shipping is a BIG HASSLE
records.text: The quality of shoe is great, box was damaged. Hassle free shipping does not mean free return shipping. Too expensive to actually return for USA customers.

records.title: Wrong colour, and two laces per shoe?
records.text: The shoes are well made, lovely design and comfortable, and look really good on.Only 3 stars this time for two reasons.1. I can't for the life of me figure out how to use 2 laces in each shoe.2. I ordered brown and you sent black for some reason. I know I could have sent them back and am confident there would have been no quibble. The only thing that stopped me was my own laziness.Having said all that, I will probably order more footwear from you in the future.

records.title: Wrong colour delivered
records.text: Very good service prompt delivery but ordered black and red Adidas with gum sole Carbon and red Adidas with gum sole arrived My son is still happy with them However the box had a sticker with the colour that arrived yet an additional sticker was put on stating black and red which it was not just something for the future to be aware of

records.title: Legit site! Not so happy with delivery times
records.text: I was finally able to get my hands on a pair of shoes that haven’t been restocked in a while, and for only £10 extra I didn’t feel like that was a bad price at all. The shoes have came perfectly fine and I have them, BUT, I did pay for 48 hour tracked delivery and the shoes were only shipped out after 48 hours, which I only found out after I emailed them asking where they were. So it wasn’t really 48 hour delivery.

records.title: Don’t really recommend 50% success rate
records.text: Bought the True pink superstar XLG, first time I purchased they sent me a refund because apparently is was the last size and when they opened the box it was a different size, all fine I got my refund. Then I ordered another pair in half a size down because I could not find the shoe anywhere else, the posting time was alright and arrived after a few days. The box came damaged but wasn’t too put off, but one of the shoes leather is a slightly different shade to the other one, I’m guessing one was new and the other was a defect pair? I ended up keeping them anyway because you can’t really tell and they are really hard to get hold of anyway. My advice for this website would be to shop literally anywhere else because you have a 50/50 success rate with this website.

records.title: Need more product informtion
records.text: Bought a pair of  new Justin Reece shoes  from this seller, on a well known auction site. Shoes were very good for the money but were an ultra slim fit and as such were un-wearable. Sorry, but internet sellers of shoes and clothes really need to start to provide detailed information and measurements of the items they sell - in this case they failed to mention the fact in their listing. A refund was given on return but I had to pay £3.90 for the privilege.

records.title: Inconsistent customer service
records.text: Inconsistent customer service, but cheap and they get there in the end!My order didn't show up.No tracking code they gave me ever worked.Sometimes they responded, sometimes they didn't..However when I rang them up they DID sort out a replacement and it DID arrive.

records.title: Slow refund
records.text: They only had a pair which were slightly different colours. Offered me a discount- all fair enough but when I declined my refund didn’t appear. Over a week later and still waiting. Now received with apology.

records.title: I ordered birkenstocks direct from the…
records.text: I ordered birkenstocks direct from the shop (the last pair size 7)  I got an email back to say when the "packers" had opened the box the wrong size was in and it was only "fitting lol" to refund me.  I then hunted high and low for the same sort of birkenstocks which I saw on amazon and guess what?  they were on offer by for 4feetshoes..............go figure, they cost me another £18.  I wanted these so paid the extra but go figurrrrrr.

records.title: Uncomfortable shoes ☹️
records.text: Very fast delivery which was great but very disappointed with the shoes themselves. They are so uncomfortable, I’ve barely worn them.

records.title: Second try was good
records.text: Second try was good. I first received a right size 10 and a left size 9. They handled it nicely but I'm still disappointed that I couldn't just get the pair I ordered.

records.title: Trainers…
records.text: Bit on the heavy side for a trainer and the back rubbed on my heel

records.title: I like it so much but there is a small…
records.text: I like it so much but there is a small flaw

records.title: No to worry 😌
records.text: No to worry 😌

records.title: Wrong boots sent in correct box
records.text: Wrong boots sent in correct box. Wyality control not checked .very disappointed as it was a Christmas present. Wont use this company again

records.title: I live in US
records.text: I live in US.  While the delivery from your company was exceptional, I am not able to return the item because the shipping to return to UK is more than the shoes cost.

records.title: Timberland's
records.text: My partner ordered me a pair of Timberlands for Christmas, upon opening they looked great , until I tried them on and one insole was too big for the boot , which I found bizarre, so took them both out and definitely at least an inch difference which made an overhang inside the boot , also noticed that the stitching at the back of the boots were not the same.  Considering your paying a lot of money I did not expect that bad quality. Given 2 stars as they have let us return them , but seeing other reviews I hope we get the refund ! Hopefully he paid by pay pal just incase 🤞 .

records.title: I returned a product weeks ago
records.text: I returned a product weeks ago, the tracking has confirmed it was received back, but I have had no email confirmation for any refund. You try calling the number on the website, it rings and then cuts you off, I have also been sat waiting on their ‘live’ chat for someone but nobody is connecting. Awful service.

records.title: Ordered a pair of boots for 48 tracked…
records.text: Ordered a pair of boots for 48 tracked delivery they were a birthday present. 7 days later they are nowhere to be see ! Contact customer services and they have apologised said they will look into it , no response. Called again and requested a refund they have opened a case for me? Plan is to call back again today and new and my refund or il go through my bank. Very disappointed. Also might be a coincidence but I had received a message from yodel the day after I ordered to say that had my parcel ? Downloaded app (didn’t click the link) and there was an order number but no further details so most likely a scam , not sure if it’s related to 4feet shoes but the whole thing doesn’t seem very legitimate to me .

records.title: Won't refund shipping cost, even when it's their mistake.
records.text: Got my shoes, the right size but the wrong colour. They will only refund the cost of the shoes, I'll lose out on my shipping costs because of their silly, incompetent mistake. I won't buy from this company again. Enjoy those shipping costs. Last of my money youll get.

records.title: Sent wrong item
records.text: Sent wrong item, also there is poor search functionality on their website meaning very time consuming to find my size (13) so I didn't bother with another order.Online chat is poor too.

records.title: Currently waiting for my delivery said…
records.text: Currently waiting for my delivery said it was due to be delivered yesterday so I stayed home nothing was delivered, currently says onboard with an est yesterday would like to know when it's going to be delivered. It is now mid day the next day and still nothing has arrived

records.title: First order was sound
records.text: First order was sound. Second order not so much. It's been 2 weeks and still not order. They state that they send 2-3 days through hermes. They've used royal mail.
