Royal mail say they are still to recieve order. Customer service said they'd get back to me last week.. I'm still waiting. I messaged last night, still waiting. No one to speak to today.

records.title: No After Sale Customer Service
records.text: Ordered ok - arrived ok but twice I emailed then about the order and got no response at all. The 2nd email was to say I have to return the boots as they are too narrow and I’ve had to work out for myself how to get them back to them. I can do this - I’m not a technophobe but some people are.  Common customer service guys that’s all.  You treat your customers like you don’t really care.

description:
Welcome to M&Co, where fashion meets affordability and style meets comfort. We believe that fashion should be accessible to everyone, and we're passionate about creating women's clothing that not only makes you look great but feel great too.


Women's fashion available in sizes 8-28, including petite and extended sizes. Shop online, or in app today.

records.title: After choosing what I wanted completing…
records.text: After choosing what I wanted completing the order was very straightforward.   I chose to collect my order at a local store.  It was ready to collect very promptly.

records.title: I ordered on line which was easy
records.text: I ordered on line, which was easy to do. My order arrived exceptionally fast, which was surprising due to the Christmas season. The Courier was very pleasant

records.title: Online success.
records.text: I am delighted with the enormous range offered by M&Co. on line. My wife is a petite size which may become a problem but has shopped at M&Co. for a considerable time with success. Lately we have found with the service, online is as good.TB.

records.title: Great price for a lovely fur girt Very happy with my purchase.Love the…
records.text: Very happy with my purchase.Love the furgilet so warm I’m sure I shall be wearing it a lot this winter.love colour will go with lots of tops.Would highly recommend has two nice pockets which are deep So won’t lose what you put in.Fast delivery.well done M&Co.

records.title: This is the 3rd suedette biker jacket…
records.text: This is the 3rd suedette biker jacket that I have bought from M & Co Lovely colours available and they are lined. They go in the washing machine too with a great result. I got a size 16 which is true to size. These are ideal jackets for the shorter ladies, I’m 5’2”Ordering line was so easy and delivery was in a reasonable time.

records.title: I am a petite lady and can always rely…
records.text: I am a petite lady and can always rely on M&Co for the correct sizing when buying any garment. This company is my “go to” 👍🏻

records.title: Ordering was easy I was kept up to date…
records.text: Ordering was easy I was kept up to date on status of my orderI was contacted with a estimated delivery timeAnd it arrived on time Overall very pleased

records.title: Easy to order speedy delivery great…
records.text: Easy to order speedy delivery great product reasonable price lovely thank you.

records.title: Once again you were great ordered on…
records.text: Once again you were great ordered on Thursday evening arrived Saturday morning with a eta of arrival What more could you ask for thank you all for a superb service especially as it is so close to Christmas

records.title: I purchased a coat from M&Co
records.text: I purchased a coat from M&Co, great item, as described super super warm great value. Great service item arrived within time frame. Thank you highly recommend

records.title: Order arrived quickly
records.text: Order arrived quickly kept 2 items out of the 6 items ordered sadly M & Co are using more and more cheap polyester materials which unless you have a perfect figure cling and look awful clinging to every bulge they also feel very static. Easy return of items to nearest Yours store.

records.title: Arrived quickly..
records.text: Arrived quickly..Dresses are thinner than I expected but as they weren't expensive I suppose this shouldn't be a surprise. Fit well as to size

records.title: Dress was lovely but delivery service…
records.text: Dress was lovely but delivery service terrible.  Parcel arrived two days late and too late for the event I originally ordered it for so I had to go out and buy another.

records.title: Nice dress but neckline a bit low.
records.text: Ordered the red dress to wear for Christmas.  The fabric is good but the neckline was a bit too low for me but I decided to attach some black fabric inside the  v shape to look like a cami and it did the trick. Very happy with the dress now.

records.title: Beautiful jumper warm and cosy
records.text: Beautiful jumper warm and cosy, looks as good as shown on website

records.title: Shopping experience was so quick and…
records.text: Shopping experience was so quick and easy.But I think the quality af the clothing has declined.

records.title: Having searched the local area I found…
records.text: Having searched the local area I found just what I was looking for on your website. My friend often admired the hat I bought from you shop . I couldn't find the exact same one but I hope she likes it.Stylish and useful, thanks.

records.title: Easy website  to use
records.text: Easy website  to use. Promt delivery with good updates.

records.title: Great easy to wear jeans
records.text: My order arrived on time which was great considering how busy all the delivery drivers are at the moment.  Ordered 3 pairs of jeans - they all fit will & are extremely comfortable to wear. Have yet to wash them so still to see how colourfast the dyes are

records.title: Let's sparkle
records.text: I loved my top ,if I have any criticism it would be that some sequins fell off ,but all round I spent the night sparkling the night away 👍

records.title: Excellent company but tricky returns process
records.text: Parcel came promptly. However, the garment was not suitable but it was tricky to return as I had no paperwork or instructions.  I had to investigate myself on line and found I had to return it to a returns portal, which I'd never heard of. Eventually I got it sorted out and my refund was very quick and efficient.

records.title: Ripped off…
records.text: I paid extra to have boots delivered next day and they didn't come till 3 days later. Very disappointed, I also arranged for them  to be delivered to 162 , but when I got home they were left on door step. In full view for anyone walking past could see. I live 2 blocks from town centre, so a busy thoroughfare anyone could have come up the path and taken them. Not good from Yodel as ever.

records.title: The jumpsuit I ordered was lovely just…
records.text: The jumpsuit I ordered was lovely just too tight, a bit pricely in Relation to their competitors, so I returned it. I was dismayed at the amount of return options (8 or 9)  all centred around return labels and printing, as it came with no return labels.-I don’t have a printer. I picked the post office option and it proved to be easy and I got my refund fairy quickly afterwards, slightly miffed at having to pay postage to get it returned as I had steady paid for delivery of the parcel.

records.title: Delivered quickly, quality goods will definitely order from M&co again,
records.text: Delivered quickly, quality goods will definitely order from M&Co again.

records.title: 2 jumpers were great, delivery not so
records.text: 2 jumpers were great. I only wish you could get size 12-14. I ordered 10-12 and this was fine as like to layer a tee shirt underneath.Delivery not great, tracking info said order number not recognised so had assumed it was lost. Customer services just sent an auto reply which wasn’t helpful.

records.title: Easy to order online
records.text: Easy to order online. Always good quality clothing at good prices mine were on sale so even better. The only small downside was delivery was longer than stated.

records.title: Nice smart work dress
records.text: Prompt delivery and the dress is a nice style, although a bit stretchier than I thought it would be.  I would have preferred a dress with no stretch in the fabric because, unless you are very slim, it's not that flattering over the stomach.Sadly this was the only suitable option on the website but apart from the stretch fabric it's a nice smart dress and it's a nice shape.

records.title: I love the dress I ordered
records.text: I love the dress I ordered.  Lovely style and true to size.  I know I will wear it many times as it can be dressed up or down, it’s simple styling is so versatile.  Delivery was quick.  No complaints at all.

records.title: Lovely top as a Christmas gift
records.text: Ordered a ladies top as a Christmas gift, website was easy to navigate and had good choices, item was delivered when advised and courier was friendly.  Happy with quality of top and it is as shown on screen

records.title: Ordered one day
records.text: Ordered one day, delivered the next...excellent!  Garment very creased but ironed out with a bit of elbow crease (dry linen)

records.title: Disappointed…
records.text: I have bought several sale items 3 of which have faults two had a hole in and one was marked.Clearly returns are not being checked otherwise this wouldn't be so frequent.Very disappointing as I like the style of your products.I now feel if I want something to wear for an occasion the state of the garment might have a fault when it arrives

records.title: The use by date on items we bought…
records.text: The use by date on items we bought wasn’t very long , especially the cakes and the starters , and everything that you do for puddings  / desserts have nuts in them, you would think in this day and age what with more people having allergies you would do something without nuts in . Also if you place a Christmas order you cannot put gravy on the order only starters and puddings.

records.title: Goods OK return experience initially problematic
records.text: Goods OK, delivery fine, bit irritated when the return label system failed x2 and then I was directed to a program that wanted a monthly subscription to answer my questions. I may have made mistakes on my route, but if I did I am sure others will too. I went round the loop again and this time the label appeared. The returns process was straightforward and efficient from then onThus the loss of stars was due to the demand for money to solve what I saw as an it problem.

records.title: Not Petite - green cable jumper was too big
records.text: Sadly green cable jumper was too big. Don't believe it was Petite, very disappointing. Return link on email did not work. Found it on website.Fortunately Pink jumper was perfect as they were gifts.

records.title: Delivery was very good on time.
records.text: Delivery was very good on time.. only two out of 4 items suited me so was going to send 2 items back, however, i was very  disappointment is that you pay for delivery, but  if you want to send items back and you get charged for this..  WHY is this.......

records.title: Quality of goods and service
records.text: Sadly I won’t be buying anything more from you because ten pounds to return one item is excessive. This is a shame because I love the  dresssing gown I got as a replacement for the one that was too big for me

records.title: Disappointed customer
records.text: Trousers great jacket arrived with a stain on lapel returned immediately still awaiting my refund so not very happy

records.title: Not the Best Quality
records.text: The style of the shirt was good but the quality of the material wasn’t great.  An awful lot of fluff covered it and it already looked a bit ‘bobbled’ as some of the threads looked pulled.  I had to wash it before I could wear it.  I didn’t return it as I needed it for a western style birthday party and with Xmas, didn’t think I would get a replacement in time.  It has made me a bit dubious as to the quality of other products that M&Co sell and has put me off ordering from them again.

records.title: loved the dress I ordered
records.text: loved the dress I ordered - was a bargain- no delivery note in the parcel though or returns label so have to return to the shop in Spalding 13 miles away!

records.title: It was my first time ordering from M&Co…
records.text: It was my first time ordering from M&Co so I ordered a couple of sizes for the same dress, not realising I had to pay to send back, I do appreciate return costs are high for a company but it would be nice to be informed prior. The dress itself was ok and did keep one size but unsure if I would order again.

records.title: Good quality but much too big!
records.text: Good quality and as advertised, very happy with actual product but much, much bigger than expected. Ordered my usual size suit and it is far too big. Tried to look for returns info but can't find anything.

records.title: Overall good but not the returns process.
records.text: Delivery was quick and everything was fine with my order so I can’t fault that. However I unfortunately had to return the item as it’s too big for the recipient of this order. I was a bit annoyed to find no return label prepaid for in my package. I have to get the label printed out myself to return the package which takes a £3 charge off your refund, and I don’t know if I’ll get a refund of the postage I paid in the first place or if I just get refunded for the item itself. I have to travel to the next over town to get a label printed to send it back. The delivery service was good but the return service is terrible for a clothing store.

records.title: My delivery came on time
records.text: My delivery came on time, but when I opened it one jumper was switched with another jumper which I didn’t order. It’s a problem sending any parcels back as I don’t have a printer so I went on the chat line which confused me. I did eventually send it back via the post office. I had the qr code on my I pad as I don’t have a smart phone so I had to carry it around with me,which is awkward as I use a stick.

records.title: Black &white dress is blk & coffee coloured
records.text: Ordered a black and white dress, the fabric is coffee and black. Mock wrap is open to the waist, dress wearable once I had sewn up to bust line. The way the dress was packed it looked like someone else had returned it, presumably for same problem

records.title: I  won't be buying online from MandCo…
records.text: I  won't be buying online from MandCo again, because on this first occasion the item was very poorly sized so I spent postage to receive and return for nothing! Most companies operate free delivery and return. Miss our store in Cromer.

records.title: Great fit
records.text: These pj’s are just right for me as I have to have easy to dress in and soft to the tough. Fit perfect. The only reason I did not give them 5 stars is because the first pair I bought had an inside leg seam not sewn properly so it all came undone

records.title: Garment more thin and flimsy than I…
records.text: Garment more thin and flimsy than I expected, and was crumpled inside the bag, as if it had been opened and carelessly re-packed - possibly a returned item being resold?

records.title: I was very disappointed with this…
records.text: I was very disappointed with this purchase. The material was to heavy and it was too big  I had to print off the returns label because M&Co do not insert one in the parcel. The label wouldn't scan when Evri came to collect it. I had to drive 10 miles to Darlington to return it. I have shopped with M& Co for years but after this experience I will have to think twice before I do it again

records.title: The parcel wasn't delivered correctly…
records.text: The parcel wasn't delivered correctly to my neighbour, but left in the foyer. Plus.  No invoice enclosed or directions for returning the said item. The trousers were in fact too long, but am having them altered.  More expensive though !!  On the plus side the trousers are very good quality and looks very smart.

records.title: Loved colour and style.
records.text: Loved colour and style.BUT really disappointed that the sequins constantly got snagged and caught up with each other. Frustrating to have to continually disconnect them.

records.title: Purchase and deluvery fine. Profuct faulty…
records.text: The process of buying and delivery was fine. However the 3 pairs of pyjamas which were £35 each are all too long in the leg - even for me 5ft 10 daughter and the button holes are all too big meaning the buttons slip out easily. The same problem has occurred in all 3 pairs. Unfortunately the pyjamas were worn by all 3 recipients before the problems became apparent.  A wasted £105.

records.title: Not great service
records.text: I ordered this dress because it said "delivered within 3 days" 7 days later it arrived. The dress was a size 16 it was more like a 14 I have noticed this with M&Co before I won't be wasting my time and postage again.

records.title: Unfortunately was too big
records.text: Unfortunately was too big. Shame no M&Co where we can actually go into the shop and try them on. Otherwise I could have tried a different size.

records.title: Great product let down by delivery company
records.text: Really great product as usual, but the delivery company (Yodel) are totally incompetent. I don't want to go through all that time wasting stress again.

records.title: I was very disappointed with these…
records.text: I was very disappointed with these pyjamas. The trousers looked as if they had been washed 300 times as they looked washed out and faded!!

records.title: Fast delivery but returns procedure…
records.text: Fast delivery but returns procedure wasn’t so easy to do picture of product looked better than item received

records.title: Delivery and ordering all good
records.text: Delivery and ordering all good. Jeans poorly finished and uncomfortable.  Rough stitching

records.title: I purchased black & pink flower pyjamas…
records.text: I purchased black & pink flower pyjamas size 10-12 they were way too big and too long. Trying to return has been difficult with a charge to return. I really need petite pjs or cuffed ankles this is becoming difficult to get now.So really need a shop to visit to make sure they are correct fit but went to the M&Co shop it had closed down such a shame….

records.title: You’ve changed your sizing from when I…
records.text: You’ve changed your sizing from when I use to shop in store 4 years ago. I use to be able to get ladies jumper size 12 which fit me perfectly. But now you do these silly sizes 10-12, 14-16 and 18-20. Hence 10-12 is sometimes to small and 14-16 to big really disappointed.

records.title: Order cancelled with no notification
records.text: I enquired where my order was and then was told that it had been cancelled and I had been given a full refund. I never received an email to notify me of this. As this was a Christmas present, I have now had to look elsewhere to try and get something similar.

description:
Welcome to the official Trustpilot profile for Radley London.


We don’t like to brag, but we’re pretty proud of what we do. Find the handbag of your dreams on our website, or in one of our stores nationwide. You can even shop in store from the comfort of home with our virtual shopping service via WhatsApp. 


We never stop striving to set a new standard for quality. As many as 20 skilled craftspeople work on every single handbag we make. And we’ve been working with some of these partners for as long as three generations. Sharing our passion for the most beautiful materials, including the highest quality leather. Ensuring it’s ethically produced. 


A mark of quality and attention to detail, our signature Radley dog has been with us since the beginning. He’s instantly recognisable. And pretty popular as well. Our four-legged friend is as synonymous with Radley London as our craftsmanship. Find him proudly placed on every design, whether hiding in the key fob charm or on an adventure across our latest picture bag. He’s very well-travelled. 

Show us how you style your look by tagging #MyRadley and @RadleyLondon on Instagram

records.title: I had such a nice experience shopping…
records.text: I had such a nice experience shopping today. I felt I had to write a review, the ladies in this shop make shopping a pleasure again, nothing was too much trouble, and Rachel in particular could not have been more helpful..

records.title: I mean I wasn’t surprised it’s Radley
records.text: I mean I wasn’t surprised it’s Radley! Great quality products all the times. I love my bag, i love the material (very soft leather), very light bag with the exact size i like (not too big nor too small). Bag arrived very well packed. Overall am very pleased with my purchase 👌🏾

records.title: Lovely, reliable quality bags.
records.text: I love my Radley bags.Very easy to navigate to reach the range of items I was looking for. Easy to order and kept up to date. I would like my pocket bags even more if they came with chrome fixings instead of gold that I think kind of takes from the whole quality and look. Also bit dissapointed that my large pocket bag didn't come with the dustbag like my mini pocket bag did. Is this hit and miss?

records.title: Fast delivery beautiful bag!good price…
records.text: Fast delivery beautiful bag!good price with discount as Will only be able to use as summer bag because the strap cannot be made longer and is too sort for winter clothes. Personally I wouldn’t have classed it as crossbody bag

records.title: Gordon bag
records.text: Found what I was looking for on website and great that it was on sale.Bag came quickly and was excellently packaged.Great quality bag and leather feels so soft but durable.Love my new bag.Would definitely buy from Radley again.

records.title: Beautiful, classy and practical.
records.text: Beautiful, quality product, exceptionally presented. A little pricey, and limited colour range but true to the adage, you get what you pay for!Brought me kisses from my wife on Christmas Day!

records.title: Quick delivery and presentation of bag…
records.text: EDIT 31 December 2024. A surprise pair of replacement socks sent by Radley! Thank you for reading your reviews. Quality company and outstanding customer care.Quick delivery and presentation of bag beautiful. I love my Radley purchases.The socks are disappointing - my big toe went through on first wear but they are lovely I will repair it.

records.title: Super speedy shipping
records.text: The bag arrived within 24 hrs! Very impressed. The quality of the black leather cross body bag was the excellent standard associated with Radley. Never disappoints.

records.title: I got an excellent deal on two…
records.text: I got an excellent deal on two beautiful bags. I had some trouble with the website, but Radley's customer service was quick to respond. The bags arrived in excellent condition and the quality is great! I've gotten compliments on one of the bags every time I've worn it.

records.title: Radley Store amazing visit
records.text: What a fantastic experience visiting the Radley shop in Livingston. The staff could not have been nicer to myself and both my daughters, they were friendly, helpful, polite and helped us all in choosing beautiful handbags and a rucksack to meet all our needs and styles. We will most definitely be back cannot recommend enough, we are planning another visit soon.Thank you Radley and all your amazing staff.

records.title: Beautiful items let down by delivery
records.text: Beautiful items packaged well. However considering the price of the items I was surprised i didn’t have to sign for them, and because I didn’t they were left outside of my house by the courier for a few hours whilst I was out. Thankfully I live in an area where crime is very low. So they were still there on my return home.

records.title: Really love my new bag(Badgers walk)…
records.text: Really love my new bag(Badgers walk) strong,bright and neatly presented,( not used yet,3 days owned)  is a Christmas gift )My only disappointment thus far,is the lack of logo. No little leather dog/ metal dog,only the one word Radley in small print lettering. First of my bags without a little dog,disappointed to be honest

records.title: Products as always were beautiful
records.text: Products as always were beautiful. Gorgeous Christmas present! Delivery was quick and easy.One issue via the courier…The packaging was extremely damaged to the point of the box only being sealed on 2.5 edges, luckily enough the handbag was still perfect and inside!!

records.title: The quality of the bag is good
records.text: The quality of the bag is lovely and the colour I like, it’s such a shame I can’t alter the length of the strap like other handbags but the most disappointing thing is I didn’t get a little dog like my many other Radley bags, maybe daft but I love them.

records.title: Gorgeous …
records.text: Great delivery packed well excellent  price bit disappointed as there wasn't  a dust bag .but the bag itself is very nice it's for a gift so hope my sister loves it x

records.title: Lovely quality bag from Radley
records.text: Lovely quality bag from Radley. Bought in the sale Nice smooth leather in a Cranberry colour which  I bought because it wasn't available in navyGood size to fit my large purse, glasses phone and other small bits and  piecesBrass zip and and wide leather shoulder strap + longer cross body strap.One internal zip pocket plus one otherSadly no dust bag and no dog charm

records.title: Another gorgeous Radley…..
records.text: As usual a beautifully finished bag, lovely leather & the perfect size! Lost a star, as Cranberry colour was slightly disappointing & more purple than I expected. Maybe you could possibly add a description of the colour in details section for online orders?

records.title: Radley bag
records.text: Excellent service, ordered the Friday night before Christmas and arrived on time.Radley lacked in communication in regard to updates on my delivery and also the bag was not quite the colour advertised on the website, hence why I didn’t give 5 stars.

records.title: Super handbags
records.text: Prompt despatch.  Well wrapped and boxed. Quality product with superb spec. and design. My wife loved the colour and the fabric.

records.title: Great purse but the clasp doesn't hold…
records.text: Great purse but the clasp doesn't hold closed very well when you have coins and cards in.

records.title: Gift box damaged
records.text: The only thing letting my review not be 5 stars is the gift box. I paid for the gift wrapping but the box is damaged I've contacted customer services and waiting on response. Otherwise it's beautifully wrapped inside. Gift box was refunded quickly. Thank you

records.title: Very good lovely bags
records.text: Very good, lovely bag I always have Radley bags, could have been a little quicker arriving but apart from that it was great

records.title: Good in the end
records.text: Purchase was very easy. Then there was a strange silence for some days where payment wasn’t taken, as payment is only actually taken when the order is picked… wasn’t sure how long that would be. Then it suddenly was and delivered in < 24hrs. Just gutted that the day after I ordered Radley had a 50% off sale. It’s a very nice bag though

records.title: Great service, no bag charms anymore 😢
records.text: I love a Radley bag and I can shop with confidence knowing the returns process is so easy. My most recent purchase was of a lovely large tote bag, but the quality isn’t what it once was. The lining was tailor’s canvas which will stain in no time, and it was disappointing there was no bag charm.

records.title: I didn’t find paying easy and address…
records.text: I didn’t find paying easy and address is automated an you can’t alter it so it said I’m I county of denbshire an I’m definitely in county of Wrexham so was worried about that but I got delivery fast other than that great Tony

records.title: Lack of information about inside of bag.
records.text: Could have had photos of inside of bag. I thought there were internal dividers but there weren't.  My last Radley bag had a Scottie on the zip so I thought they would all have one, so disappointed.

records.title: Beautiful box and presentation
records.text: Beautiful box and presentation. However I only purchased socks and bath wash,, the box was so big I was embarrassed when she opened it as she thought it was going to be a handbag.. A  cringe moment for me! Nevertheless she really appreciated the gift.

records.title: Took advantage of offer
records.text: Wife informed me of bag she would like for her upcoming birthday/Christmas present. Offer gave me a good reduction so took advantage. Only issue was with delivery which was longer than expected and courier left package on wall next to house - could easily have been stolen 😡😡

records.title: Not overly impressed with the way the…
records.text: Not overly impressed with the way the bag was packaged and presented when opening the box it was delivered in, considering this is a top brand product. It looked and was presented has a cheap brand you’d get when ordering something from a third party site, cheaply wrapped and no thought on image presentation, I purchased another well known brand handbag and this was presented has you’d expect, a box it was delivered in then a inner box with the brand name with a large ribbon/bow , then on opening the box you was greeted with a brand card and separate card thanking you for purchasing, the bag was inside a outer protective bag,my Radley bag had none of this just wrapped in cheap plastic wrapping and the box it was delivered in was the box it stays in , everything felt cheap & not what you’d expect from a top brand name, this is the 2nd handbag I’ve purchased for my wife from Radley and honestly not impressed with the way there products are presented, would have loved to give a positive feedback score but on this occasion I can’t,

records.title: I’m more than happy with the product…
records.text: I’m more than happy with the product but the customer service is sub standard The contact number on the website is out of action I needed to tweak my order and they flatly refused it was only changing the size of an item

records.title: Loved this bag but
records.text: This bag was just what i was looking for ,i bought it but was very dissapointed with the canvas strap so wont use it over my shoulder .Spoilt a really gorgeous bag

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: I’ve got loads of Radley products and have never been disappointed until I bought direct. I purchased a purse as a Christmas present and it arrived unboxed and just sandwiched between two pieces of card. I’ll have to purchase a gift box before I can wrap it to give as a present.I expressed my disappointment and their reply is equally disappointing. ‘ Our gift wrap has had to be removed for the time being due to an influx of orders.’Well guess what it’s Christmas and it’s very likely you’ll get an influx at this time every year. It’s also more likely that the purchases will be for gifts so you shouldn’t compromise your standards - you should be ready for the influx!!

records.title: The quality of the zips is not as good.
records.text: The quality of the zips is not as good.There is hardly any soft leather, it is all grained now. Tpp many gimmick bags.

records.title: One unfortunate  purchase.
records.text: I have bought quite a number of Radley and have always been 100% pleased. But this last bag had a smell of mold of something that led me to believe it had been sitting in a damp area for a long time. Very disappointed.  I am ordering one more  and hope it comes smelling clean and bright as all my others. The one I didn't  like was Badgers Walk, medium Forest. .I must have 6 bags and a number of wallets. Also sent out a number of gifts. Always get wonderful compliments.

records.title: Had to make another choice because the…
records.text: I had to make another choice because the item i wanted not in stock

records.title: Picture looked like it was black the…
records.text: Picture looked like it was black the actual colour was grey

records.title: Disappointing packing for a gift
records.text: Bought a handbag as a gift. Came chucked in a cardboard box which has Radley on the inside, no gift box, no dust bag... extremely annoyed as it is a present and wasn't cheap. I would be grateful if customer services can respond..clearly states on website gift wrapping....I have taken photos

records.title: Lovely bags, poor customer service!
records.text: Poor customer service!I ordered a cross body bag and a purse on line.The bag arrived quickly and was super, but no purse.I contacted Radley- got a AI generated response .....So i awaited further information as instructed.The next day I received a Radley invoice for the bag only. I checked my account this was the only charge made.Today, a week later, I am asked about my experience. I have had no further update about my order of the purse- which I assume had sold out and I am not getting it. But no apology or explanation from Radley. This is not customer service, and I am not inclined to use companies that do not provide a proper service- as goodness knows what would have happened if any goods were lost or damaged in transit- and these are not cheap goods. Lovely bags, poor service.

records.title: When Radley pick two items for you
records.text: When Radley pick two items for you , Bag and a Purse they should match the colours better I HAVE A LIGHT BROWN BAG AND A DARK BROWN PURSE ....They were listed as the same colour....

records.title: My items were delivered by DPD to the…
records.text: My items were delivered by DPD to the local supermarket rather than my home address, despite Radley having all my details!

records.title: A mixed experience
records.text: When I received the lovely bag I ordered in the Black Friday deal which meant it was half price, I could immediately see that the zip had been put on upside down.  I rang Customer Service to explain the problem and they said I could send it back to them at no expense to myself which I did that morning.However I could see how popular this handbag was and therefore i was concerned that as the bag was faulty I didn't want to loose out so could they put one aside for me.  This isn't their policy.  One has to wait for the bag to be inspected once it is received before a decision is made as to offer a replacement.It took 3 days for the bag to arrive because of slow post office service it would appear, so I left it 2 days before ringing Customer Services again who informed me that indeed the zip was faulty but it had been repaired which I was rather surprised about and was I happy to receive this bag now everything was ok.As no more bags were available in this style I agreed and was delighted when the bag arrived 2 days later looking perfect.  However I do not agree with their policy when bags are faulty.  If the bag could not have been repaired then I would have lost out through no fault of my own.

records.title: Like the watch but a bit disappointed.
records.text: Like the watch but don’t like that I have to ask for heart rate, oxygen rate manually I want it to do automatically. Night sleep does not register and I don’t know how to do this.

records.title: Nice bag, shame about the dustbag
records.text: I bought the bag as a gift, when it's arrived there was  o dustbag for protection.When buying something that's meant to be a luxury item I would of expected so.ething to protect the bag.I've been onto customer services and they have said they will look for a dustbag that should fit the bag I purchased, but there was no timescale given on when or if I would recieve it.As this bag was for a gift it doesn't look very good on my behalf.

records.title: Cross body bag review.
records.text: The design of this bag is perfect and I love the wide strap. It is smart and classy looking. I have received several compliments. It would be much nicer if it were 1 1/2 inch wider and maybe an inch taller. Keeping in mind not to take away from the current appearance of the bag. It is difficult to get much more than my cell phone in it. I think the extra inches would help without taking away from the look of the bag. The quality of the leather is nice. I love the color selection.

records.title: Order and shipping okay
records.text: Order and shipping okay - Product not what I would expect - poosr quality for the money and it was a sale item.Dissapointing

records.title: Bag is nice but delivery took 10 days…
records.text: Bag is nice but delivery took total of 10 days and was only posted after I enquiried if item was sent. I chose standard delivery and checked that item should have taken 3-5 working days only. Item was delivered outside of the timeframe advised on the website and I can evidence it. I dropped a star after receiving poor response denying my claim.

records.title: Good delivery time  faulty goods
records.text: Good delivery time. Cheap packaging, could hear necklace rattling around, without any padding or paper inside box.HOWEVER, the earings were faulty, as the order of the 3 stones differed. Customer service ordered a new set to be delivered 3 days ago, still waiting for dispatch notification. If not arrived in time for Christmas, as promised  then only 1 star rating.

records.title: Love the look of this bag but
records.text: Love the look of this bag buthaving purchased it to go to the races I'm very disappointed ....there's no inside pockets of any kind, which i missed online and there's not enough room inside plus It doesn't open wide enough for ease of use.  Spending a day anywhere requires you to take not just your phone but a portable charger, keys, a little makeup, comb, glasses and a small purse. I had to leave my money in the base of my bag, carry my phone and put my keys in my pocket which spoils the shape of the jacket. Overall very disappointed.

records.title: I was disappointed that a microfiber…
records.text: I was disappointed that a microfiber len cloth was not included in the order. Also missing was the returns slip and information. The quality of 1 of the 3 sunglasses purchased is questionable.

records.title: The bag is just what I wanted but…
records.text: The bag is just what I wanted but unfortunately the pull for the zip came off, thankfully I had some superglue to fix it

records.title: Series 21 smart watch
records.text: Series 21. The sleep tracker of the watch is absolutely erratic, sometimes it logs no sleep, sometimes it logs way more or less than my actual sleep hours. I contacted support and they sent me to Peers Hardy, their watch manufacturer. Selling smart watches and not providing proper tech support, great idea!

records.title: Poor quality catches
records.text: I bought a Radley purse for my wife for Christmas, exactly the same as one she had owned previously, of which the popper catch decided not to work. She loaded her cards and monies in the new one and tried to fasten it, but the popper catch on new one is inferior and will not stay fastened. We returned it to store where it was purchased and got full refund, but were told that we should buy a separate holder for cards. That is not the point when you are requiring a purse with cards to be included. Obviously the catches are of poorer quality and suggest anyone with same problems to voice their concern so that Radley will address the issue. They are selling an item which is not fit for purpose.

records.title: The strap has a permanent crimp in the…
records.text: The strap has a permanent crimp in the area where the sizing clip sits. When I shortened the strap, it became painfully obvious. I have tried stretching it out, but it remains bumpy and wrinkled, and quite unattractive.

records.title: Customer Services unable to help on order error minutes after order placed
records.text: This is just my experience from purchasing online.  The product itself is absolutely fine and no issues in terms of quality etc.  I purchased a handbag online and instantly received the confirmation email.  I checked this and quickly realised that in the order placing I have selected the wrong colour some how.  I wanted the 'ink' colour but seemed to have been processed with 'grey'.  I noticed within a couple of minutes of placing the order and I messaged on Whatsapp to ask customer services not to send and to exchange the product to the colour I wanted as the pricing was all the same.  I also emailed to make sure I gave every chance to change or refund the item as I didn't want a grey bag.  When I did get a reply, customer service said they could do nothing at all and proceeded to ship the bag anyway.  I cant believe there was no opportunity to change or offer an alternative than to ship something I said I didn't want, even though it was my mistake.  I still wanted the bag from them.  I would be happy to wait until the bag I wanted came in if it was out of stock.  I had no options and customer services seemed dismissive and carried on when an issue could have be corrected for the customer.

records.title: My bag was missing the Radley Dog tag
records.text: My bag was missing the Radley Dog tag. Have tried to contact seller with no response. It has taken the special look off the bag.HBM.

records.title: Your delivery driver did not bother to…
records.text: Your delivery driver did not bother to do his job and left the package at a collection point instead for me to collect despite me paying for delivery. Radley did not respond to 2 emails I sent. I had to take time off work to collect. A disgrace

records.title: Poor quality
records.text: I’m used to getting quality bags from Radley but the Suffolk bag I received is cheap and tackyThere was nothing in the parcel so that I can return itI’ve now bought a cheap bag from Amazon that is far superior to Radley

records.title: I love the purse but it arrived with a…
records.text: I love the purse but it arrived with a big scratch across the front. Customer service said there was no way to fix the scratch and they were too busy to replace the purse at this time. They did give me a percentage off the price but my eyes are drawn to the big scratch. I doubt I’ll buy from Radley again:-(

records.title: Bought a nice purse for a Christmas…
records.text: Bought a nice purse for a Christmas present for someone but when it arrived, it was only come a purse & a dust bag. Not even a presentation box. Disappointed

records.title: This was a £3 Leather Protection Cloth…
records.text: This was a £3 Leather Protection Cloth I bought to protect my bag before I used it.  But I was charged £4.95 for shipping and handling, so I did expect the cloth to be of a reasonable size. What arrived was a small sachet not even the size of a letter. To charge £4.95 'shipping' when this would have fitted inside a small envelope with a first class stamp, was exorbitant! To add insult to injury there was so little product impregnated on this cloth it barely covered my bag. Come on guys - get a grip..we're not stupid out here and we do know the value of things.

description: ROKA bags and backpacks are designed to make you smile and live life in colour. Feel bold and proud when you wear a ROKA, and confident that the important things you entrust it to carry are safe.

records.title: Lucky dip January sale
records.text: Lucky dip January sale I went for two of the Maxi Mystery option. I wanted something suitable for my husband. I received a large Finchley in Stormy and a small Bantry In Cranberry. My husband was pleased with both of these backpacks. Ordered on 27 December and received on Monday 30 December so processed and delivered really quickly.  I have several ROKA backpacks and bags which are very good, hard wearing and waterproof. Sizing details on website are really helpful when choosing something suitable for need.

records.title: Great service and great products
records.text: Excellent choice of bags on the website. Easy ordering and payment. Despite the Christmas rush my order arrived in super quick time, well packaged and in perfect condition.My wife is very happy with the quality and style of her new bag. Christmas hit!

records.title: Gorgeous bag, great quality!
records.text: I received a beautiful medium Canfield in Rooiboos (dark orange), and black label edition with black logo, inside, straps etc. Absolutely delighted! Roka bags are amazing quality and come in fabulous colours so you don't have to have a boring work bag. I have loads now in all sizes!

records.title: Colour complication
records.text: my daughter gave me a ROKA bag which in the shop lighting looked maroon coloured but when it came it was brown which is not me and definitely not a summer colour so i ordered a pale blue one which came promptly and is lovely.  The brown one is lovely too but i wish it was say the teal colour which would be more me.  My son gave me a red purse which is brilliant too.

records.title: Brilliant Lucky Dip but dont be greedy!
records.text: Brilliant Lucky Dip sale but you HAVE to be open to receiving anything. Still, the bag I received was a bargain and great colours too.  A glitch with despatch email was very quickly sorted by emailing Roka.. really good customer service and very quick to respond over the few days after Christmas when the office was officially shut

records.title: Lovely airforce blue Bantry B …
records.text: Lovely airforce blue Bantry B small backpack from the Maxi lucky dip. Not my usual style of bag - I’m a cross body person, but I want to give this style a try. I received a burgundy coloured Paddington bag in my first lucky dip last year and I have used it almost everyday. The colours have suited what I tend to wear.

records.title: Canfield Rolltop Small
records.text: Canfield Rolltop Small - Burnt OrangeI bought this bag after a friend bought one. Love the ethos behind the making of them and find it so practical, yet bright & funky 😊Ordering was easy and delivery very quick.

records.title: Lucky Dip
records.text: Lucky Dip!  Just a huge thank you to ROKA for the 2024 lucky dip!  My friend and I went together to order two maxi lucky dips on Boxing Day.  We got two wonderful bags and are so happy with them.  Huge thank you to ROKA staff as well as postal /courier staff for working so hard to fulfill these orders during the holiday period.

records.title: Perfect ruck sack …
records.text: Perfect ruck sack for my busy lifestyle has loads of ‘secret’ pockets and I love the magnetic fold over top for security. Super colour and very quick delivery. Thank you 🤩

records.title: Lovely bag which arrived really…
records.text: Lovely bag which arrived really promptly. Chosen because a few friends have Roka bags and were really pleased with them, they say they’re perfect when travelling and fit nicely under airline seats as carry on hand luggage.I’ve only just started to use mine but so far so good. Janet

records.title: Lovely bags
records.text: Lovely bags. Would suggest looking carefully at the exact sizes on the website, and not just the photos in the size guide. I ordered two bags - a "large" Willesden B and a "medium" Paddington B - in fact, they're almost the same size! (and rather small for a "large")But both are comfortable and have many pockets.The international shipping was rather slow, but that might be the result of the local postal services being horrible.

records.title: Would love the lucky dip to include more size ratings
records.text: Bought the large/maxi lucky dip and although you can't specify which item I was really hoping for a larger bag. The bag I received is lovely (Bantry B) but won't be one I can use for work as just too small to fit my laptop and this was my hoped use. It would be great if the lucky dip could be used to pick a size of bag, rather than a price range of item. I will be more likely to consider using the lucky dip again in the future if you can specify size and feel this would be better from an environmental point of view as well. Edited to add: I also ordered a mini lucky dip and enjoyed this surprise, I wouldn't have thought to order this myself but it will be perfect for when I need to carry my phone and keys around without much else.

records.title: Perhaps lucky dip isn’t for me
records.text: Perhaps lucky dip isn’t for me, bag great quality as usual but I hadn’t thought through all the colour options available

records.title: I was overall pleased with my Lucky Dip…
records.text: I was overall pleased with my Lucky Dip purchase & the whole idea of it is that it’s a surprise & have no control over you get. The only gripe I have is that I received no confirmation that my parcel was on it’s way.

records.title: This was a lucky dip bag
records.text: This was a lucky dip bag. Really good quality bag, colour is fabulous.I would have thought it was a medium rather than a large bag, but it is well made with lots of compartments

records.title: Nice small back pack. …
records.text: Nice small back pack but was a little disappointed not to get medium or large back pack in maxi lucky dip. Quick delivery.

records.title: Very good quality and finishing
records.text: This is my first time buying anything from Roka London, i really love the design and finishing. Looks like it will last forever.

records.title: a Lovely Bantry B bag
records.text: a Lovely Bantry B bag, shame is black! Only buy at Roka for all inspiring colours. packaging could have been better in rapport to the lucky game.

records.title: Great bags
records.text: Great bags. Would have been 5 but was hoping for lucky dip large bag- that’s on me for not reading descriptions properly 😊Bags are great!!

records.title: Lovely items and deals to be had
records.text: Lovely items and deals to be had, just took a little longer to arrive than expected. Also a bit too many emails/ marketing afterwards so I knocked one star off. But all-in-all,  buy with confidence, great company!

records.title: Well packed and delivered on time
records.text: Well packed and delivered on time. It was a Christmas gift and the recipient was very pleased with the quality.

records.title: Good quality products
records.text: Good quality products, arrived in good time.Blackfriars M - suggest including dimensions of the laptop pocket, as the overall bag size made me think my work laptop would fit. It does fit in the bag, just not in the laptop compartment…

records.title: Products great choice
records.text: Products great choiceCustomer services excellent in sorting out an order that had gone awol

records.title: What’s not to like
records.text: Easy to order and speedy delivery. Love the Bond bag, and the range of colours. 4 stars instead of 5 is because I prefer the version with non-leather zip closures. Apart from that it’s fine and dandy. Love Roka.

records.title: The size of this backpack is perfect
records.text: The size of this backpack is perfect , sadly having to replace my original one which faded after one summer , Roka weren’t very sympathetic. Hoping this one lasts a bit longer.  .

records.title: Ordered a bag for Christmas
records.text: Ordered a bag for Christmas, received confirmation and notification of delivery but it never arrived and unable to track package. Contacted Roka who were very helpful and sent out another bag which arrived next day. Problem may have been with Royal Mail rather than Roka. Well done for sorting it out.

records.title: Ok but!
records.text: My rucksack was delivered promptly with a big discount but, sadly, I hadn’t appreciated how small the medium size would be, or how uninteresting the charcoal grey would be. It’s largely because the front to back depth is so shallow! That’s my fault for not getting my head round that dimension. I guess it will still be useable, but, buyers be aware that only the large will really be large enough to take a laptop and a lightweight puffer jacket.

records.title: Handy size and lightweight fabric.
records.text: Quick delivery from Roka London and plenty of delivery updates. I dithered over which cross body bag to choose but settled for the Willesden Mulberry - large size. It’s not large in reality but I double checked the dimensions before I chose and it’s just the ticket. Big enough for my wallet in the front patch pocket and my ‘phone in rear, out of sight, zip pocket, plus of course the main compartment for other stuff. I gave 4 stars because the front patch pocket and main compartment zip arrived squashed and creased and I can’t come up with a way to undo that. Perhaps Roka could come up with a way to pad out the front pocket in particular for delivery. In general I love the handy size and lightweight fabric - better than my previous heavy one which made my neck ache.

records.title: Super Quick returns
records.text: The bag arrived quickly but was faulty. But customer services were super speedy and I got the replacement in 2 days so all good.

records.title: Rapid delivery
records.text: Rapid delivery . Not disappointed with lucky dip item

records.title: Lucky dip chaos !
records.text: Very disappointed that even after people ordered  Maxi lucky dips which were advertised with a price band of £59.95- £89.95 you then saw fit to change it after customers complained about receiving lower priced bags! For a big company like Roka it’s very disappointing. They also offered differing levels of redress ! It should have been the same for every customer who received a lower price bag.

records.title: I recently bought the maxi lucky dip
records.text: I recently bought the maxi lucky dip. When I bought this the description was valued between £59.95-£89.95. I love the bright bold colours of Roka. Unfortunately very disappointed this year. I got a small black Bantry rucksack. Full price worth £54.95. So not as described. Also very boring colour, Will be sending this back. Have raised the issue around description with customer service. Await response, But notice since I bought this the description has changed to £54.95.

records.title: Slightly disappointing
records.text: Slightly disappointing - paid for a large lucky dip, got what was very obviously a "small" rucksack. Have requested info from company for a returns or replacement and heard nothing. It's a shame, as I generally like Roka bags.

records.title: Disappointed in the lucky dip
records.text: Disappointed in the lucky dip, what was advertised wasn’t what was received so I felt a little misled, although still good value, I managed to swop it with someone else. Bags are great and great quality.

records.title: Do better Roka
records.text: Was very disappointed with this years lucky dip . Firstly the starting price for the maxi dip was changed even though people had already ordered. the new starting price was lower and included a less valuable bag , which a lot of people seemed to end up with . Then there were different options as a goodwill gesture from the company! Some people were given a free bag! Some people £5 site credit , some 30% off! There was no consistency to the redress made to customers who ordered in good faith . Do better Roka

records.title: No dispatch email or way to track items
records.text: Products were great, however, no contact from Roka after order placed, no tracking and didn't know if the products had been dispatched.

records.title: It's pot luck as to what you get.
records.text: It's pot luck as to what you get. Got the round crossover bag..another one.Colour going to be difficult to match with.Not favourite colour for many i presume..mustard but it is what is is ..

records.title: It’s my fault for paying for a lucky…
records.text: It’s my fault for paying for a lucky dip. I saw the lovely bright tote bags and got greedy. Unfortunately, I received the most boring bag ever created. It’s grey and functional. So so so dull. I do wonder how much of the lucky dip is lovely and how much has the Eastern European vibe.

records.title: Very disappointed with my maxi dip…
records.text: Very disappointed with my maxi dip purchase.

records.title: You haven’t advised when it will be…
records.text: You haven’t advised when it will be despatched

records.title: Bag is good, marketing strategy is awful!
records.text: The bag is great and all but the company made me feel like a sucker. I bought the bag from the "VIP" sales where the bag I originally wanted to seem to be not on sale. So I went for something I moderately liked as I was in desperate need for one but was waiting for the sales. About 5-6 days later I did the purchase, they included more models in the sale including the one I actually wanted and opened up the sales to everyone. I wish I hadn't fallen into the trap! I would have been better off if I hadn't received the "VIP" sales email!!!!!!!!!!!! It was too late to return the bag at that point and too much time and effort because of their stupid marketing strategy!

records.title: Product 10, Online Experience 0
records.text: Great quality product but the website and online admin caused unnecessary issues: instead of clearly stating that a size was 'out of stock', my order defaulted to an alternative size. When I noticed this on the order confirmation, I contacted Roka via the company's 'support' process but there was no response and the order wasn't cancelled. Delivery was prompt but I received the cancelled and the replacement orders and now have the hassle of returning the unwanted product.  Please review your admin processes as it has put me off buying from Roka again :(

records.title: I am pleased with the bag which I…
records.text: I am pleased with the bag which I bought in the sale. I gave it 3 stars because I had to repair the stitching on the front pocket label. This took a couple of minutes, less trouble than returning the bag. Given the full price of the bags I think Roka could improve their packaging, the front pocket was very creased. The bag is well designed and I like the choice of colours so I would buy another one.

records.title: Slightly disappointed with colour of…
records.text: Slightly disappointed with colour of bag as shown on line. Colour described as mist. Looks very white. Might have thought by name it would be a bit grey if not white. Turned out to be beige/green.

records.title: Ordering bags have been great and we…
records.text: Ordering bags have been great and we liked all of them bar the most recent black bag which we think is cheap looking with flimsy handle and nasty material.The other ruck sacks and colourful bags were lively

records.title: Difficult to choose colours online
records.text: I ordered a Canfield bag in Majestic purple and a Finchley bag in Teal.I'm really happy with the colour of the Finchley bag, however the Canfield colour was a bit disappointing as it wasn't as bright as it appeared online.I haven't decided whether to keep it yet.

records.title: Different colours! …
records.text: The colour of the bag looked completely different from the picture. I am returning it, but having to pay for the privilege.

records.title: Beautiful bags
records.text: The bags are beautifully made & lovely quality. Unfortunately, the colours I like have been discontinued. Would be nice if you brought back warm, earthy tones, especially for autumn. Also, it’s free delivery over £70 but most of the bags are just under £70. Puts me off buying any more.

records.title: Customer service could be vastly…
records.text: Customer service could be vastly improved - shocking experience when trying to return an order that wasn’t suitable. Also, be warned you will be charged for returning an order - Roka choose the postage rate, you don’t get a say. I had keyworker discount that was effectively not a discount due to their extremely high postage costs as it took me below their recently raised ‘free delivery’ threshold of £70. It was £50 not too long ago.I was refunded £10 less than my original order cost for some reason too; couldn’t be bothered to get in touch to argue. Products are great quality - that is their only saving grace.

records.title: Maxi lucky dip sadly not a laptop sized bag
records.text: Having ordered 2 midi and one maxi lucky dips, I received lovely 3 bags, one quite small round bag which my daughter has quickly claimed, and 2 similar sized medium bags. Turns out ordering a maxi lucky dip does not get you a bag big enough to fit a small laptop in.  Really disappointed not to get a new work bag ☹️Still waiting for a reply from Roka customer services.

records.title: I ordered two maxi lucky dips…
records.text: I ordered two maxi lucky dips advertised at minimum retail value £59.95 and of the bags that arrived retails at under £40.00.   I made Roka aware and was offered a £5 credit on my account it a free return, not acceptable.  I have asked for a solution but not heard back.

records.title: Rather disappointed this year
records.text: There has been confusion over the lucky dip this year . I bought a maxi and a midi dip. I received a medium Bantry not a large bag as previous dips. I also received a Paddington which previously would have been small . Many others received significantly higher value products in the maxi dip , Heathrow, Trafalgar, large rucksacks. While some have been offered a return and refund - some minus the original postage , cost for the return (mine), others offered a 30% credit plus keeping the bag they received . The inconsistencies in response to the many different customers is a concern . Roka is a great brand, the bags are very good- customers  enjoy the lucky dip , however this year the vast number of black medium Bantry bags in the maxi package has been disappointing . I hope that every customer who was disappointed can be provided with the same service rather than some being given credits , others paying for returns etc Also a maxi is not medium .

records.title: Sadly I was disappointed with my…
records.text: Sadly I was disappointed with my surprise. It is a black bag which I find dull and would never have chosen. I have loved every other bag I have purchased and won’t be buying a surprise again.

records.title: Lucky dip disappointment
records.text: First time I’ve been tempted to try the lucky dip. I won’t bother again- cheapest bag in the price range & horrible colour.

records.title: Ordering was simple but after a week I…
records.text: Ordering was simple but after a week I still haven’t received my bags

records.title: Although the staff are very Helpful and…
records.text: Although the staff are very Helpful and prompt , the current Lucky Dip promotions are miss leading , I ordered a maxi , and expected to receive an item in the upper price bracket , the ones I got were both from a lower price , this is dissapointing,  did anyone actually receive and Item that would cost that amount,  I think looking at the comments on social media  a lot have had the same issue , such a shame as the bags are fabulous  , I won't be ordering from the lucky dip in future,  Thank you

records.title: I bought of the Creative Waste…
records.text: I bought one of the Creative Waste Canfield B Recycled Nylon Edition 4 because I loved the vibrant colours that's made of but they don't look nothing like the picture. If I had the time I'd return it and change it for another combination of colours or a plain one. I was really looking forward to have a Roka. The delivery arrived without any notice apart from an email a couple of days before saying that the items have been shipped. They left the bag behind my black bin and my partner found it the next day by chance. I wish I had an email confirming the day of the delivery or if this had happened, specially because it wasn't given in hand to anyone but left outside.

records.title: Ordering easy, unable to cancel
records.text: Placed an order easily enough. Immediately contacted the company to say that the person I was buying for had changed their mind about the colour and I would like to cancel the order. I provided the order number. Was told they couldn’t cancel as they have no way of knowing which order was mine as they ship 100s. I paid £5 shipping, which given the wording of their responses about this charge being refunded when I return the bag, I don’t think they want to refund. At the time of me contacting to cancel the order, I hadn’t received shipping confirmation so this whole thing could’ve been avoided. My partner then placed an order for the bag my giftee actually wants without any trouble.

records.title: Don’t take out in the rain. Not water proof even though they claim they are
records.text: Great  looking bag plenty of room - but NOT waterproof I was out in rain the other day and ALL my items were wet on my return home even in the main compartment paper was wet. I brought a large yellow Canfield in recycled nylon - it says water resistant.  This is not a practical bag at all especially as I brought the large version hoping to use it for all occasions but now relegated it to the cupboard how can you have a bag scared that if it rains your items become wet... Looking pretty is not good enough

description:
Pom Pom London was born in 2015 with the aim of delivering affordable, stylish and contemporary products. 

All our products are sourced and designed from the UK. We are passionate about creating fashion pieces that are unique and fun for all ages and our expanding range is a reflection of this. 

Whether you are looking for a warm hat or a useful bag we hope you find something appealing. 

Thank you for looking. Of course please do not hesitate to get in touch should you have any queries about anything!

Pom Pom London Team x

records.title: Beautiful bag - easy ordering system
records.text: Easy ordering system - Select bundle required. Find your favourite design and colour : click.  Select your two straps : click.  Go to payment. Easy peasy.  Christmas pressie from hubby.  The package arrived in less than 24 hours of making order, just WOW.  Love the quality - this is my 2nd Pom Pom bag and will defo be purchasing more in the future

records.title: Beautiful,Functional and Stylish
records.text: I recently purchased a handbag from Pom Pom London, and I couldn’t be happier with my choice! The quality of the materials and craftsmanship is outstanding—it feels durable yet remains lightweight and comfortable to carry. The design is not only chic but also incredibly practical, with well-thought-out compartments that keep everything organized.The customer service was fantastic, with clear communication and fast delivery. It’s clear that Pom Pom London takes pride in their products and values their customers.I’ve already received so many compliments on my bag, and I know it’s a piece I’ll cherish for years to come. Highly recommend Pom Pom London for anyone looking for the perfect blend of style and functionality!

records.title: Amazing!!
records.text: Pom pom london are the very best online company ive ever used. Since finding them i have bought lots of their City and Mayfair bags, and  i havent finished yet!!! The quality of the bags are fabulous, packaging and delivery,  i couldnt ask for more secure or quicker. (Ive had 2 in as many weeks) Pom Pom London you are receiving my childrens inheritance 🤷🏻‍♀️🤷🏻‍♀️ my guilty pleasure....ive only had to use customer service once but they were very helpful and only added to my wonderful exerience with this company.

records.title: Absolutely love this brand
records.text: Absolutely love this brand! The quality of the bags are fantastic and they are just simply stunning. I bought 8 of these in different colours/styles last year and I cannot get enough of them. Service is brilliant. Highly recommend

records.title: Repeat customer
records.text: I have made several purchases from PomPom London. Every bag is beautifully made with excellent quality leather and amazing straps. Every item is shipped quickly!!

records.title: Pom Pom London are great!
records.text: Love these bags from Pom Pom London! Well made leather bags with choices of accessories which is a lovely touch. I own 3 now and will definitely be buying another at some point. Would recommend ❤️

records.title: I have now bought 4 Pom Pom bags and I love them all
records.text: I have now bought 4 Pom Pom bags and I love them all!The little extras which come with each bag which you can choose are lovely and make the bag extra special.The quality of the leather and other materials is first class and I have had many compliments for my bags, even from strangers.Placing the order, confirmation and delivery are very efficient, and the website is well designed.Looking forward to my next purchase!!

records.title: Brilliant from start to finish
records.text: Brilliant from start to finish. The team let me know when the bag was back in stock. My partner loves it, great quality and surprising what she can get in it. The versatility and variety of straps make for winning combinations in every way. Excellent all round. Thank you

records.title: I’m absolutely in love with my Pom Pom…
records.text: I’m absolutely in love with my Pom Pom London bag! The size is perfect—just right for carrying everything I need without being bulky. The straps are so practical and comfortable, and the craftsmanship is flawless. The attention to detail in the finish makes it feel so luxurious. I loved it so much that I went ahead and bought another one! Highly recommend!

records.title: Stop looking!  This is the perfect crossbody
records.text: I searched for months to find the perfect crossbody,  This is it! 2 outside pockets,one fits a cell phone perfectly and the other my keys.  Inside it large enough for my wallet, lipstick, and glasses.  It is made beautifully with soft leather, and comes with changeable straps.  Super fast delivery to the US...I highly recommend Pom Pom

records.title: Adorable bag
records.text: Great bum bag. High quality with sturdy straps. Holds a lot and fits nicely on the body. Pom Pom accessory ads charm. I would take off a half a star only for the zipper because it’s a bit sticky when opening and closing. I hope it lasts for many years.

records.title: Lovely bags
records.text: Bought a tan Mayfair in the sale - my third purchase. Love all the bags - great quality and worth the money. I wish there were a wider selection of straps though, as well as free returns/exchanges. I also find the photography on the site misleading sometimes, in terms of colours - the tan, for example, is a lot less orangey in real life. Finally, I'm sad that all the bags will eventually have a panel at the front...I prefer them panel-free. I would buy more if I had the option to choose.

records.title: Great bag - bad tassle key ring
records.text: Purchased the City bag in slate blue - it’s very cute!  Great size, ample pockets, good everyday bag or would be great for travel.  The bag itself is nice quality - the leather tassle key chain that came with had shed leather pieces all over the cover the bag came in and it was poor quality. I messaged customer service about it and they told me to “give it a shake” - lol.  No surprise - that didn’t do the trick so I just tossed it.  Luckily I didn’t pay for it.  4stars because of that - great bag otherwise!

records.title: Superb quality & style
records.text: Wonderful service! My collecton grows as o know the leather is 1st class- the most beautifully soft leather with lovely gold metal work.Choice of straps is so good, my bags work for both day, night, casual or smart, I know my bags are just right.The scream style & class.Fastest delivery ever arriving in lovely storage bags that are strong and even they look good!Customers services is excellent.Introducing my daughter to you with her Christmas present.

records.title: Easy to order, freebies perfect
records.text: Easy to order, few freebies did come with the bag I've ordered for my wife..

records.title: Absolutely lovely my Pom Pom London…
records.text: Absolutely lovely my Pom Pom London handbags, soo many different colour to choose from, and so easy to wear with anything. The only thing I find is that if you wear dark colours I find it rubs off on the bag. Any ideas to get the marks out with out damage would be appreciated. I also keep loosing out on the deals I.e Snowflake charm…A heads up for your loyal customers would be appreciated. Thanks

records.title: The perfect bags!
records.text: The perfect bags! I love my pink  Plus purse & purchased Mayfair Minis as Christmas gifts for my 12 year old twin daughters. Beautiful quality and great value for the money, even when not on sale (though I bought ours at a good discount). Shipping was fast and delivery without issue. The one thing I don’t absolutely love is the monogramming - it’s hard to make out & my initials (as an example) look like they spell BAG when they are actually EAG. However, personalization was free during the sale, so I feel like I can’t complain too much about that - and maybe it will wear in such a way over time that it’s clearer to make out.

records.title: Quick delivery
records.text: Quick delivery, well packaged. Unfortunately one free gift of card wallet, was sent wrong, coin wallet sent instead. Still not received replacement after 2 weeks

records.title: Good product, fast shipping, misleading offer
records.text: Shipping was quick. The quality of the bags seem good so far. They advertise on their website banner that you can choose a bag, get 2 free straps and $100 off, but this is not actually the case. The promo code for this doesn't work (I've put in two different orders on two different dates).  I emailed customer support and basically the two "free" straps and "key ring" (ie the pom pom or tassel bag decoration) is the equivalent of $71 in value. So not a $100 discount, and I would say a misleading advertisement in their banner, and it's intended to create a sense of urgency in the buyer. I would prefer they were more up front about the promo - that if you order a cross body bag, you get two free straps, and that is an every day, standard offer.They just ship the stuffed bags in a dust bag and then into a plastic UPS bag. My bags did arrive unharmed, but I think that's not a lot of protection for the cross-continental journey.

records.title: The "Mayfair" handbag
records.text: I bought the "Mayfair" handbag. I love it because it is a not a big bag but is deceptively small. It's way more spacious than it looks & can take in a fair bit. The leather quality is very good. The delivery was quick. If there is one thing that I would want different is the bag is heavier than other leather bags I have. Wish it was a bit lighter.

records.title: Pom Pom for Australia
records.text: Great experience once I had an assistant helping me. Have bought 3 lovely bags now for my family in Australia. Two have got there by post ready for Christmas. The problem I have is when I want to pay on a UK credit card but as the delivery address is in Australia the price defaults to  dollars. On-line this can’t be over ridden so I required help by phone and had to read out my order. Thanks for the help.

records.title: Lovely products
records.text: Lovely products, good quality, and good customer service.Would have given 5 stars but...stock can be an issue! I had a birthday treat and then it was Black Friday so I struggled to get the bag I truly wanted with the straps I truly wanted...and my treat was subsumed into BF deals. I'm happy with my bag but it was my third choice.

records.title: Lovely mocha mayfair
records.text: Lovely bags. Have the Mayfair in suede mocha and it's lovely. Good for anytime of year. Wasn't keen on the gold chain strap that it comes with as very heavy so sent back one of my fabric straps and exchanged for the gold and silver chain which is lighter and goes well with the colour. Good service.

records.title: I had been looking at this bag for a…
records.text: I had been looking at this bag for a while & did purchase one & am so delighted with my choice. The quality & size is perfect, holds everything necessary for a day/night out.Will use it on holiday & it will be a lovely addition . I intend to purchase another one.

records.title: Great quality
records.text: Quick service, great quality bag. Plastic bag it was delivered in was damaged on arrival

records.title: very very happy with this bag i can fit…
records.text: very very happy with this bag i can fit so much into this bag and yet it is compact i personally don't use the long straps so i ordered a small chain from amazon and it is a small grab bag which i prefer.. was disappointed with the debossing because it wasn't noticeable so i ordered angleus leather paint and worked fine! personally on black handbags it should've  been embossed in gold anyway

records.title: Beautiful bag
records.text: I opted for the crocodile skin burgundy Mayfair plus. It's really nice. Plenty room inside and the outside compartments plus the small pocket on back. Only thing I found ot was a lot firmer than the ordinary leather Mayfair or London city bags. The zips are a little harder to open so I'm hoping it gets a little freezer with use. Very classy looking bag

records.title: I couldn’t believe just how beautiful &…
records.text: I couldn’t believe just how beautiful & perfect my new Pom Pom handbag was when it arrived at my home. I love it. Many friends have complimented me on my new handbag and have asked me where I bought it, and, of course, I’ve told them.

records.title: Beautiful high quality bag
records.text: Beautiful high quality bag. It came quickly. However, it was couriered to me in a rolled up dusty plastic courier bag.  Although inside it was contained in a Pom Pom dustcover, it kind of spoiled the unboxing of this fancy product not having it arriving in a nice box.

records.title: Prompt service, great bag
records.text: It's always hard buying bags online, but Pom Pom has a good user community to help out.  The bag arrived promptly, the colour was as described and the bag is good quality, exactly the size I needed.  The only reason I'm giving this 4 stars is that I wish they'd made it clear that the particular bag I ordered had a hard base.  Apart from that, experience was great.

records.title: Lovely Product
records.text: I actually found the website and the pictures could have been more helpful needed more pictures and better pictures of the product. Product really lovely when it finally arrived

records.title: Advertising
records.text: When ordering said sale ends in 2 days but yet 2 months later same sale is still on.

records.title: I thought I had ordered the larger bag…
records.text: I thought I had ordered the larger bag as before but sadly not, I kept it, but not as good.

records.title: The City Plus bag looks great but....
records.text: The City Plus bag looks great, fits everything I need in it & love the interchangeable straps, however after 2 months of use, not every day, the navy colour of the  leather is rubbing off, which I am disappointed about as it's on the front of the bag. So starting to look shabby.

records.title: I bought this bag for my sister as a…
records.text: I bought this bag for my sister as a present, she wants something from London, saw the website of this Company info, bags made and designed in UK, when I received the bag I like the bag but looked inside there's a tag "made in China" I was disappointed 😞 my sister is from China!!

records.title: No protective dust bag
records.text: Ordered the Sloane bag in the sale. Happy with the bag, but not the packaging. Contacted Pompom to inform them that no protective dust bag was included (their website said it would be included). The response I received was that sorry no protective bag big enough.
