Not the customer service I expected and still waiting for a response from them to my reply!!!!!

records.title: Beautiful bag but quality of leather questionable
records.text: Arrived promptly. Beautiful bag as expected. Straps good quality. Straps a little thinner in width than previous bag of different brand, have to admit prefer straps wider. This is my preference though. Sadly after 9 days of use the bottom edges have worn away! Concerns with quality of leather and workmanship. Contacted PomPom via email and replied within 24 hrs with postage return for bag to be inspected. Pleasing customer services so far. Bag returned and awaiting response. Wear after 9 days highly unexpected from regular working mum of 2.

records.title: On the fence at present
records.text: 3 stars at the moment.  Item arrived and pleased with bag:  However, one of the straps was nothing like the colour image on the website, I returned for an exchange paying the postage myself.  I was then presented with £4 charge before the ‘free’ exchange could be shipped.  I have looked in their website and the returns form and cannot see any mention of a £4 charge.  They do say that exchanges will be sent free of charge.  I am awaiting a response and will amend the stars one way or another depending upon what he outcome

records.title: Not a true colour and bad straps
records.text: The bag was nice, although the colour (nude) was not as pink as depicted in the pictures. Much more of a beige than a pink. Also the straps were not great quality. I got a rainbow one and the design is one sided, so the other side (obviously very visible) is plain and it feels fairly thin and not very comfy on your shoulder. I'm not sending it back as it was a "deal" with the straps, I'll just have to find better quality straps elsewhere. So not overly impressed, but the packaging and delivery was good.

records.title: I've previously had a great experience…
records.text: I've previously had a great experience but my last experience hasn't been great otherwise I would have rated a 5*.The bag I ordered last week was for a birthday present and it didn't arrive on 31 May. I spoke to Customer Services on Monday 3rd June and they have refund my postage back but I've not even had a follow up email to state you are looking into this or if you have any further update.I do hope the bag arrives, as it was the Mayfair Cornflower blue bag which is now out of stock again.

records.title: The product is amazing but be careful…
records.text: The product is amazing but be careful of the return policy if you're thinking of returning something. The shipping is on the buyer! If you live outside the UK, it's VERY expensive to send something back. I live in the US and shipping of my unwanted item was $150 for a $65 item! Even them offering to give me their shipping rate of $27 USD, I'm better off keeping it.

records.title: I love pompom bags and have several
records.text: I love pompom bags and have several. I recently brought two more and unfortunately on the first outing a zipper fell off. I have emailed with photos but no response. Shame as before this I was 100% satisfied returning customer

records.title: Disappointed but now resolved
records.text: I bought the Jubilee special edition bag in May this year. At the time I was very pleased with it. Since May I have only used it once as wanted to keep it for special occasions. I have kept it in it's pink cotton bag it came in. However, I decided to use it for the second time few days ago, and was disappointed to find the front of the bag has puckered and bubbled. It looks and feels as if the leather is going to peel away!  I have contacted Pom Pom but received no reply. UPDATE 01/12/22 PomPom have contacted me and resolved the situation. Their customer service has been excellent! My faith in them has been restored. Thank you PomPom.

records.title: Beautiful bag, but…
records.text: The bag that I purchased was beautiful and of a high quality. It was a gift for a friend, but unfortunately, the colour wasn’t quite right. I therefore decided to return and replace it. So to speed things up I purchased another bag before returning the original.  However, the refund policy didn’t state that there was an ‘online portal’ that could be used for returns/exchanges via WhatsApp. This would have been helpful had it been in the refund policy, as it gave the option of a refund or exchange and the opportunity of using a QR code to return the bag. I did  use this, but I ended up spending more money on the second bag than I needed, as the online portal gave me a full credit, allowing for the new customer discount that was originally applied. Disappointed.

records.title: Great bag, bad delivery
records.text: Great product and no issues with the bag at all- now my second and love it! Paid for next day delivery and bag didn’t arrive for 5 days- messaged the customer service team but didn’t get a response as to the location of my bag.

records.title: Product gets 5 🌟
records.text: Product gets 5 🌟. Customer service gets 3 bc of slow response time between US and UK as well as the return/exchange shipping cost. 1st bag ordered was different color than pictured. Shipping time was excellent though! I will order another bag in the near future and so will my friends, bc the product quality is great. 😁

records.title: Beautiful but …
records.text: Ordered the tan city bag and it arrived so quickly in the states and was beautifully made. Sadly it was just overwhelming on my petite frame … not just the size of the bag itself (which I know .. I had the measurements but thought it would work) but the width of the guitar straps. I hope you consider guitar straps that aren’t quite so wide in the future.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: I purchased a city bag last year. After 7 months of infrequent use the top zipper broke. Because the warranty is good for one year, they quickly replaced the bag. However, the bag I received was poorly shipped and the tassel was completely twisted and misshapen. But more importantly I noticed the quality of the leather was not nearly as good as my first bag. They claimed no changes were made but it was a significant difference. Maybe it was a returned or rejected item because it was a replacement. Regardless, I will not be purchasing from them again.

records.title: Shame about ugly branding patches
records.text: My bag is nice enough but this year’s fun spring colours all have this really ugly branding patch on them really prominently. So disappointing to be limited to only buying ones without this cheapening edition. I know there are lots of bags of this style out there, so they want to distinguish, but for me adding this is a big mistake for the brand. Could easily be added subtly to the side of the bag.

records.title: Recommend Mayfair bags, not Lambeth
records.text: I bought two Mayfair bags and was 100% pleased with the exceptional quality of both the purses and the straps. This positive experience prompted me to order a Lambeth bag. The leather on the Lambeth bag is so thin that the top droops. While I can highly recommend the Mayfair bags and the beautiful straps, I do not recommend the Lambeth bag. Plus it is smaller than it appears in the pictures so if you do order a Lambeth bag, make sure to check the measurements.

records.title: No stock
records.text: The bag my girlfriend wanted was out of stock, despite the fact it was advertised in a Christmas brochure she had just received. She chose another one, but it was also out of stock, so had to settle for a third choice in a different colour and style. The two straps she wanted were also out of stock. Very poor.

records.title: Bags darker then shown in pictures.
records.text: Bought two bags, both have arrived and are much darker then the pictures show.reached out to the company who took a day to reply as advised, but when they replied they said they could send some pictures to show how versatile the bag is, said ok, took another to send pictures and they were just pictures from the website that i had already seen, so feel like they've taken me for a mug a little bit.Giving two stars because the quality of the bags is really high, got them both engraved but its hard to make out on both bags.

records.title: Absolutely not what I expected
records.text: Absolutely not what I expected, my bag arrived with the bag torn open. And once I looked at everything I am so disappointed. Leather looks like it's plastic, gold hardware looks cheap. Not a fan of the bag straps at all, makes the bag look even cheaper. The size is great bought the city plus, but so disappointed with this purchase. I will not purchase again. On the plus side bag arrived quickly.

records.title: Honest review after six months
records.text: I was initially happy with grey my city bag, but after six months, the grey colour has faded and looks ugly and used for years. The zip keeps getting caught. I’m very surprised that the quality is so low, the way the fabric gets damaged is the same as cheap fake leather goods. I don’t think this bag is worth the money. I should have just kept the money and invested in something better…I like the idea of having different straps although the default one is too long for short people.

records.title: Pricey bags…
records.text: I’m sad to say I’m not a huge fan of their bags …as I had one bag (the bigger sized one…)replaced as the zip broke (& the personalised embossing wore off v quickly…) & now the replacement has failed …. These bags are not cheap & TBH there are many other companies selling leather bags that are the same..I won’t buy from them again ..

records.title: Not entirely happy with quality or cusotmer service
records.text: Ordered a Mayfair Lattice Bag as a gift for someone and paid £9 for next day delivery.  Goods received on time but the quality is lacking.  The "PomPom London" label on the front of the bag is all wonky and not even centred.  I have submitted two requests via the website and not heard back from anyone. Have tried to call today and got a mesage saying nobody is available to take my call .....

records.title: Astonishingly bad service
records.text: Ordered navy bumbag after seeing Instagram advertisement saying all bags come with 2 free straps & coin purse.  Bag arrived without free straps or coin purse.Emailed company to advise & got response saying if you’re not happy with purchase, return it for a refund! Astonishingly bad service!

records.title: Pom Pom bags just don't last!
records.text: Sorry but these bags just don't last!! All the buckles have tarnished and pom pom fallen apart. I just dont understand how it can cost so much and be made with such poor materials. My husband got me the bag Christmas 2023 and I really didn't expect it to degrade this quickly. I personally would never recommend these bags to anyone.

records.title: Sorry love the bags BUT RETURNS SLOW
records.text: Sorry love the bags , but I returned two and its been over a week since I posted and went through the process of return, they still have NOT arrived at the depot so I cant get a refund, so this process will have taken over two and a half weeks... I thought that "going through the process" of return on your web site would speed up the returns business, instead it appears to have slowed it down

records.title: Quality disappointing
records.text: I purchased a London city mini bag and loved it immediately. Unfortunately the hardware on one of the zips fell apart almost immediately. Customer service sent a replacement which was great. I was very happy for a few months but then the leather on the front of the bag started peeling, I've had the bag less than a year now and it looks pretty rough. Overall seems like the quality just isn't there, disappointing as I was hoping to get another bag or two but now will not bother.

description:
Welcome to Stashy Scrunchie. We are a small but passionate scrunchie brand focusing on helping women with our useful and unique products! 

We hope to share our passion and love of scrunchies with you and of course be there if you have any issues or questions.

records.title: Fab product
records.text: Fab product, great quality and swift delivery even the week before Christmas .Great packaging and like supporting a small business.They email when you subscribe but don't overload you which I REALLY like as that's rare.It's a big thumbs up from me especially for the anti spiking cover for my 18 yr old 👏

records.title: Fantastic product for kids and adults
records.text: Really great product for both kids and adults. High quality and hold the hair back really well (no slipping!) even when doing sports. Good product for all age ranges so a perfect gift idea and a good idea to buy in bulk so you have a few colours. Packaging that the parcel is delivered in is really lovely and customer service is brilliant. Highly recommend

records.title: Great idea for safety on nights out
records.text: I bought scrunchies & glass toppers for 3 family members for Christmas. Great idea to keep them safe, when out drinking.

records.title: Xmas present for nieces
records.text: Purchased some for my nieces. They arrived in good time and I liked the colours. As someone else has mentioned, I thought the inside of the zip would have been a bit more like a pouch but it’s just an opening and you see the elastic inside. But the girls seemed to like them so I’m happy. Something a bit different.

records.title: Super scrunchies!!! ❤️
records.text: I think it’s such a great idea to have a scrunchie that can hold something like a house key or money. Perfect for teenagers! And the drink cover was also a hit!!! The patterns were a great success! I would definitely recommend! Thank you!

records.title: Bought them for my daughters
records.text: Bought them for my daughters, they love them. Great for putting your door key in when running and storing the anti spiking glass cover when going out. Great idea

records.title: Easy transaction
records.text: Easy transaction. Great quality product. Would definitely recommend. Thank you.

records.title: Fast postage and the wife absolutely…
records.text: Fast postage and the wife absolutely loved the stashy scrunchies. She had seen them online and now she has a couple to use. Will definitely come back for more

records.title: Great items - Exactly as described
records.text: Great items. Pefect for the stocking top up and really useful already. Thanks

records.title: Great idea to keep people safe I…
records.text: Great idea to keep people safe I purchased for my daughter & niece

records.title: A clever idea
records.text: Ordering easy, product arrived promptly.  The idea of the zip in a scrunchy is a clever idea, for keys, lip balm etc, perhaps whilst out for a run, or a quick walk and suchlike, when you dont want to take a full bag. The colours are great too, Dark Green and Plum, look lovely.These are gifts so cannot comment on how useful they actually are.  But I am hoping that they work out to be very useful.

records.title: Thought I’d ordered 8 scrunchies
records.text: Thought I’d ordered 8 scrunchies, with the anti spiking covers. Received the covers but no scrunchies. Although pleased with my order I feel the advertising needs to be clearer.

records.title: Perfect …
records.text: I have bought a few as stocking fillers for my children and in-laws.They are just a scrunchy, but with a very good hidden zip, I love the fact you can put your key in or some cash, or your favourite lippy. I plan on buying more for my colleagues at work.

records.title: Great scrunchies!
records.text: These scrunchies are such a great idea! The patterns are great and the elastic works really well; they do both functions excellently (staying in my hair/staying zipped up). As well as choosing some scrunchies, I also chose a mystery box. I was pleased that this contained no double ups, a waterproof one and a Halloween one. I discovered that the waterproof one is more "showerproof" than "waterproof" as the inside will get wet - it will hold up in the rain but I wouldn't recommend swimming in it (this is fine for me but other buyers might want to know). The Halloween one did also have some loose threads and start pulling a little bit but I tied them off so it's fine now. I am still incredibly happy with my purchases and think they're a great price. I will definitely be ordering from here again!

records.title: Received eventually
records.text: I never got my item checked my mail my door every day and didn't get it EDIT: After reaching out to the company I did receive my product a whole month passed since I ordered but I'm sure it doesn't take that long typically and I am happy with it two scrunchies and a cover can't wait to use them. If you need help with ur order the company will help you 100% :)

records.title: Recommend them apart from the waterproof ones
records.text: Happy with most of my Stashy Scrunchies, they are cute and practical! The exception being the waterproof one. I wore it for half an hour, and not even in water, and the pink colour and coating is already peeling in many places onto the underlying mesh.Other than the waterproof one, I would recommend them!

records.title: They are really nice scrunchies
records.text: They are really nice scrunchies, and dont easily come loose out of your hair. I got 3 types, a velvet black, and silky pink and a white leathery kind of material. I liked the black and pink but I wouldnt choose to buy the white one, it reminds me of cheap faux leather sofa material

records.title: Excellent idea
records.text: Excellent idea, I always have an elastic round my wrist for instantly tying  my hair back, and I thought this was brilliant for that purpose or to keep round the wrist with a key or money in. I also wanted to support a small business. The item came quickly, well made, the zip good, but I think it's a bit small, the elastic inside makes it snug around my wrist (and I have thin wrists!) although one of the 3 scrunchies I'd ordered seemed a bit looser. So I'd say, maybe a tiny bit more "give" in the elastic would be more comfy!

records.title: Overall good product
records.text: Overall great experience purchasing three Stashy Scrunchies. After I paid they did double charge my account, but the refund automatically came through later in the week thankfully. They delivered fast and look great! I would probably only hide a key or chapstick inside if you were to use it in your hair and not on your wrist due to weight and it's ability to stretch and hold your hair, but great idea for women!

records.title: Great products! Just a recommendation Xx
records.text: The scrunchies were very well packaged, were quick at arriving and seem to be excellent quality. I’m very pleased with my order though I would request a detachable feature of some sort (perhaps a small button?) for the drink protector schrunchie, as on a night out when I am mostly drinking, my glass tends to wear it more than I do, still a fantastic product though. I feel much safer when drinking in public now Xx

records.title: Almost there
records.text: They've finally replied and my second subscription is on the way. Not full stars yet because now when I try to reactivate my subscription, it keeps popping up errors. So that needs fixing but I'm sure it's a small issue. I'll update to 5 stats when that's resolved.

records.title: Great buying experience, product needs improving…
records.text: The buying and shipping process was fine. My problem was with the product. I was expecting a designated pocket area inside the scrunchie. Instead all I saw was the inside of the scrunchie including a crudely tied elastic. I was under the impression that there would be a lined pocket inside the band but instead it's just all open and items are free to migrate all around the inside. I definitely feel that this product has a great idea but could be improved on in the future.

records.title: Cute and sturdy
records.text: Super cute and they hold my long, thin, straight hair! The only thing I had a slight issue with is the zipper clasp gets caught in my hair & the brown waterproof scrunchie looks cheap but works well when used to wrap my hair around it.

records.title: Please make a bigger size option
records.text: Please make a bigger size option! I bought one for myself, one for my 20 year old daughter and an anti spiking one for her friend who goes out a lot clubbing. The anti spiking one is great. The regular scrunchies are good quality especially the zip but I ended up not really using mine because, for me personally, it just needs to be bigger to be useful, one key is fine but you have to take it off your split ring, so add in a £20 note and a lip balm and it’s tricky. It can’t be used as a scrunchie if it has a key in too…I love the anti spiking one but I haven’t used the regular ones; I just use a very small bag.

records.title: Pretty cool product
records.text: Great quality actually. Was surprised the zipper and the little grip that hangs off the zipper were way smaller and more hidden than they looked in the pictures. Awesome product! Would love to see like an XL Stash Scrunchie though, one that looks like those poofier scrunchies so you can store more in or even a little bit bigger products. Like you can store a vape in these ones but you can super tell something is in there. Love the product though, fast shipping as well!

records.title: After a bit of confusion on addresses…
records.text: After a bit of confusion on addresses and lost deliveries they quickly addressed the problem and I received exactly what I was wanting. I held off for many months ordering, finally did, and very impressed with the product.

records.title: I would have given it 5 stars if I…
records.text: I would have given it 5 stars if I would have received the free one like stated in the advertisement if you purchase 2 (which I did), you get one free (which I did not).  So that was a little off putting. Other than that, I love the Stashy Scrunchie. My sister and I used the cup cover this past weekend.

records.title: Quick shipment and scrunchies are good…
records.text: Quick shipment and scrunchies are good quality. The only disappointment I have is that 2 out of the 3 scrunchies I bought have a white zipper lining so it shows up and is obvious. The pink scrunchie I got has a colour-matched zip so blends in nicely. I think you need to make the effort to have zippers that match the colours of all scrunchies - or make it clear that some of them are white and so show up more.

records.title: Great scrunchies but not easy to cancel…
records.text: Great scrunchies but not easy to cancel the subscription BUT when finally managed to cancel ( through email ) I was refunded, so great service and I took one star away because it took a while until the t was finally sorted

records.title: Noice!  But go bigger :-)
records.text: I found this company through a Facebook story advert and was enticed to spin the wheel which won me a free scrunchie!  I only had to pay for postage.  I chose the scarf scrunchie and I actually really like it.  It arrived quickly with good comms and looks nice.  My only reason for not giving 5 stars is that it's a bit smaller than I would have expected.  This isn't a problem ergonomically for me as I have thin hair, but aesthetically you buy a scrunchie for it to be noticeable and part of your "look" - if you not can just use a hair elastic.  So I like the product, but please make it a bit more physically bold in the next redesign.  I would buy from this company again.

records.title: Not good product
records.text: Not good arrived asp but product not good scrunchies poor quality Zip yes but no linning so you can see the elastic inside These are not a quality product I purchased the mystery box of 3 and nit even worth that price Good idea just not well made and his passion no .Even there reply is robot .Quality is there priority .apparently

records.title: I recently decided to support smaller…
records.text: I recently decided to support smaller businesses like Stashy Scrunchie and ordered a couple of their products. They offer some unique designs, and the quality seems good. I tried their lucky dip, which included a variety of scrunchies, and they were delivered quickly. While I appreciate the effort to use quality materials and unique patterns, I'm not completely blown away but they're certainly decent. Overall, it's a satisfactory purchase, and I might consider buying from them again, especially to support a small business.

records.title: anti spike scrunches not in sub box
records.text: I paid for the subscription box and I am disappointed. I subscribed as the anti spiking scrunchie is advertised everywhere but I can't justify paying £8 for it but, it's clear to me that they will never put that scrunchie in the subscription box so, I'm going to have to pay £8 for it.I've been getting the subscription box since about 3 or 4 months ago. I am extreamly annoyed with the fact that now it's sent in plastic and not cardboard.  I only subscribed as I supported this guys business but to rely on your sales by advertising only the anti spiking scrunchie is abit of a let down having never received one in a subscription box for a brand that pushes its one of the only brands in the uk to offer anti spike but it isn't even an option in the subscription box.

records.title: Don't get the original stashy scrunchie…
records.text: Don't get the original stashy scrunchie which is what I thought would be in the subscription box.

records.title: Scrunchie, not Stashy
records.text: Liked the scrunchie, not the stashy.I got the black satin Stashy Scrunchie and I enjoy using it to put my hair up, but it's not sturdy enough or big enough to really hold anything while being worn. Even around my wrist, a couple keys were clearly visible inside the scrunchie and pulled it down uncomfortably. I think a thicker brocade or velvet might improve the functionality but overall it seems a bit gimmicky to me for now.

records.title: Customer service takes forever to…
records.text: Customer service takes forever to reply… order took longer than expected to arrive and reply was dry, no apology for not responding right away or that arrived way past expected time. Scrunchies are nice but didnt think the inside would be visible and could easy come undone. Shall see how long they hold. Ordered 12/27 and arrived 1/13

records.title: Not overly impressed
records.text: Not overly impressed, great idea though, but the cap-it one is very small barely fits a gin glass (due to glass shape) quite a struggle to get it on without your drink going everywhere

records.title: Good quality scrunchies but very…
records.text: Good quality scrunchies but very disappointed that every single one of them was wrapped in individual plastic bags and then the outside packaging was plastic too. Nowadays, we should switch to paper or other alternatives,not  to use plastic and so much of it in one parcel!  This is the only reason I won't buy them again.

records.title: Customer service needs help, scrunchies overall are nice
records.text: The scrunchies overall are nice, the drink cover does the job and is light weight so it doesn’t drag the scrunchie down on one end if you fan it out.Customer service can use some improvement. Part of my order was missing because I had ordered 2 of the same item, human error I get it. However, it took 5 business days to get a response. 48-72 hours I get it, 5 days is a bit long

records.title: Nice product but overpriced
records.text: Two of the scrunchies ordered are well made, have your logo on and were individually wrapped. The third one in my opinion is not as well made, the zip doesn’t lay as discreetly as the others (possibly due to choice of fabric), it has no company logo sewn in and didn’t come individually wrapped. It makes it seem like the free one was a reject! Slightly overpriced for overall quality.

records.title: Good product, customer service isn’t great
records.text: I really like the product but have been disappointed by the customer service. I order 10 stash scrunchies and only 4 arrived. I have reached out twice requesting updates on the missing items and still haven’t heard back from them.

records.title: I was disappointed the scrunchie didn't…
records.text: I was disappointed the scrunchie didn't have a zip .. the hole was very small and the cap was attached to the scrunchie by another piece of elastic .. I definatly could have made this product myself .. not good enough quality to give as a gift!!

records.title: Great products, took a while to receive them
records.text: Initially, they took my money, didn’t deliver the product, and ignored multiple attempts at communication.However, they explained that their email system was struggling, and sent me more product than I had ordered as apology. I would give them 3 stars as it took months for this to be sorted, but they did come through in the end. And the products were great when I received them.

records.title: Cool concept but more realistic to just…
records.text: Cool concept but more realistic to just wear on wrist and not put in hair as the zipper itself is hard and pulls hair when in it.  Was expecting zipper to be smaller and delicate so it didn't do that.

records.title: We love the quality and the creativity
records.text: We love the quality and the creativity, but we use to get 3, now we only get two and it was disappointing for us. The cost is still good but I lost my job recently and will be cancelling.

records.title: I love the scrunchies themselves
records.text: I love the scrunchies themselves, great material and well made. My problem is I have to wrap them two to three times and therein lies my problem… I would only be able to keep a few dollar bills in it, no keys or lip balm.

records.title: The value is good
records.text: The value is good. So is the customer support. I liked the scrunchies I got but the waterproof ones were much bigger and not as cute as the other options. Also, there isn't much room in the stash pouch but even just a key felt like it looked and felt weird. It's not for me but I think it's a cool idea and they were high quality for the price.

records.title: Pockets  are too small for anything…
records.text: Pockets  are too small for anything showed in their advertising. Sent an email for fabric content never got a response.

records.title: Great product and lovely scrunchies but…
records.text: Great product and lovely scrunchies but one of mine turned up with a lot of loose threads. It was intended as a gift but unfortunately I cannot use it now. The other items that arrived were lovely and good quality.

records.title: It took to long
records.text: I haven’t received my order I place over 2-3 weeks ago. I was told it was on its way but still haven’t got it. 😡   I finally received my order and am very happy with my scrunchies. The waterproof one is a bit balky, but it’s still cool. I just don’t like how long it took. Over all if I knew I was getting an order in a reasonable time I’d order again.

records.title: Have to order scrunchie separate
records.text: I ordered the drink covers but didn’t realise I had to order the scrunchie separate. So now they have the covers but no scrunchie.

records.title: Ordering and product was fine until it…
records.text: Ordering and product was fine until it wasn't. I try to place a second order recently, and their website wouldn't allow shipping to my address, which makes no sense by the way. Additionally I finally started using them as my hair has finally grown long enough, and within a couple uses they are already coming apart at the seams. I've reached out to you their customer service for both issues via email and Facebook, and no response. I love the concept, product needs better sewing, customer service is non existent.

records.title: Too Small and Airtag Dies Quickly
records.text: Too Small and Airtag Dies QuicklyI got two regular and one tracking stashy scrunchie. Unfortunately the scrunchies are too small for a credit card or DL (it's very obvious something's in there). Additionally the airtag for the tracking scrunchy had a low battery after only a few days of use.Shipping costs to return these are half what I paid (plus the aggravation of USPS) so they're not easily returnable. Really disappointing for me.There doesn't seem to be a review option on their site, either, so I'm leaving one here.

records.title: Still haven’t received order
records.text: I ordered a mystery pack A month ago and it still has not been delivered. I received a confirmation email and an email saying my package was on the way but have not gotten any tracking numbers or Shipping confirmations. It is slightly frustrating knowing that I also purchased a subscription box for three months and haven’t even received my first box

records.title: Wasn’t what I expected
records.text: Wasn’t what I expected. Didn’t get the drink covers like I thought I’d be getting by the ad for the mystery scrunchies. But they are fine, they are just a basic scrunchie nothing special. One is leather though and garbage to actually use in your hair unless you want ripped out hair

records.title: Not worth it
records.text: Not worth it, sadly. Cute idea, but I wasn't pleased on the quality for the price, plus there were stray threads, and the zip often tangles in my hair - I'd hoped it would be neatly tucked in/less obvious. The scrunchie also often slips out of my hair, but if I made it tighter, it would pull on hairs and damage them.  Delivery took longer than I expected, too. Feels like a cute gimmick, but they're asking too much for the quality they're offering.

records.title: It’s a cool idea but I thought based on…
records.text: It’s a cool idea but I thought based on the marketing scheme the scrunchy would have a zip “pocket” instead scrunchy just zips open & whatever you put in it moves around the circumference of it. They are also quite small & the fabric is way cheaper than I expected for the price.

records.title: I used the code buy 2 get one free I…
records.text: I used the code buy 2 get one free I ensured there was 3 somehow one deleted and I only received 2 I reached out and was told I could place another order and could buy 2 get 1 free but I don’t need more. I bought them as gifts and I am now down one. Honestly they are bulkier than a standard scrunchie as well so overall not a great experience. Cool idea but one be buying again. Don’t remember exact date of purchase so selected todays it was a few weeks ago. Money is short so this deal was an incentive to make the purchase.

records.title: Customer service non existent
records.text: Wanting to return items as they’re not what I was expecting (need a larger pocket to hold my car key than this product provides). There is no phone number you can call, I have emailed and had no reply, I have filled out an online form on their website with no reply. This isn’t good enough customer service. I will be sending the product back regardless and hopefully receive a refund.

records.title: Wrong item received, no response from seller
records.text: I really like the scrunchies however I ordered 3 different colours and one of them was not the colour I had ordered. Been trying to contact the seller via email and social media to have the correct colour sent out to me and have had 0 response from them and it’s been almost 2 weeks now. Disappointing as it’s a relatively small issue but with a lack of response for something that minor that could be resolved quickly I would probably not order from them again.

description:
We began trading 30 years ago, and now have a high street store Trowbridge.

This online store first opened in 2006 and offers the same genuine, top branded footwear found in our stores, at competitive prices. This site is produced in-house to keep it fully up to date and to display new ranges as soon as they become available.

records.title: Grood Service and Reasonable Prices
records.text: Bought a pair of Hoka walking shoes from Mastershoe, one of the very few places which had any stock of wide fitting in my size, and at a bit of a discount price. Everything went as expected, had no issues at all.

records.title: First time user……/
records.text: First time user……/Very fast and efficient service Extremely impressed, will definitely use again and would happily recommend to anyone else who is interested. 💯

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: My first purchase from this company and wow! Amazing customer service, speedy response to a query I had and the correct information provided so my query was resolved efficiently. Very impressed

records.title: Excellent experience
records.text: Excellent experience: full range of half-sizes in stock; supplied exactly what I ordered and it arrived when expected. Very good price, too. Happy 👍

records.title: In her Good books.
records.text: Bought these Fly Boots for my partner, great price and very fast delivery My partner loves them,I'm in her good books.😃

records.title: Brilliant pair of walking shoes  as…
records.text: Brilliant pair of walking shoes  as described super fast delivery 5 stars Thank You 👍

records.title: Really efficient service and great…
records.text: Really efficient service and great prices! Arrived very quickly after ordering and shoes were perfect. Thank you!

records.title: Excellent customer service experience
records.text: Excellent customer service experience, quality of leather and suede is exceptional and I will be going back for more boots soon! My new favourite place for boots!

records.title: Fantastic service
records.text: Brilliant company with fantastic service. I bought a pair of Grisport walking boots from Mastershoe earlier this year - excellent website, great price, fast delivery etc.Very comfortable boots which I wore every day to take our dog for a walk. I contacted Mastershoe about a problem with the boots. They were fantastic, paid for return postage and replaced the boots (arrived this morning). Great communication and fantastic service too. Thank you Mastershoe. Happy Christmas.

records.title: Mastershoe has a great range of boots…
records.text: Mastershoe has a great range of boots to choose from. I found the perfect ones for me at a good price.The ordering process was easy and straightforward. My new boots arrived promptly and in perfect order.They fit perfectly and I am very happy with my purchase.  Thank you Mastershoe

records.title: Great service from Mastershoe
records.text: Great service from Mastershoe, shoes arrived in the estimated delivery time. Unfortunately they were the wrong size, so had to return them which cost about £5, hence the 4 stars. But great for initial cost and delivery and lots of updates on the order.

records.title: Service was good
records.text: I ordered some Hoka Speedgoat Trainers, they were extremely competitively priced which was my main motivation in purchasing from Mastershoe for the first time.All was fine with ordering, delivery etc. unfortunately the item came up extremely small & I had to return it, as they were incredibly undersized I was reluctant to order a further size as you have to pay for returns with Mastershoe & that could come out pretty expensive in returns if you’re not careful. Delivery was free as the item purchased was over a certain amount but having to pay for returns isn’t great, sort of makes the ordering online process not great for something you’re unsure of. I normally buy with free returns but felt confident the shoe would fit after doing research & checking Hoka fit service etc. consequently I wouldn’t use Mastershoe again but they did my refund in a timely manner so can’t complain on the service front.

records.title: Master shoe  - a good service, so far
records.text: Master shoe was the only company that provided the right size in wide fit. Initially it did feel larger as suggested in the advertising but once a custom insole was put in all feels fine.It doesn’t either look or feel the quality of the previous shoes of Thai origin (these are made in India) but I can only comment really after the practical life of the shoe - so vote on longevity and quality is still out.Happy so far

records.title: Beautiful boots but narrow in the foot
records.text: The customer service was excellent and it was easy to return my boots when I found out that they did not fit properly. However these Boots were quite narrow in the foot and I feel this could have been pointed out when they were posted for sale. The boots themselves were beautiful, good quality genuine leather and suede and they looked gorgeous. The pair of boots I had been looking for for years but unfortunately they did not fit.

records.title: Faulty boots
records.text: Prompt delivery,but unfortunately there was a defect with the boots.Called customer services and spoke to a very nice guy,problem was dealt with very quickly and a refund issued,very efficient service.

records.title: Very accurate and correct.
records.text: Very accurate and correct.My order was shipped on time ,carefully packed

records.title: Good service
records.text: Good selection and service.

records.title: I actually wanted a different shoe

Welcome to Savana, where the spirit roams free and the heart beats wild. Inspired by the wild spirit of the Savannah, our brand celebrates diversity, individuality, and endless possibilities. We're more than just a clothing line; we're a sanctuary for the daring, the dreamers, and the fiercely independent souls. 

From college campuses to city streets, we've got your back, providing the perfect pieces for your eclectic tastes and thirst for adventure. Online all day? You'll find styles inspired by the hottest social media trends, empowering you to dress for the adventure of everyday life in clothes that don't break the bank.

description:
Go Thrift – Where Sustainability Meets Affordability!

At Go Thrift, we're on a mission to provide a more sustainable and affordable way of shopping for clothes online. We firmly believe that the fusion of sustainability and affordability empowers us to build a society capable of reversing the fast fashion mindset, making mindful choices for a better world.
No Stitch Left Unchecked:
Ditching the stigma of second-hand clothes, our curated collection comes with a quality guarantee. With every piece arriving as described at prices that make sense, we've earned the trust of our customers through the Go Thrift seal of approval.

With quality pieces you can trust from brands like Carhartt, Levi's, Tommy Hilfiger, Ralph Lauren, Adidas, Nike, and more, we welcome you to a more mindful way of shopping, free from the pressures and pace of fast fashion.

Positive change requires conscious thought and action. Just by being here, you're already contributing!

Explore our collections and join us on this journey towards a more sustainable and stylish future.

description: Here at BrandAlley, you’ll find up to 80% off your favourite labels in clothing, footwear, accessories, homeware and beauty every single day of the year.

Thankyou Shannon you saved the day ,I am very grateful .Twice I have needed to contact Brand Alley Customer Services and each time has been an excellent result . Thankyou so much .

records.title: Great retailer
records.text: I have purchased multiple items from BrandAlley over the last few years. They offer great products and their customer support team is one of the best I've come across. Definitely recommend and will purchase again.

records.title: Exceptional Service
records.text: I rang BrandAlley as I had an issue with my order, I spoke with a young lady called Fabiha who was brilliant. She promptly arranged a return for a couple of days later, asked if I wanted a replacement or a refund and credited £10 to my account for the inconvenience. She provided exceptional customer service, was polite and friendly. She is an asset to BA for sure.

records.title: Excellent Customer Service
records.text: I had a bit of a problem with an order, contacted Customer Servict and spoke with Fabiah. She was wonderful, sorted my problem and went above and beyond. This is the way a company should deal with its customers. Excellent in every way

records.title: I had a fantastic experience with Tim…
records.text: I had a fantastic experience with Tim at Brand Alley! From the moment I reached out for assistance, he was incredibly friendly and attentive. Tim took the time to understand my needs and provided me with excellent support. His commitment to customer satisfaction truly stands out. I was impressed by his prompt responses and willingness to go the extra mile to ensure I was happy and my problem was solved. It's rare to find such dedicated staff, and Tim made my shopping experience enjoyable and stress-free. Thank you, Tim, for your outstanding support!

records.title: Amazing customer service.
records.text: Not very often that customer service exceeds expectations, I made a mistake and shipped a Xmas gift in a return box, I rang BrandAlley and got through to a lovely lady called Adele who followed this up for me, she managed to track my parcel and also arranged for it to be posted back to me.. I cannot thank Adele enough, this is what customer service should all be about.. would 100% recommend this company to anyone and would like to thank Adele again.

records.title: Adele is NOT a BOT

records.title: Very happy

records.title: I actually have shopped with brandalley…
records.text: I actually have shopped with brandalley since 2017 and since then have placed 24 orders with them with multiple items in each order and have been generally happy and you could say a loyal customer. This time has been terrible I placed an order on the 8 December which contained 4 Christmas presents which I was then going to post on. The estimated delivery was 13-17 December which was already tight.Its now 18 December and no sign of a despatch note. I have contacted them through live chat and twice on what’s App and this is their response ‘ We are still awaiting an update from our logistics department. we will inform you once there is an update’. So now I have no idea when they are going to arrive and what to do with the situation of not having presents. I look forward to hearing from them on a resolution to this stressful situation.I have updated this review rating as my postage was refunded and I did get a response from them following the review however the presents I had bought did not arrive in time for Xmas and it did take an unreasonable amount of time to deliver the items and receive a satisfactory response

No option to exchange for smaller size so if reordered I would have spent £13.85 on postage….not worth the risk of ordering inaccurately sized items.

records.title: Wrong item received. I ordered what I thought was a brand…
records.text: I placed an order for a Grey GG Gucci scarf, but received the complete wrong item, a Cream scarf. I returned this item, and after a brief discussion with the customer support team, my refund was expedited immediately. I also received a £15 voucher to spend should I order again. Thanks to Zak Speer

records.title: Trousers very creased on arrival
records.text: Trousers very creased on arrival. Creases have not dropped out when trousers hung up. Parallel lines instead of 1 pressed seam up front of leg ie very badly pressed. Expect much better product. Intend returning as don’t feel capable - or in lined to - of extensive pressing.Procedure of buying very slick. Disappointed.

records.title: Not received purchase & BA asking for a review?
records.text: I'm hoping to be happy with the purchase although I have not received as yet, which is quite stressful this close to Christmas. I'm not happy you are asking me to review before receiving???

records.title: Disappointed!
records.text: Thank you for ensuring the parcel arrived on time. However, I am disappointed with the condition and contents of the package.The box of leggings I purchased was already open and damaged upon arrival. Furthermore, I ordered black leggings, but I received a grey pair instead. To add to the inconvenience, I had to pay for the return of the item, which was not my fault.

records.title: Poor quality control
records.text: Received a dress with two oily marks on the front, had been slow delivery so had then gone out of stock too. Now trying to order elsewhere so that I can return. No offer of a partial refund from customer service despite sending photos. The short sleeved pyjamas I ordered arrived and were actually 3/4 / full length sleeves, completely different to the picture. Only realised after washing.

records.title: Not the best experience
records.text: “I recently ordered a jacket from BrandAlley, and while the product itself was fine, I was shocked to find dead mosquitoes inside the jacket . This was quite disappointing and raised concerns about quality control and hygiene standards.When I contacted customer service, they were polite and offered a refund, but only if I returned the item. Given the unusual situation and the distress caused, I had hoped for a more customer-friendly resolution.I expected better from a brand like BrandAlley. While the product was usable, the experience left me questioning their attention to detail.”

records.title: Christmas Wreath
records.text: Christmas WreathProduct is good quality and design but was supplied with non-existent packaging to prevent getting bent or damaged. Just wrapped in plastic.

records.title: Really disappointed
records.text: Really disappointed with the quality of the jewellery I ordered. For it not to have even a cloth bag or box is a disappointing experience when spending nearly £200 on pieces that are allegedly RRP £500.Plus, one of the items had dirt/glue on it - how did that pass quality control or inspection? Very disappointed and then I got charged to return them!

records.title: The delivery and communications very…
records.text: The delivery and communications very good. However the jumper I ordered was incredibly small for a large, no mention of the type of fit in the description. I also had to pay for postage each way, so I'm out of pocket for about £10.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Ordered sales goods and opted for next day delivery.  Goods were delivered within 24 hours and were excellent value.  One item was faulty and this was resolved within days and refund received.  Fabulous service.

records.title: I can confidently recommend buying from Frasers
records.text: Really quick delivery & right on Christmas too! Items were excellent & exactly as described. Very happy with my purchases & can confidently recommend buying from Frasers.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: I ordered two items, both arrived safely packed and within a few days of ordering. Excellent service, a great shop , online as well as visiting Frasers store in person. I order online as it is most convenient. Happy customer . Thank you so much.

records.title: I loved my whole shopping experience…
records.text: I loved my whole shopping experience with frazers. From placing an order to delivery, everything was spot on from keeping me informed till the items arrived at my door. Well done team frazers.

records.title: Arrived as promised

records.title: Had some great experiences with HOF in…

records.title: Good Choice of Products

records.title: easy to use and great choice
records.text: The site is easy to use and there is a wide variety of products. Items are usually reasonably priced and normally arrive in reasonable time. The sales and offers are very good , though these sometimes are not in stock or take a little longer to arrive.

records.title: I’ve purchased a lot of stuff from…
records.text: I’ve purchased a lot of stuff from Fraser good experience overall although when I’ve brought trainers the boxes are always damaged and tatty and I spent £750 on a cp company dd puffer jacket and was still charged for delivery which in my opinion is ridiculous when you spend that amount of money.should be free

records.title: Bought 3 e vouchers online

records.title: Delivery is quick, but expensive

records.title: Contacting them frustration

It’s very frustrating. Please take note.

records.title: Good but not quite excellent.

The reason for 4 stars rather 5 was that I thought I'd ordered  a golf polo and golf shorts based on the graphics displayed but got 2 golf polos. The abbreviated wording must've thrown me ! Nice shirts though .

I was at home so a doorbell ring would have been appreciated.

records.title: I made an order
records.text: I made an order . I pay for transport and also pay 30 euros to return the orderI sent an email to refund my moneyI am waiting since no money have been refunded This is not fair If we have to pay enough money to return an order the refund should be fast

records.title: Delayed refund resolved
records.text: Recently, I posted a negative review with my other account on Trustpilot about Frasers due to the prolonged wait for my €500 refund. The company Frasers investigated and discovered that my return package was unfortunately ‘lost’. Nevertheless, they refunded the full amount to me. I appreciate their efforts to resolve this issue and believe it’s important to share this positive experience.It’s fair to report not only negative experiences but also when a company takes responsibility and corrects the situation. Although it’s unfortunate that the package was lost, I’m satisfied with the solution provided and the refund.I encourage others to share positive developments when a company takes action to resolve a problem, in addition to reporting negative experiences. This offers a more balanced perspective and helps other consumers make informed choices.For tips on writing balanced and constructive reviews, you can consult Trustpilot’s guidelines.  ￼

records.title: The service was ok

records.title: Difficult one to answer

The confirmation email talked about the product being ‘none mint’, there was no mention of this in the product description. The box was slightly damaged but contents were fine.I paid for next day delivery, don’t be fooled into thinking you’ll get a delivery the next day, it’s next day once they have processed it! This is definitely not made clear in website. I am awaiting a partial refund for the issues I encountered.

records.title: Not happy with delivery
records.text: Happy with the products delivered however delivery was several days late and I was not advised it would be late or when I would get delivery. Ended up getting just before Xmas but was not happy with the lack of updates

records.title: Disappointing to pay £4.99 for click…
records.text: Disappointing to pay £4.99 for click and collect on a £270 order… to then have to spend £4.99 to return it because you cannot return web orders in store. Won’t be ordering online again due to this.

records.title: Excessive postal costs

records.title: Customer service non existent

I bought it online, from Italy and considerably cheaper. Your Versace and Vivienne Westwood jewellery is also about 40% cheaper everywhere online. There is a difference in high end and overpriced. Frasers is becoming more and more like a cheap tart in a posh dress! Just look at the clientele you're now attracting in store!

records.title: Not really your fault but...

As Christmas presents, I'm very annoyed and can't believe nobody has complained about this before. I've also read that you charge for any returns and charge again for replacements. If that's the case I'll be complaining as you aren't selling what's advertised. No issues with the website, process or delivery though.

But, I will not be ordering from house of Frasers in the future. Clearly a company that doesn’t  value customer relationships, and is more focused on quick, easy, cheap efficiency.

records.title: A day after placing my order I wished…

records.title: Order cancelled, late deliveries, don't order from Fraser!
records.text: I didn't get a follow-up email until I received one saying 'order was cancelled upon request'. Whose request? Not mine. Apparently it was out of stock. No apology, no sorry, just a basic email stating cancelled upon request. The estimated delivery date wsa 16 December, I received the first part of the order on 18th. I then got an email for second part of order again stating delivery was 16th - I received email on 19th. I got the second part on 24th. Again no apology for the delay or the cancelled order. I won't be ordering from Frasers again, and I advise others not to. Very disappointed.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: I recently bought a number of items from House of Fraser, totaling nearly £300. Unfortunately, some of the shoe sizes are too small, so I went to return them at my local store. However, I was told that they no longer accept returns in-store and that I needed to print a return barcode from the website and send the items back via courier or Royal Mail. To my surprise, when I tried to print the barcode, it wasn’t available. Instead, I found out that I’d have to pay separately for each return, with a minimum fee of £4.99 per item.What frustrates me the most is that when I bought the items, I only paid £4.99 for the entire order’s delivery. It feels unfair that now, when trying to return items, I’m being charged more than what I paid for delivery in the first place. I’m really disappointed with how this process has turned out, and I just don’t understand why customers are being treated this way. I've given up on returning all items back to them. Hugely disappointed with House of Fraser.
