records.text: A trip to Scotland is not complete to me without a visit (or two, or three) to Cotton Traders! The clothing is an excellent value, of course, with fabrics and colours that are attractive and easy care. What really sets Cotton Traders apart is the friendly and helpful staff! Their warm genuine smiles are contagious!

records.title: Most comfortable shoes
records.text: Ordered trainers for myself as my old cotton traders trainers were worn out, also slip on shoes for my husband.  Both excellent quality.My husband has a problem with aching feet but these have been so good he is walking really well and he says they are so comfortable.Very quick delivery.

records.title: Excellent Service all around
records.text: Excellent Service all around. Would highly Recommend.Only downside is I wish men's trousers came in 30 inch waist as the smallest currently is 32 which is far too big. I have seen numerous pairs of trousers that I could purchase if only my size was on offer.

records.title: Great value of the items I purchased in…
records.text: Great value of the items I purchased in the sale. Not worn or washed any of them yet but I’m sure they will be up to usual Cotton Traders high standard. Very easy to order online & delivery very prompt despite it being Christmas. Very pleased with purchases & Cotton Traders as usual

records.title: A reliable company and helpful staff.
records.text: Cotton Traders can be relied on to refund quickly and make it easy to return items. I recently purchased a lovely jacket for my husband, which was too small. I returned it to our local store and re-ordered the larger size, which came quickly. Cotton Traders are a delight to deal with and their merchandise is very good quality and fairly priced.

records.title: Repeat order
records.text: Both the jeans and the pack of two bras are an excellent fit, look good and very comfortable.  In fact, this order is an exact repeat of one I placed in October because I did not want these items to suddenly become unavailable, which is always so frustrating.  I know I now have new spare items waiting in the wings.

records.title: Problem sorted.
records.text: We had an issue with an order which should have arrived next day.  I phoned and the lady was so helpful and sorted the problem out straight away.It's nice to have someone to actually talk to when you have an issue rather than an automated robot.Can't reccomend highly enough.

records.title: One of two items delivered
records.text: One of two items delivered, 2nd though available when ordered unavailable till 2nd week in Jan.I'm exactly 36" waist, order elasticated to allow for comfort and slight change, but elasticated Trousers only just stretch to 36" size, so not good, for me 38" too big baggy and poor fit.It would be great if elasticated waist  allowed for this.

records.title: Printed Micro Fleece Half Zip.
records.text: It was easy to place the order via the website, and the top arrived quickly considering that this was in the run up to Christmas. The top itself has a lovely feel and the colours are as per the images on the website.The printed micro fleece half zip itself is a good length in the sleeve and body. It is warm to wear and also has 2 nice big side pockets.The fleece itself feels very baggy in the body for a ‘Large’, it could do with a couple of darts in the back.

records.title: Easy ordering prompt delivery
records.text: Easy ordering prompt delivery, if left on the door step, the shoes themselves, are quit 'rigid' and need a good pair of socks hopefully they will relax with use! Tread a bit thin.

records.title: Size not right on 1 pair.
records.text: Ordered  2 pairs of ultimate chinos, same Suze 34/27 but in different colours.I do need 27 inch inside leg and these seemed perfect for me. However I was disappointed that the dark blue chino was actually almost 28inch inside leg even tho the label showed 27". Frustrating as I had planned an event where the blue chinos would have been perfect. Think Cotton Traders need to take more care as even the finish on these wrongly sized chinos was to say the least untidy. I kept them and wore them to the event I had planned but did feel uncomfortable. Not sure now that I'd trust Cotton Traders to get it right even next time.

records.title: Prompt delivery.
records.text: Prompt delivery but unfortunately, the trousers were a little too long and they were returned. Don't forget you pay postage to return so you pay for delivery and the same to return.

records.title: It was delivered on time
records.text: It was delivered on time. It's thicker wool than I  expected from the pictureand did think I would return it, but I  haven't seen anything else that would be better for what I  want.

records.title: I am happy with the prompt delivery and…
records.text: I am happy with the prompt delivery and the quality of the product, but the product was too big unfortunately.I would also like to see an extended returns time during the Christmas holidays, as this item was a gift.

records.title: Not a great experience
records.text: The top I ordered was quite large for the sizing guide & was subsequently returned. The trousers which were supposedly in stock at the point of ordering (wanted for Xmas) were not & have yet to receive them.Guess not a great experience Thanks to Customer Services for their prompt response to my initial review and for their kind gesture.

records.title: My main winge is to offer large…
records.text: My main winge is to offer large discounts in the sale but have no stock for customers to purchase. But the trousers that I bought came quickly alas they don't hold a crease well.

records.title: The item purchased was as described
records.text: The item purchased was as described, in good condition and delivered promptly.  However the promotional offer item promised was never received despite the promotional code being accepted at checkout.  Irritating, as I keep getting more promotional codes (several a week), but the one I used has not been honored.  I emailed them about this but have not received a reply.Sorted promptly when I phoned - the man I spoke to was very polite and offered a variety of alternative promo items or a partial refund, which I accepted.  A shame not to have received the original promo item, but these things happen.

records.title: Stretch jeans
records.text: Prompt delivery and good communication. Would like to see the online discount field amalgamated with the order summary so that the price adjustment can be properly viewed before commiting.Jeans are well made, good price, a true fit waist and leg and comfortably stretchy. However, would have expected the legs to have been more tailored as a straight fit - certainly the pictures suggest a cleaner line. I would class these as a relaxed leg, not straight, as there is more material in the leg than I prefer. They will probably do, but I still have some issues with CT around sizing.

records.title: The service is always good but.
records.text: The service is always good.However I recently returned a pair of size 10 chino's - they were very well made & I would have loved to keep them but the fitting was definitely not a size 10 as they were massive! Om my return slip I requested Cotton Traders paid for the return cost but according to my refund they have taken the cost of return

records.title: Speedy delivery good service
records.text: Speedy delivery good service. Think delivery charge is expensive especially when I only want 1 item. Has stopped me making a purchase. Limited stores now available to buy & return. None within my area.

records.title: The item ordered and paid for was lost…
records.text: The item ordered and paid for was lost by the delivery company. However after my complaint the matter was resolved immediately and a new delivery was made. I am delighted with the shirt and am now happy to give a 4 star review.

records.title: Good quality
records.text: Good quality - I’ve bought several pairs over the years.However, even the Short length is too long, so I have to pay a lot for shortening each time.An Extra Short size would be appreciated.

records.title: Easy ordering and returning only…
records.text: Easy ordering and returning only downside is that you take the return payment off the amount refunded. Free returns would be better.

records.title: Good quality goods and a great price - shame about refunds taking so long.
records.text: Xmas present ordered which arrived quickly. 1 item was returned as it was too small . Shame their is a charge for returning item via Evri or Royal Mail. Have not yet received a refund but was only 2 weeks ago. Apart from that quality and choice was good.

records.title: Fantastic service .
records.text: Very good customer service did not receive an order I had placed and another was sent with no quibble .

records.title: Early Christmas Presents to me.
records.text: Early Christmas Presents to me.13th Oct 2024 Ordered FAIR ISLE TURTLENECK JUMPER (AL11609) in RUBY size 18.28th October 2024 ordered FAIR ISLE TURTLENECK JUMPER (AL11609) in BISCUIT size 18.7th November 2024 ordered a pair of Ladies stretch jeans in ALPINE GREEN (AC16446) to pick out the green in the recently purchased Fair Isle Jumper in Biscuit.The jumpers are lovely and soft, hope they and the jeans was well.5th December 2024 ordered the Wide Leg Stretch Cord Trousers(AC16559) in PECAN.But had to send them back, as they did not suit me!  Looked good in the Catalogue, but not on me.16th December ordered the Stretch Cord Midi Skirt (AG10868) in NAVY.NOT YET WORN, but the material feels good.Miss S Roughley

records.title: Great trousers but leg longer than advertised
records.text: Bought trousers for my husband as a gift.  Advertised as 29 leg but seem longer.  Not a problem as I am able to alter them.  Otherwise great trousers.

records.title: Really disappointed that my original…
records.text: Really disappointed that my original order did not arrive. Made things a rush to get the aizing right and sone of the items were no longer in stock in my size.Garments are fine, just the overall experience tainted.

records.title: A good fit, but dull colour
records.text: A good fit, lovely soft fabric, but I was disappointed at the dullness of the colour.  From the pictures I had expected a purple. In reality a muddy, dull colour.I must find a way to brighten it up. Might well suit a blonde  but not so good with grey hair.

records.title: Ordered online and trusted that the…
records.text: Ordered online and trusted that the size (XL) would be same or similar to other XLs that I had bought in shop.   Sadly much smaller than expected, so has had to be returned.

records.title: Slippers wrongly sized so disappointed
records.text: I purchase two items as presents. The trousers for my sister were lovely, but the slippers for my husband had been sized incorrectly and were possible two sizes too small. So disappointing, and wondering how many other people had a similar problem

records.title: Jumper deceivingly looked lined
records.text: Jumper deceivingly looked lined, but they only lined the hood. Cheaply made and thin jumper. Definitely wouldn’t have bought if I could have seen in person. It’s ok, just cheap, but not cheap prices.

records.title: Cotton traders service was exemplary
records.text: Cotton traders service was exemplary. Sadly they were let down very badly by Evri,who said they had delivered but had not.This was confirmed  by CCTV

records.title: Poor sizing and quality
records.text: Ordered 2 pairs of jeans same size and style etc but the length on one was anojt 2 inches to long and the other ones were to small in the waist. I returned for a refund luckily i used klarna so i opted to upload my proof of shipping to get refunded straight away. Otherwise i think i would of been waiting a while as it was weeks before i has a refund notice from cotton traders. Unfortunately it was for the wrong amount and there were going to update my klarna refund for a lower refund. After i contacted then they quickly fixed the issue but i do think things could be better. I was a first time customer and kinda out me off ordering again to be honest

records.title: Sizes are inconsistent
records.text: The tracksuit trousers I ordered were 1.5" longer than indicated on the website and were not very thick.  The plum colour was as expected and made a change from grey, navy or black.I have kept them for warmer weather, but will have to alter the length when time allows.

records.title: Unfortunately after spending £6.99 for…
records.text: Unfortunately after spending £6.99 for delivery charges  for my item then being told that the system is down again in my local store to return it ..£2.95 to send it back .. disappointed with ths online service…

records.title: Too short
records.text: Unfortunately the fit wasn’t right for me. I tried size8, 29”length but still found them too short. I’m 5’6”. They were also more flared, like bell-bottoms, than wide leg, I thought.

records.title: Disappointed. I was very pleased with the tr I…
records.text: I was very pleased with the trousers I ordered online but the promised free gift did not arrive and still has not despite 2 emails to customer services.

records.title: The trousers were shorter than expected…
records.text: The trousers were shorter than expected despite having given my leg measurement, and there appeared to be no stretch in the waste band. Item returned and refund made promptly.

records.title: The delivery was messed up
records.text: The delivery was messed up, they changed the date and times several time bofore I got the goods.  The quality of the goods was good as usual but I have said in the past and will say again the items and colours I buy are often not avaiable.

records.title: Beware unisex sizing
records.text: Good quality, but even XS in the unisex sizing is just too big overall for a size 10.

records.title: I ordered 2 pair’s of trousers 1 pair…
records.text: I ordered 2 pair’s of trousers 1 pair came and the other pair is 4-6 weeks away, People should be aware at the point of purchase of a delay

records.title: Good product, crap delivery
records.text: I have no issues with what I bought, but if I’d known the courier I would not have bought them.  Text coming between 6.30/7.30pm, changed to 8/9pm, nothing got them next day after calling the supplier company who were very apologetic and attentive.  Change your courier.Lewis

records.title: Delivery arrived on time by Evri but…
records.text: Delivery arrived on time by Evri but can't give you a review about the items because they were only socks and they weren't for me. I would order more if your ladies trousers and jeans were long enough and your ladies shoes won't fit and the mens don't come in bright colours.  I told you about the shoe colours issue 10 - 15 years ago and you said you'd look into it but you never did.

records.title: Lovely looking boots but too small and…
records.text: Lovely looking boots but too small and a bit hard inside. Have had to return for a refund unfortunately

records.title: Generally good service apart from…
records.text: Generally good service apart from recent order which despite being ordered end of November is still not here.Very disappointing as kit was supposed to be a Christmas present.

records.title: Overall pretty good and I like the…
records.text: Overall pretty good and I like the products, but pay close attention when purchasing. The website accepts discount codes but then email confirmation quotes full price. I have had this problem a few times now.

records.title: A bit disappointed all round
records.text: Delivery took far too long compared to other company's delivery arrangements. I ordered 2 maxi skirts, received 1 pair of jeggings and 1 skirt which was far too short for even a midi skirt let alone a maxi. Didn't even try it on, I knew it wasn't any good.

records.title: You get what you pay for but who wants…
records.text: You get what you pay for but who wants to walk around with 'Cotton Traders' on your clothing? I couldn't see it online as it's white on pale blue. My main gripe is that I returned the order on 6/12 and EVRI show it as delivered to CT on 9/12 but the refund has not been received as at 30/12. Having said that, Customer Services have been good but I shouldn't have needed to waste my time calling. It would have been a nice touch not to deduct the cost of return but I'm just not buying from them again.

records.title: Poor delivery service.
records.text: For the second time in the past few months Click and Collect at our local store has not been available so we have to pay postage. We even have to pay postage if we collect via Evri which means we have to drive to the next village to pick up our parcel. No explanation has been given for this continuing problem.Cotton Traders needs to improve its delivery service.Discount Shoe Zone provides free next day delivery no matter how much you spend.Perhaps Cotton Traders needs to take investigate other firms delivery strategies.

records.title: Hello
records.text: Hello I love your denim skirts and have most colours and I know I dont have any other choice to abide by your policies  but I really dont like  paying full amount  for them  knowing I need to wait nearly 7 weeks and then  for  it to arrive really  badly creased I would like to suggest customers pay a small deposit on items you know are going to take this amountof  time to arrive and please have a word with your supplier in regards to folding items properly

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: Sorry, but these very expensive Cotton Trader pillow cases are not remotely as soft or smooth as my Dorma pillow cases. Yet these Cotton Trader pillow cases are supposedly made with a 500 thread count. (My Dorma ones are made with a lower thread count.)

records.title: No proof of order or receipt for…
records.text: No proof of order or receipt for payment after placing order via telephone, despite me ringing several times to ask specifically for an email confirmation. I only obtained my order number by ringing back to ask for it. This is not the level of service I would expect from any reputable company. I don`t understand why this shouldn`t be followed through on. I`ve never known any other company to not provide either an order confirmation email or receipt of payment, and I`ve dealt with hundreds of companies both large and small over decades. Doesn`t fill me with confidence in using again.

records.title: I find your sizes are not consistent.
records.text: I find your sizes are not consistent.34 inch waist seemed too tight & 34 is my normal size. So I ordered a 36 inch waist & that seemed even smaller.  It's very disappointing.

records.title: Next day delivery took 5 days.
records.text: The item was great but I ordered it in early December and paid for next day delivery but it didn't arrive for 5 days so too late for my requirements. I contacted customer service and have not had a reply.

records.title: I ordered size 7 boots
records.text: I ordered size 7 boots. I received size 4 boots. I have  got to make a 22 mile round trip to take them back or pay postage for return. I am in my late 70s, I try to be independent however I will have to wait till my daughter has a day off.

records.title: Cotton traders: photos online different from product
records.text: Cotton traders: Bat Mat and toilet mat arrived in good time to my door. Unfortunately the product looked nothing like the product online including pattern and material. Called to express my disappointment and why I wanted to return and was kindly offered a new one, but as they could not guarantee it would be different, I declined and asked for a refund which they were happy to do. @trust pilot: would be useful for customers to upload photo to support the evidence.

description:
HJ HALL



Buy the FULL RANGE of HJ socks direct from HJ Hall. The sock specialists since 1882, including the infamous Softop® non-elasticated sock accredited by the Institute of Chiropodists and Podiatrists. HJ diabetic socks are made with sensitive feet in mind, made from natural fibres to improve the comfort of the sock and provide an antibacterial finish. Also home to our Pro Trek hiking socks, Kilt socks and outdoor, boot socks.
 SHOP MEN'S 
 SHOP WOMEN'S 
 SHOP SOFTOPS
 SHOP PRO TREK

records.title: Soft top socks
records.text: I bought two pairs of my brother's favourite socks for Christmas and two pairs for my husband's birthday in April. My brother is very pleased, and I'm sure that my husband will be! I'm considering buying some for myself as I have size 6-7 feet but ladies' 4-8 socks always seem too small after a few washes.

records.title: So far so good - fingers crossed!
records.text: The socks arrived promptly and safely and appear to be just the sort of thing I had ordered (colour, material, soft top etc.) I have worn one of the pairs so far and they seemed fine - they feel a tiny bit 'thinner' than my former socks but that is perhaps a trade-off for other benefits.       The package, when it arrived seemed 'anonymous'. I could not tell just from the label what was inside the pack, otherwise I might have opened it earlier.

records.title: Comfort, warmth and convenience
records.text: Bought as a gift for an older gentleman who had never heard of soft-top socks. He is delighted with the comfort he now experiences. He also mentioned that they are keeping his feet warm, as well as staying up! As a buyer I appreciate being able to choose the colours in a multipack. Delivery over the Christmas period was speedy and the package fitted through the letterbox. Highly recommended on everything!

records.title: Ordered Christmas Eve did not expect…
records.text: Ordered Christmas Eve did not expect them till after new year arrived early than expected. Thank you for your quick response

records.title: Your the best  socks are the best of the sort I'm…
records.text: Your socks are the best of the sort I'm looking for especially  for my wife currently. The bamboo is really soft and flexible and the soft tops are yielding and are exactly what the name says... unlike 3 other similar brands we've tried. More single light coloured colours are needed

records.title: Fabulous socks
records.text: Brought these socks for my husband for Xmas. He loves them , which is why I did order more .., Because he’s under going treatment for cancer the tablets/treatment  makes his ankles swell a bit so all his old socks he had to cut as the elastic was too tight, From now on these socks are the only ones.

records.title: Ordered online
records.text: Ordered online, which was easy to do  - both for finding the socks,  the ease of completing the order, and checking out. The package containing the socks was robust, and delivered promptly.Very pleased with the whole ordering experience.

records.title: soft top walking and ladies socks
records.text: My order for soft top walking and ladies socks was delivered swiftly as a Christmas gift. The socks themselves are excellent quality, soft, nice colours and soft top too. The recipients were very impressed with them as their ankles swell. They had not seen soft top walking socks before and will be buying from hj in future

records.title: Quality sox in varied designs
records.text: Quality sox in varied designs and good offers the sox go on forever - I always buy them as I always loose them and so need a steady supply !!!

records.title: Great service all round!
records.text: The socks arrived well packed and in good time. My husband really liked his socks and my Dad loved his diabetes socks he said they were soft, warm and so comfortable to wear.

records.title: Great socks…
records.text: Quality of the socks was as I had hoped, very good and suitably packaged. Delivery took longer than expected otherwise I would have given 5 stars. I will certainly be purchasing more.

records.title: The socks are great at staying up…
records.text: The socks are great at staying up without an elastic strip. The only issue was that the short socks had 2 labels attached by the plastic ties and the ties had caught and pulled the thread on 2 out of 4 socks so had to be returned for replacement.

records.title: Socks are almost as good as they used…
records.text: Socks are almost as good as they used to be 10 years ago, until someone meddled with the design but now they appear to have returned to form and function.More colour choices needed in larger sizes.

records.title: I was a bit disappointed in how long it…
records.text: I was a bit disappointed in how long it took for the product to arrive. Other than that everything was fine

records.title: Good site
records.text: Good site, easy to select items. Excellent quality at a good price. Quick delivery.

records.title: HJ softop socks always a good buy
records.text: HJ softop socks always a good buy - have bought them for many years ('Indestructibles' onwards). Always nice fit and 'feel'.Pity that the 'Rambler' type don't have a softop version. I'm confident there's a demand there.

records.title: HSJ socks
records.text: Easy to order, user friendly website & brother-in-law really likes the product. Yodel unfortunately wouldn't accept change of address as out of catchment area when in reaality it was sister just round the corner hence 4dtar instead of 5.

records.title: Delivery info was not good
records.text: Delivery info was not good. No indication that the order was going to be delivered by Evri, trying to use the tracking information was hopeless, from looking like nothing had even been despatched to an email notification that delivery was happening that day. However it ended well.

records.title: Good customer service. After sending me someone else’s order…
records.text: After sending me someone else’s order in error, their customer service team dealt with the returns and order replacement process in a friendly and helpful way.I was even compensated by having the replacement reduced to their current sale price.

records.title: Great products, not so great delivery.
records.text: Another company asking for feedback prior to the customer receiving their order! I’ve purchased many socks from HJ Hall and they have ALL been excellent and I have no reason to think this order will be any different. If I was to highlight a lesser positive, would be the delivery duration, we live in the 21st century but it still takes 10 days (and counting) to receive an online purchase.

records.title: Good Socks Bad Bill
records.text: The socks supplied by HJ Hall Socks really are excellent. My disappointment was that the promised'Black Friday' discount of 25% was not deducted from the cost. This made me feel rather grumpy with HJ Hall!

records.title: The socks are great.
records.text: The socks are great.I especially like the softtops as they don't leave marks on your legs like elasticated ones do. I have ones in bamboo, cotton and wool for different purposes/times of year.One criticism is that the order confirmation says that they will email upon despatch but this has never happened on any of several orders.  However, the delivery company does at least let you know when they are due to deliver the package.

records.title: I bought abamboo socks with…
records.text: I bought a pair of bamboo socks with soft tops and they are very comfortable but rather pricy when you add in the postage costs. However I do intend to buy more

records.title: Delivery A Nightmare.
records.text: Cannot fault the socks - they are excellent. But using Yodel for delivery was a nightmare. I rang H.J. Hall to explain about the dreadful experience with delivery. Declared I would not order anymore from them if Yodel was to used. Customer service lady said there had been lots of complaints in the same vein.

records.title: My first order
records.text: I bought to asses and compare the products, the delivery was not too slow although it isn’t cheap these days.  The socks are for a gift.  They feel nice and I like the range of sizes offered.

records.title: Positive products
records.text: This is my 2nd order of socks from you.Delivery time as indicated and products are of good quality

records.title: Easy to use website.
records.text: Easy to use website.Good communications. Delivery via Yodel not great - they send an email saying 'parcel on its way' - whatever that means?Next day they send an email saying 'parcel out for delivery' but no time given. Had to wait in all day😠

records.title: Easy ordering with guest checkout
records.text: Easy ordering with guest checkout! No communiction about dispatch! Good value for money.

records.title: Softop non-elastic walking socks for women please!
records.text: It was good to get advice on which socks might be right for me as I need non-elastic walking socks - any others and my legs get very swollen around any elastic tops.However, there are no normal thick socks that are good in my usual walking boots. The Softops are excellent but only seem to be for men's sizes so although I have bought Softops I have to get insoles. Also there are very few thick women's socks, and men's feet and calves are different!

records.title: Delivered correct goods in reasonable…
records.text: Delivered correct goods in reasonable time.  They are a gift so can say nought about the socks themselves.  When will you start selling decent Y fronts.

records.title: Good customer service but disappointing product.
records.text: Quick delivery,  easy to order, nice colours. It's rare to find wool socks for ladies.BUTBecame completely shapeless after wearing for a short time. Extremely disappointing as I bought some for a present as well as for myself.

records.title: Once the colours of the socks were good…
records.text: Once the colours of the socks were good the way that the socks move round on your feet is quite disturbing. Don’t want to end up slipping coming downstairs just wish there was a sock where the top was soft and not hard against your skin but the sock itself is more, fitting

records.title: Limited choice of sock size
records.text: Good quality and range, but sock size 6-11 is ridiculous.  I need size 8 and they stretch to be more like size 11.  Other companies offer 6-8.5.  Five sizes covered by a standard size doesn't work and needs a re-think.  I won't buy again until range of sizes available.

records.title: Careful what you are choosing!
records.text: We were mislead by the website into thinking that 'wool' socks were suitable for the winter: these are not. They'll be fine next spring but no use now.Delivery was scheduled, but actually arrived 3 days later.

records.title: The socks look fine but for a present…
records.text: The socks look fine but for a present so can’t comment. The company did not send an email to confirm the item had been dispatched. I only knew I had a parcel when got a message from delivery company to say it had been delivered. No card through the door and no photo to show where. After searching everywhere in the dark with my mobile eventually found it behind a plant pot near front door.

records.title: Great socks, but delivery hassle!
records.text: HJ comfort socks are great- warm, comfortable & don't cling giving marks around the ankle. But the delivery was a hassle. I work from home so can usually take in deliveries, but do request items are left in my porch in case I'm stuck on a call or have popped out. The delivery company advised they had to get a signature, so couldn't leave them as requested. These are socks, not very valuable items!

records.title: Boots were a little tight so had to…
records.text: Boots were a little tight so had to stuff paper inside to loosen them a bit. I'm euro size 41 but the sizes are shown in uk sizes only so I had to choose a uk 7 and ended up with a euro size 40, which was slightly smaller than I needed.

records.title: Have been shopping with HJ for many…
records.text: Have been shopping with HJ for many years. Have been very satisfied with their products. Yesterday I received the latest order for 2 pairs of socks. One of the socks had a hole in the front of the ankle. I photographed the hole and sent a message but there has been no response from them. I would expect better service from them.Don Robinson

records.title: Had to return these socks as softop…
records.text: Had to return these socks as softop socks are only suitable for people with swollen legs. Free post return and refund posted to my account within two days. Have suggested to customer services that this is made clearer on their website

records.title: Quality spoiled by tight elastic cuff
records.text: Prompt delivery of what is basically a good quality sock BUT disappointed to find there is a tight and restrictive band of elastic around the cuff.  These leave red marks on my (normal-size but sensitive) legs. Consequently not as comfortable as expected.

records.title: Overall good quality socks, but some ranges are disappointingly thin and lightweight.
records.text: This company generally offer a good, wide range of socks. I have used their long knee-length cotton Bermuda-style socks for a few years now. Excellent quality.I recently ordered some wool-rich (wool/polyamide) soft-top socks, as now I am getting older, the tight elastic socks from other shops are proving uncomfortable. Hall's soft-top socks are great, BUT these traditional styled wool/polyamide ones  -although comfortable -are THIN and not really good value for money. They need to offer these in a heavier duty wool mix.  I am disappointed in them.

records.title: Ordering/delivery was good.
records.text: Ordering/delivery was good.I wanted a thick pair of soft top socks to give extra cushioning due to arthritis in my feet (soft top because of lymphedema).The socks are lovely but they are much too thin so have returned them.

records.title: Socks delivered on time in full.
records.text: Three socks ordered to try the different materials and the non-elastic grips. All arrived on time.  Construction quality seems good, and sizing is spot on.Only complaint is that the Olive colour is grey rather than the anticipated green.

records.title: Time

records.title: Cold Feet

records.title: Poor quality

records.title: Delivery was delayed by a day because…
records.text: Delivery was delayed by a day because some clown had decided the parcel couldn't be left in my designated safe place but had to be delivered to a person. All for a pair of socks, for heaven's sake, and it isn't as though thay have gold threads running through them with a value to match! Yodel is equally at fault because they wouldn't show me a photo of the delivery on the web site but wanted me instead to "download" something called an "app", presumably on a smart phone. Not everyone has a smart phone, and those who have don't always want to clog them up with apps they'll only use once in a blue moon when someone has decided the delivery man has to leave a parcel with a neighbour - the same neighbour probably that you don't trust not to pinch my parcel from my designated safe place. Totally logical!In the end it transpired which neighbour it was, but by that time they'd gone out for the evening, so it was the next day before I got my socks!As for the socks themselves, I like the fact that they have a high wool content, but the tops aren't as soft as I hoped they might be, so unfortunately I won't be buying any more. Pity. Thanks for trying.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: The socks are soft top as advertised but they don't stay up. They also look like men's socks so I am disappointed with my purchase.

records.title: When online I was unable to find the…

records.title: Slow delivery

records.title: Disappointing

I couldn't see how I could have avoided it. Wherever I had tried to open the package was a lottery. After all there was nothing covering the socks inside the plastic exterior package.   Oh well, shops in future I think.

records.title: Wool Softop Cushioned socks

records.title: Cotton Work Socks Review
records.text: Socks arrived promptly. A bit disappointing really- what are advertised as ‘cotton work socks’ incorporate a high percentage of other man made fibres- clear visible information about this up front would have been useful and would have affected any purchasing decisions. Also they’re thinner and of a lesser quality than expected for the relatively high price, considering it’s directly from the manufacturer. Taking all of the above into account I’m not sure about how long they are going to last , time will tell. A proper work sock is more robust and of higher quality. Hopefully HJ will take this on board and make improvements.

records.title: Socks are fine but nobody can…

But one of the socks in the second pair is, like, a shapeless, loose piece of formless material that falls down around my ankle the second I put it on. Very infuriating.Regards

records.title: Poor quality finish
records.text: I recently bought a pair of HJ long wellington socks. They looked very attractive in the shop but I am very disappointed with 2 aspects of the sock. 1.The 'Fully cushioned' aspect of the sock is non existent. i.e It is the same 'knit' under the foot as on top of the foot giving no additional comfort or thickness at all. 2. The toe seam is very prominent inside the sock and is uncomfortable on the top of your toes. I would not recommend these socks.

description:
From the North East to the world, END.’s drive to inspire and educate its community has remained steadfast since 2005. Through fashion, design, art and music, we’ve brought globally-recognised names and emerging luxury and streetwear designers straight to your doorstep, wherever you are in the world. With 800+ brands to choose from - and a hand curated range from the likes of Stone Island, Palm Angels, Nike, Moncler, Arc'teryx and Birkenstock - an unparalleled range of brands and exclusive premium labels that never miss the mark.



From shipping to over 70 countries on mobile, tablet and desktop - to live chat and hassle-free returns - customers remain at the core of our community. Or, take a break away from the screen, and come visit us in one of our stores in Newcastle, Glasgow, Manchester, London and Milan. Here, you’ll also find live workshops and events so you’ll feel like an industry insider in no time. 




We provide our worldwide community with an unparalleled experience, both face-to-face and online, from our North East headquarters in Washington to our Highbury office in London. So, whether you're looking for the latest viral sneakers, or forward-thinking, cutting-edge fashion - you can always count on END. to come through.
