It is shallower than I expected (I wanted it for tiramisu) and the photos or description didn't say so I took a risk. It's still a gorgeous dish however and I'm really happy to keep it. Great service. Great shop, I'd like to visit in person sometime.

records.title: Disappointing service…
records.text: I placed an order online for a number of items including a dress. I received an email days later to say that the dress was out of stock. This was very disappointing, as I had ordered it as a gift. If the item is not in stock you should not be able to order and pay for it on the system. I have ordered goods many times from the Hambledon and this experience has tarnished my view of them, which is unfortunate, as I have always found them to be reliable. The rest of the order arrived complete and well packaged.

records.title: Lovely product
records.text: Lovely product, beautifully wrapped in tissue and ribbon, hand written note, speedy delivery, price left on!!!

records.title: The product is brilliant, but
records.text: The product is brilliant, but why have you addressed the feedback email to my husband and not me? I ordered this gift for him?

records.title: Sweet little toy but not as big or…
records.text: Sweet little toy but not as big or robust as I was expecting

records.title: Happy but not happy
records.text: Really happy with my product and the delivery. However, the product I had ordered I had been trying to buy for quite some time but was out of stock. I had requested notification of when it was back in stock on several occasions. I had looked regularly and submitted request regularly so was surprised to find it in stock and had not received notification, hence the reason for 3 stars. Please don’t offer this service if it is not workable. I had given up looking and was a sheer fluke that I happened to check at weekend .

records.title: The initial experience of purchasing my…
records.text: The initial experience of purchasing my item was straight forward and you sent this out for delivery the following day. Unfortunately your choice of courier in DHL has been disappointing! I’ve had daily texts from them for 4 days now to say that my package will be delivered by the end of the day, but it hasn’t! It looks like it’s been in Bristol since last Thursday!!!

records.title: Mixed review
records.text: This is a difficult one as the necklace I ordered looks beautiful on the website. The order and delivery were great and arrived exactly when it was supposed to. However I cannot check the quality or if it is in fact the correct item without spoiling the wrapping. After paying £50+ for a little something extra for my 17 year old I was disappointment to open and find the necklace is packaged in a thin white paper bag sealed with a little sticker. If I open the bag to check it I cannot repackage as it isn’t substantial enough. I will have to go out tomorrow to see if I can find a suitable small box to put the gift in. This totally defeats the object of shopping on line to stay safe as a high risk person. I presumed the packaging would be as nice as the necklace is on the site! Let’s hope once I open it I am not disappointed with the item!!

records.title: Gift vouchers
records.text: Gift vouchersThe print off looked a bit peculiar and my gift message didn’t appear So it didn’t look very professional

records.title: Towels a bit thin
records.text: Towels a bit thin, placemats a little duller colour than expected, nothing very good value, however have not returned anything.

records.title: The size of the pipes were smaller that…
records.text: The size of the pipes were smaller that expected

records.title: Overpriced for size.
records.text: Ordered chocolate lobster. Arrived in good time but contents so much smaller than in the picture. So expensive for the size received.

records.title: Prompt but Wasteful
records.text: Very prompt.  Thank you but there is ONE significant problem.  PLEASE do not use so much packing for a small candle.  The box was huge and it had a combination of cardboard, brown paper wrapping and bubble wrap inside.  Businesses like yours need to be aware of the impact on the environment.  So please, in future, keep the packaging to the absolute essential and simple.

records.title: Good customer journey, awful quality item.
records.text: The customer journey was good, the packaging had great attention to details, but the actual item I purchased was the absolute lowest quality ever. The most I’ve ever spent on the thinnest piece of brass.

records.title: Necklace all noted
records.text: Necklace all noted. Presented in small bag with no card to stop it twisting. Very small chain, too small fir average adult. Delivery was fast and a nice little thank you note

records.title: Very disappointed
records.text: Very disappointed! I can’t believe how small the chocolate packets are and how tasteless are the tiny chocolates for the price charged! Not worthed at all waste of money!

records.title: The body oil I bought is out of date
records.text: The body oil I bought is out of date. The body wash however is absolutely lovely

records.title: Awful delivery process
records.text: Awful delivery process. Not even a signed for delivery, just left outside in the rain. £300 earrings!

records.title: Gift Voucher
records.text: I wanted to buy a gift voucher for a friend’s birthday. Onsite it said if you want to arrange a physical voucher then email which I did. No one got back to me and with time running out I bought the voucher as an e voucher and have printed it to put inside a card, but it hasn’t printed out in the same format. Have tried twice. Not very happy. Have bought a few things from here and have always been impressed. Disappointing this time.

records.title: You have sent me this review before I…
records.text: You have sent me this review before I have even received my order. I emailed you yesterday to say I had a problem with your courier DPD and I have had no response. How would you rate my experience?

records.title: I haven’t received it yet
records.text: I haven’t received it yet. I missed the delivery and DPD have taken my parcel to a Sainsbury’s that is a 30 minute drive from my house. There must be a collection point closer.

description: &SONS offers a unique range of vintage style clothing designed by & for craftspeople, artisan makers and creative pioneers. Browse the original collection here.

records.title: What I like about the company
records.text: What I like about the company, well the use royal mail which lets you have a time slot so you know when the item will arrive. Secondary I had made a comment before about showing photo's of the inside of the jackets so we can see how many if any inside pockets the jacket has. I have found that on some of the new jackets they brought out they indeed show you the inside pockets.

records.title: Fantastic service
records.text: I ordered on Boxing day and received the package the next day, at no extra cost, which was amazing.The loyalty programme is really worthwhile with great discounts and perks.One of the few times I believe a company is invested in its customers and providing a good service.Thank you.

records.title: Adventure gloves…Great quality!
records.text: Another top quality purchase from &Sons. Really looking forward to putting my new Adventure Gloves to the test this winter. They arrived quickly in the usual classic packaging, and appear to be VERY well made.

records.title: Very good
records.text: Have purchased 3 items during December - green plaid shirt, trucker cap and Bonnington Parka. Was very grateful with the disco received via the app. All 3 items are made to a high quality and quite unique for style and details. Sizing advice seems to be very good. The service is also great. I ordered 1 of the items on Xmas eve which arrived on the 27th to enjoy over the holiday period. Without wanting to alienate anyone else I find the products tailor well for a maturer outdoor active lifestyle. All the best for 2025.

records.title: Cannot fault these guys and girls…
records.text: Cannot fault these guys and girls extremely good company fantastic delivery times even at Christmas. Amazing products. I have 2 Pair of Jeans and coat, shirt, scarf and a denim jacket every single purchase was spot on.

records.title: Love it
records.text: I recently purchased a shirt from &SONS, and it’s easily one of the best clothing investments I’ve made. The craftsmanship is exceptional, with every stitch exuding quality and durability. The fabric feels luxuriously soft yet sturdy, making it perfect for both casual wear and more polished occasions. The fit is impeccable, offering a flattering silhouette without compromising comfort. It’s clear that &SONS prioritizes both style and practicality. If you’re considering one of their shirts, don’t hesitate—it’s worth every penny!

records.title: exceed expectations
records.text: Hello!    I am very pleased with the product, the quality and feel that the product gives are excellent!   I am grateful to the creators of this model for authenticity and elaboration.            Now I'm your fan

records.title: Great clothing
records.text: Easy to use website, good quality photos and size guides and quick delivery of a high quality piece of clothing that is fairly unique to get all those things from one place. Thanks

records.title: Sharp shirt
records.text: Amazing service, arrived just in time for the party season. Great style, easy to wear overshirt in a go with anything light neutral colour. Detail is fabulous, uniquely &Sons.

records.title: Matching my wardrobe.
records.text: I visited the shop in Cheltenham where the staff gave me a lot of help with choosing trousers to go with shoes and other accessories that I already own.

records.title: Fast and efficient service so close to…
records.text: Fast and efficient service so close to Christmas.Clothing is high quality. Great fit.Would have been 5 stars if delivery had not have been left behind a bin in the dirt and wet, with no calling card left to indicate delivery. Not down to &Sons but could have been a disaster if the products had not have been so well wrapped individually. inside the outer packaging.

records.title: The good & bad of it.
records.text: The good, Drifter Waistcoat is wonderful, fabric, look, quality all looks top notch and it is everything I hoped it would be. Time will tell for durability. The bad, ordered a large and according to sizing chart it fits a 44 inch chest. It does, but will hardly button. 44" is absolute max with no room to breath. These run small!. I sent an email regarding exchanges with no response. Ordered next size up and it fits perfectly. Decided to sell first vest outright as I would have had to eat the cost of the return shipping.

records.title: &sons-socks
records.text: Got the socks I ordered pretty fast considering it shipped from the Uk. But honestly I was expecting a much better quality. The socks nice but it wasn’t was I was expecting. They’re light and thin and the material is not that great.

records.title: Great products and kept informed…
records.text: Great products and kept informed through out the whole process, will treat myself again as soon as I can.

records.title: Good quality
records.text: Nice quality, quick service, well packaged, good price

records.title: Quality and look of the shirt is good
records.text: Quality and look of the shirt is good, the fabric looks a bit darker than the one on the image, though. Can’t rate the fit yet as this is meant to be a gift this Christmas :)

records.title: Products great, delivery company crap
records.text: Products were great as normal from &SONS, so no complaints about them. What I do have a gripe about is the delivery company who basically tossed my parcel over the garden gate into a drain. Lucky the products weren’t damaged or wet. Suggest &Sons get some payback from their delivery vendor.

records.title: Great delivery time to Australia…
records.text: Great delivery time to Australia approximately 1 week to my front door. Jeans 5 stars great fit sizing is right great quality. Henley t shirt 4 stars great quality sizing runs small xxl more like 118cm to 122cm. Braces 4 stars great quality but are on the smaller size so if you’re 6 foot or taller these may not fit even at full extension. All great quality products would have given 5 stars if the t shirt was the right size and had some of the sold out items in stock. Will definitely but from this company again.

records.title: Too Early to Tell-Great Experience So Far
records.text: To early to tell how well this garment is in terms of its build and quality however, the first impression has been outstanding. Customer service has been exceptional as well as the shipment time. So far, it has been a great experience. Ultimately, I will see how long this garment lasts but I do hope it last for a long time. It is well designed and great variety of colors and comfort.

records.title: Excellent delivery time
records.text: Excellent delivery time. Trousers as always top notch but could do with brace’s buttons.

records.title: Jeans Purchase
records.text: Great fitting and at face value high quality product. I’m a 32/32 in Levi’s. Ordered the 32 in these jeans and fits perfectly. At this price point they need to last many years, so a further review after longer ownership would be required to achieve 5 stars.

records.title: Nearly perfect
records.text: Customer service and shipping was 10/10.  Fast, efficient, high quality and helpful. The  sweater and hat I ordered is fantastic and top of the line quality. Unfortunately, the sleeves brush the zippers on my sweater and pull out the threads routinely. After wearing for a week my inner arms are not in great shape.

records.title: One of a kind gear
records.text: I really like most & sons purchases I ve bought and that's quite a few. I like the fact it's all kinda one off stuff so good if you Don t want to see other people wearing the same clothes as yourself

records.title: Shopping for clothes online is dificult
records.text: Shopping for clothes online is difficult because the size guide needs to be clearer. I am 1’80 cm tall and weigh 75 kg. It is difficult to choose size M or L.

records.title: Good Choice and Service
records.text: The choice is good and the buying experience is straight forward. Being able to use PayPal and break the amount down is useful.It does take a few days for the package to arrive, but very pleased with the product on first viewing.

records.title: I have to say guys you uses a very good…
records.text: I have to say guys you uses a very good materials for headwear... The designs are really good, old school, but it turnes faded faster than normally does on other brands... Your web stock says "New design" but out of stock?, so you will notify restock but it'll never happen ever

records.title: Boots
records.text: I have given 4 stars because the purchase of my product was easy and they delivered it quickly and they were brilliant quality. Unfortunately the boots were too big so I have had to return (at my own expense) and I’m now waiting for them to say they have received them and send me a smaller size. I returned them next day delivery and proof of delivery and 4 days later I still haven’t heard anything from them……

records.title: Love the style of this brand & am an…
records.text: Love the style of this brand & am an often returning customer BUT I do have a complaint with the Drover boot. Sole came lose after only a couple of months. Glued not stitched. Had to have it fixed a couple of times since. At Redwing prices I expect the same quality.

records.title: Waited a while to get these but worth…
records.text: Waited a while to get these but worth the cost as  another quality addition to my wardrobe

records.title: Great All Round Package
records.text: Expected quality of the clothes never fails to satisfy, with great detailing. Packaged and sent in good time to Guernsey. It's nice to receive a well presented &Sons leaflet on the clothing range within the package, tempting future buys.

records.title: Return Experience Disappointing
records.text: I was disappointed in the return experience. I bought a shirt for my son-in-law for Christmas. He has purchased shirts from your company in the past and he requested the shirt I bought him in size medium. He loved the shirt but it was too tight. I needed to make an exchange but realized even for the exchange I was responsible for the postage costs. Plus, I only had 14 days to make the return. Since the item arrived before Christmas I only had two days left to return the shirt. It was an anxiety producing event!

records.title: I got 2 xtra large shirts because that…
records.text: I got 2 xtra large shirts because that size fits me well in all brands. One is too tight and the other I can’t even button. I’m 6’2” with 48” chest

records.title: Nice quality, but frustrating
records.text: Nice quality as always, but inconsistent sizing (this one was a bit tight on me, often medium is a bit big) and lack of free returns means I'm out of pocket again for trying something on.  Bit frustrating.

records.title: i am a return customer because I love…
records.text: i am a return customer because I love the styling of your clothing... but twice in a row, a rivet has popped - on a pair of jeans and on a pair of coveralls... Thankfully I knew how to repair them but it seems like a quality issue.. Again, I love the style and general quality of your products but this is the second time that this has happened and it's a little concerning... shipping took much longer than usual this last time as well...

records.title: I disliked the fact it gave me a 20%…
records.text: I disliked the fact it gave me a 20% discount but at checkout it added it back on saying I d already had it.Why do new customers get discount over loyal customers who spend a lot with your company

records.title: The Clothes and shoe sizing doesn’t…
records.text: The Clothes and shoe sizing doesn’t seem to reflect true sizes as I have now returned boots and pumps also a towling T-shirt and shorts set !I buy a lot of clothes shoes & boots on line and I very rarely return them or have to change sizes I have just bought a track top is great same size as bottoms xxl & track bottoms xxl  the track pants are really over sized I am exchanging for a size down I am worried I should have gone down to a large Also you pricing compared also leaves me scratching my head I have recently bought track suites from £200 -350 and boots and shoes from £150 up to £350 plus happy to spend and like your on line catalogue but have felt some what disappointed as stated above .Your return and exchanges i feel could be so much easier I think scan a code rather than printing

records.title: Ordered grey wool trousers... but
records.text: Ordered grey wool trousers... looked good online but when trying on was underwhelmed at the material and did not like the cut considering the price point - so returned. Refund pending - little slow.

records.title: &Sons Ahab jumper
records.text: I love &Sons and have bought enough before to know Im normally an XXl so bought the Ahab jumper in that size. Unfortunately whereas &Sons XXL is normally like an XL in other brands this was true to size and the roll neck far too baggy. Should have got XL

records.title: I love the jeans, but!
records.text: I love the jeans. The finish is excellent, and they arrived on time, especially given it's Christmas time.The only problem is the fit. The waist and thigh are spot-on for me, but the leg is too long. I know they are supposed to be turned up, but the turn-up is so big that it looks ridiculous. You get a choice of waist but not leg. I don't have particularly short legs at 31 inches. I usually get away with a 32 ", but these are 33", except they are not. They are longer.I would like to see options in leg length. We're not all a perfect size, so please, And-Sons, you need to offer tailored lengths.

records.title: Nice vest
records.text: The vest was absolutely lovely and my father loved it. However it runs extremely slim. I had to buy a new one in a bigger size because they do not exchange at all.

records.title: Nordic Rucksack
records.text: I’ve had this for just over a year with almost daily use. Let’s start with positives. The rucksack is really well made and the materials are obviously high quality. Capacity is great for a day out with the side pockets and loops for other bits and bobs. It’s just a really nice pack. I would like to change the straps though. The chest clip really needs attaching to the side of the strap rather than the front. It causes the strap to twist and dig in making it uncomfortable. Ideally the buckles could do with the same quick release rather than the belt sort of fitting (no sure of the proper name!) many times these have come undone and the bag has fallen (once breaking a tablet screen that was in the bag, landed bang on the corner). The roll top straps could do with moving in a little, it’s easy for the canvas to come loose and unwind because they are so close to the edge. Would I recommend it? Yeah but only as a work/general bag.

records.title: Lovely shirt but ridiculously small.
records.text: Lovely shirt but ridiculously small for the size stated. Bought the same size as a jacket I bought some months ago which fits perfectly. Shame as you don’t do a larger size.

records.title: Hat didn’t fit returned tracked…
records.text: Hat didn’t fit returned tracked received it on the 22nd still not heard anything or had money refunded

records.title: Prospector Jacket Underwhelming
records.text: Was so excited to receive this, and hoped as it was so expensive and the pictures were so great, that it was going to be one of my new favourite pieces. But sadly it is very underwhelming, and not a great fit. Unfortunately, as it’s Salvage Stock I can’t return, but I knew that, so it’s the chance I took.

records.title: Must introduce free returns!
records.text: I've been lucky enough to have a sizeable gift card for &SONS for a while now.  The quality is undeniable - I struggle much more with the fit at times.  What I find very disappointing is having to pay for returns - this has cost me approx £50 in the last year, the latest being £7 to return their rucksack, which I found to be too awkward to load due to the narrow opening.  With their pricing and discounting they have clearly built in a healthy margin to their product lineup, so the least they could do is allow online shoppers to shop with confidence.

records.title: Oversized and faulty shoes
records.text: Sadly the items I received were all oversized. The insoles in the shoes weren’t stuck down at the toes so bubbled up. Otherwise items look well made just wish the fit wasn’t so large for size small or there was a smaller size option if the sizing is going to be oversized

records.title: Clear quality, sizing inaccurate.
records.text: Ordered 4 pairs of the Brendon Jeans, same size, 4 different washes. 4 completely different fits, and feel of the denim. Quality is there but it unfortunately the sizing was wildly all over the place. Still going to keep one pair but not too thrilled about the $12 I have to pay to send the other three back.

records.title: &SONS Vintage S Hoodie Black Fade X…
records.text: &SONS Vintage S Hoodie Black Fade X 1Size LQuality is very good but I feel the sizing is incorrect, Size L should be a M, Had to send back for XL,I am size L and bought other items from & Sons size L but in this particular case with this item, Size L was too tight

records.title: Sleeves too short.
records.text: The sleeves on the athletic top I recently purchased are too short (size L needs to be 1.5"-2.0" longer). Otherwise like the fit and material a lot.

records.title: Shirts are very nice but in 100% cotton
records.text: Shirts are very nice. But there is room for improvement concerning fabrics. Specially having them in 100% in cotton is really nice and suitable. Changing to only 50% cotton and 50% Polyester is really not nice and suitable for these nice T-shirts. Do a little bit more 100% cotton instead of mixes with artificial like Polyester. Thank you

records.title: Watch Cap - Disappointing Quality
records.text: I recently purchased the yellow Watch Cap and  was very disappointed with the quality when compared to my other &SONS Watch Caps. The price even in the sale is premium the product however is not.Also, after achieving the pioneer status in the tier points club I am still waiting for the reward that is supposed to be posted out.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: I have always been very happy with the quality and style of the clothes from &SONS. But when you buy over the internet you can't try the goods on so return should be free. I bought gloves in size M because I don't have particularly large hands but they are too tight. To return with a view to exchanging for L I had to pay nearly £5 in postage. OK it's not a lot but the principle should be free returns.

records.title: Sharp marketing practice
records.text: Sharp marketing practice - offer reductions for first mail order purchase, 20% I think, and offer 10% for joining marketing email list”, but gave neither on sale items! Just saying. Gloves  I bought were good but overpriced - can get way better for less elsewhere.  You’re definitely paying for lifestyle hype! Gloves will be returned.

records.title: My first order was also my last
records.text: The company describes the men's boxer as a slim fit, but it's more of a boxer brief. When I suggested the advertising might be changed to reflect that, a manager said no one else had complained. I live in the US. Maybe European men don't make a distinction between boxers and boxer briefs. Manager seemed confrontational rather than helpful. First time customer who won't be returning.

records.title: These are very over priced…
records.text: These are very over priced for a jumper you can get in M&S for £30. This jumper has just turned up 5mins ago and it’s already packed awaiting a return as the quality doesn’t match the price tag and I feel conned

records.title: The hat lacks thickness and quality for…
records.text: The hat lacks thickness and quality for the price , would of expected better as I’ve had good quality  clothing from this Company

records.title: Spoke dreadful customer service to customer service and put in…
records.text: Spoke to customer service and put in writing on my order that it should be sent by DPD because I have lots of problems in my rural area with Royal Mail. That was all agreed and can you believe the order was still sent by RM and yes it did get lost and took 3 days and a lot of hassle to find it !! Need better customer service. Product good though.

records.title: Awesome Company. Some bizarre fits mind.
records.text: Firstly I really would like to sing the praises of the customer service team, I have been buying from this company for a long time and the service is phenomenal. This review is for the Washburn Shirt Black. Unfortunately whilst the quality and colour of this shirt is great, the fit is extremely bizarre and in no way representive of the description on the website. This is most definitely a ‘fitted’ shirt, so bear this in mind, the website states ‘Regular’.However it is only fitted across the shoulders and back, it then flares out across the body, so from the side it’s look quite weird. It is very disproportionate. So the body is a regular fit and the chest, shoulder and back are fitted. Just bear this in mind, as it will cost you quite a bit to return these items due to the value. Again, I am only reviewing the product, if you do purchase from this company, you will not be disappointed.

records.title: Disappointing Stitching on an otherwise good Sunday Shirt Army Green.
records.text: I purchased the Sunday Shirt in Army Green after seeing the stylish photos online. While the design and overall look of the shirt were impressive, I was disappointed to find that the stitching at the base of the bottom left front and back was poorly done. Despite repeated attempts to iron it down, the fabric continues to pop up, which is very frustrating, especially due to the cost of the product.  I was going to add a photo too on this review, but there was no option to do so.It's unfortunate because the rest of the shirt fits well and has great potential. In contrast, I also bought The &SONS Sunday Shirt in Corduroy Tan, which fits perfectly and has become a regular part of my wear.If the company wishes to discuss this, I am open to returning the green shirt and having it replaced with one that meets quality standards. Although this experience dates back to early 2023 and I had set the shirt aside and forgotten about this actual shirt until I had a small tidy out at my home.

records.title: Product good but to then be offered a…
records.text: Product good but to then be offered a £45 discount less than a week after purchasing at full price does not sit well ! Very disappointing.

description: Wolf & Badger is home to the best independent, ethical and unique brands from around the world. You can shop online or in-store in London, New York & Los Angeles.

records.title: Great looking and fitting dress
records.text: When I saw the dress online, it looked like it was the color gray with fine white lines, but it's actually black with bolder colored white lines, but it still looks refined and not gaudy.  It fits perfectly and looks very stylish and modern and I love it.  2nd time purchasing from Wolf & Badger; haven't been disappointed yet.

records.title: The pair of slippers I ordered in color…
records.text: The pair of slippers I ordered in color cream ended up being out of stock and I received a text message to alert me. That was a nice touch versus just not giving me the choice to choose another color. As for the item I will say the slippers seem to run small but nice quality. We both have to continuously reattach the broaches on our slippers… which sucks because now I’ll have to spend more money to have a seamstress sew the broaches onto the slippers.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service.  Ordered necklace which arrived very quickly as I am across the other side of the world in New Zealand and it is over the Christmas period.Necklace is beautiful and I am very impressed overall with the necklace and the speed it arrived.

records.title: Special dress and earrings.
records.text: The dress and earrings arrived right on time for the New Year’s Eve party. The dress viscose/ silk fabric has a lovely sheen and the cockatoo print was commented on by all. Fabulous. The earrings are a great statement and arrived beautifully boxed. Thank you.

records.title: Amazing Customer Care
records.text: I made a few purchases recently and one of my items has yet to ship out, and Dennise has been an absolute doll during the whole process. She continues to check in on me and with the brand the item comes from for updates on my order. She also personally saw to my other purchases and made sure they were in fact delivered and delivered safely, as well as checking in with me to make sure I received my other items as well. I already loved Wolf & Badger, but the customer service really solidified that for me.

records.title: Gorgeous scarf
records.text: My silk scarf is even more beautiful than I thought it would be. Lustrous colour and sheen. Nicely packaged in a protective storage pouch. Fast delivery. I’m very pleased .

records.title: super trustworthy and outstanding service and garments
records.text: Wolf and badger make searching for ethical independant slow fashion across the globe easy. Seamless, fast and affordable shipping makes for a pleasant experience. You may also be lucky to pick up a good bargain in their sales. Ive collected so relly great gems pver the years. This is my fifth year with W&B and have never had a bad experience.

records.title: Wolf and Badger lives up to the hype!
records.text: The Wolf and Badger brand lives up to the hype! I ordered the Siren Double Chain Cuff Earring in gold by Aaria London as a Christmas present for my sister and the quality of product was immaculate. While there was a brief delay with the estimated delivery time, the Wolf and Badger team were prompt and thorough in their communication with me and clarified any concerns I may have had. Fortunately the product arrived just in time for Christmas so all was well. Would definitely use their site again - a great find!

records.title: An amazing range of unique
records.text: An amazing range of unique, quality products. Good payment options.  Super easy check out and my product arrived from UK to Australia in a short time frame. I was sent the tracking infomration so could keep tabs on my parcel.  Overall a really great shopping experience.

records.title: Stunning customer service
records.text: The customer service went above and beyond. Due to some stock issues, my order was delayed, so I contacted their team as the item was an anniversary gift. They were prompt, sincerely apologetic, and kept me updated throughout the process, including their communications with the supplier and my available options. I would definitely order from them again.

records.title: It's really hard to get a hold of a real person
records.text: I just found it hard to get a hold of a real person, when trying to find out more information on when my order was going to arrive. I really love the product when it finally came. And will probably order another one.

records.title: Very good service but I kind of wish…
records.text: Very good service but I kind of wish the estimated arrival date on the initial emails were more accurate. The first three confirmation emails all said December 23, then December 24 and then ultimately the product arrived on Dec 26. Its just an expectations management thing. I would have understood if the real date was just the 26th, just let me know.

records.title: Great communication and product!
records.text: Great communication. I've bought 2 pieces from Wolf and Badger and have been very pleasantly surprised both times! This dress is much more detailed than the pic shows. Each leaf is crocheted and the material is a heavier weight....AND LINED!  I'm a little technically challenged,  but I'll try to post a pic next wear. Also the buttons!! They're bold and beautiful!!

records.title: Let down a bit by courier...
records.text: We liked what we bought. The quality was good and the price reasonable. I docked a star for delivery, your preferred couriers delivery updates felt old fashioned and protracted and they delivered outside the delivery slot they promised so we were not in. Fortunately a neighbour was.

records.title: Great item and super fast…
records.text: Great item and super fast delivery/arrived before Christmas thank you very much /little niggle is that the Anker for the stone gummy bear is silver colour and the neckless is in gold colour so a little mismatched/but super item

records.title: Good service but the product I ordered was not
records.text: The product was nice and came very quickly.  However, the ring holder clasp on the necklace barely opens and it is very difficult to easily save our ring on the holder.  I would not order this product again or recommend this product but I would recommend the company for other products.

records.title: Gorgeous products
records.text: Gorgeous products. Speedy delivery too . Dropped a star because I ordered 2 special plates but they were packed together in one presentation box and as they’re presents I was disappointed.

records.title: First Timer
records.text: First time ordering… I was a bit nervous about purchase. The purchase arrived in ok time about 10 days from order date. It was packaged well and appears to be good quality

records.title: Good experience
records.text: Prompt delivery. Although the delivery fee could be cheaper. Love the dress.

records.title: Easy to use web site
records.text: Easy to use web site. Regular updates on progress of.delivery.

records.title: Overall the earrings appear very nice
records.text: Overall the earrings appear very nice.  Delivery was quick.  The outer packaging was good, but the actual gift box was slightly crushed, which only matters because they were a gift for someone else. Also, the gift message appeared in a small box on the delivery note, which you are not going to give to the person, otherwise the purchase was good.

records.title: Good purchase
records.text: Good purchase Was easy to order the item i wanted for a christmas present Only negative thing about my order was the delivery it said it should have been delivered at the beginning of december i contacted customer service who was very helpful in assisting me with the order

records.title: Delivery was pretty quick and seamless
records.text: Delivery was pretty quick and seamless. The black boots I ordered looked different from the online pick. I didn’t like the styling when I had the boot in hand.

records.title: My item arrived on the day I was told…
records.text: My item arrived on the day I was told it would arrive - right to the door and in my hand. The only thing that might have improved this service would be a "ball park" time or a phone call thirty min prior to ensure I was home. Nonetheless, I'm very pleased with the service

records.title: The slippers are utterly gorgeous
records.text: The slippers are utterly gorgeous. The only issue is I think they fit small. They fit but only just. The quality of the embellishments is outstanding. I adore the fish and chips detail. My family owned a fish n chip shop so we found these hilarious. Your foot slightly slips out and back as material is so silky. Although that could be as they were slightly too small. I'm a 6 and ordered a M xx

records.title: Great customer experience on changing size o my order
records.text: But after receiving the Mauritius jacket it is sup par quality that this company got cheap from Pakistan and charged me 150$ more. I am familiar with this from Pakistan. So I would like a refund label for this jacket order number 2551884 to Charlene Acciari 1007 West Webster Ave Chicago Ill 60614. Thank you

records.title: Good service experienced
records.text: Good service experienced, the delivery was timely and my enquiries were answered promptly.

records.title: Emails and info provided by tracking…
records.text: Emails and info provided by tracking system were wrong so it was confusing.

records.title: Needing to exchange an item
records.text: The customer service representatives that I texted with were very kind and helpful.  I found it very frustrating that there wasn’t a way to do a direct exchange for a different size.  Also I found it frustrating that your refund menus didn’t allow putting in a unique issue like what I was having. I had to just keep pressing the different menu items until I finally was able to get a representative online who could help me.  Other than those two issues you guys were fantastic!  I loved the look and materials of the bracelet that I received.  Unfortunately, I guessed my husband’s wrist size incorrectly!

records.title: Very quick to respond to queries
records.text: Very quick to respond to queries - ensured delivery to Australia in time for Christmas. I was impressed and appreciative.

records.title: Average costs a lot these days
records.text: The image on the scarf from Artifact was more blurred than in the online picture. I expected clearer detail for the cost though reduced to £138. Would be furious had it been full price over £180.  Will keep the scarf but will not buy from here again. Also the delivery company DHL were so useless it arrived late meaning another present had to be bought for Christmas Day.

records.title: Items much smaller than pictured
records.text: I do love W&B even if they are slightly over priced. Just received my order of a 3 piece travel bag set and am really disappointed. They are A LOT smaller than they appeared in the pictures. Also the brand’s price label states £40 however you charged £48 plus postage… I know your profit margin would have been factored in when buying wholesale (eg much cheaper) for your site.Please W&B include an item in the product pics that gives the customer an understanding of the size of product(s). Dimensions given in a description don’t relate as well as a visual reference

records.title: Great variety, slow shipping, weird rules
records.text: It’s great to have someone ch a variety of goods and jewelry from all of the world in one place. However, some items are truly overpriced. Shipping is quite slow. Interestingly, international item arrived earlier than one claimed to be from US. Additionally, the promotional 10% off didn’t work on an order that I wanted to place saying it was not my first order. The first order already had a promotional discount and 10% of the first order promotional code came late. When you give a promotion for signing up you should give it to the next order, not only for the first one, as the majority of other companies do. I feel cheated.

records.title: This is my first order and I must say…
records.text: This is my first order and I must say that I'm not enchanted.  The purse is described as made from suple leather and it's actually very hard,  which I don't mind. The hardware is well designed but it seems of inferior quite . It's listed as made in Italy but nowhere on the purse it's specified a Made in.. Especially nowadays if it's made in Italy it is specified. Also, on the Apatchy site this item is on sale. I'm thinking of returning it, and there are no instructions which adds to the process.ZN

records.title: The packaging was very good but the…
records.text: The packaging was very good but the order didn‘t arrive on time, since it was not dispatched as scheduled

records.title: The order was promised for the 24th…
records.text: The order was promised for the 24th December but didnt arrive till after . The order is NOT in transit as your label didnt work in 2 shops to return it..Its still here with me at home

records.title: Too short in the torso
records.text: I'm 5ft 4 and a busty/average size 12. This jumpsuit had so much potential, but the torso was too short. I bought a size 14 to compare, but the hips were too wide and lost the flattering shape of the size 12. I bought it in the Emerald Green. Gorgeous colour, but not worth £65.00.

records.title: No clarity on taxes
records.text: No clarity on taxes, British site had a better price..I was sent to the American site, with higher prices Regardless the item was sent from Uk and I had to pay 50% taxes on it, ridiculous If it had come fro US it’s 16%, which any way should have been reflected in the sale price…it felt a little scammy….

records.title: Fast delivery but the returns process is a faff…
records.text: Fast delivery but the returns process is a bit of a faff, and the window isn’t generous enough for the festive period.

records.title: Beautiful coat return process has not been simple.
records.text: My wife loves the coat but I ordered the wrong size.  We went through the process to return it and much to our surprise we could not simply exchange it.  We sent the item back today December 27 2024 and we have to wait for a refund before I order the same coat but in a size large which we will be doing.    We tried calling to start the return process no one answered.  We chatted with a nice young lady who sent us a return label but the process in getting to that point is ridiculous. Again the coat is beautiful my wife loves it we will be ordering the same coat again in a size large once we see our credit card refunded.  I am not sure if I would use wolf and badger again  We will see how the rest of this process goes.

records.title: nice items but had true price  reveal.
records.text: It items were nice, the rating is really for the prices. Discounted items really weren’t, as the merchandised came with their euro price ticket attached. Therefore, doing the conversion into USD it really wasn’t a discount. It’s just feels like being cheated.

records.title: I ordered 2 pairs of earrings
records.text: I ordered 2 pairs of earrings, from your website.  They arrived separately.  One pair was absolutely fine, but the second pair were damaged and one of the earrings wasn’t even inside the little plastic bag.  These were Christmas presents.

records.title: The peacocks are really beautiful…
records.text: The peacocks are really beautiful designed, lovely colour , well thought , the only inconvenience is the circumference of the holes , way too small , cannot get the salt and the pepper out !

records.title: I will be returning the sweatshirts
records.text: I will be returning the sweatshirts.  To begin with, they arrived later than the projected date and they missed the Christmas party. However, when they did arrive, the quality was so poor, they will need to be returned.

records.title: Ok but not worth the price.
records.text: Speedy delivery from the USA and nicely packaged. The item itself wasn’t what I expected. The shell was a particularly unappealing yellowish/brown colour and the metal work was rough and not neat. The fragrance is pleasant and strong smelling. Overall, I don’t think the product is worth the price due to these faults.

records.title: Beautiful earrings
records.text: Beautiful earrings. However, they have no backs. They arrived loose in the box, rather than in the display cushion, and the backs are missing. The “presentation” was disappointing for an expensive item. They also recommend keeping them in a pouch, not the box. A pouch would be welcome on purchase of the earrings.

records.title: Your service was ok
records.text: Your service was ok. I guess my major issue was that you sold me products that you didn’t have and then after me contacting you, we established some back and forth communication. The product has finally arrived and I appreciate as a gesture of good will you reimbursed $10 of my postage.

records.title: I spent that much money for a mug…
records.text: I spent that much money for a mug thinking it would keep my coffee hot, but it was warm by an hour with the lid on. I was disappointed.

records.title: Service was very good
records.text: Service was very good - just shocked at the quality of the product- really not what I’d expect from Wolf and Badger! It was very poor quality and especially for the price. Interesting the company selling it - on their website it was £20 cheaper - still rubbish for that!

records.title: Good checkout, bad shipping.
records.text: Loved the site, and checkout was easy. The shipping and initial communication was disappointing. I was told when the item was initially shipped but then I didn't receive it. Then I contacted Wolf & Badger about canceling the order. The reps were pretty good with communication. I received my order approximately 2 weeks after ordering. All and all I like the item, I'm just a little skeptical about ordering again due to the third party.

records.title: Let us Pre pay Import taxes!
records.text: Not sure if this review is about the crochet bralette or the recycled glass rings but here is what could have gone better with each order…bralette took ages to arrive…I considered canceling the order but didn’t…on all of the orders through Wolf and Badger please consider the pre paid taxes in the finalPurchase order…I shop online a lot and many companies offer this…1.it is a drag to have to wait for the delivery person to pay the import taxes (and no paying with my credit card is not an option because my delivery address does not match h my billing address so I do have to wait for the DHL delivery and hand over cash and no they don’t carry change so it has to be payed to the cent ) 2. One can not guesstimatewhat the import tax will be upon purchasing on Wolf & Badger…BECAUSE an outrageous import processing fee IS TACKED onto the import tax…(the importing processing fee is sometimes 1/2 of the import tax:( at least with DHL Mexico)

records.title: Beautiful earrings
records.text: Beautiful earrings, one of the earrings post broke off when putting on my ear. Very disappointed.

records.title: Shipping times not accurate
records.text: I only ordered this item because it said the latest it would arrive was the 18th December. It arrived on the 27th December. It was my partners birthday present 😭. Item was very nice though

records.title: Christmas present for my wife
records.text: Christmas present for my wife. Very disappointed. Expensive beautiful slippers but both badges fell off after wearing for 10 minutes.

records.title: This is the 2nd time that I have…
records.text: This is the 2nd time that I have experienced sizing problems with W+B unfortunately.I am a regular size 10, so ordered size 10 jacket and trouser suit. The jacket fits well, but the trousers were very small; I have had to order a size 12. Also experiencing difficulty completing the return of the small trousers!

records.title: Not great so far …
records.text: Well so far 1 have received 2 of 3 items ordered. I have sent an email requesting an update but apart from a message of receipt, nothing.All pretty stressful!

records.title: Details matter
records.text: The actual item is great but guess what guys…. The colour of the dog is super important! The image of the slippers I ordered was for the liver & white spaniel but I’ve actually been sent the black & white spaniel. Assume most people buy these slippers for “dog mums” specifically with the colour/ breed of their dog……

records.title: Out of luck if you need a live person to help
records.text: I want to exchange my shoes for a different size. There is no option to do that nor can I reach customer service (online or by phone) to get an answer as to whether it’s possible. Because I can't exchange it I will lose the promotion becuase it's no longer in place. This is atypical and disappointing.

records.title: Refund made without advising me
records.text: I purchased underwear and the bottoms of the set were refunded without asking or advising. What use is half a set, it was for a gift. Now I have to go to the effort of returning the tops, I would imagine at my expense. Disappointed customer.

records.title: Mixed up orders not yet resolved
records.text: I understand that when things go wrong they take a bit of time to work out, but I’m yet to receive an update about my dress that was sent to someone else and I got their order instead. So far not happy with the customer service.

description:
Established in 2006, Tilletts are an independent family owned business providing quality clothes at affordable prices for the every woman. A mother and daughter buying team comprised of Melanie, Grace and Nancy, Tilletts whole ethos is ‘Style With Confidence'. Tilletts pride themselves on providing excellent Customer Service and ensuring every lady leaves their shopping encounter with Tilletts feeling comfortable, confident and confident in their new purchases.
This dedication and drive has earned the Tilletts numerous award wins and nominations including a European Digital Award for Best Digital Marketing Campaign and ‘Retailer of the Year’ in the Lincolnshire Tourism Excellence Awards.
SHOP NOW

records.title: Just bought my third pair of super soft…
records.text: Just bought my third pair of super soft leggings in the sale. Great value for money, so comfortable to wear and the quality is good. Customer service is always great with Tilletts, easy ordering process, good communication and quick delivery. I have placed many orders with them so would definitely recommend.

records.title: The customer service is exemplary!
records.text: The customer service is exemplary!!  Nothing is too much trouble!I was collecting an online order and ended up buying some other items whilst in the store

records.title: trustworthy  , hard working team.

records.title: Love my new top

records.title: Fantastic service as usual and the sale…
records.text: Fantastic service as usual and the sale was a added bonus ordered 3 times thanks team Tilletts

records.title: Exceptional service
records.text: Everytime i have been into the store the service has been exceptional. All staff are friendly, helpful and honest. Sarah is amazing and after a few visits knows what clothes suit me and is able to recommend new stock etc. She also helped my husband choose my Christmas presentThe clothes are great quality and value fir money. Parking is right outside the door. Love this place. Thank you Tracey

records.title: Everything I ordered was in stock it…

records.title: All the cloths that ihave received have…
