records.title: Quality worth paying for.
records.text: Lovely staff, size ypu order is always correct, good quality as well, I've been a customer for over 5 years now

records.title: Simplicity itself to order
records.text: Simplicity itself to order, delivery within 48hrs. Peace of mind when ordering from Tilletts, gives you confidence to order, if any problems they are sorted immediately through customer services. Love Mel on the lives daily, so informative on sizing, colour, fit etc. All goods received are amazing quality.

records.title: I like shopping with Tilly always find…
records.text: I like shopping with Tilly always find something that I like. Customer service is great and I enjoy mel catch ups every morning

records.title: Quick service and good quality items
records.text: Quick service and good quality items. Only downside is the difference in sizing. Two XL jumpers but not the same fit.

records.title: hi well never had any issues but sent…
records.text: hi well never had any issues but sent wrong sz boots so would have been a 5 so i am having to pay pp again to return the sz 3 ,when i am sz 6

records.title: Lovely top
records.text: Delivery was sooner than expected and the parcel was well packed. I love the garment although one seam is not flat. It is comfortable to wear.

records.title: Great clothes and prices …
records.text: Great clothes and prices love the 0730 live's  but disappointing when you have purchased and paid for few items and waiting for delivery to then receive a notification one item will be refunded ? no explanation why the item wasn't then available.I have checked my inbox and spam  and no email was received from tilletts if you can give me dates and time I can look again thanks

records.title: Very quick delivery
records.text: Very quick deliverydid not give 5 stars as the waist band is noe of those where the elastic waistband twists

records.title: Ordered 3 items,but only kept 1
records.text: Ordered 3 items,but only kept 1, love the lounge set, but black wide trousers, wasn't keen on material, and  jacket didn't suit me.

records.title: Bought in the sale
records.text: Bought in the sale, so happy with the price. Easy to purchase and quick to arrive .

records.title: Faulty Longline fleece gilet
records.text: I recently ordered  a fleece longline gilet unfortunately this particular item must have dodged the Quality Control section as there were 3 glaring faults. The hood ties came out in completely different levels, the pockets were not the same size or stitched at the same height and the splits at the side were also different lengths! However after getting in touch with them, and after sending photos an exchange was agreed upon. I still liked the style.

records.title: Love the variety of clothing
records.text: Love the variety of clothing. Although I don't think certain items live up to their name or either poorly made, bigger than you require.

records.title: Customer service is excellent
records.text: Customer service is excellent. However very disappointed with 2 items on my last order. The stitching on a jacket was dreadful and it wasn't cut straight. Also a black mark on a cream jumper. I buy alot from Tillets and I was shocked at the items sent to me.

records.title: Mimi sweaters
records.text: Having had these in the past i was really pleased these Mimi sweaters are available again.  Flattering comfortable & lightweight fit.Have bought the three colours

records.title: Lovely quality and quick delivery
records.text: Lovely quality and quick delivery. Just wish more of the clothes come in smaller sizes. I am 5’3” and a size 12 and find the tops just swamp me regardless of the fact I have mentioned this before and am told your models are smaller sizes. Even a separate section for smaller sizes would be great. It’s annoying to see something lovely only to find they are sizes up to 18/20 and know they will be way too big on me. Disappointing 😢

records.title: Great shawl at 50% off
records.text: Great shawl at 50% off. Italian acrylic nicer than other acrylics.

records.title: Delivery was great and the jumper was…
records.text: Delivery was great and the jumper was superb, soft and fitted perfectly, thanks Tilletts

records.title: A little disappointed
records.text: Item I ordered was pre order and order process good. Approximate delivery time was correct and arrived well packaged.  Item was a little disappointing. Two piece crochet item Natalia. The outer crochet top was lovely but the under vest was ridiculous sizing, very small, thin stretchy poor quality material. Sizing advertised as to fit 12-18, I am a 14.  I kept item and will wear over my own vest top.

records.title: Very easy to order on line and delivery…
records.text: Very easy to order on line and delivery was within 48 hours, great service. Ordered 2 of the same jumper in different colours, not the quality I was expecting and one of the jumpers is shorter than the other, never the less, nice jumpers and I will be keeping them both. States one size will fit up to an 18, I’m an 18 and the fit is perfect with plenty of room, just a bit on the short side as I’m 5’10.

records.title: Top was quality garment
records.text: Top was quality garment. Scarf not so much. Started fraying on ends as soon as put on

records.title: Order click and collect
records.text: Items ordered for collection as convenient for me. Parking an issue though as not many spaces available to use. Returns dealt with in same way for convenience.  Refunds always prompt.Looking forward to the new store opening soon!

records.title: Great shop but said didn't have a…
records.text: Great shop but said didn't have a sweater I wanted which I later discovered was in stock but they sent it free of postage charge so everything ok

records.title: I thought the quality was poor so am…
records.text: I thought the quality was poor so am returning the utems

records.title: Easy website, confusing collection information.
records.text: Ordering on the website was nice and simple. Collecting the order was a little confusing due to an email stating to go to the warehouse, on arrival to the warehouse was a note directing me to the shop. I explained this to the lady behind the counter who didn't really acknowledge what I'd said or an apology. Maybe worth changing the email with clear collection point.

records.title: Used to be good
records.text: I used to buy from Tilletts almost every other week and have wardrobes full, but feel that this year the quality and choice of styles has really dropped. Such a shame

records.title: Only reason it got 3 stars was the top…
records.text: Only reason it got 3 stars was the top arrived very creased. Customer services did sort out for me and I was offered 20% discount to keep which I refused. I did love the top like.

records.title: My experience as always is good
records.text: My experience as always is good, disappointed with product things that go up to a 20 are always to big on me I looked swamped in them I’m a 14/16. Lucky I’ve got a friend who takes them of me.How come your models look good in them

records.title: I ordered 4 items which were delivered…
records.text: I ordered 4 items which were delivered within a couple of days so thank you.  Unfortunately, I ordered an orange roll neck top and was sent an orange cardigan.  The tag on the cardigan says it's a roll neck top too which  I think whoever was sending it out should have realised.  I will be sending the cardigan back in the next few days.  Could you send me the correct top or a refund please. I have had quite a few deliveries previously so I know this is a genuine error and it won't stop me ordering in future.

records.title: Love all the magic trousers but it…
records.text: Love all the magic trousers but it would be so helpful to have a range of leg lengths.  I've had to pay again to have them shortened.  So going towards companies that offer options as much as I don't want to.

records.title: Love the colouring but the description…
records.text: Love the colouring but the description didn't mention the jumper has sticky out bits by the hips looks like pockets are missing. I shall keep it but, will need to have it altered which will make it a very expensive jumper

records.title: Queries /observation
records.text: Can you please advise when Mel is “selling” especially clothing with extras like tassels sequins that she never states any washing instructions. Which would be very helpfulI love watching but this is just an observationLove the top that I just received but alas no washing /care instructions it would be do helpfulThank you

records.title: Had  previously ordered these  tops the…
records.text: Had  previously ordered these  tops the patterned roll necks  and the quality was really good Ordered this top for  a friend and the quality is  nowhere near as good really disappointed

records.title: I love the ethos of Tillets and the…
records.text: I love the ethos of Tillets and the community they have built. Very helpful customer service team. The clothes are generally nice, I see some of the lines on other online and local boutiques at different prices, but they have some nice different pieces, however very small volumes and unless you are watching a live video on Facebook at 7:30am you miss out on many things. I find the size ranges are not overly accurate and the models are slim and fit smaller sizes so it’s hard to gauge

records.title: Fast efficient service but the jumpsuit…
records.text: Fast efficient service but the jumpsuit I ordered didn't fit - i'm a size 16 and it said it fit to size 18.  I've ordered some other things so fingers crossed.  It's just if you don't like something sending back and paying for postage both ways is acceptable but when it's a sizing issue that's a bit annoying

records.title: Great clothes, but not perfect.
records.text: Although I do love the clothes, some of the tops and dresses do come up big under the arms, so I find I am not buying as much because of this. After paying for delivery and return, it can cost nearly £7 more so will only buy if you can see how they sit under the arm.  Would be good if they show you this on the models.

records.title: The item I ordered was on preorder
records.text: The item I ordered was on preorder. There was no confirmation email for the order I rang customer service and person I spoke to gave me order number and said she would send another confirmation order email. I did not receive this either. Checked my junk mail nothing there either. Item eventually did arrive almost 2 weeks after first ordered. Not sure whether I will keep it .Item is very shapeless and baggy in this one size fits all style that Tilletts seems to specialise in. Looks good on model but not on me unfortunately.

records.title: Lovely looking jumpers
records.text: I ordered two of the longer lurex jumpers that looked lovely on line but when I tried one it fitted on my chest but as it got down to my hips it was so wide and then went back in again as it went down, I know they go up to a size 20 I am a 16 so was disappointed and had to send back

records.title: Delivery took far too long
records.text: Prices and quality are great but when pre ordering out of stock items alongside in stock ones, it would be much better not to have to wait for the entire order. I waited a month for delivery and did, in fact, have another item ordered later and delivered much sooner

records.title: Stylish looking.
records.text: Clothing looks fashionable and stylish. However, the quality of some items is not very good. Poor quality fabrics, stitching and finishing of items could be better.

records.title: It is my wife’s 69th birthday in March…
records.text: It is my wife’s 69th birthday in March and I wanted a voucher for £69 representing her age( I’ve done this with other independent companies before,) but could only get £60 or £100…… my wife purchases from tilletts on a regular basis so it won’t go to waste! Just needed some flexibility, give the customer what, they, want not what suits them. Lost £9! Xx

records.title: Disappointed customer
records.text: I have had to return the top because it was far too big. The sleeves were very long.

records.title: Leggings nice but fall down one…
records.text: Your leggings nice but fall down one size fits all and are very thin materials so advise tights under neither. Picked some stuff in sale will see quality in those items. But the dog tooth leggings and checked are more summer and need adjustable waist band. I actually got some few years ago from morris ons of all places quality band n thickness there and they don't have a huge range 3 yrs on still going strong, these ones won't last a dog walk for sure. They are so thin..

records.title: My purchase was for something specific
records.text: My purchase was for something specific. I was aware it was a pre order and was given a 10 to 14 day delivery when I ordered in 15th November. The product was not available until a month later. I had no updates and rang 3 time enquiring. A simple email explaining would have been polite.

records.title: Took too long and could’ve been cheaper
records.text: This item took 7 days for Royal Mail to confirm they’d received it, much longer than usual from Tillets. I saw the Christmas jumper in a local shop just after I’d ordered it from Tillets priced at £18. i.e £4 cheaper than Tillets so with the postage costs I could’ve got it almost £7 cheaper and in time for the event I ordered it for.

records.title: Very disappointed tops not great…
records.text: Very disappointed tops not great quality and didn't sit straight when on.

records.title: I’ve ordered several items recently and…
records.text: I’ve ordered several items recently and I’m finding the sizes are not true to size,  I’m a 18/20 in all stores like M&S, Roman, etc.  so when Tilletts advertise an item as 20/22 I’m expecting it to fit. Ordering and then returning is costing me £7.00 Recently I’ve spent £21 in postage, makes me think I won’t be ordering again

records.title: Awful quality
records.text: Awful quality.  Not returned them as brought in the sale and costs 3.50 to return

records.title: Disappointed!
records.text: Disappointed in the quality of this black dress although it was bought in the sale for a quarter of the original price. The hanky hem style is nice but the material, in my opinion, is flimsy and not fit for purpose. Not worth returning so I’ll probably use it as a nightie as there is no way I would wear it to go out in. Tilletts’ customer service, delivery and returns facility is first class.

records.title: Bit of a disappointment….
records.text: I usually adore most of my purchases but when the black and gold tartan waistcoat arrived yesterday 🙈🙈 it just was not the usual standard at all. The buttons looked so cheap ( SORRY!) and the material was not Tilletts usual high standard. .,So disappointed !

records.title: I was happy as ever with products but…
records.text: I was happy as ever with products but extremely disappointed with the amount of packaging a small slate and wooden board and 3 fabric bottles holders required.A padded envelope or similar would have been adequately safe , instead a box sort or square hamper size with plastic bubble wrap inside. Love Tillets but really upset at the non environmentally friendly way this order was dealt with.

records.title: Not a happy customer
records.text: That’s a few damaged items I’ve had to return now they’ve been ripped or stitching coming away then they are sold out so can’t get them replaced,I’m finding the quality control isn’t great.but customer service always deal with the problem straight away and never had a problem getting my refund.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Ordered 4 items. None suitable. The lining was too short on one.The second was too big everywhere.A vest top and shirt which I had planned to wear together were slightly different colours.Disappointed to have paid for delivery and return costs. Would put me off ordering again.

description:
VISIT HOMEPAGE 
 SHOP INDIVIDUAL PAIRS 
 SHOP GIFTS 
 CONTACT US 

London Sock Co. was founded on a belief that the little things – like socks – have the power to make a big difference. A great pair of socks can transform not just your style, but your state of mind. 

We love how a dash of colour can keep the grey at bay. Can help you walk brighter.

The truth is, an appreciation for the little things lies at the heart of our brand. It starts with the quality yarns we choose, the attention to detail in the designs and our signature gift boxes.

Importantly, it also extends to the little things we can do to make a difference for others. With every order, we donate a pair of socks to charity as a part of our Share a Pair initiative.

records.title: Excellent Customer Service
records.text: I ordered a number of packages and when I had paid and had the order confirmed by email I realised I had forgotten to use the 20%off code when checking out. I sent a quick email to see if it could be applied retrospectively to my order and I received an email and then resolution within 24 hours - I was so pleased and I’m really looking forward to receiving my socks as well. Thank you London Sock Company - excellent Customer Service.Stephen M

records.title: Christmas present for my boyfriend
records.text: The quality of these socks are unmatchable.  They material is thin yet absorbent and stays in place.  The colors are hard to find and the fabric is quite lovely against the skin.  The logo is not too extra…the sets make it easy to pick out and they make a lovely stocking gift at Christmas.

records.title: Grerat socks and service
records.text: Website was easy to navigate and easy to place an order and pay. Socks arrived quickly with no delay, and most importantly, there is a great range of socks of high quality and design to choose from.

records.title: Beautifully presented
records.text: Beautifully presented, lovely quality socks.Recipient loved them. Thank you from a very happy customer. Will certainly be ordering from you again.

records.title: Good delivery
records.text: Had a hard time with my country's postal service, but having that another order arrived perfectly on time to the U. S., I can infer that their delivery system is as efficient as can be.

records.title: Easy to order very happy with delivery…
records.text: Easy to order very happy with delivery time and quality of the socks my husband is delighted with them he loves them and has ordered them himself previously 😁

records.title: Brought the 6 pack sock set as a…
records.text: Brought the 6 pack sock set as a christmas gift, package came on time and the socks are nicely presented as shown on the website and most importantly the recepiant was delighted! Good choice

records.title: Superlative quality, colors!
records.text: I had been looking for Dueple socks to buy for my son, who is particular.  They are hard to find, but I took a chance on yours, because they looked similar (great colors, high quality!). They arrived quickly—for Christmas—and he is delighted !  Thank you!

records.title: I want  to amned my  last review of…
records.text: I want  to amned my  last review of this company. They made a wrong right.  The London Sock Company does have tremendous  customer service and for this I am truly thankful and will order again in the future. Or for sure visit a store when I am in the area.

records.title: Real quality product
records.text: I’ve gifted my husband last Christmas with 6 pairs of beautifully boxed cotton socks and he says they are the best socks he’s ever had, so this Christmas he got another set of 6 cotton socks.  They are truly a quality product.  It doesn’t shrink in wash or dryer and the colour doesn’t fade at all.  The old ones sre still good as the new ones!  Just truly an amazing product ❣️. Truly value for money ❣️

records.title: Socks great
records.text: Quality and color great.  Would have appreciated a presentation box for 6 socks.

records.title: My go to dress socks
records.text: Excellent quality(especially the sartorial socks, the boot sock could use a little more padding though) & amazing color selection. The sartorials are my go to dress sock. I miss having all of the single pair simply sartorial colors all together to look through vs picking color collections to buy single pairs. I wish they'd release simply sartorial matching pocket squares, dress t-shirts, and gloves.

records.title: Product is great
records.text: Product is great. Delayed delivery due to delivery company choice. Sadly this delivery company choice would make me anxious about purchasing again. It was a lot of money spent to be anxious about whether product would arrive or not.

records.title: Very responsive and respectful.
records.text: Very responsive and respectful.Unfortunately the website automatically assigns the express delivery. I did not notice this and was charged for express even though it took a week for delivery.George, corrected this gracefully!I cannot comment on the product as it is a gift and I cannot open it.

records.title: Good service.
records.text: It was a bit over due but otherwise well-handled !!

records.title: This was my first purchase from the…
records.text: This was my first purchase from the London Sock CoThe 1pr Pants & Socks setOrdering was easy and the delivery was prompt Came in a lovely black box with the logo on the front My only thought was that the garments were loose inside the lovely box and would have looked so much better if they had been anchored and displayed as a set , rather than just a pr of socks & pants flying around inside Other wise very happy, hence the 4 stars and not 5

records.title: Beautiful for a Gift
records.text: GiftLovely socks but issues with delivery required contact with the shop who were very helpful and sorted it all out immediately! Very happy😊

records.title: Good socks, worrying durability first impression but super star customer support
records.text: Bought quite a few pairs of socks wanting to invest in some higher quality one's. They are quite expensive and for the most part everything was going alright, they are comfortable and stylish however one sock, after only a few uses over the course of a few weeks, developed a hole. That is quite unacceptable especially for that price tag however the good news is their customer support is far exceeding anyone else's. Since they have a one year guarantee, I emailed them about it and after telling them which one it was, they instantly shipped a replacement, no questions asked. Hopefully the rest will continue to hold up well over the coming months and hopefully years but I can rest easy knowing that they truly care about customers experience

records.title: Quality control issue.
records.text: Socks are nice, and good quality, but one pair in a three pair box had a hole in the neck of the sock.  This is the second time I have ordered from London Sock Company and received a pair of socks with a defect.  I’m ordering from the US, so the return process is just inconvenient and time extensive.  I will continue to order socks from this company because I haven’t found better quality at this price point.  I just wish quality control was more attentive to these issues.

records.title: I love the sock designs along with…
records.text: I love the sock designs along with their comfortability! The only thing I wish the company would change is to allow their customers to mix and match different socks in a package of 3, 6, 9, etc. instead of buying a specific package that contains most of the sock designs you want. Other than that I love the product!

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: An excellent product, and excellent customer service from LS Co.Evri, the courier that delivered the first pair, left them in a very inappropriate location, and they were promptly stolen.LS Co were great and sent a new pair out straight away, by DHL. Very much appreciated.

records.title: All’s Well That Ends Well
records.text: The webpage told me i would receive the package within 8 business days, but today is day 10 and it hasn’t arrived. This is more a criticism of DHL than London Sock, so i didn’t let it affect the rating so strongly. I’ve come to expect such poor service and nothing done about it from German companies like DHL, but why does a British company use them? The tracking which didn’t update daily, showed my package sitting in Great Britain with DHL for several days before it even left for me. Sure hope the socks are good quality. Sock arrived and fit. Let’s see how well they last now to determine if worth the price, but the color and pattern options are great!

records.title: I love them anyway..
records.text: The socks I have ordered from London Sock and worn thus far have been amazingly comfortable in comparison to other companies I've had the displeasure of using. However I would think that a company with a really successful line of products would have a truly rapid delivery system. Perhaps they will think it out and try to be less British in such maters. Another note,  the sizes seem to run slightly tight to the size and my feet soon notice the slight squeeze. Ah, but what's a little.. I love them anyway..

records.title: Great product, really helpful service
records.text: Placed my first order, without an issue. Seemed to be taking time to arrive but London Sock Co. very helpful is providing tracking numbers. Although delivery took too long, socks were worth waiting for and I will order again and maybe pay more for delivery service

records.title: I would give 4.5 if an option
records.text: I would give 4.5 if an option. My second order - quality product, good designs and fast shipping. I did receive a substitution for one pair in a 6 pack (the color combo I really wanted of course). No communication beforehand.

records.title: Fab socks to make happy feet
records.text: Everything was superb from delivery to the products themselves. My husband was absolutely delighted with the socks I gave him. The presentation is first-class! I am giving 4 stars due to technical problems when I tried to order being my first time and claim on the limited-time discount.

records.title: I would have given this a five start…
records.text: I would have given this a five start but the shipping took a very long time to the US. I had to reach out personally for an update. The quality of the socks though is amazing and am very satisfied. Customer communication could be improved through automation or process.

records.title: Best quality but costly delivery
records.text: The quality and comfort of the merino socks is fantastic and very satisfying, albeit the 23-pound standard delivery to Europe.

records.title: I was a little disappointed with the…
records.text: I was a little disappointed with the half price mystery box, but other than that the other purchases have been excellent, especially the Merino wool box, toasty toes, lovely. Washing guidance would be a useful addition to your website.All in all a quality product.

records.title: Excellent product
records.text: Excellent product. Socks are superb, well fitted high quality. Don't get the mystery box get the exact socks you want and you won't be disappointed. Premium designs and selections and well fitting.

records.title: long time to delivery and too Spencer…
records.text: long time to delivery and too Spencer for that  quality

records.title: Expected more for the price
records.text: For the price, I sure expected more. The colors are vibrant and the sock is comfortable, but it is sure slumpy on my ankle. Furthermore, I expected thicker material. I don't expect these to last like I would expect. I will likely be returning the entire lot.

records.title: Skimped, tight & rough
records.text: I bought some knee length socks from London Sock Co.Despite only being made of cotton, they were very tight on my legs, the material felt rough compared to my usual brand (Falke airport) and they made my legs feel very itchy.After corresponding with the company, my view of the socks has not changed, but they are a very good company to deal with, and I am happy with the outcome.

records.title: Good product, bad shipping.
records.text: The product is absolutely what I wanted, and the quality appears to be very good. The experience of shipping left much to be desired. The advertised timeline for shipping to the states is not what I encountered. It took over ten days from date of shipping to reach me, which is not the experience I have had ordering from other UK organizations. When the box arrived, the packaging was quite dented as well.

records.title: good quality, nice patterned, beware of racing green
records.text: I love the quality and the olive patterned socks I received in the 3-green sock bundle. I am disappointed however, with the 2 pairs of racing green socks I received with it. They didn’t look that color on the site. In fact, they looked more olive. Little bit disappointing, as I won’t wear this shade.

records.title: Not too mysterious
records.text: Bought a mystery box, thinking that, in a winter sale, they may have mixed it up a little and thrown in at least one pair appropriate to winter wear i.e. wool pair. No chance. Three summer weight lisle socks, just different designs. Mystery solved amid buyer disappointment.

records.title: I like the quality and comfort of the…
records.text: I like the quality and comfort of the socks but I regret I got burgundy instead of plain red socks.

records.title: Socks Good. Delivery appalling
records.text: The socks are very good and beautifully packed.  Regretfully, the delivery service stinks.  The package was lobbed against my front door as the delivery driver raced off.  I was home, and saw it happen.  Good job it was not raining etc.  Come on London Sock Co, get a good delivery service.

records.title: Like the Socks
records.text: Like the Socks.  They were appreciated by those gifted.    However, 1/3 of my order never arrived, no notice of delay until after delivery and I asked for an explanation.  Would have appreciated a heads up in order to have a alternative gift.  Second order - came in twice as many ordered!  Paid for!

records.title: I found my last order to be less than I…
records.text: I found my last order to be less than I expected in sizing and quality.The sock size was over sized and looked baggy.  The material felt much more nylon like, they did not have the comfort or texture that has been typical of your past products.

records.title: My complaint is not about the product
records.text: My complaint is not about the product, but about the service. My package was supposed to come to Massachusetts but instead it went to Germany. The people at London Sock Company were responsive but couldn’t seem to tell me what was going on. The company, did, however, give me a $10 credit on the price and the socks came in time for Christmas.

records.title: First delivery was delayed but LSC sent…
records.text: First delivery was delayed but LSC sent a replacement quickly, so well done. Then the delayed package arrived, meaning that the item had to be sent back.  There was no explanation as to why initial package was delayed and hopefully outsourced delivery arrangements are under review and will improve to give the confidence that if another order is placed it will be received in a timely manner.

records.title: Excellent quality but colors not pastel
records.text: The socks are excellent quality and arrived well. The colors, however did not match the colors that displayed on my computer screen. This was supposed to be a box of pastel socks.  While two of the six were pastel, instead of being a pale yellow, it was a the mango yellow that I already have. There were also sort of a neon blue that I already have. If socks are called “pastel” they should be pastel.

records.title: Delivery Waiting
records.text: I placed online order on Dec 7th and received the crooked parcel on Dec 21st, just a few days before Xmas. Though the gift was safe and sound, it was still emerged with a sense of unsettling!

records.title: Late arrival of Christmas present
records.text: What was a Christmas present, which I was assured when I ordered after contacting LSC directly to check, and was assured it would arrive in time, came 5 days late and after Christmas. Not great.

records.title: Love the products but buying from…
records.text: Love the products but buying from Germany it is - including shipping - just too expensive. And also I guess I would buy more, if the largest size would be available for more styles.

records.title: The mid-calf socks fall down
records.text: The mid-calf socks fall down. I wouldn't normally consider this a big deal, but for the price, I was expecting a better design. The knee-high socks work great. I wish I only purchased them.

records.title: Socks are comfortable but fall apart…
records.text: Socks are comfortable but fall apart after a few washes. The elastic around the top band has started to come away Not that impressed for the priceStill waiting on a contact from the company

records.title: Too aggressive Marketing
records.text: Too aggressive Marketing, too many mails,  sometimes more than one in a day. Charming web presence, slow delivery.

records.title: False representation
records.text: Didn't receive a red pair of socks in my Shaken/Stirred 6pk box set; primary reason set was purchased. Beautiful socks though

records.title: Delivery was late after i paid for fast…
records.text: Delivery was late after i paid for fast delivery it was for a birthday gift.

records.title: Unfortunately
records.text: Unfortunately, I did not receive the product I ordered.

records.title: Designs are nice, not comfy
records.text: Designs are nice, but sock fabrics are scratchy and unyielding - at this price point would have expected soft, comfortable fabric.  Very difficult to get on, must be sized to diminutive British feet or something (I believe I have normal sized feet - 9.5 US, don’t buy wide sized shoes or anything).  My least favorite socks!

records.title: The packaging was terrible
records.text: The packaging was terrible. It arrived torn and the sock box damaged so the presentation was shot. For a premium product which is meant to show up as a nice box, it was disappointing.

records.title: Over-priced.  Under-valued.
records.text: Nothing particularly went wrong.  I like my socks well enough.  But the product is overpriced compared to the value received. The styles are fine, but nothing so special as to justify spending US $126.00 for a box of 6 which I won't be spending again with London Sock Co.

records.title: Poor response to complaints
records.text: Quality socks but mediocre customer service via online chat and email if things go wrong. People do business with people. A verbal apology goes a long way towards customer loyalty when the online system goes wrong.

records.title: Have not received order after 14 days
records.text: I ordered my socks on 12/2/24.  It is 12/16/24 and I still have not received them.

records.title: Used to like them
records.text: Used to buy their socks but changed my mind after this purchase. Loose threads at the end of the sock, different sizing between different lines of products and most unacceptably, loose socks that falls to your ankle after 10 minutes of walking. Not wearable especially for a brand prides itself for their products for the sartorially savvy customers.Edit: I appreciate the reply from the company and look forward to speaking to the customer support team.

records.title: Great socks but develop holes quickly
records.text: I signed up for the sock subscription which is a fantastic idea, the socks look great. Only problem I found is that on the socks they develop a hole in the big toe area after a few months, this seems rather quick compared to other socks. Unfortunately due to this is I have cancelled my subscription which is a shame. This issue may just be one I have and if anyone is unsure I’d say buy a single pair and give them a go.

records.title: Really dissappointed
records.text: Really dissappointed.  The first socks I saw on the site were all cotton which is what I wanted.  As I perused through the site,@$20 pair, I thought all the socks were cotton but when i received them (8 pairs) they were all poly mix.  Now after spending $178, I spent $43 to return them to England and they have not refunded or acknowledged the return.....Really London Sock?UPDATE March 21:  Now they are saying that the "fulfillment centre is extra busy.  Can you please send proof of shipping " .  What a pain.

description:
Welcome to Toonzshop’s atypical world, a shop conceived and created by enthusiasts of the alternative world.
Here you'll find original clothing with extraordinary designs.
Driven by a responsible business ethic, Toonzshop brings together designers and independent brands that offer custom-made outfits in a variety of styles: from Bohemian and Fairy to sometimes Medieval, Steampunk or Rock-Goth, and of course, with Psytrance inspiration.

records.title: I was really impressed with my purchase…
records.text: I was really impressed with my purchase of tank tops. They fit perfectly. I will definately be shopping there from now on. The delivery was prompt. I love the idea of supporting local artisans by buying their products. Kudos to Toonzshop!

records.title: Same review
records.text: Same review. I will be buying other colors as well. Everyone says I look like I jumped out of a Dune movie or GOT series or Star Wars or something.

records.title: Everything I've ordered has been good…
records.text: Everything I've ordered has been good quality and unusual design which I love. Delivery is quick and service is good I would highly recommend and will purchase from again

records.title: Always love buying with Toonzshop
records.text: Always love buying with Toonzshop. The cloak i bought is beautiful, the process is easy and shipping is super quick. Also a shoutout to Delphine and Constance in customer service, for answering my questions sweetly and thoroughly. Love Toonzshop!

records.title: Will purchase again!
records.text: I had a small problem with the buying process. I aked for help and received it within an hour. It worked. After that they checked in to see if averything was working fine and confirmed my order. Clothes themselves are superb quality. Will buy again!!

records.title: Great Alternative Hippieish Clothing
records.text: I've been using ToonzShop for quite a few years and love some of the models. I love how I can come back 4 years later and buy my favourite models in another color. They also create new models, which is awesome, but nothing better than being able to get your favorite style again and again. Shipping has always been quick and service great

records.title: Great option for unique clothing
records.text: Great, unique clothing with plenty of choices with natural fibers. Quick delivery, even right before Christmas. The clothes are exactly like on the photos and seem to be made of quality fabric. Will order here again.

records.title: Just gorgeous clothing
records.text: Just gorgeous clothing.  Pretty quick shipping to the US as well.  Will definitely be a return customer! Thanks!

records.title: Phenomenal
records.text: Website is very easy to navigate. My package arrived so quickly and I am absolutely obsessed with my new clothes. I cannot wait to get more.

records.title: Perfect Gift for My Girlfriend – She Loves It!
records.text: I recently purchased a few pieces from Toonzshop UK as a gift for my girlfriend; she loves them! The quality of the items was fantastic, and the whole shopping experience was seamless. The website was easy to navigate, and the delivery was fast. I'm considering Toonzshop UK for future gifts. Highly recommend!

records.title: Fabric is a little thin
records.text: Fabric is a little thin. Sadly it was better years ago.

records.title: High quality, beautiful item
records.text: I bought the “Wanda” harem skirt trousers in M/L. I wear a UK size 12 or 14 depending on cut, and these are an excellent fit. Fabric is nicely substantial, unlike a lot of clothing of this type that is clearly designed for a tropical climate. Like one of the German customers reviewing this item, I find the dangling pocket annoying and may cut it off - that is the only design flaw, and the reason for 4 rather than 5 stars. Women want pockets *inside* our clothing! Otherwise a fantastic item. Delivery was quick, too, considering this was travelling from France to Scotland.

records.title: Nice colors, nice materials, a bit too long
records.text: The product arrived quickly, the materials are good and the colors are very pretty. Ordered the "Eo-Lüne" pullover, Wine and black, size L. My one complaint is that the fit is much longer than what you see in the image, so the corset portion ends up directly on your butt and doesn't look as in the image.

records.title: beautiful clothes and good customer service
records.text: Really beautiful jumpsuit and boots. Time will tell how the quality holds up, but they seem really good so far. Docked a star because the boots I was originally sent were the wrong size (looked like a returned pair put in the wrong box), but Emma in customer service was very helpful in refunding and providing credit to re-order the correct size at no extra cost (as I'd originally ordered in the sale & without shipping fees).

records.title: The garments are adorable
records.text: The garments are adorable, good quality even if I think they will be quite delicate. The customer care is ok, very kind, and the delivery time is good. The only issue I would like they could improve is for the returning items, since it is at our charge. I'd like if they could make the prepaid labels for free returns, at least in Europe. Other than that, easy and pleasant experience and I will surely purchase again, I love this clothing style!

records.title: I love the fabrics for some of the tops…fabric quality
records.text: I love the fabrics for some of the tops I purchased , others of the same style the fabric isn't as nice

records.title: For years that I order on this website
records.text: For years that I order on this website. Great products although sometimes the quality of the material is a bit less then I am used to receive from the Toonzshop. Try to keep up the quality of your products because only like that you will continue to receive good reviews & happy customers.

records.title: Excellent quality, excellent additional sizing advice
records.text: The quality of clothing and online product descriptions are excellent. I especially appreciate the additional notes on sizing. The website works well on a pc, but it performs exceptionally poorly on mobile devices. This is my reason for giving a 4 instead of a 5/5.

records.title: Lovely quality items
records.text: Lovely quality items, unfortunately part of the dress was missing and it was a little on the large side - I was kindly given free return postage which was great.

records.title: Shopping and shipping easy and fast
records.text: Shipping was very fast and ordering was easy. The product had some seams that were not properly tied and started to undo immediately. No major damage but slightly annoying.

records.title: First purchase but not the last…
records.text: This is my first time purchasing from the company. Everything looks so lush and attractive online.  The hoodie-sweater arrived and is so soft! I love the shade of green,too! I'm very excited to wear it! The website itself was a little bit tricky to navigate. A fewxof the accessories I was considering purchasing where already sold out, as well.

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: Fast delivery. High quality products.The only down point is because one of the boots have a flaw. I had to place one of the buckles in place.If it was cheaper I would have return them and buy new (because they are great) but the cost of delivery is not cheap.

records.title: Cool designs and fast delivery, although quality is average
records.text: Quick response and delivery (to Czech Republic), designs are very pretty and unique, though i would expect a slightly better processing and material quality for the price (seams are not even at some spots, materials feel a bit cheap and thin). But the designs are really cool!

records.title: Unique clothes, friendly service
records.text: Unique and ethical clothes. Order was handled fast after placing. The delivery took longer than expected, but it was to blame courier, not the store. The customer service was fast and friendly.The clothes are beautiful and look same as in the pictures. Material in the kaftan I ordered was more sheer than I expected (not necessarily a bad thing) and shirts have a bit too long sleeves, otherwise I'm happy with my order so far.

records.title: cheap materials, great service
records.text: The purchase and delivery were great, I also like the look, but I do think they smell and feel quite cheap and artificial, for that price I would have wished for better quality, today it was pretty warm and my feet were sweating in the sandals… it just felt like plastic.Thank you! One more star for the great service:)

records.title: Beautiful dress!
records.text: The shipping was on time and the dress is beautiful, i love the many dressing possibilities it gives! The color is the same as in the pics and the fabric is very soft! Just a little note: on the website it says the fabric is 95% rayon while actually on the dress it's described as 75% cotton...but i prefer cotton over synthetic tissues so it was a nice surprise for me :)

records.title: Fast delivery, trouble with paying
records.text: The delivery was really fast and the dress arrived in perfect condition. However, I did have some trouble placing an order so I had to switch to a computer that has Google Chrome instead of Brave. All in all, a good experience, this was just a bit annoying :)

records.title: Pleased
records.text: Got four items on a sale, they arrived quickly within EU, though they didn't seem to share my phone number to the shipping company. I did not get any delivery notice, and I had to dig a bit to realised that it had arrived and to figure out where it was. Little bit of communication issue along the way?

records.title: I really like their clothing style
records.text: I really like their clothing style, I like how they display their clothes on their website.I talked a little bit with someone who works at the company on Instagram and I was treated very well.Anyway, everything is great with the carrier section, I had delivery problems due to the holiday, it was a poorly calculated logistics job.

records.title: It's been almost 1 month since order…
records.text: It's been almost 1 month since order was shipped and still not received my order to Finland. And order tracking is not updated since 24.7.2024. I thought in Europe shipping is fast. Not buying from here again. ~ very friendly customer service for sure and I have got full refund. Thank you (:

records.title: The delivery and service is ok
records.text: The delivery and service is ok. The quality however is not as expected as it is not great.

records.title: Low quality dress that isn't flattering
records.text: Low quality dress that isn't flattering (the a-line shape starts below the hips, which makes the silhouette unflattering).

records.title: The clothes are lovely and the delivery…
records.text: The clothes are lovely and the delivery was quite fast but the company send me a different colour that I ordered. When told them first the day is the right colour which is not. As I order teal and the sticker clearly says dark teal. After I pointed this out their solution was to send it back and get a refund. You gotta pay 9 pounds for return , they told me they will cover the return money but that doesn't make it better as I would still lose the 10 pounds for delivery and I need it the item which means I will have to pay another 10 to buy the right one. So I don't understand how they think that me spending extra 20 is fair when is their mistake and not mine.

records.title: Good quality but sizing off and return options not great
records.text: The two tops are both well made, warm and comfortable material. It is unfortunate that even with the extra sizing advice the clothes are not consistent sizing. One top advised sizing one size up so I did, but it was still very tight. Unfortunately the return costs from the UK are off puttingly high, which coupled with the inconsistency in sizing means I can’t risk ordering again even though I wouls otherwise have been very happy with the clothes (including quick delivery).

records.title: Fits perfectly but doesn't seem to last for long...
records.text: I was really happy when my goods arrived - both shoes and clothes fit perfectly!The second time I wore one pair of boots, a rivet fell off and I glued it back together myself.I have worn one blouse about 5 times and now one buckle has fallen off, which I am quite sad about.Unfortunately, the products do not seem to last particularly well and it is simply such a shame - I should really try to return the blouse, but it's such a hassle that I don't bother trying

records.title: I love the style. Would love to have it in organic fabrics though
records.text: I love the style very much!Very sad though that the materials are mostly plastic based.. this would be my absolute favorite shop if the fabrics would be 100% organic and natural.

records.title: The pants are great but I'm disapointed…
records.text: The pants are great but I'm disapointed in colour. The coloure I chose was number 6 warm orange, but the real colour is nothing like that. Till now everything I ordered from this site was like in the picture, this is the first time that it isn't.

records.title: Love the clothes, but….
records.text: Love the clothes, would give 5 stars for the clothes, however, I was hot with a 41 pound import charge which which is 27% on top of what I paid for the clothes.I checked the website which specified that taxes were included at checkout and that shipping is free for purchases over 85 pounds (I spent 150)When contacting toonzshop, I was dismissed with a “thanks for your understanding” message. Don’t thank me, because I am not understanding.If it were transparent in the website that shipping to the Uk incurs import taxes on top on my purchase I would have no complaint however the website specified that taxes are included at checkout.So, love the clothes, not happy with my service and lack of transparency from the vendor

records.title: I like the design
records.text: I like the design, it’s original. Unfortunately the fabric is of low quality. It’s itching my skin a little bit and it started forming those little balls of fabric only after few days of wearing, very disappointing. Overall I like the design so much that I don’t regret buying it.

records.title: The sizing is off in this shop
records.text: The sizing is off in this shop, I'm normally a medium but had to get a large and even then the cardigans didn't do up properly. Disappointed. I have sent items back and still waiting for refund.

records.title: Terrible sizing but 5☆ quality
records.text: Quick shipping, great design, nice quality, but it doesn't fit eventhough I sized up to an XL as a woman who wears size 12 jeans (US). ...Guess they'll have to be "goal pants" with how expensive they are.

records.title: Not worth 80$.
records.text: Not worth 80$.. I like it, don't get me wrong, but very thin material I'm worried one little snag and it will fall apart. Im terrified to wash it. I had to rip out the straps because they were laced in criss cross (not how they are shown in store pictures) which completely changed how the garment laid and they were coming out the wrong direction so it caused rolling at the top hem. Since the loops were so tiny I could not thread the strap back through so had to seam rip the loops. Figured better to keep it for the 90 spent (including shipping), than to send it back and lose out on 20$ of shipping and have nothing..

records.title: I’m conflicted on my thoughts
records.text: I’m conflicted on my thoughts I was so excited when I discovered Toonzshop. The clothes selection really fit my personal style and I was enthralled to give it a try. I bought a pair of skirted leggings, that I absolutely LOVED. The shipping was extremely quick (especially since it was coming from another country). When they arrived, the material was so incredibly soft, which is what I needed due to my sensory issues. I put them on and LOVED them even more. However, I wore them for the first time and noticed a flaw… when ever I walk, the pant leg turns. I will turn the pant leg to fix it, but as soon as I start walking again, the seem twists around. It drives me absolutely crazy, especially because of my sensory issues, seems can be a little uncomfortable. I am unsure I will ever wear the skirted leggings, and because of this, I am unsure that I will buy from Toonzshop again.

records.title: I ordered leggings with a skirt trim
records.text: I ordered leggings with a skirt trim. They are very funky but the material isn't the best, it's very light and see through. A little disappointed but they are still nice:)

records.title: Fast shipping, but not very good quality
records.text: Fast shipping, true in size, but golden print is not durable as a thought: after 5 washing on 30° it's golden coat got washed off

records.title: Love, wish they were a bit smaller
records.text: Love these pants, however if you’re a true XS, the small will probably still be a little big. I’m 5’9” and size 00 and easily still have an extra inch in the waistband, with room in the thighs as well. Love the pants themselves and they fit well enough to wear but definitely wish they didn’t slide down every time I sit down. Happy with the length and quality.

records.title: Poor sizing, fabric, and return policy.
records.text: The order came quickly, which I appreciate very much. The item (size large) was loose in the lower body, and a bit tight in the bust and arms. The fabric was synthetic… not soft. The buyer pays for return shipping.

records.title: Not worth it
records.text: The shipping was fast and I'm generally happy about the level of the service. The products look nice.BUT they are absolutely noth worth the price. They look as shown in the pictures and I'll use them for sure, but ther quality is not good enough to justify the price. I don't expect the clothes to last more than a season or two. I won't return them because they are not bad and look nice, but I will not buy again from this website because I don't think the products are worth it.

records.title: Design ok, but material could be better
records.text: Design of the clothes is wonderful but I expected more quality of material for this price.

records.title: sizes are way too big
records.text: sizes are way too big. Normally i wear XL but even a M trouser is too wide. When i would take even smaller the length wouldnt fit anymore. There are also a lot of threads standing out. Beside that the products are nice and good quality.

records.title: 5 out of 6 items missing. No response from customer service after a week.
records.text: Made an order of 6 clothing pieces. Received only 1 of them (and 1 completely incorrect item - seems they may have mixed up orders). Wrote them and after a week there's not even been any acknowledgement, much less any progress towards a solution.Will update this depending on how things work out. Right now it seems like I may need to flag them with my bank and recall the money for fraud, but hopefully they're just overwhelmed and slow to respond.Edit: Thanks for the response. I didn't find a contact email (the order confirmation was no-reply as you mention) so I took contact through the ticket system with no response. Have written the email now and awaiting resolution.

records.title: DHL does not ship to post offices
records.text: DHL, the international shipping group, made the delivery very difficult. I had my address set to a P.O. Box without knowing that they do not ship to P.O. Boxes. For about a week and a half I kept getting messages that they were trying to deliver my package but the “premises were closed,” so I had to keep extending the delivery day. I tried getting ahold of customer service to explain to them that it is a post office and they need to check the hours before delivering. I was getting extremely frustrated trying to get an actual human to talk to instead of a robot. I finally gave up and switched the address to my friend’s house, and luckily I was there when it got delivered because they needed my signature (I ran out of delivery requests lol). So in essence, the delivery process was less than ideal, but I finally got the package.

records.title: Very poor quality leggings
records.text: Hi Toonzshop, I recently received my order and I wish I could give it 5 stars, however the quality of the fabric of the leggings I ordered ("Lilith" Long Leggings) was atrocious. As soon as I put my leg in, the outer seam of the left leg ripped apart! I made sure to order the correct size, however as expensive as these leggings were, I was VERY disappointed in the poor quality! I'm so sad I will not be able to wear them. I will be returning the leggings for a full refund of the item. (I'm happy with the other items in my order).

records.title: I received a pair of shoes that were…
records.text: I received a pair of shoes that were covered in mold. Two clothing items also had holes in them. Quality control overall was very disappointing and I will not be ordering from this store again.

records.title: poor quality for the price
records.text: Edit - clothing turned out to be very poor quality for the price (falling apart at the seams before I ever washed or wore it) so I am downgrading my review. Won't buy here again.I did not realize this company was located in France when I ordered, but even so, the clothes arrived pretty quickly and the return process was simple. I never interacted with a person, it was all automated, but that's the way things are now for the most part!

records.title: I’m very disappointed with the items I…
records.text: I’m very disappointed with the items I received this time.  The leggings have a very strong that remains after I washed them, the white dress had very weird padding in the bra area and when taken out, a strange slit in the middle of the area remains, making my boobs look very strange, the black wrap skirt is not a wrap skirt at all but has very tight uncomfortable elastic around the waist band and the skirt is very long.  Shipping back is so expensive so I’m going to have the skirt tailored but not sure what to do with the leggings, they still smell bad and I’m not sure if I can send them back after washing them.  Please let me know and I’ll send them back.  Thank you.

records.title: Not size accurate
records.text: The ordered dresses are indeed beautiful but not at all size accurate. I had carefully followed the guidelines, but one dress was too big and the other too small. You have to pay the return costs yourself, which costs me 10 euros, and I don't want to take the risk of ordering another size...In response to customer service: I indeed ordered 2 different sizes. Bizarrely, the XXL was too small and the XL was too large

records.title: The leggings have a terrible smell…
records.text: The leggings have a terrible smell coming from them. I have washed them 5 times and they still smell. They will probably have to go in the trash at this point, the texture as well is a very crusty type feel . The smell was so strong when I opened the bag it made me feel sick to my stomach. Not sure where they are made but it’s concerning. Unfortunately it’s wasted money for me. It’s too bad because I like the clothes but I can’t afford to risk this happening again.

records.title: Clothes look amazing quality is lacking
records.text: Clothes look amazing and they're super comfortable.However the leggings already have multiple holes in them, almost like they just melt in time...This is more a gado gado review however:However I already have multiple holes in my leggings from just wearing them... One of the prints from a legging is already faded but the description mentioned that could happen. I used to have one older pair of leggings from this brand (like 10 years old) and that actually lasted me years with the print still intact.so the decline in quality is really noticeable... I'm trying to sew the holes shut but everyday I notice one more 🫤. I ordered them around 7 months ago. I'm Really sad because these are the most comfortable leggings ever...

records.title: I am disappointed
records.text: I am disappointed. the goods look high quality in the photos. but i opened the package, one part of it came in the wrong color and the rest just wasn't like the photos. i'm disappointed. i want to return the goods, but i can't find an address anywhere. i'll never order there again.

records.title: Great product

records.title: Great Success Multiple Times

records.title: Always a great experience when shopping…

records.title: Communication is excellent as is the…

records.title: Very happy with my items

records.title: Best iron on labels

records.title: Had a little difficuly

records.title: They resent my package because I think…

records.title: quality item .....

records.title: I am happy.

records.title: My Granny labels  order took longer than I thought…

records.title: Durable Labels

records.title: The label is good quality

records.title: The labels came out as expected

records.title: I love the product and the fact that I…

records.title: Great stickers, iron on name tags not so much

records.title: I ordered many different labels mostly…

The quality control needs to be much better. Super inconvenient to have to wait to finish my projects. I won’t be using this company again sorryThankyou for the reply, just want to clarify it wasn’t one or two labels from the orange order it was the entire order of 60 labels obviously not checked. Not the usual standard of print yet they were sent to me!

records.title: The uniform stick on labels are very…

records.title: Bad quality

I need reliable quality. And now after 3 consecutive years using this service I am looking for other options. Really disappointed.

records.title: Long time buyer worried about quality...

records.title: Won't order again from this company.
records.text: The first time I attempted to order labels from this company, I had a hard time checking out, so had to redo my order several times. I was SO aggravated, that I decided to cancel and start my order again. Well, when I finally got to check out on the second attempt, it looked like I was being charged for TWO orders. I tried to remove one and it would not let me. The next day, I emailed the company and told them what happened, but was told that there was NOTHING they could do about canceling one of the items.They told me I could return one of the items , but it would be at my own cost in shipping. This company is in France. A decent company would have given me a refund right away for something I didn't order and was not entirely my fault. Their website is not very people friendly. The labels I had ordered are fine, but I could have easily ordered something similar for far less money from somewhere else.

description:
Chilly's mission is to accelerate the adoption and everyday use of reusable products.

records.title: Excellent, super fast delivery
records.text: My daughter wanted an ice cube tray that would make ice to fit in her chilly bottle and a spare lid for Christmas. Thank you, I wish all online shopping worked as well.

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: I purchased the series 2 flip lid bottle Nov '23.  It's the best drinks bottle I've ever had. I've had correspondence with Chilly on two occasions since my purchase and found their customer service excellent. I would highly recommend Chilly.

records.title: Highly recommend this lovely guy

records.title: Great cup

records.title: Lara from Chillys was extremely helpful…

records.title: I bought this cup for my 6 year old for…

records.title: Trustworthy company!
records.text: We have used Chillys for years, they have beautiful designs and do exactly what they say. I can make a coffee in my bottle when I go to bed and it will be hot in the morning or I can put a cold drink in and it will be stay cold all day! All our other bottle went out when we bought our 1st chillys and we haven't looked back we all have one and I buy for presants!

records.title: chilly’s mugs are great quality
records.text: chilly’s mugs are great quality, when I had a query about the products, I received prompt and helpful responses.

records.title: My daughter loves her new Chilly bottle…
