records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: Excellent customer service. I could not fault it one bit. A role model to other businesses.My parcel was seemingly damaged in transit, I contacted Chillys to say it hadn’t arrived. They looked into this immediately and did all communications directly with the courier. I did not need to sort a thing. They found it was damaged beyond repair and immediately sent a replacement for next day delivery. The communication was fast and with regular updates, no need for me to chase. Issue sorted smoothly.Item arrived well packaged, efficiently, and is a well made, lovely product. Would buy from them again.

records.title: I replaced my coffee cup's Head and…
records.text: I replaced my coffee cup's Head and Lid. I could not see any Retainer (basically a screw which connects the Lid and Head) on the website, and one did not come in the order. I contacted customer service who quickly advised that they, weirdly, don't sell the Retainer but would send one free of charge. It arrived really quickly, so problem solved. My only criticism is that the Retainer is the most easily lost and broken component of the Coffee Mug, so should be available. All in all, great customer service.

records.title: Having lost my chilly lid
records.text: Having lost my chilly lid, I was delighted to find I could replace it so easily and at a relatively low cost.

records.title: Great product and very easy ordering…
records.text: Great product and very easy ordering process through the website. Would have been exceptional but for the customer service email response time regarding an address change. How to change the address wasn’t easy to find on the website and by the time I got a response, the item had been delivered to the address I wanted to amend.

records.title: Fab bottle shame about sports lid
records.text: I wanted a pretty bottle for my gym classes that keeps my drink ice cold and this fits the bill. My only criticism is the sports lid I bought extra. It is so hard to pull and twist it out it’s ridiculous. Way too hard that you can’t just do it fast for a quick drink as it takes maximum effort.

records.title: Good fast reliable service
records.text: Good fast reliable service. However feel it's a little expensive for the product. Maybe engraving on your site could be free or cheaper...

records.title: came early no name on delivery box tho
records.text: Bottle was engraved and came before the expected delivery, very good! only complaint is the packaging only included company name and not my name, so although delivered early it took a while for sorting to get it to me.

records.title: Customer service has been very good
records.text: Customer service has been very good. I ordered a replacement series 2 coffee cup lid and head. Unfortunately the locking mechanism is not part of the items bought and it would be helpful if it would be possible to buy them as well

records.title: Great product and size
records.text: Really pleased with my Chillies bottle, it's a good size and keeps my squash nice and cold. 4 stars because the straw/lid combo is only spill proof, not leak proof and while they do state this in the description I don't think it would be very hard to create a straw lid combo that's splash proof.

records.title: Lovely purchase
records.text: Lovely purchase,  quick delivery. Item was what my daughter wanted for Christmas.  She will be delighted.  Both my children use Chillys water bottles.

records.title: Parcel not delivered even though…
records.text: Parcel not delivered even though delivery says it has. Contacted Chillys to find out what the issue is and rectify, they say 1-2 day waiting time. It's been 5 days and no reply. Still no parcel but they have my money..Replacement has arrived. I would recommend not using Evri, problems seem to happen quite often with them.

records.title: Evri are awful!
records.text: Initially not good, mostly because of evri not being able to do their one and only job. Then ‘Chilly’s’ sorted it and sent via a much better delivery service and received within a few days. Do not use Evri.

records.title: Pretty cup and super functional
records.text: I ordered a custom coloured 500ml coffee cup in peach with green & peach lid attachments in the black friday sale and could not be happier with it. I get coffee before every shift and this cup has changed my life, it keeps the coffee hot for hours so I don’t have to chug my coffees in the morning anymore & the outside doesn't get hot so no risk of burning my hands. It also just about fits in my cars cupholder so it won’t shuffle around and spill everywhere.The cup is cute and well designed, beside one small flaw: there is a little piece that goes inside the lid that Chilly’s recommends screwing in with a coin? It’s kind of gross and after cleaning a coin it didn’t even fit, it’d be nice to have a little tool specifically to screw it in but I’ll search for something myself that will fit and is sturdy enough to screw it, in the meantime I managed to twist it in with my hands and a lot of effort.

records.title: Fabulous
records.text: The bottle is fabulous and I know my Daughter will love it. Ordering and delivery were excellent came next day even on busy Black Friday weekend. Only slight disappointment is the size of the engraving for £10 it took me a minute to find it!

records.title: Customer service is good
records.text: Despite there being a fault with the product. A replacement was sent out quickly. I did find the online form a bit daunting and had to get my daughter to help. But once done the team at Chillys sorted it and replacement arrived within a few days.

records.title: When the first bottle arrived it had…
records.text: When the first bottle arrived it had chipped paint. Not something you expect from a £52 bottle. But Chillys did send a new one immediately and they did not expect defected one sent back. Impressed with the customer service levels I experienced

records.title: Christmas gift
records.text: Disappointed with outer packaging, not sturdy enough. Package half opened on delivery. Fortunately inner package for the bottle was undamaged but could have fallen out and lost in transit. Might be an idea to use a firmer cardboard for outer packaging.

records.title: Good quality products and quick…
records.text: Good quality products and quick delivery. The only negative is the return process. Very slow and no refund issued until getting in touch to chase.

records.title: Great product & personalisation option…
records.text: Great product & personalisation option perfect for a gift Only 4* as website not easy to use it kept crashing & trying to charge over £100 for personalisation

records.title: Love the bottle
records.text: Love the bottle and it comes well packaged.  The only thing is the colour.  I thought it would be a darker green so was a bit disappointed when it arrived.  I realise devices and screens can vary but I do feel the colour wasn’t correctly advertised.

records.title: Place of delivery and bottle defect.
records.text: When ordering would prefer options to request  delivery location at the time of placing the order. Changing delivery after delays time. Recent order of original Chillys water bottle. Having purchased 3 Series 2 bottles. Noted same problem they retain fluid at the base of the bottles in a little pocket which cannot be cleaned properly. ( if you shake the bottle you will see the water sifting out). You shouldn’t have to do that.

records.title: The student discount did not work at…
records.text: The student discount did not work at all and wouldn’t even let me put in the code although I tried to numerous times. The website crashed multiple times whilst trying to order and wouldn’t even let me go to checkout, however the bottles are really good quality just a shame about the website and we got no discount.

records.title: Lid too tight
records.text: The lid (lid opening) was very difficult to loosen and required a lot of work to make it usable. We did follow your instructions. My wife can use it now

records.title: Easily scratched
records.text: While customer service was helpful, my product scratched within seconds.These bottles aren't the only one prone to easy superficial damage, but it's a shame nonetheless.

records.title: The colour was not what I expected
records.text: The colour was not what I expected. Thought it might be a darker grey but was blue. Actually wanted black and there were none so tried this as a next best option. :)

records.title: Good bottle but very stiff to open/close the lid.
records.text: The bottle itself is clearly a very sturdy bottle that has been crafted from quality materials which is evident from the touch and feel. However, considering the price point of the bottle, the opening and closing of the lid seems to be extremely stiff. We have tried to loosen it as per the advice on the Chilly's feedback/troubleshooting tips, but it still seems to be very stiff. Maybe it is just because the bottle is still so new and will ease off after a period of time, nevertheless it is still quite frustrating to use whilst the lid is so stiff.

records.title: Not worth it
records.text: The water bottle has no protection on the mouth piece.  The straw inside is adjustable and fiddley. The bottle airways leaks. Carry hook gone in a weekI have the coffee cup too and the water comes out the air hole at the top. I also wrap a tissue around it so my clothes don't get covered in coffee. Designflaws hut the liquid stays hot / cold

records.title: 500ml coffee cup - difficult to open
records.text: Delivered quickly, and we'll packaged. The coffee cup itself is difficult to open for drinking.

records.title: Pleased with the purchase but did a…
records.text: Pleased with the purchase but did a duplicate order by mistake. Sent second one back but not heard from Chillys or received refund after nearly 2 weeks.

records.title: Website not working
records.text: Website wouldn’t work numerous of times! Very slow and wouldn’t let me put items in my baskets on numerous occasions.

records.title: Nothing special
records.text: Delivery time was fine, no damages on delivery. Product is aesthetically pleasing.Ergonomically not the best. The twisting seal can be quite fidgety and difficult to use at times. When drinking from the mouthpiece, it always leaves liquid residue requiring a quick wipe after each sip. Product has leaked a couple times. To be honest there’s nothing special about this travel mug. I wouldn’t recommend it to a friend given its value for the price.

records.title: Disappointed that the gift box is the outer
records.text: Disappointed that the gift box is used as the parcel outer so has the large address label stuck on it (doesn’t come off). Should have been wrapped.Also, mine arrived wet and the box had come unstuck so it was open.

records.title: Delivery was late and box damaged
records.text: Delivery was late and box damaged. Looked liked it had been sent to other customers first and not in fit state to give as a gift.  However product itself is very good quality.

records.title: The external paint chipped right away…
records.text: The external paint chipped right of the bat, at the first cleaning.The bottle is also not leak-proof, which they tell you, but I hoped it would be a little more hermetic.Other than that, it’s a very nice bottle with vivid colors and works as intended.

records.title: Okay
records.text: I love chillys products, I have two of the series 2 cups but the lids on both broke so I ordered some replacements for the head and lids however the screw that holds it all together wasn’t included and doesn’t seem to be on the website. This kinda defeats the whole purpose of being sustainable and environmentally friendly if you have to buy a whole new cup instead of simply replacing the parts that are damaged.

records.title: I recently ordered the series 2 500ml…
records.text: I recently ordered the series 2 500ml with accessory pack specifically for the straw aspect.I like the bottle itself but I would say for the price I’m disappointed the straw is so wide and also does not have a rubber seal so rattles around.Wouldn’t order it again or recommend unless changes were made.

records.title: Too large and heavy
records.text: Too large and heavy and overly expensive- bought something better for £9

records.title: I love these water bottles
records.text: I love these bottlesI bought one for a Christmas present in the sale at £60. Very disappointed with the way it was packaged. The box was ripped and the straw and flip up lid was loose in the box. I think it could definitely been packaged better

records.title: Series 2 Chilly bottle is an overcomplicated step backwards
records.text: I had a Chillys series 1 bottle for 11 years. It went everywhere with me, keeping me warm in deep snow and cool in the desert of Dubai. Eventually it was so dented it wouldn't stand up and I decided to upgrade to the series 2. Already it feels overcomplicated. The 2-part lid doesn't work; try to unscrew it and invariably both parts unscrew. Why they didn't find a better way to lock the top section (reverse thread?) is beyond me. A perfect example of a perfect design ruined by overcomplication. I miss my series 1.

records.title: My bottle leaks..
records.text: My bottle leaks... which is a disappointment. It's the new flip lid but if the bottle tips slightly it leaks. I have bought the coffee cup and loved, and the 500ml series 2 bottle and now the 1ltre bottle with added flip lid which has the only disappointment as it was so expensive as an extra to my litre bottle!

records.title: Stick with the screw top lid
records.text: I have had many chilly products, including food pots, cups, the original series 1 bottle, the series 2 and most recently the series 2 flip bottle. I purchased the series 2 flip bottle for ease of drinking whilst doing workouts or if I am out and about, as you don’t have to remove the lid so it’s perfect for on the go. I have never before been disappointed with a chillys product however this bottle leaks so much I can no longer use it unless I know it’s going to remain upright the entire time. If the bottle goes on its side, all the water leaks out through the straw. I wouldn’t mind a drop, which would be understandable, however the whole bottle leaks out and it has caused me many a wet car seat and soggy bag! I am going to stick to the original screw top lid from now on but it is a shame, as the convenience of the flip bottle would be fantastic if it worked.

records.title: Cup Lid was almost impossible to move…
records.text: Cup Lid was almost impossible to move when first used. I know the instructions said the lid may be stiff for the first time but it took way too much strength and patience to start the lid rotating and had to move back and forth so many times before it became even usable for my wife. Should have probably returned it, and would not purchase again based on this.

records.title: Doesn’t really keep my food very warm
records.text: Doesn’t really keep my food very warm. Can get about an hour before it gets cold. Lid gets stuck on and just spins on itself. Regret buying this.

records.title: not clear info on how to buy the retainer accessory
records.text: I forgot to rotate the retainer in my Chilly's bottle series 2 cup, and it broke. I bought  Accessory - Coffee Cup Head and Coffee Lid to replace the broken part, however the retainer was not included there. Either I have to buy the actual bottle again to get the retainer, or the retainer does not exist anymore after some design upgrade, and it is not explicitly mentioned anywhere. Furthermore, I am trying to chat online, but I live in Switzerland and there is no English option on the chat box.

records.title: Brought as a gift
records.text: Brought as a gift. Both the coffee cup and water bottle look Lovely unfortunately the coffee cup is near on impossible to open even after using it a few times and the water bottle is so hard to suck any water through the straw you have to undo the bottle to be able to use. Both really disappointing

records.title: Leaky cups.
records.text: 2 out of 3 of the Chilly’s keep cups that my husband bought leak. They drip out of the bottom which is really weird as it looks like it’s sealed from the inside. One of them really poured   unfortunately we couldn’t even return them as by the time they were given, as gifts, and  used, he couldn’t remember where he bought them from e.g. direct or Amazon or somewhere else. definitely won’t be buying Chilly’s  hot water cups again

records.title: Bottle is great, packaging not!
records.text: Bottle is great, bottle holder is ripped. It’s for a present so emailed Chillys and heard nothing back. Not too happy considering how expensive they are.

records.title: Bought a water bottle for Christmas…
records.text: Bought a water bottle for Christmas present. However give how expensive they are i expected it to be in some kind of gift box. Instead it was loose in a brown packaging box which was damaged.

records.title: Disappointed. Not easy to clean
records.text: Looks great, but you have to use a knife to disassemble the lid in order to clean it properly. Not easily done and I can see this has already damaged it. Major faff for something I want to use daily. Form should really follow function. Disappointed. I wouldn’t have bought it if I’d known.

records.title: 2 damaged coffee cups
records.text: Bought a coffee cup for it to arrive with multiple marks on the cup. Sent back. Received another coffee cup which again was damaged. The base was peeling off. Now being sent a replacement silicon base, to replace myself? Been offered 10 % refund. Let’s hope the silicon base works?

records.title: I ordered a cup as a gift via my phone…
records.text: I ordered a cup as a gift via my phone and it did not give me option to personalise or if it did it was not obvious - I tried to reboot and start again in the hope it would but it did not.  So my gift is just blank where the name should be.  I was very disappointed

description:
WeAreUs. WeAreboohoo
Keeping one step ahead is what boohoo does best. Offering up-to-the-minute fashion across womenswear and menswear, boohoo brings you the very latest trends inspired by the catwalk, celebs and the street, alongside a huge range of basic styles to keep your wardrobe looking fresh every day.
You want it, we've got it. From our party-ready Night range to the laidback boohoo Blue line and our Plus and Petite collections, there's something for everyone with up to 100 new styles dropping daily. 
See it today, wear it tomorrow with our super-fast next day delivery service available in the UK. We also ship internationally to Europe, the USA, Australia and beyond so there's no excuse not to get something new.

records.title: Needed to return a shirt that was…
records.text: Needed to return a shirt that was damaged, Jane B was really helpful and fixed my issue really quickly. Issued a refund,  and allowed me to keep the damaged shirt, recommending that it be recycled rather than sent to landfill :)

records.title: The return portal wasn’t letting me put…
records.text: The return portal wasn’t letting me put through my returns after Christmas, so contacted Boohoo through apple message and they sorted the problem swiftly and made the process very easy, no stress. Helpful members of staff were Jay G, Claire and Micah R

records.title: Easy returns process for a faulty item…
records.text: Easy returns process for a faulty item after the return portal period closed. Skye Rae was very helpful with detailed responses and resolved my issue. Thanks

records.title: Good service - great to deal with a human
records.text: Good serviceI bought some trousers on October and they have split at the seam after wearing twiceI reported this and managed to be put through on Apple message and have been refunded fullyAn assistant called Warren dealt with this for meWhat a difference to some sites where it is impossible to speak to anyone and endless bots

records.title: The return portal wasn’t letting me put…
records.text: The return portal wasn’t letting me put through my returns after Christmas, so contacted Boohoo through apple message and they sorted the problem swiftly and made the process very easy, no stress. Helpful members of staff were FEDERICO and Micah R

records.title: Return item
records.text: I needed to return an item (I ordered to the wrong size - my bad) but the Returns link wouldn't offer any of the options. Perhaps because I live so rurally? Anyway, Amy at Customer Services replied swiftly and generated a return QR code at her end, before forwarding it to me. A very swift resolution. Great service.

records.title: I experienced trouble returning an item…
records.text: I experienced trouble returning an item after Christmas. i spoke with Ronie via the virtual assistant and couldn't have been more helpful. Ronie was able to fix the issue i had promptly, and got my return sorted. Ronie was also very polite. Thankyou.

records.title: Contacted boohoo via apple messages as…
records.text: Contacted boohoo via apple messages as I’d forgotten to add an item into the bag before returning. Frederico sorted it all out super quick without hassle! Thank you 🙏

records.title: My return was taking so time to be put…
records.text: My return was taking so time to be put through as it’s the crazy Christmas period and I messaged the customer service team to help and I must say the help I received was so quick and so helpful. Christian A help me so much and so quickly.

records.title: Rodillo B was superb
records.text: Rodillo B was superb. Helped me arrange a return when the returns portal wouldn’t work for me. Was efficient and made everything simple. Great service!

records.title: My shirt arrived with a couple tears in…
records.text: My shirt arrived with a couple tears in it but customer service, Luz, was extremely quick to refund me and they didn't make me mail back the item! Very pleased with the service.

records.title: Helpful Customer Service
records.text: I ordered a dress for my friend's wedding, which came with a rip in the bottom hem of the dress. After reaching out to their Customer Service, Nathaniel helped me sort out the issue and was able to refund me for my purchase after I sent a picture showing the damage. He was very helpful and kind.Thank you, Nathaniel!

records.title: Missing Item
records.text: I had a missing item in my order and Zyrexon from Customer Service assisted in arranging the item to be delivered to me. Overall, it was an easy and fast process.

records.title: Couldn’t return
records.text: Couldn’t return. But apple message helped. Liselle A was great help. Thanks again

records.title: Helpful Assistance
records.text: I’ve always shopped from boohoo, their products are nice. Although I did receive a faulty item, Jay-G from the help centre was able to help with processing a partial refund, allowing me to keep and fix the fault in the item.

records.title: Great customer service from Liselle
records.text: Great customer service from Liselle A., I got quick and helpful response from my enquiry about a faulty return.

records.title: One item arrived faulty but customer…
records.text: One item arrived faulty but customer service couldn’t have been more helpful in sending another item in 24 hours

records.title: After returning an item via In post…
records.text: After returning an item via In post locker, I was not made aware the return had not reached BOO HOO until I've chased it. This comes after following return process. I would like to thank Me I for prompt and effective communication via Facebook messenger today and a refund has been confirmed, thank you 🙂

records.title: Faulty item
records.text: Unfortunately, I recieved a very faulty item. The dress had many parts of the hem not stitched and other parts had frayed. I contacted customer services who were quick to respond and offered an option of a refund or the same dress. I have been told I will receive a refund in 5 days and have had a second email from Boohoo to confirm this.Thanks to Jezzamil and Mark H.

records.title: Liselle was brilliant I had a faulty…
records.text: Liselle was brilliant I had a faulty skirt and she offered the same item again or a refund immediately. Chat was slightly slow but it was 5pm so would potentially avoid this time as I’m assuming it’s when most people use the service. Everything else was fab.

records.title: Rosary was great.
records.text: I purchased some boots that then broke and arranged a replacement pair which did not arrive. When I chased the replacement Rosary was quick and efficient and organised another pair to be dispatched. Great service from Rosary. I would have given this a 5 star if I hadn't needed to chase it.

records.title: Really good customer service
records.text: Really good customer service. Mary Lagarto was friendly, quick to reply, very helpful. Unfortunately I had an issue with delivery and returns but easily solved and quick to respond.

records.title: Have ordered from boohoo numerous of…
records.text: Have ordered from boohoo numerous of times and have never had any issues. Next day premium delivery is usually 2 days and not next day as stated but doesn't bother me never usually longer the. 2 business days. Only reason for the 4 star. Always happy with purchases

records.title: Good Prices, Quick Support, and an Eco-Conscious Approach
records.text: Good range of products at affordable prices. While some items aren’t top quality, it matches the price. The elastic on a pair of trousers I bought snapped on the second wear, but customer service was quick and helpful in resolving it. I especially appreciated that they encouraged me to keep the faulty, fix it or donate it, to avoid waste, showing their environmental concern, which I really appreciate! Despite the fault, the easy solution and their values mean I’ll definitely shop here again.

records.title: Returns missing in the post
records.text: I made a recent return that went totally AWOL in the post. It was very difficult to get hold of a human being who could assist, but once I did, Zyrexon was fantastic and sorted my query out within an hour, tracking down the missing packages and processing my refund. Excellent customer service from the humans… just the robots that need some work 😅

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: Had a recent issue with boohoo where I ordered an item and the wrong item arrived. I contacted the customer service team via iMessage and they responded very quickly and sent out a replacement item with next day delivery which was very helpful and I was impressed at how easy it was. However unfortunately the item that arrived was faulty (just bad luck for me I think!) and again I contacted customer services using iMessage. Again they were super helpful, really quick to respond and issued a refund very quickly. They did not ask me to return the item but instead encouraged me to upcycle or donate the item instead which I thought was a nice touch. Special thanks to Mei who helped me with this issue!

records.title: Great service
records.text: I initially struggled to find the Customer Services Chat function but once through and explained the issue Romneck offered various solutions to make sure I was completely satisfied. Excellent customer service received, only dropped 1 star as was difficult to find the function online.

records.title: I was having an issue with a discount/…
records.text: I was having an issue with a discount/ price discrepancy. I reached out through their FB messenger. After a few false starts Renzo go me 100% sorted. They were all you'd hope for. Asked relevant questions, acted on the replies I gave, and was able to recommend a solution within minutes.

records.title: Recently ordered and had a faulty item.
records.text: Recently ordered and had a faulty item.Nathaniel S from customer service was so helpful, polite and understanding. He quickly resolved the issue!

records.title: Joyce’s response time was great and I…
records.text: Joyce’s response time was great and I had my order details within a matter of minutes, thanks!

records.title: Not fit for purpose.
records.text: I purchased a pair of boots that were on sale. The sole of the Washed Pu Hiker Boots KHAKI 6 fell off. As a result I had no choice but to purchase a pair of shoes. I contacted Boohoo, that requested photos. I sent the photos and the receipt requesting a "good well" payment for the shoes. Granted the response was speedy and I was informed that I would get the boot refund of £14.18.  However, Boohoo did not reimbursement for a pair of shoes that I was forced to purchase as I could not walk around in the footwear was not fit for purpose.One thing that I have learnt is to read reviews prior purchase. Lesson learned.UPDATE - 20/12/24Boohoo have kindly issued me a refund as a good will gesture. Thank you. I look forward to treating myself to something nice. 3 star treatment.

records.title: Writing a review as a trench coat I…
records.text: Writing a review as a trench coat I ordered has no wrist straps on it , when I contacted boo-boo chat to resolve it I spoke to Carla and Amy and they have offered me a 50 % refund , shame I can’t get the straps for the coat but a partial refund is better than nothing . Thanks Amy she was the first person a i spoke to and was very helpful and the carla took over thank you both .

records.title: Good plus range, inconsistent sizing and high delivery/return costs
records.text: I like that boohoo have a good range of clothing in plus sizes however the sizing is all over the place, and the delivery fees combined with the return fees make it unaffordable to get the right size. I bought some coat options earlier in November, reordered smaller size on Black Friday (the price had gone up!) and the smaller size was still much too big. I can’t afford to spend any more on delivery not to mention the coat is now full price.  Both the larger and smaller size are my usual size and based on the size guide on their website. I could go down another 2 sizes (if I could afford another delivery).

records.title: Unsatisfactory Returns Policy
records.text: A week or more ago, I ordered a pair of shorts from Boohoo [Petite Paperbag Waist Shorts] and found them to be completely unlike what I thought I saw on the website; so I sought to return them. The return process is very easy, Boohoo has facilitated it well. However I was disappointed to learn that Boohoo does not refund postage. Almost half of the cost of the item I bought was the postage. I understand why Boohoo cannot refund postage without damage to their business --- however I think that future customers would do well to be aware that if they wish to get a refund for their item, the postage won't be refunded. Unfortunately it's often a significant portion of the cost.

records.title: Although i received 2 items faulty Id…
records.text: Although i received 2 items faulty Id like to applaud Georgia from customer service for dealing with it so promptly and efficiently.  She is a credit to the customer service team.

records.title: Nice, but Not worth it!
records.text: They have really cool items, I'm talking about boohooman. But the return shipping costs from Europe are outrageous. 23€!!

records.title: Ordered a white button top and as soon…
records.text: Ordered a white button top and as soon as I opened the parcel the button was covered with white tape as like someone tried to tape the button back on! Very strange. Anyway messaged boohoo straight away and a lovely man James was helpful and refunded me straight away. Just hope this doesn’t happen again…

records.title: Boohooman doesn’t refund returns
records.text: Been using this website for years and there are always problems when it comes to refunds. They tell you to wait 15 days when it only takes 3 for the returned item to get back to them. After the 15 days they still won’t issue a refund expecting you to have forgotten. If you don’t message them directly they most likely won’t issue a refund. Dishonest business. If you buy something make sure you won’t return it, if you do then write down every detail, put it in your calendars, set alarms because they won’t tell you. I once waited a whole month and a half and they didn’t say a thing until a checked and realised they never refunded me. Also if a parcel goes missing don’t bother asking for help, they don’t care. Thankfully customers service has been improving and you might get lucky to have help from a person with a working brain. They should just add a refund as store credit option and be done with it.

records.title: Returns never work but Valerie on the…
records.text: Returns never work but Valerie on the text service was helpful, sending me a label. Annoying having to to and fro to pick up the info needed from the app.

records.title: It is very hard to find a suitable fit…
records.text: It is very hard to find a suitable fit for a low price. Sometimes when I place an item in a basket the price (which I thought was low) is now a higher price than the one before I put it into the basket. They also are not always accurate about their large sizes.Also I would prefer it if there were measurements for other items such as handbags or tote bags, however this I formation is absent in the description.

records.title: Next Day delivery issue and faulty dress
records.text: I paid next day delivery of £5.99 on orders placed before 11pm on Monday evening as I needed the dress for Thursday. The delivery then didn't arrive until 1630 Thursday afternoon. Once collected I tried the dress on and the zip came off! Contacted customer service where I was dealt with by Princess who was great help and sent me a replacement for next day delivery...we shall see if it arrives tomorrow. Still disappointed that the original next day delivery issue wasn't acknowledged.

records.title: Issues with returns portal again!!
records.text: Aisha who I spoke with on the online chat was incredibly helpful. However, since Boohoo have changed their returns portal I have had nothing but issues. Whenever I attempt a return it never recognises my email or postcode meaning I’m on the chat for up to an hour trying to get a simple QR code, this has happened on multiple occasions.I use to think Boohoo were the easiest company to deal with but in the last few months I’ve had nothing but issues😞

records.title: Late deliveries
records.text: I order a fair bit from boohoo but the past few deliveries have taken 3 days when I’ve requested next day delivery.  It’s very frustrating.  Also I’ve had issues with the sizes lately as you just can’t trust they will fit as they vary so much.  It’s just very annoying as it’s difficult to know what size  to order when there is such a variation so I order elsewhere where I can trust a 14 will really be a size 14.

records.title: I go to boohoo for most things and have…
records.text: I go to boohoo for most things especially holiday stuff, and have been very happy with many items, I have to mention though, I’am still waiting for an email to confirm if they received a hoody i returned a while ago, I probably won’t be getting my refund, tried but failed for help…Great price really lovely clothes

records.title: Not happy with my first experience
records.text: Well, I never received my order and it was needed for my daughter’s prom.  I doubt I will ever use boohoo again because it was quite challenging Tomkins a way of contacting them to get my money refunded.The reason for 3 stars and not one is I did finally get some assistance and a refund after some help from crizalda peruda.  Unfortunately, now I have to find some clips for my daughters hair by tomorrow!

records.title: I had an issue trying to return my…
records.text: I had an issue trying to return my parcel as my local drop off point was out of service. Had some trouble with the first person I was put in contact with, who could do with some lessons in customer service. But melinda was fab she sorted my issue immediately and had great customer skills.

records.title: I often receive incorrect items from…
records.text: I often receive incorrect items from Boohoo. It’s really challenging to purchase items because you never know if the colour will be accurate, or if you’re really gonna get what you saw online. For my latest purchase, however, I reached out and within a matter of hours, a rep named John was able to assist me quickly. Thanks John!

records.title: Premium crotchet lace mini dress.
records.text: Ordered the dress which is as beautiful as the picture. Really good quality and looks gorgeous on, however the zip is awful. Tacky and cheap, didn’t do up properly on or off. Ordered another, exactly the same, so sadly had to return.Didn’t get a refund for 3 weeks so contacted customer services via text. Very  efficient and helpful, Ardielyn processed the refund straight away! The whole process took less than 3 minutes, great customer service!!

records.title: Process is rubbish but great customer service
records.text: The refund experience was a bit long and ridiculous having to get in touch to be told to wait 15 days and have nothing happen on the the 15th day! however Jay G was amazing and helped my issue right away, with no fuss. The chat function is really helpful. Can’t fault Jay G’s service.

records.title: Order never turned up
records.text: Order never turned up, also the second time this happened tried ordering the same item last year. Assuming as it sunglasses a small item gets lost amongst other parcels. however costumer service team resolved the issue within good time. Giving a full refund.

records.title: This is a phone less company
records.text: This is a phone less company.  You have to reach out either chat, email or fbFb messenger kept answering questions about shipping (which wasn’t why I contacted them)My email bounced back the first time. I ordered boots. They hadn’t even been delivered yet and they went on sale for 60% off. Company woukd not match the price for me

records.title: Customer service is never great and…
records.text: Customer service is never great and they have flat out refused to refund items that were missing from an order. Haven’t ordered from them since and warn everyone not to unless they like losing money.

records.title: Here’s a draft for your review:
records.text: Here’s a draft for your review:Beware of Misleading Prices at CheckoutI attempted to purchase two items through the app: one priced at £15.49 and the other at £23.10. However, the total at checkout came to £53.90—completely different from the expected amount. When I contacted customer service for clarification, their response was as fallowing Hi,Please be advised that Prices do fluctuate depending on the different discounts and promotions that we have on our website and app. It's best to keep an eye out as it's regularly changing. Also, if you're adding any promotions to your basket then this may affect the price when checking out your order due to the terms and conditions of the promo code - Matthew  unhelpful and failed to resolve the issue.

records.title: Late delivery, No refund
records.text: I placed an order on November 28th my bridesmaid dress was scheduled to be “expected” on December 9th, instead it has arrived on December 17th. I contacted “customer service” through Apple messages and asked for a reimbursement of the shipping fee because I find it utterly unreasonable that I paid $10 for shipping only to have it come later. Arguably a day or two late, but certainly not over a week late. This is what Kai the ai assistance had to say “Your order is currently marked as "dispatched" and was delivered on December 17th. Since the order status is not "cancelled" and there is no refund data available, I cannot process a refund for the shipping fee at this time.” I'm really upset, but I'm not requesting that my order be "cancelled." This was my first time shopping from Boohoo, and my friends had no issues with their orders—in fact, one of them had ordered a bridesmaid's dress the day after mine, and it arrived at the same address. Although the dress is beautiful and the material is just as described, I'm not happy with this purchase.

records.title: Bad customer service and overall a disappointing experience
records.text: Contacted customer service because I wore my corset top once and the wire of the bra part went through the fabric and was now sticking out, meaning there was no proper support. I had only worn it in the car on the way to the event and the moment I walked inside I noticed it was broken. I was pretty upset considering I paid € 40 for this top and expected it to be of better quality. It was a pain to be able to contact customer service. They decided to refund me € 20, rather than the full amount I paid or send me a new one. Dear Marirose, since you specifically asked if I could mention your name in the review, here you go. I am not happy with the way boohoo handled this issue. Marirose also suggested I fix this item myself, because apparently it’s up to the customer to take care of overpriced items that are made badly. Very disappointed with the overall boohoo experience. Shipping took ages, the product quality was sub par for the amount they’re charging, and I’m dissatisfied with how customer service handled this issue. Would not recommend. You could get the same type of quality on shein or temu for much cheaper.

records.title: Received an expensive jacket  with a…
records.text: Received an expensive jacket  with a very cheap awful zip. Asked customer service for a partial refund and they’ve just told me to send it back and pay. Not pleased at all

records.title: Wrong sizing information/advertising
records.text: Size clothing is absolutely wrong am a L and the hoodie looks like an XL. Trousers lengths and size is really what they need to improve on because not everyone is under 5’4 they need to work on tall girl friendly clothing. Bottoms also need to curve plus. Material is lovely and the delivery is good am just disappointed in the lengths of the pants i got and it was a last a minute outfit so it’s really annoying that now i don’t what am gonna wear and now i have to start doing a return. Need to be more inclusive.

records.title: I ordered a suit (pants and sweater) in…
records.text: I ordered a suit (pants and sweater) in chocolate color from USA. In the description I read that it was 100% cotton. I received something shapeless with a composition of 95% polyamide. The color of the pants is different from the color of the sweater (a couple of tones lighter). Unfortunately, I ordered this to send to another country, and it is more expensive for me to return it than to throw it away.  Pity that the information on the website is unreliable and the products are low quality. On the plus side, the only thing is that I bought it at a discount. So I'm throwing away less than I would .

records.title: Expensive delivery
records.text: I’ve spent £58 on 4 items on Black Friday sale and still had pay £4.99 shipping costs. Returned every single piece of clothing. Had to pay £1.99 to return it. So almost £10 gone just on delivery fees. Never again. Rip off for what it is .If the delivery was free or at least not that expensive, I wouldnt be leaving a bad review. Would rather shop at Zara.

records.title: Ive ordered from Boohoo before and…
records.text: Ive ordered from Boohoo before and never had an issue until the day it really matters. I leave for my destination wedding on September 22. I ordered a swimsuit cover up for the trip on 9/13 and paid $11 for it to be shipped within 4-7 business days.Then I get an email this morning saying it won't be here until September 26th! That's almost two weeks later! I looked further into it and I saw that it's being shipped from the UK!  SO annoying. I feel like I should be refunded $11 or given credit for the inconvenience.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.

records.title: Account holder for over a decade and happy to recommend
records.text: I have had a next account for over ten years and order several times a year. The reason I use NEXT is that I trust the delivery will be on time. On the odd occasion I have had an issue (such as Xmas deliveries going astray or not being delivered) customer service has been easy to contact and has resolved my issue. The website is easy to navigate and the account details simple to follow and track regarding payments and orders. I would happily recommend NEXT to family and friends.

records.title: Finding a swim suit for my wife to wear…
records.text: Finding a swim suit for my wife to wear at a local leisure club has never been easy, until now. The Next website provided excellent information to help me choose one which has proved to be just right and my wife is delighted with her Christmas gift! Thank you.

records.title: Absolutely love next!
records.text: Absolutely love next! Good quality clothing and easy ordering.   On occasion when I have to return on line orders to store, its such an easy process and refunds are swift too!

records.title: Regular update on my online orders
records.text: Regular update on my online orders. Secured and easy checkout process on online orders. All stuff are lovely, durable, and fits well. Good customer service at till by staff team. Regular monthly statements, all stores are always clean and tidy. All items are easy accessible in store.

records.title: Good customer service experience
records.text: Wow. I am super impressed with Next. I had click and collect items waiting for me in store. I had an operation on my foot and wasn’t healing as quickly as anticipated. I called Next advising them that I couldn’t currently drive and asked them to hold on to the items for me as they were intended as Christmas presents. The advisor on the phone arranged to have everything sent out to me, via next day delivery, free of charge. I wasn’t expecting that but I was very appreciative as I was struggling to get a lift to store. Thank you, Next.

records.title: Hollie from Doncaster is the best
records.text: Over the last few days I have placed a purchase for my mum and, due to having been prompted to create an account, I did so and today when I requested a call-back, it happened almost immediately (which is pleasant) and I got put through to Hollie from Doncaster, who was excellent! She was kind, attentive and quick to put my mind at ease regarding collection!Only wish there were more people like Hollie :)Happy New Years anticipation ! :D

records.title: 🌸Lovely clothes🌸
records.text: The quality of the clothes is amazing,and you always know you are going to be delighted with what you have ordered.And your sales are brilliant🌸☺️🌸 My grandchildren look amazing in crew clothes and would fit in nicely in one of your adverts🫶 package well and arrived in good time Thankyou for these wonderful clothes ☺️

records.title: Brilliant
records.text: Brilliant, I was really desperate for a present for a very special Grandson. And Tele next , two days before Christmas day to see if they could possibly deliver before Christmas I placed the order and Christmas Eve Evry delivered on behalf of next.I will always be grateful and would recommend them to.family and friends we have ordered many items before but as you can imagine this was a real winner. Thank you Next and Evry.

records.title: Erin L from Durham working York CC
records.text: I don't often shop at Next however I did recently purchase a Christmas gift online for collection in store. I've just popped in and probably was served by the most outstanding person this year. Erin, from Durham attending university in York.Simply, outstanding. Thank you

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Products came early, well packaged and although fragile were in perfect condition. Delivery driver polite and friendlyThank you all

records.title: Not all of items have arrived yet
records.text: Not all of items have arrived yet, but the cushions and towels have and they are great quality. The only thing that let’s next down is their delivery. Safe place is ignored every time and it’s left on doorstep in all weathers…luckily no next orders ruined, but other items have been stolen and soaked with rain.

records.title: Simple and Straight-forward
records.text: I opted for click and collect for my Next purchase. Everything was simple and straight-forward to do. I had no problems. They communicated well and let me know when my order was ready to collect. I didn't have to wait long at all once actually in the store. Good experience overall.

records.title: Search facility needs improvement but overall good shopping experience…
records.text: The reason I dropped a star was because the inability to find what I actually was looking for even though I had a photo of the label but whilst hunting around found something else. Delivery to store was quicker than informed and pick up was quick considering the sale had started.

records.title: Great service.
records.text: I have always found that you get exactly what you have ordered, delivered quickly and efficiently. The wider range of clothes etc. available online is excellent.

records.title: Have had problems with goods being…
records.text: Have had problems with goods being delivered to wrong store, so it can take three days to get to store asked for, instead of next day delivery

records.title: A good item of clothing
records.text: A comfortable pair of jeans, but the delivery was delayed.  However, I will give a 4 star for keeping me informed of the delivery situation.

records.title: Good experience, would order this way again!
records.text: From time of my online order to time of delivery, everything went smoothly and according to what I was told when initially ordering. I would certainly purchase this way again.

records.title: Lovely light shade but a bit difficult…
records.text: Lovely light shade but a bit difficult to install on my own trying to balance on a stepladder holding the glass shade, droppers & lampholder.

records.title: On line purchase
records.text: Purchased on line with no problems. Easy to navigate through the process. Choice of delivery and of store and of collection date. Next day is brilliant.  Items in good condition and just what I wanted. Always a good experience at Next.

records.title: The service was okay
records.text: The service was okay. I have stopped shopping so much at Next since my credit was decreased without explanation. I now shop elsewhere since settling my account in full. Felt very disappointed

records.title: You try and help the planet!!!
records.text: When I placed my order on 25th December, I ordered 3 items. At the end of going through the routine, I was asked if all 3 items could be delivered together on the following Wednesday. This was perfectly fine as it was explained to me that it would save on omissions. What happened was that each item was delivered on separate days. So the omissions were 10 times worse.

records.title: I’ve had a directory account for over…20 years
records.text: I’ve had a directory account for over 20 years and I can’t say anything negative. There have only been a couple of occasions when things haven’t been delivered as quickly as expected given the extra yearly charge. The person that delivers always does so efficiently and where it wouldn’t be stolen by any opportunists.

records.title: Great choice of products
records.text: Great choice of products. Good delivery although it was requested that items be delivered together to reduce packaging & this didn't happen.

records.title: Order delayed
records.text: Ordered on line to collect in store on Tuesday, message received stating delayed. Went in Thursday but told still not available.Rang customer service and lady was exceptionally helpful. She tried to call the store who cut her off as order should have been there. She then ordered the top again and got delivered directly to my home which arrived the next day. Thank you to customer service lady.

records.title: Ordering is easy and lots to choose…
records.text: Ordering is easy and lots to choose from. Its delivery that I cant count on.I generally don't get things delivered to the house anymore. The amount of times they didn't arrive, I was charged for them and then I had to go through the process of calling CS. I now get things delivered to the store which is not always convenient but at least I know they will arrive!

records.title: Had to look for a member of staff...
records.text: The only thing that let our experience down was having to go and look for someone instore that could answer our questions and then take the order.After that, everything was as it should be. Friendly, attentive customer service and a fairly swift ordering process, as we've come to expect from Next.

records.title: The order was easy to placestocked late delivery
records.text: The order was easy to place. But what was disappointing, was the fact the shirt was stated as being in stock but took over 2weeks to be delivered. Which meant I missed the appointment I ordered the shirt for.Regards Ken Baggottć

records.title: Unfortunately not good C&C service.
records.text: Unfortunately - and unusually, the delivery process fell apart for this purchase. I had ordered it on C&C at my local store and received a text message with a code on the expected day. When I got there, there was no parcel. I returned the following day - a purposeful trip this time - still no parcel. On the day after that, an email and message arrived - still the same code, and this time the parcel was there 👍🏼.Also unfortunately, and our problem this time, the item ordered was much bigger than expected, so a reorder and return have been arranged - hoping it doesn’t take three visits this time.

records.title: Service with a smile
records.text: Always pleased with service from next be it online or instore, products are always delivered in a timely manner. Clothing is good quality as is Home store products.

records.title: Order
records.text: I love next. Always deliver on time, staff happy to help.  Love the home, clothing & to be honest everything Next has to offer.I know this is an extremely busy time for all involved at Next, however I was disappointed that I have not been kept up to date with an order  which is a Christmas present  I had to contact customer service to find out more information as to where my order is, to be told otd not on the warehouse, it's been delayed.  May be delivered next week, which is only Monday Tuesday possibly,  baring in mind it's Christmas day on Wednesday 😡 or after Christmas..not helpful as its a Christmas present & ordered a while ago

records.title: Website ordering simple - service in collection store poor
records.text: The website was easy to navigate and I placed my order with no issues. I had to collect in store and from that point the simplicity disappeared. I was returning a gift from Christmas (jumper) with receipt but was told this was outside of the return window so I could only be given a gift card. I explained I had ordered 2 other jumpers (double my original spend) online and I was collecting this so could I just have a refund. They refused and the Manager refused so I asked could I spend the gift card online and they said no in store only even though it was ‘Next’ it was a return refund card. I asked if they sold the item I just bought online and they said yes so I had to buy the jumper in store with the ‘return refund card’ and then return the identical jumper that was in my online order and get a refund into my bank. This just made hard work and surely does not say much about Next’s carbon footprint. Won’t be shopping here again

records.title: I gave 3 stars because I bought /…
records.text: I gave 3 stars because I bought 2 jumpers recently £ 49 each . Couple days later they were less than half price in sale . So bit annoyed. Honestly though usually very happy with Next . Easy ordering , returns and very nice & friendly staff in Gapton Store . Happy New Year 🎊

records.title: Bad service
records.text: I have been a Next customer for many years and have always found the service excellent. However, My recent experience is far from good. I have been let down on a delivery wanted for  Christmas with  absolutely no apology. Maybe the service is sliding?I have a delivery pass too.

records.title: Return error
records.text: Usually, I order, collect and all is super. However, on this occasion I picked up some of my order & when I went to pick up the rest of it (within the time as I had until 29 Dec) it was returned by the store, without any warning to me. I never got the chance to pick it up in the first place. Refund as not appeared either. I have just assumed it is down to the busy Christmas season. Just a little unfortunate on this occasion.

records.title: Pricing issue
records.text: Process of ordering and collection from store was straightforward. No queueing My only issue was the three products I ordered had labels on each £1 cheaper than I was charged Still awaiting a response from Next regarding this (it's Christmas so I'll give it a few more days before I chase up a reply )

records.title: Did not arrive within the timescales…
records.text: Did not arrive within the timescales advised. This is always the case with Next. They need to update the website with realistic timescales. Very disappointing. People don't mind waiting 3/4 days as is expected when ordering online however when told it will be next day delivery and getting constant updates that delivery will be late a d waiting 3/4 days is very frustrating.

records.title: Better issue management in store is…
records.text: Better issue management in store is needed. Went into the store to pick up an online purchased item. The iPad that customer needs to use to check in for pick up item wasn't working. One of the customers informed the Staff, the immediate response of the Store to this problem definitely has room to improve. Many customers stood there did not know whether should go to the till for help or wait at the collection point. It is clearly a lack of issue management in the store. One girl from the till running around to help to get the preorder out, then a male staff suddenly asked, did anyone know the iPad wasn't working.. ( Honestly, after more than 20 min !). What made it even more frustrating was there were staffs in women section downstairs stood behind the till chatting. That means it wasn't a staff issue, it was a communication issue and issue management within the team Will avoid click and collection from store again.

records.title: Missing items from order
records.text: In the past week I have ordered two pairs of ladies pyjamas on separate days. On both occasions the tops were in the bag but not the bottoms! You should be more mindful when people return items they have ordered that both pieces should be returned not just half of it. I think it’s called stealing! Disappointed!

records.title: Usually 5 star
records.text: Usually 5 star , probably not Nexts fault but the item I ordered didn’t get delivered I messaged Next they didn’t know what had happened I think it’s lost but still shows as being delivered on my account

records.title: Nice candle
records.text: 3 stars as this was bought as a Christmas gift. Otherwise,  notifications were good and delivered on time at the revised date

records.title: The clothes are good but the packaging is awful!
records.text: We really like the baby clothes from next! They’re fun and bright and not as strictly gendered as other places. The big reason against 5 stars is the packaging. I ordered 10 items and they came in 7 or 8 separate plastic bags! I understand that some things come from different stores but some of these items were matching pyjamas that were personalised by the same people. If you’re shipping 10 items in 8 separate bags you could at least use the paper shipping bags. They’re baby clothes so they didn’t even take up a quarter of the bag. They’re not reuseable or recyclable at home. It’s just frustratingly wasteful.

records.title: Perfect items,  delivery poor by Evri
records.text: Items were perfect however I paid for next day delivery which didn't happen, took 3 days to arrive.  Next customer services were helpful in refunding the delivery cost promptly, however Evri failed with delivery times.

records.title: Great customer service in Didcot store but poor stock management
records.text: Great customer service in the Didcot shop but poor management / stock practices. I tried to buy two specific picture frames which I knew were in stock. It was a very important day and purchase for sentimental reasons so I made sure the shop had these specific items before setting off. When I got to the till to pay I saw there were large security stickers stuck down heavily onto the frames. I asked for them to be removed and sure enough all of the surface was pulled off. Of the three in stock only one was presentable enough to be given as a gift. In the obsession with shopliftters it seems counterintuitive to use materials that in themselves damage the products. I was left with only one item and was not able to give the present I wanted. The man in the store was very patient wth me and the situation and probably wondered why I was making such a fuss but I didn't want to burden him with the backstory of why this was important. Please think about the products and the waste that is caused by carelessly adding stickers and damaging them.

records.title: I ordered my husband a jumper for…
records.text: I ordered my husband a jumper for Christmas and I couldn’t pick it up as I was at work all week When he picked it up it wasn’t in a bag so he saw his Christmas present, so there was no surprise for him at Christmas

records.title: The flowers did not really look like…
records.text: The flowers did not really look like the picture on the website. There were instructions to arrange them in the "hat box" but the stems would have to be very short to fit. The outer box was damaged on delivery and the inner tissue was soaked-looks like DPD didn't keep them upright in the van. The flowers were OK but the overall effect not as good as expected.

records.title: Delayed item with no ETA
records.text: Delayed item with no ETA. Live chat function not available each time I tried. Emailed via online form yesterday but I don't know how long response will be. Better information and quicker support would be helpful for Xmas shopping. Also item descriptions online could be improved

records.title: Order not arrived
records.text: Nice item, quite expensive.Had text to say order at shop. Wasn't so had to make another trip to pick up......very frustrating and time wasting.

records.title: Would have had 5 stars
records.text: Would have had 5 stars, but at to go back the next day to collect other item.Thought that  the computer system would of been able to pick up my other deliveries

records.title: A bit disappointing
records.text: 2 gifts were fine but the pack of 2 nighties only contained 1. This meant an additional trip to return the packet, something I wanted to avoid at this busy time of year!

records.title: Disappointing and frustrating delivery and item
records.text: Requested delivery on the Sunday. No parcel arrived but Evri marked it as delivered with no proof provided. I had to chase this with Evri and Next. Whilst dealing with this, Evri changed the status to delivered, with a note that it couldn’t be delivered. They later confirmed it would be delivered on Tuesday. This was delivered on the Tuesday, but Next still said it had been delivered on Sunday, and provided a picture taken on Tuesday, making me out to be a liar. Disgusting. The bedding itself, whilst lovely, is far too large for the duvet of the same size, and we are left with a foot at one side of just material, which the duvet doesn’t fill.

records.title: Website function is shocking.
records.text: Website function is shocking.Can’t pay using a gift card online. Contacted their customer services team, and all they did was send me a link saying ‘try this’ to enter a 10 digit pin which isn’t applicable to the gift cards. Waited 30 mins to be told this. Message back, no response. Warning: you need to create an account to buy anything off their website. It’s not just a simple find and buy like most retailers.

records.title: Ordered two T shirts well before…
records.text: Ordered two T shirts well before Christmas as presents for my grandson. One arrived quickly. After a week I received a message to say one had been delayed and would be about 5 days. Nothing after that, no T shirt, no messages. Eventually I cancelled the order. I was refunded but would have appreciated better communication to give me a fair chance of buying something else. Update: Following the reply from Next I have sent an email with the details.

records.title: Ordered for a birthday gift and item…
records.text: Ordered for a birthday gift and item was in stock and due to be delivered next day, never arrived! Then received an email to advise it would be delayed and would be delivered next day! Still didn’t receive for another 5 days, really disappointed

records.title: Didaster
records.text: I ordered a 2 skirt pack - new. I got 1 and a hand written unsigned note saying I only got 1 as only 1 was returned!!?? It was a gift and I ended up only getting 1 skirt which was the same price as the 2pack! Also, because I'd bought on line the store couldn't refund my original payment - which I'm still waiting for. So essentially I've paid double for half of what I wanted! Not satisfactory at all.

records.title: Where is quality control?
records.text: I bought two mens tops, the same in different colours. When tried on the sizes were so different to each other we had to check the labels. We measured them and they were no where near the same size, not the first time neither.  I would expect this from a cheap retailer, but these tops were not cheap. This is happening more and more, seems to be no quality control at all. I seem to spend more time taking clothes back, costing me time and petrol.

records.title: Rubbish experience
records.text: Ordered on 18/12 chose next day delivery. Chased it on 19/12 to be told it was running late. Chased repeatedly and finally on 23/12 was told it was lost🙄 Had to phone next and get reordered and redelivered for next day delivery. Ridiculous that I had to chase multiple times for a parcel I paid for next day delivery.

records.title: Indirect racist profiling by a next staff
records.text: One of the staff in next shop Cambridge, the one around Andrew street has the worst form of customer service I have ever experienced. The guy was rude and a racist. I went to shop during the sales period on 27/12/2024 and the guy gave me an indirect profiling. I tried a suit and since it didn’t fit, I dropped it back like the other customer did. The guy came to meet me out of all the customers in the store at that time to go show him where I dropped the suit. He was not even matured enough to hide the look of disdain on his face. I had wanted to create a scene but I decided to act matured. I ended up spending over £150 to get some of the things I needed cos some of the ladies staffs are welcoming and helpful. That guy is not supposed to be working in an environment like next

records.title: Not notified that parcel had arrived
records.text: I was not notified that my parcel had arrived in store, either on the app or by email. I had next day delivery. Tracking said it was still ‘planned delivery’ on a date that had been and gone. I went into the store four separate times to check and each time was told it was coming later. On the fourth time, the employee actually checked and found it had arrived on time but had not been logged.

records.title: Match description and photos to the actual item would be great!
records.text: I'm just fed up of ordering things and they don't live up to descriptions. Cardigans that are not super soft but as prickly as an army blanket. Pyjamas that don't fit a 7-8 but are big on a 9 year old. Items that are not designed for the size. If it is a size 22 sleeves and length should be a size 22 also. Tank tops should not show all the underside of your arms down to the bottom of your bra. They don't on the models, why is that?It feels like for every item I kept recently I took 3 similar back. Please don't suggest I shop in store. The chances of me finding a size 22 in the design I like are slim to none. In the past I've challenged members of staff in store to find a size 22 in anything.

records.title: Late delivery and incorrect depot
records.text: One of my deliveries and shies I ordered went to a wrong depo so arrived too late to wear . Was over week later2nd order due for delivery Monday was also delayed and only arrived today so I had to take trip to the shop in both to return them
