ABOUT DISTURBIA
Established in 2003, Disturbia is a UK-based fashion brand dedicated to dressing the Other. Where light and darkness intertwine, Disturbia blazes its trail, creating otherworldly fashion to empower those who dare to celebrate all that is distinctly individual.

records.title: Customer service was responsive
records.text: Customer service was responsive. Unfortunately due to an over sight on my part my order could not be delivered. I was told it would be returned to sender and customer service assured me that once the item arrives my refund will be processed. While I don’t like that I have to wait for the item to arrive- I super appreciate the quick and friendly way I was informed of this policy and will definitely shop this brand again if everything shakes out the way I was told it would!

records.title: Weak Stitching but Immaculate clothing
records.text: I love everything about Disturbia. Their clothes are gorgeous, sizing is immaculate and designs are beautiful. So much so I can't even take a star away when I have to mention my only gripe is their stitching is very weak which is becoming a bit of a problem. It's something I can fix myself, I don't mind doing it, but it is getting a bit tiresome that every piece of clothing I have from them needs a stitching repair.

records.title: Quick shipping for last minute…
records.text: Quick shipping for last minute Christmas gift that arrived on time! My daughter loved her sweater and fingerless gloves! Will definitely be shopping here again - love the quality and quick delivery!

records.title: Disturbia is one of my favourite shops
records.text: Disturbia is one of my favourite shops. The clothes are edgy and stylish, well made and quality. I had an issue last week regarding an item and customer services were amazing! Thank you Beth & Abby for the best customer support I’ve received in ages. I have purchased the yearly delivery service, which I have with all my favourite shops if it’s available, as I have ordered a lot recently and will continue to do so. It’s just up my street with the style and my daughter also loves it too.

records.title: Fabulous company
records.text: Fabulous company - great quality products and sends your stuff out in good time.  Recently bought a bag from them which I treated myself to at christmas and love it and have already had compliments from people on it :)

records.title: Very fast delivery + good quality stuff
records.text: Very fast delivery + good quality stuffI ordered a backpack, sweater, and a blouse, everything feels nice and pleasant on my skin. Material-wise, most of it is cotton or viscose. Can recommend if you are looking for something goth-casual

records.title: Striking special occasion dress!
records.text: Unique design and  got lots of compliments. Pictures on the website really showed details of the beautiful dress, it was exactly as expected.

records.title: Always love my hauls from Disturbia…
records.text: Always love my hauls from Disturbia spend ages looking at what I really like as like so many things The uniqueness of clothing is why I choose some fits are hit and miss but I always take my chances. The quick delivery service is good and love it when they have offers on the clothes I’ve liked for ages eg. 25% off sale items

records.title: beautiful dress
records.text: beautiful dressi wish the sizing was a little more consistent but the information about sizing is really helpful, especially with  info about whether or not the item has any stretch to it.this is my fourth purchase from Disturbia and everything has been great.

records.title: Super quick delivery Ordered one week…
records.text: Super quick delivery Ordered one week before Christmas and arrived in two days.Beautiful dress and perfect fit.Can’t wait to wear it Many thanks Disturbia Team

records.title: Wish the ffabric was thicker
records.text: Clothes arrives in great condirion and match the pictures. The quality of the fabric seems good, but its thinner than i expected and the shirt is close to see through which is disappointing.

records.title: Beautiful, stylish, quality clothing for someone special
records.text: Beautiful, stylish, quality products. I ordered the wrong size and realized quickly. I tried to contact customer service and by the time they responded I had already received the wrong sized item. It was quickly replaced with the correct size. In the meantime, I placed another order to make sure it arrived in time for the holiday - and I ended up receiving both on the same day!! Shipping was quick, which is a plus. But Disturbia charged $8 to return one item and I'm still waiting for the remaining credit. Not sure I'll shop here again for this reason. Sorry.

records.title: The quality of the dress was so thick…
records.text: The quality of the dress was so thick and great, size 12 was also accurate using their sizing chart, a little expensive but worth it . Their shipping got delayed but they gave me a €5 voucher to apologise which was good .

records.title: Great overall, exept the size guide
records.text: The dresses are great. Beautiful and exactly as the pictures! Some fabrics strings here and there but overall I would definitely buy those again. Can't tell anything about the long term quality. Size guide was a size too big and was sadly very wrong, I'm glad I asked another person to help measure and translate to European size and so I got the right ones. That's why one star less! Shipping was fast and without problems. Would definitely buy again at Disturbia <3

records.title: It would have been 5 stars if the…
records.text: It would have been 5 stars if the discount code had worked. However, I reached out, and they gave me the money I would have saved in store credit.

records.title: Delivery to the Netherlands was good
records.text: Delivery to the Netherlands was good, took less than a week to get here. Everything was packaged well. I was a little bit scared my items wouldn’t fit because I saw other reviews online that said their sizing is off, this was not the case for me. The only reason I am giving 4 stars is because of the 8 items that I bought, 6 were amazing in quality but 2 were not what I expected at all.

records.title: Excellent clothing designs
records.text: Easy to browse the website. The clothes are always top notch. The size charts are of questionable utility due to discrepancy between the 'magic tool' and the traditional chart (which is buried at the bottom of the site). However when I order my usual size it usually works out. In a couple of cases I have had to make exchanges, which the company takes care of very well.

records.title: Very fast delivery and exchanges
records.text: Very fast delivery and exchanges. Easy process to change items. Beautiful products. Sizes can vary quite a bit, can be deceptively large sometimes. But love this shop!

records.title: Beautiful dress but no pockets!
records.text: Love this dress, perfect for the Australian summer being so light and airy but the lack of pockets will drive me insane, so it loses a star. Was tempted to give it 3 stars just for this one oversight, but won't be that harsh.I'm a size 12 and got the 10 - fits like a dream.But PLEASE Disturbia, design dresses for us with pockets! I won't be buying again unless I see pockets.

records.title: Beautiful dress, bust area could be bigger
records.text: Another beautiful dress by disturbia. I’m only giving 4 stars as I think the bust area could have been a bit bigger. I’m a 14E and ordered a size 16. Otherwise happy with the fit elsewhere

records.title: Lovely dress and fabric
records.text: Lovely dress and fabric, always buy dresses from disturbia ...but it's the second time the left pocket has a hole in it?? I ordered another design of dress which had the same issue?

records.title: Overall just love but there area few buts for customers not of the UK
records.text: Its a pity u cant use the points system outside of the UK, it should be available to all customers and if its not, take that feature off the site for customers outside UK. The clothing and the quality is great and I browse the website almost daily. Ordered two hauls (this far) but I expect there eill be a lot more. Customerservice is awesome, got an answer within a couple of hours and they where so nice and helpful!

records.title: Thin fabric but looks nice
records.text: Thin fabric but looks nice. Big pockets. I'll need to steam it before I can wear it.

records.title: Good quality but sizing is hard to figure out
records.text: I bought two items: a top and a dress. The quality of both is rlly good and I love the designs, but the sizing (or rather the guide) is off. The website has a size guide, which told me to get a uk12 for both items (I’m normally between an uk8 and uk10 but i didn’t care). The top fits rlly good although I’m sure it could’ve been a size smaller as well but the dress was about two sizes too big and it showed. Because I‘m from Germany I didn’t want the shipping process to be done because of one item and I worried that another size wouldn’t fit me perfectly as well so I took it to a local store to get it resized.

records.title: Good experience
records.text: Great service, everything went smoothly. As expected, shipping took some time but was all in all okey. I'm just a bit disappointed in the thickness of the material as the pictures suggested a much thicker material.

records.title: clothes are great but...
records.text: Im really happy with my clothes. at first I was worried because 5 days after the parcel was shipped, my courrier still hadnt received the parcel. There was no answer on the phone, just voice message and then you get cut off. however after a day i got a decent reply back from customer service...and items arrived a couple of days after that. there were delays at Holyhead, storms and Black Friday to take into consideration. In saying this, I do think the overall shipping info is purposefully vague ( understandable from a business point of view but not from a customer pov) and I feel there should be a person available  on the phone. for a day or two I worried i got scammed while I waited for a reply as a lot of customers were complaining of slow shipping. Im a single mother and buying clothes is a HUGE investment and treat for me and I think a more timely and transparent customer service should live up to the awesome clothes.

records.title: Good quality
records.text: Shipped fast, easy return when I decided against two items. Love everything I kept, although a bracelet I bought is already chipping paint, I'll still wear it but a little disappointing. Otherwise the clothes are great quality, super cute and fit nice!

records.title: Easy return/exchange & decent quality!
records.text: Ive ordered from disturbia a few times and because the sizing is really unpredictable, I’ve had to do a few returns/exchanges. The process is really easy, and they dispatch the exchange within a week (when the return product is received).  The quality is mostly good, but some pieces are not as great. E.g. recently ordered a pinafore dress and the fabric was great, but there was zero stretch at the waist, and an unproportionately large chest area, again, with no stretch. The underarm area was winging out by 1.5”, and there was no way to wear it without looking silly. I’ve had a couple other pieces that could have had better stitching/seams lining up.  Overall 4/5 though!

records.title: I love this store but...
records.text: I love this store, but wish it was a bit cheaper, or that returns were free - it's so hard knowing your size, and when you have to pay for returns too it's hard to gamble :(

records.title: Amazing but could use improvement
records.text: Delivery is usually really fast, which I really appreciate. But for my black friday purchase, I have been waiting for a while now. Disturbia did reach out and say it's due to the high order of items but it would be much appreciated by customers if Disturbia sent an email (or even made an announcement on their Instagram) saying orders will be late. I've seen a few other customers complain online as well.Usually I would give 5 stars cause the quality is amazing and everything is as it is online and shipping is very fast, but communication could be much better.

records.title: Waiting 25+ days for Order to SHIP
records.text: I placed my order on 12/5 and 25 days later, it still hadn’t shipped. I’ve already reached out to CS to explain the situation, and they’ve assured me it’s delayed. I understand, but 25 days to ship from the store or the DC? That’s 3 weeks my package has been sitting there I acknowledged after you already took money from my account.

records.title: Handling was difficult
records.text: Handling was difficult - Mastercard rejected without reason, shipment takes longer then 2-3 days. Still not onsite by today, 28th of December, 2024.

records.title: Everything was ok but the sizes of some…
records.text: Everything was ok but the sizes of some items are wrong.I followed the size guide and in all of them it indicated one or two sized larger than what I should have bought. They should bring back the size chart with the measurements, or adjust the current size guide better, because now I dont know what size to buy anymore.

records.title: My order never came
records.text: My order never came. I had to email 4 times to get a refund and wasn’t offered any credit or apology so probably won’t order again after fighting to get my $300 back.

records.title: Great clothes but delivery appalling
records.text: Great clothes but delivery appalling. Tracking updates almost nonexistent. Delivery extremely slow. Package left in exposed area despite people being home. Delivery person didn't even attempt to knock.

records.title: Honestly I need to stop buying these
records.text: Honestly I need to stop buying these. The patterns are to die for but the sizing is always hit or miss, and the cotton fabric ALWAYS shrinks like crazy. Too expensive to okay a guessing game when you pay to make returns.

records.title: First order at Disturbia
records.text: First order at Disturbia! The products correspond to the description but the size is a little big compared to the French sizing and the products are of less good quality than I thought, compared to the price, I don't find them worth it.

records.title: One day fine, the next? Eh.
records.text: I've ordered from them only twice. First time was issue free, everything came and it has lasted me longer than Killstar's clothes have within the last 3 years. The quality is great. However, during their black Friday sale, I ordered myself a coat. I had to reach out 2 weeks later to inquire why they hadn't shipped my order. After my email, they processed a refund and told me that my coat was out of stock, however, if you check the website, it still had it listed in stock in several sizes including the one I ordered. I don't know what they're doing recently, but it left a bad taste in my mouth that I had to reach out and get info 2 weeks after placing an order with radio silence for that 2 weeks outside of a generic email about being loaded with orders. If it were a shipping issue with Canada's strikes, that'd be one thing, but the lack of care is off putting. I may order again on a non holiday, since it seems they may just want to gouge you of money. They at least offered a coupon code for the 25% off that id be missing out on.

records.title: Request sizing before ordering
records.text: Website pictures of the ramen bowls I ordered are beautiful and blue compared to the mostly black with a hint of blue I received, the only reason I didn't return them was because of the size of them. Also ordered 2 mugs with no size in the description, one is almost teacup sized and the other is basically a soup bowl with a handle.

records.title: Okeish
records.text: Items are ok, some are better quality than others and sizing vary as well.I am happy with my items but not sure I will buy again as their return policy is not ideal from non-uk customers. I had items from 2 different orders to return and I could not ship back one parcel, had to return separately paying about 50+ € of returns. I returned them anyway cause keeping something that doesn't fit is a waste but still, not very happy.

records.title: Customer Services Sucks
records.text: Customer Services SucksOrdered 12 hours before the black Friday sale, contacted them 1st thing - well before the item had been picked - they refused to cancel the order.If the item was for me I'd have returned it but its a Christmas present (specifically requested) so I have to take it on the chin

records.title: The sizing of two of the items was all…
records.text: The sizing of two of the items was all over the place and both tops far too short in length which was not made clear from the pictures on the website. I also did not realise that you had to pay return shipping costs so I feel out of pocket for trying on two tops neither of which were an acceptable fit. I did manage to keep a dress that was quite nice but overall I wasn't impressed and doubt I will bother again as if items are so hit and miss the charges for the return shipping just simply won't be worth it.

records.title: Ill fitting stuff
records.text: Ill fitting stuff, leather is cheap plastic but expensive, I ordered a shirt and they failed to update me that it wasn't in stock until after I received my order I won't be buying again, y'all have fell off

records.title: Return options aren't explained properly
records.text: The return options aren't explained properly.The site said that you'll have to pay for returns which is fine. But when I wanted to return my order I specifically had to do it via DHL while this is way more expensive then my other post office. I was forced to pay €20 'at a discount' through DHL while I could've paid €12. More information before ordering would've been much appreciated. Delivery and handling was perfect and I had my package within 2 days which was great.

records.title: Good experience, will tailor the dress for perfect curve
records.text: The dress needs adjusting it doesn’t curve through the centre quite right. But the material is gorgeous and the embroidery. Took a bit linger than expected but it is December and I am in Australia. I will use Disturbia again.

records.title: Shipping took longer than expected but…
records.text: Shipping took longer than expected but I also know it’s the holidays. Clothes were so cute. Some could be better quality but overall good experience

records.title: Beautiful materials and design, poor execution
records.text: I really want to love clothes from Disturbia - their materials and design are so unusual and beautiful, like nothing else out there. The problem lies in the cut and fit of the clothes, they're always poorly fitting or cheaply put together. I bought a parcel recently and a dress 2 sizes smaller than my usual size was too big, and another dress had a tie at the waist that was so short in the body that it tied around my ribs instead. It'd be OK if returns were free because you could try your luck and see if something actually fits well, but I have to pay each time I (inevitably) send stuff back. Such a shame but don't think I can shop here again.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: The first disappointment was that the teapot is not blue, but black. The second disappointment is that the lid does not sit securely on the pot as there is no well for it to sit in. The third disappointment is that you asked me for a review a week ago which you did not publish, possibly because I wrote the above.

records.title: Didn’t get order yet
records.text: Didn’t get order yet. Shipping delays. Appreciate the offer for five dollars off the next order, however, considering how much the price of some of your items is, I think an acknowledgement and an apologies more than suffice, and that five dollars doesn’t have the effect that you think it might. Have not received the item yet, Overall experience on the website was good, easy to order and use, still waiting over 24 hours for a response from customer service regarding shipping, tracking and wait times, however, I did receive an automatic update from your website regarding those things, so that’s good .

records.title: Birthday haul
records.text: Received 3 out of 4 items order, on was oversold and refunded. Loved 2 out of three items received one was grossly oversized stating itself as a ten more like a 14.

records.title: Ordered two purses at 44 pound each
records.text: Ordered two purses at 44 pound each Only one received.. ordered end of November.. no communication to tell me when my second purse will arrive.. disappointing as were Christmas gifts

records.title: Haven't received my order
records.text: I ordered several weeks ago and have yet to get my order. I am also unable to track it. I asked customer service for a tracking number but did not hear back from them. It's difficult to assess how happy I am with the quality of the merchandise which I was hoping to wear for NYE but seems little hope for that now.

records.title: long shipping times
records.text: long shipping times, only resolution was $5 off my next order which is not useful as I don’t shop here. This was a christmas present

records.title: Repetitive bad purchase experience
records.text: I wanted to like this shop so much but their stock and delivery management is really bad. On 3 orders, 2 of them were problematic with one of them cancelled with no notice. It took me reaching our 2+ weeks after for them to let me know that my order was cancelled due to stock error on their side. I really wanted to like them but at this point it feels like whenever i buy from them I'm gonna find myself in ordering hell.

records.title: I feel like you can never know what you…
records.text: I feel like you can never know what you get from this shop. This time the dress was nice quality but smaller than the measurements seemed. At the same time the shoulder straps were too long. They also make the customer fully responsible for the return and I paid 29 euros for it. Would expect better return options, since the sizing is weird. Most likely not going to buy anything from here ever again.

records.title: Bad shipment experience
records.text: Today is December 23, 2024. I made my order on December 6 and still haven't received a confirmation of the shipment. This was supposed to be a Christmas present, and at this stage, I don't know when I'll get it. I haven't received any notification of when this can be solved.

records.title: I've wanted this blanket for years
records.text: I've wanted this blanket for years, finally bought it and I'm pretty disappointed in the lack of quality for the high price. The design is poorly printed & grainy. It's not double sided the back is yellow/black and the edges that are tasseled are multicoloured. I don't think I'll be purchasing anything from disturbia again which is a shame as everything looks good online but I wouldn't want to drop £60 on a dress for it to turn out to be this sort of quality

records.title: Item canceled at last minute
records.text: Very responsive to my messages but I did not receive one item I ordered due to a stocking error of some kind. That was disappointing because, per the website, you had them in stock. And I was not notified until I inquired about my shipment. I’m not sure what would have happened if I hadn’t asked.

records.title: Inconsistent sizing
records.text: Everything aside from the dress I ordered (which I sized down for despite the website recommending a larger size) was too big. I went according the individual measurements for every single item and nothing is right. Since I ordering during the Black Friday sale most of the items are out of stock so I can't do an exchange. With the amount of money these items cost this kind of oversight in quality control is a little ridiculous. First and last time I order from here.

records.title: I attempted to contact you at least 5…
records.text: I attempted to contact you at least 5 times regarding the order I tried to cancel and then ended up just eating the shipping and returning. Then you went ahead and charged me $180 and I have zero idea why. I love your clothes. It's like hottopic for adults but your customer service sucks.

description:
We’re Cue + Case, a family-run business based in Yorkshire, we’re positively passionate about Everything Snooker and Pool.

Our brands include:
+ Baize Master
+ Jonny 8 Ball
+ PRO147
+ Kudos

records.title: Probably one of the best
records.text: Probably one of the best, if not, the best I have ever dealt with! not everything went smoothly, but this was in no way a reflection of Cue & Case! more to do with the postal service and or couriers, letting them down! Cue & Case kept communication, made every effort to keep me informed as to progress, and I strongly recommend, their products and services.

records.title: Excellent
records.text: Purchased an item that was unfortunately lost in the post. Customer service to rectify the issue was excellent. Clear communication on status and actions taken to resolve and replacement order arrived as advised. Can't ask more than that.

records.title: Great cue sports company
records.text: Decided to start playing snooker and pool again after a few years not playing. My old cue had had it so ordered a new cue and case from cue & case. Both excellent quality, priced well and arrived well packaged and on time. Would definitely recommend this company if you want anything snooker or pool related.

records.title: Great Products, Great service
records.text: I wanted a set of snooker balls and carry case from 'cue & case' but having initial problems ordering on their site (probably an issue with my browser) i placed the order via amazon. Contacted Alex at 'c & c' who confimed the order and despatch/delivery dates via email. Both items were ordered on a Sunday and were delivered Tuesday and Wednesday the same week! The items were exactly as described on both 'c&c' and amazon's website and arrived well packaged and in pristine condition. Look forward to trying them out later this week. Will definitely use again for future snooker related items.

records.title: Good product, good price,  pool cue ,
records.text: Order was efficiently executed and swiftly dispatched item securely packaged, would recommend this company to anyone,

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: Original order got lost in transit but after contacting Alex at Cue and Case, he arranged for a replacement to be shipped and was delivered the next day. Super happy with product and company. Will definitely shop again.

records.title: A very good experience sorted…
records.text: A very good experience sorted everything out I bought the carbon fiber snooker cue and I'm very happy with it and I've never looked back with it. I also bought some taom chalk and taom magnetic holder and everything was sent out fantastically fast. Staff Very Excellent Service.

records.title: Great Service
records.text: Alex made the process from start to finish seamless. He had a genuine interest in what I needed and could recommend a cue and case based on my needs, even answering all my questions without hassle. Would recommend. Thanks Louise

records.title: Excellent service from team at Cue and…
records.text: Excellent service from team at Cue and Case. Received my new Baize master carbon fibre cue and case in Auckland, New Zealand. And in good order. I could see items were packed and shipped with care. Special thanks to Charles and Dan for making a exception to ship to New Zealand. I highly recommend.

records.title: Great product and excellent customer service
records.text: Really great team and pleasant to work with. Little bit of a mixup in order which was not only dealt with quickly but the team were willing to listen to my requirements to see if the could help me find the ideal cue.  Really happy with what I purchased and customer support team was great with Comms. Helpful and pleasant throughout. Already placed another order with them!

records.title: I’m happy with the product
records.text: I’m happy with the product, but I think it’s overpriced for what it offers

records.title: Order 146953/01
records.text: Despite the invoice clearly showing the products should've been supplied with cases, and checked by 2 staff members (Charlie and Keith) these were not delivered. After emailing to report the shortage, the cases were promptly dispatched and delivered next day.Very good customer service.

records.title: Great site
records.text: Great site, had a couple issues with delivery and small damage due to being in transit but was compensated and was handled very well would definitely use this site again!

records.title: Good buying experience, bad delivery.
records.text: Great service from the product side, and the Cue was fantastic value for money, and really high quality. The only let down was i paid the extra for the "expedited" delivery and they just got half way round the delivery that DHL showed and then turned round and took it back to base delaying it by another day. This would have meant i would not really been any later than the free delivery, and i ended up going to the DHL base two towns over to go collect it. With a better delivery partner this would be a straight 5 stars.

records.title: Easy to order
records.text: Easy to order. Quick to arrive. Disappointed with the packaging tho, brown paper wasn't sufficient to protect the item so it was shoved through the letter box by the idiot from Evri. This caused deep scratches to the pool cue handle purchased which is a xmas present. I would order again in the future but only if the packaging situation is improved.

records.title: Bought a new sooker cue and case
records.text: Bought a new sooker cue and case. The cue was delivered, but not the case. Called up customer support, who confirmed the error and sent me out a replacement on next day delivery without any fuss or issues. Used the cue several times now and I'm very pleased. Will definitely use cue & case again.

records.title: Came quickly and cue is really nice…
records.text: Came quickly and cue is really nice looking also don't know if it was in there by accident or not there was a mini bag of harbour tangtastics in there which were very yummy lol

records.title: Excellent product that came within 4…
records.text: Excellent product that came within 4 days that arrived in quality packaging with no damage. The only downside was that I didn’t get and email to say when it was coming or even after it arrived but this could just be a problem with Royal Mail.

records.title: Present for hubby
records.text: M order was dispatched quickly and arrived in plenty of time to give the cue case to my husband for Christmas. He specifically asked for this one so don’t think he’ll be disappointed

records.title: Good service
records.text: Good service.  I initially phoned them for some advice on which cue to purchase, then placed an order for a new cue, hard case, towel & chalks.The package arrived a few days later, but unfortunately they'd mailed out the wrong case (a soft, inferior one), so I got back on the phone and they asked me to send an email and attach photos of my package.  Shortly afterwards, they sent me a form to enable Royal Mail to collect the case.I'd heard nothing further from Cue & Case, so again I contacted them to remind them that they needed to mail out the correct case.  They then confirmed that this would be mailed out - and three days later I now have the correct case.The quality of the products is great - along with the initial advice I received, but the communication (and of course checking that they've initially packed the correct items in the order) could be improved.

records.title: Don't pay for upgraded delivery.
records.text: Very happy with the cue and case. Not happy paying the extra delivery charge to not have it be delivered by evri/royal mail like it was advertised only to have it delivered by royal mail.

records.title: Company was super helpful but I had to…
records.text: Company was super helpful but I had to call back a few times.  When I got the right person, they resolved my issue immediately.

records.title: Quality and Service were excellent
records.text: Quality and Service were excellent. Had an issue with the delivery but one short email and it was dealt with immediately with no fuss. Would recommend.

records.title: first cue was lost by the post office…
records.text: first cue was lost by the post office but another was sent and arrived in two days cue is very good for the price ,slight bend in it but nothing to concern you,overall i would recomend to friends

records.title: Impressive case
records.text: I was really impressed with a well built sturdy case atlas world map I got which stands out from the rest great case great quick service.

records.title: The case is great and it was delivered…
records.text: The case is great and it was delivered very quickly even over the Xmas period. The only thing I would say is that the depth of the case could be a little deeper to house my chalk holder. This is a minor thing though, the case looks fantastic and it holds my cue really nicely.

records.title: Cue has chip in it when it came got…
records.text: Cue has chip in it when it came got 9.99 back which is okay, so would only rate 4 star cuz of chip

records.title: Cue tip shaper
records.text: The Red Ultimate Tip Disc is a good design but I find it a bit coarse in comparison to my old shaper!

records.title: beautiful cue
records.text: beautiful cue, well balanced and easy to play with. I would've given 5Star if the bottom shock absorber wasn't already a bit loose.

records.title: All good
records.text: All good, smooth transaction, goods dispatched straight away, goods as described

records.title: Thanks cue + case
records.text: Delivery was quick and efficient and we were very pleased cue + case were able to accommodate our request for weightier cues. Only the fact that there some chips on the shaft of one of the cues made us give 3 stars. Even so the cues play really well and we will still use cue + case in the future..

records.title: really nice
records.text: really nice, great cue. Just a small chip in the paint

records.title: Missing cue and tip fell off
records.text: Ordered two cues and two chalks, order arrived and one cue was missing. Phoned to advise and was asked if parcel came with a packing note, when I said yes, and it had a name on it, was felt like I wasn't believed and they say they would have to check the packing videos.Eventually the 2nd cue was sent and arrived about 3 days later.On the 2nd use the tip fell off!!

records.title: Bought two cues one straight one wasn't
records.text: Bought two cues, one was straight one was not, not that bothered as it's for my kids but at nearly £38 a cue I expected them to be reasonable, I should of just used Amazon.

records.title: Great product with minor quality control issue
records.text: Cue and accessories is as advertised and I am very pleased with the cue, communication and delivery.Someone needs to take more care with the cue case before despatch however as the screws in the metal work were all loose so the fittings were loose too. At these prices you don’t expect to have to complete the manufacturing process with a screwdriver yourself.

records.title: Without a doubt the service was very…
records.text: Without a doubt the service was very good and the product arrived promptly. The only problem was the cue has a slight bow in it. However, I have emailed them and I’m awaiting a response.D. Dulley

records.title: Disappointing.
records.text: Disappointing.It was not easy to find a pool cue distributor in my physical area so I reluctantly did a search on the net.Cue and Case? Came out on that search so I looked at the products, the pictures were to me not clear, part photos of the cue's, so as a matter of haste I ordered and took a chance on the cue expecting to "receive" a case, as the tittle of the site suggested.To my disappointment no case was included, having phoned this supplier they confirmed this to be the situation for this product?!Therefore, I had to go to the further expense to purchase a case to suit this cue, another £30Had I been informed there would not be a case included I would not have placed this order.

records.title: don't know if it was the post strike
records.text: don't know if it was the post strike , but being asked for a review before items arrive is a bit pointless

records.title: Good but no tip
records.text: Cue was fantastic but didn't have a tip on the end

records.title: I ordered a blue and white cue case and…
records.text: I ordered a blue and white cue case and was sent a black and white cue case as no stock in blue and white , phoned and was told none available until August . Don't take the order if you don't have the stock , very disappointed and now stuck with a case I didn't want .

records.title: Damaged case
records.text: My case had a crack in the plastic and the wrap wasnt glued properly so had to repair the case myself as havnt been able to get through with cue and case

records.title: Not what I expected.
records.text: Ordered a cue case as a Christmas gift, I was so disappointed when it arrived was some mould on the inside, a black mark across the orange patch work and lose treads. I’ve sent an email and messaged on both Facebook and Instagram with no response from anyone.

records.title: I ordered a cue
records.text: I ordered a cue, not a very expensive cue, but expensive enough for me. the top of the cue is slightly bent. This is not from me storing it improperly, i have it in a hard case standing up. 'G14 Baize Master Gold Series 58 Inch ELECTRIC EMPEROR Snooker Cue Hand Made ¾ Jointed Professional Ebony Snooker Pool Cue with 9.5mm Tip and 6 Inch Mini Butt ExtensionAlso, a Baize Master 3/4 Luxury BLACK PATCH Snooker Cue Case with Round Corners and Securing Straps'

records.title: Cue and Case / funky chalk
records.text: Cue and Case / funky chalkThe pool balls turned up and were in new condition as was the pool cue and they were fineunfortunately they use fedex to deliver oh my god check out the reviews for them If the supplier uses them in the future I will not buy from themso many excuses so many emails this part was a joke

records.title: No communication, late delivery
records.text: Paid for expedited delivery between 1-2 working days. Arrived in 5. No communication about delivery when it was made in fact no communication until I chased it up

records.title: Delivery still outstanding
records.text: Still waiting delivery it’s been the the delivery warehouse for 5 days now.

records.title: Brought a cue from this company did not…
records.text: Brought a cue from this company did not open it for a couple weeks when I did play with it there was a problem, not that I’m very good at snooker, but I asked a couple of the lads to have a look all it thy told me it was bent.contact these people thy told me I was out of time fair enough but expect the queue to be fit for purpose which is was not.got it on eBay

records.title: Cue had defect and had to be returned
records.text: Cue had defect which should have been picked up during manufacture which suggests a lack of Quality Control. They sent a replacement but parts were missing. They have now sent the missing parts but I still don't have the case and extensions. It is almost 3 weeks since the initial order.

records.title: Damaged goods
records.text: The cue case arrived with no zip fastener so was completely useless. Quite disappointed as this was supposed to be a birthday present for my husband. On the plus side they were quick to reply offering a full refund or exchange. Downside - the cue case was out of stock so had to go for the refund.

description:
At The Knights Vault you will find one of the biggest sword collections available anywhere including many unique weapons. From sword replicas inspired by Lord of the Rings or Game of Thrones to Viking and Roman swords and hand made Scottish weaponry. 
As well as weaponry, we stock a broad range of beautiful handmade Scottish gifts, Lord of the Rings and Game of Thrones memorabilia, and heraldic themed gifts.
There is something for everyone backed up with world class service and worldwide shipping.

records.title: Witch King Sword
records.text: Excellent service. Item on back order. Not sure it would arrive for Christmas Provider kept in contact regarding expected  deliver times & possible alternative goods!

records.title: Customer service is one of the best…
records.text: Customer service is one of the best ones I have ever seen, very helpful. Sword is made beautifully. I bought it as a gift and seeing how great they are I'm definitely getting something for myself.

records.title: Lovely products worth the money with exceptional customer service
records.text: Bought two small blades as presents for Xmas. They were on the smaller side so less expensive but they look and feel fantastic for the money paid. I preferred one of the blades over the other so decided to exchange it for another. I cannot begin to explain how brilliant Sarah Newton was in assisting with this and ensuring they arrived in time for Christmas. Brilliant quality and superb customer service, would recommend!

records.title: Fantastic customer service!!
records.text: Fantastic customer service!!! They answered my product questions quickly and then the shipping was fast and efficient !! It was incredibly speedy considering it was an international delivery - My son is delighted with his  Dagger 🗡️ - it’s fabulous quality and is the perfect addition to his LOTR collection from The Knight’s Vault

records.title: We visited your shop last summer when…
records.text: We visited your shop last summer when we came to Scotland and my daughter picked out a piece she loved.  Now that Christmas is coming I knew I had to come back here to get another sword for her collection

records.title: 10/10, would recommend :)
records.text: The swords are beautiful and very well made. The delivery time was very fast (Croatia). Keep in mind though that you may need to pay additional fees for customs (it was approx. 90€ for me).

records.title: Great Shop both on and off line
records.text: Second time purchasing first time online, speedy delivery considering it's a small operation. Very thorough and good quality swords for the price

records.title: Brilliant customer service
records.text: I had frequent conversation with Sarah Newton before I made my purchase. I wanted to know things such as the legalities of purchase and transport of the sword. She was able to aid on all of these queries and it really solidified my purchase. In fact it made me want to upgrade my purchase to the deluxe style as I knew I was in good hands. Thank you so much for this!

records.title: Received purchase within the date…
records.text: Received purchase within the date given. And all contact was received well.

records.title: Amazing Outlander Sword and Dirk!!!
records.text: Very professionals. Excellent communication and amazing response to solve evry problem. And the products amazing. So far got the Jamie  Fraser's Outlander Sword and Dirk and they are fantastic. High quality and replica.

records.title: Lovely present
records.text: Delivered in good timing within the time frame stated, good quality for the price and looks like it does I be pictures.

records.title: The Knights Vault
records.text: The Knights Vault - 5 stars, unfortunately the makers of the Lothlórien Dagger - 1 star for not having a flush fitting dagger hilt to the sheath.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great customer service In helping me with my purchase Good service in delivery    Great sword and sheath    The wall mount was the thing stopping 5 stars.  Chipped and scratched at the edges so almost seemed second hand My daughter is ecstatic with it though so I am a very happy customer     Thank you

records.title: Beautiful looking product
records.text: Beautiful looking product! Came in with a few paint scratches, probably getting slightly damaged during shipping, but it doesn’t take away from how gorgeous the sword is.

records.title: You get what you pay for.
records.text: Great customer service, and fast shipping.  The quality of the blade is as you would expect for the price. I purchased Anduril for £103.  The hilt had some dings and imperfections, the pommel he a significant scratch on it, the blade is flimsy.  If I paid more than 103 quid for this sword I would be severely upset, but it’s not bad for the price.

records.title: Very swift service
records.text: Very swift service, fully happy with item ordered. Star deducted as communication left a little to be desired, website issues made me think I was not logged in and trying to contact to fix the login issue I received no reply.

records.title: The sword we ordered was amazing but if…
records.text: The sword we ordered was amazing but if took a lot longer to get to us due to courier problems. Got here in the end tho so no real harm done even tho it was a birthday gift

records.title: LOTR sword.
records.text: Quite a wait for the sword to be delivered, but the staff were very responsive and communicated honestly about delays. Very pleased with the sword itself.

records.title: Great Product
records.text: I bought the Anduril Sword and while I had to wait a few weeks for it as it was on back order, I am very happy with the product. It is very well made and a must for any Lord of the Rings collectors.I will definitely shop at the The Knights Vault again.

records.title: Quick delivery,good quality goods
records.text: Quick delivery,good quality goods, was purchased as a gift for my son and daughter in law as they are both into medieval things.

records.title: Great sword and very well put together…
records.text: Great sword and very well put together but the plaque isn't very good for holding the sword straight or tight.

records.title: Helpful service
records.text: The sword I ordered was poorly packaged and ended up having a little mark/dent on the cross guard and after sending over the proof of damage, Kieran who I spoken to during this issue was extremely helpful and sorted out any problems I had, thanks again

records.title: Great staff
records.text: Staff were very polite and helpful despite issues regarding stock and I was notified right away once my order had been restocked!

records.title: Had a great experience with customer…
records.text: Had a great experience with customer service and item was sent out quicker than expected however I didn’t realise the handles would be plastic and the plaque has some what looked like wood dust and a little scratch other than that very satisfied

records.title: Staff very knowledgeable
records.text: Staff very knowledgeable.  The line moved slow because only one employee was working.

records.title: Nice quality swords and friendly staff
records.text: Nice quality swords and friendly staff. It’d be nice to have had more information on where and how the swords were made.

records.title: Rohan sword
records.text: Came really quick and is a very nice sword but it doesn’t come with a sheath which could do with as its quite a blade. But very nice product.

records.title: The sword is great
records.text: The sword is great! I just missed the screws to hang it on the wall and wooden wall-mount.

records.title: Order system really easy to use
records.text: Order system really easy to use, quick, and efficient. Items are great quality for the price.Didn’t receive a confirmation email of purchase only delivery information.Will definitely be back!

records.title: First sword I’ve ever bought
records.text: First sword I’ve ever bought. It’s very light but the detail is very good. I was looking for a much larger and heavier sword but I’ll learn from the experience.

records.title: Good sword, a little bad info
records.text: Had bought the sting sword from the hobbit. Sadly i could not keep it as i was travling to france with train and as the blade was “a Little Sharp” it was Seized by border control. I had inquired about being able to travel with it, and had gotten confirmation from an employe that there should not be any problem. So no you cannot travel with it, get it sent with postage, if you are in need of a blade.

records.title: Swords?
records.text: Have placed 5 orders over a few years. Outlander - Jamie Fraser's Dirk & Broadsword. LotR - Legolas's & Auriel's Knives & The Orcrist(The Goblin Cleaver). Pleased with the items I've received, good delivery for the Dirk & Knives but the Broadsword took months and The Orcrist(ordered 30/10/22 still waiting). But they have kept me informed via emails and a personal call from Kieran their manager so cannot fault their customer service and will definitely continue being a customer.

records.title: Good price and product. Shipping packaging could be better.
records.text: Solid product for the price. Was disappointed with how product was packaged during shipping. Ended up a bit dented and bent on arrival. Nothing that can’t be fixed, but I’d pay more for shipping for some bubble wrap or something to ensure everything arrived in perfect condition.

records.title: Had nicks and scratches in my blades
records.text: Had nicks and scratches in my blades, but was cheaper than a lot of other websites but you get what you pay for.

records.title: Slow delivery
records.text: The delivery was slow and the packaging insufficient for the product.

records.title: Poor customer care
records.text: Product was great, but what I received through the post was not what was advertised. I informed them about this and they refused to send me what was advertised. The response was also quite unsympathetic. I found this very frustrating and unprofessional. It’s a shame because it’s put me off the company despite really liking their stuff. Very poor customer service.

records.title: Missing sword
records.text: I ordered 3 swords, and got two of them, the box they were shipped in was opened when it arrived. I have tried reaching out to the store to find a way to either get a refund or the missing sword but they have not replied to my email. I absolutely love the other 2 swords, but these swordsare very expensive to have one be lost/stolen during shipping

records.title: Great sword but no scabbard.
records.text: I eventually recieved a beautiful sword about a month after making order. On arrival there was no scabbard for the sword which was advertised with the sword I ordered origionally and I was not made aware of this. So that was I have to say  disapointing. There was a back and forth to correct my address, and Sian if you are reading I am grateful you tried to resolve the issue. Unfortunetly I had to contact a couple or more times as the address stayed the same and was about to be posted but eventually got sorted. Maybe just a busy month and communication between work shop,shop and web get a bit muddled.

records.title: Product and sevice feedback
records.text: I did not make an on line purchase, however, since I received this request to provide feedback on the Knight's Vault, I will take advantage of the offer.I visited the Knght's Vault in person in June of 2017. During my visit, I purchased two swords; Anduril and Sting. My experience in the store was very pleasant. The attendant (I don't recall his name) was friendly, courteous, knowledgeable and very helpful. He made arrangements for my swords to be shipped to my home in Texas, USA. I was surprised at how quickly they arrived and was very happy with the quality of the swords. My only issue  is that the scabbard for Anduril was a bit defective in that the sword would not fully sheath to the hilt. Something blocks the sword leaving 3-4 inches of sword unsheathed. In July of 2017 I emailed the Knight's Vault explaining the issue, however, I never received a response therefore the rating of 3 stars as opposed to 5

records.title: Beautiful product but they don't even send a suitable box to store it.
records.text: The product is lovely, but I expected at least a proper box to store. The box was completly covered in tape and shipping stickers that cannot be used to store or give as a gift. For the price and shipping cost, I expected better service.

records.title: Item didn't arrive in time.
records.text: Item didn't arrive in time.I ordered it as a gift 4 days before it was required, but unfortunately, it didn't arrive for nearly a week. I understand there are delays due to COVID etc. so it's not one star, but the reason it's still 2 stars is because I called after a couple of days for a quick update on my order. I was told I'd receive a callback but never got one and then the product arrived late.As it's a gift, I'm reluctant to open the box so can't confirm its quality etc. either. Frustrating experience - I'm sure it's great and I hate to leave a bad review, but just be aware that I experienced slow delivery & uncommunicative service sadly.

records.title: The research of the family is good but…
records.text: The research of the family is good but it would be an asset to be able to see the crest when ordering as what we always believed was the crest is not the one that was sent. We were definitely surprised and don’t understand.

records.title: Hidden fees/busted box
records.text: Hidden fees.I paid for the Anduril delux sword which was £265. I was then charged a further £60 for delivery to Ireland. When it arrived in Ireland I have to pay another €95. When I was delivered it came in a busted box, the sword itself came in so casing!!

records.title: The order took the best part of two months
records.text: The order took the best part of two months to come through. I chased it several times by phone and by email but never heard anything back. It was only when I started getting grumpy did I get a reply in the form of an email then eventually the product about 1 week later. Too infuriated to even look at what I ordered given it was supposed to be a birthday present, which was missed by the time it arrived. The most astonishingly shabby online shopping experience I’ve had to date. Didn’t even get a meaningful apology.

records.title: Swords are very poor quality even for…
records.text: Swords are very poor quality even for wall hangers, will fall apart, they don’t even offer the minimum one year warranty on there extremely low quality items. They take a long time to answer emails and are generally unhelpful. Would not recommend to anyone.

records.title: No search function on the website
records.text: The website said to check the database for the name to see if it was in it, but there was no link to any search that I could find.  Since I had gotten a copy of my family's Ancient Arms at the Edinburgh Castle, I thought the name would be in there (the Knights Vault e-mail is on the printed document).  I had hoped to give a copy to my nephew who was interested.  However, after I placed the order, I was informed the name was not in the database.  The notification was polite, etc., and I did get a refund within a week, but I am disappointed and a little puzzled as I am looking at a printout of the document from the Castle.  I do not recommend using the website without first talking to a person first to be sure about the name.

records.title: Our product came in Our product came in defective. The blade is on crooked, the handle is missing paint and it doesn’t fit in the wall hanger. I’ve already sent an email asking for a full refund. Hope
records.text: Our product came in defective. The blade is on crooked, the handle is missing paint and it doesn’t fit in the wall hanger. I’ve already sent an email asking for a full refund. Hopefully, someone will get back to me.

records.title: Hopefully waiting in Canada
records.text: I had a very good experience when I bought in person however ordering online has been unsuccessful I have not yet received my order and I am still waiting for you to straighten out your shipping problems

records.title: I am £123 out of pocket
records.text: I am £123 out of pocket. Order not received, no phone calls, no emails, nothing!

description: Birth Pool in a Box is the gold standard for home water births, trusted by mothers and midwives alike to create a safe, calming, and empowering birthing experience. Designed with care and expertise, our high-quality, durable, and portable birth pools have supported thousands of families during one of life's most precious moments. Recommended by NHS Trusts and home birth professionals, every product we offer meets the highest safety standards and best practices, giving you peace of mind when it matters most. Whether you're planning your first home birth or adding water birth to your journey, you can trust Birth Pool in a Box to provide the reassurance, support, and comfort you deserve.

records.title: Thank you Birth Pool in a box
records.text: Thank you Birth Pool in a box. I purchased the accessories box to compliment my hired mini pool from local community interest company. Not only did allow me to have the most wonderful home birth but it also meant I didn’t need to invest in everything needed. The box came with everything required for a smooth set up and clean up. Furthermore, order and delivery was super quick!  Highly recommend.

records.title: Everything arrived next day and…
records.text: Everything arrived next day and packaged beautifully. Thank you. I didn’t actually use any of the product as my little one arrived unexpectedly quickly but I was able to donate everything toy Homebirth team who were delighted- so everything will be used to help another little one arrive into the world. Thank you 🙏

records.title: Great company
records.text: We had a bit of a nightmare getting the box from the couriers - DPD are awful, but these guys were superb.  They stayed on the case until it was resolved, giving us constant updates and really listening to the problem to help find a solution.  We haven't used the pool yet, but in terms of customer service I can't recommend them highly enough.

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: The night before we received the pool my wife had Braxton & Higgs contractions and she was quite worried the baby was going to be born and we wouldnt have a pool because NHS didnt have any available. I have rung "Birth in a pool" and a super helpfull lady took care of everything and we received the pool within 12h of ordering. My wife was much more calmer after that. Baby was born in the pool and all went perfect, thank you for helping

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service. Received pool promptly without any damages. Everything as it should be. Really great company to work with, and a lot of products available .

records.title: Amazing customer service
records.text: Amazing customer service - DPD were a nightmare and would not deliver our pool. These guys worked closely with us to make sure we got what we needed in good time. Very impressed

records.title: Complete Essentials Kit for…
records.text: Ordered Complete Essentials Kit for Birth Pool in a Box which arrived within 48 hours of placing order. The kit was great, and so much easier buying as a package rather than sourcing everything individually. Having everything ready in one box made it much easier when it came to getting the pool ready for our water birth. Also makes the process of emptying the pool so much easier and stress free. Would recommend!

records.title: Perfect, affordable solution
records.text: We ordered our Birth Pool in a Box for a baptism. It was the perfect solution. Easy to inflate and sturdy once inflated and filled with water. Also it maintained the temperature very well. It was easy to enter and emerge from. I would recommend it for smaller ministries as an affordable, and long term alternative to hiring a private swimming pool or other baptisteries available.

records.title: Great addition to our home birth
records.text: Birth pool in a box mini was a huge part of a beautiful labour and birth experience for me and my family. Everything arrived rig but away, pretty easy to install and fill and also easy to empty and pack away. I can’t wait to use it again and I highly recommend it!

records.title: Amazing experience
records.text: The pool arrived in a neat box which was easy to store until birth. Set up was easy (10 mins- we actually didn’t test it before) and filling took around half an hour. It was such a relief to get into the pool, and made manoeuvring at the pushing stage so much better. Our daughter was born peacefully into the pool after around half an hour of pushing. I would recommend this pool to anyone considering a home birth, our experience was amazing and I found it to be a reasonable price for the size and quality of the pool.

records.title: 4 out of 5
records.text: 4 out of 5. Would have been 5 if cheaper

records.title: A bit pricey …
records.text: A bit pricey …But otherwise all good.Used before having had 3 successful homebirths.

records.title: Ordered something, it arrived
records.text: Ordered come hose piping, it arrived

records.title: Easy to navigate site
records.text: Easy to navigate site, and items were delivered quickly.

records.title: Make sure you buy liner as well as kit
records.text: Liner should be included in the birth pool kit would help in the future

records.title: Good birthing pools
records.text: Successful home water birth, quick delivery

records.title: disappointed
records.text: Hi, we were disappointed to find a small puncture in the bottom section which we had to put a patch on.

records.title: Good pool however water temp drops quick.
records.text: Pool was easy to put up and a good size, it remained inflated for a good amount of time and was easy to put away however my concern was that the water cools really fast and does not stay warm for the length of time it states it does.

records.title: Universal tap adaptor is a failure
records.text: Unfortunately I didn't have a good experience with the products from Birth Pool in a Box.My due date was 6th February but my son was born in Feb 13th.I had borrowed a regular pool, so bought a kit with hose, tap adaptors and thermometer. As there were 3 kinds of tap adaptors we did not worry about trying especially cause one of them is a universal tap adaptor. But during labour we realised none of the adaptors fit any of our taps at home, not even the universal adaptor, which was quite disappointing and frustrating.  So we had to change my plan to give birth in a pool, and instead I spent active stage in my bath and pushing stage I spent leaning in 4 on my yoga ball. Due to the circumstances I am now trying to sell the kit I did not use... alternatively maybe I could get a refund and send it back.

records.title: I have ordered and paid for Complete…
records.text: I have ordered and paid for Complete Essentials Kit for Birth Pool in a Box but I have received only a pump. I have sent email to this company. A week has passed and nobody answered for my email.

description:
Since 1966 the LD Mountain Centre has equipped people who love the outdoors, to travel safely and comfortably in the mountains. The name LD Mountain Centre derives from the surname initials of Peter Lockie and Gordon Davison who founded the business in 1966. 

At LD Mountain Centre we pride ourselves on being one of the best independent outdoor stores in the UK. Over the years, we have supplied expeditions from pioneering ascents, led by Sir Chris Bonnington and the UK`s top Himalayan summiteer, Alan Hinkes OBE, to Duke of Edinburgh Award schemes and of course, those of us who simply love to escape the hustle and bustle at the weekend. 

With the Berghaus heritage and the reputation of LD Mountain Centre, we attract some of the best and most knowledgeable outdoor staff, all of whom, gain their knowledge and experience first-hand by getting out and using the kit, whether that's on skis, board, foot, bike or the end of a rope. All this means that here at LD Mountain Centre we can help and advise you so that you make the right choices for your outdoor clothing and equipment.
