records.title: Had to Purchase a Bag at the Last Minute and LG Came Through
records.text: I had to order a bigger bag for a multi month trip. I'm a fan of Osprey and I could have got a similar bag for less than half but I decided to stick with a brand I know. LD Mountain Centre had the bag on sale and they offered fast delivery. I've used them before and have always been happy with their service. Plus when you buy from a know retailer you can trust that you will get a genuine product unlike buying from Amazon.

records.title: Highly recommended and trusted shop
records.text: I always trust LD Mountain Centre for competitive prices on snowboarding gear! My partner and I have purchased a range of items from them, from snowboards to hoodies, and have always been impressed with the price and availability of the products. They consistently beat other big online retailers on both counts. Delivery is always timely and items are always well packaged.We used to live close by the shop and have also had one board serviced here, for again a competitive price and in a very timely manner. The staff are also super knowledgeable and very friendly! Would definitely recommend!

records.title: Great product, great price and swift delivery
records.text: Gorgeous Patagonia fleece at a great price. Swiftly dispatched despite the Christmas break, securely packaged and was exactly what I was hoping for. I would highly recommend LD Mountain Centre and will definitely use them again.

records.title: Good prices and super quick delivery
records.text: Good prices and super quick delivery. I chose express delivery so I got the item delivered in time for Christmas after another company let me down.

records.title: Perfect!
records.text: Perfect!This went as all online transactions should do.  I needed this quick and during the xmas period.Everything LD promise about stock, dispatch and delivery was true when it was unclear elsewhere.A very competitive price too!

records.title: I received my goods from LD Mountain…
records.text: I received my goods from LD Mountain Centre in a very timely manner just in time for Christmas. the OSPREY rucksack was very competitively priced, well packaged and as described.Cannot fault these guys

records.title: A company to do business with
records.text: Nice clear, easy to use website - good range of products at good pricing with concise info. Easy to order; good communications & goods arrive as ordered well packed & in eco friendly packaging.A company to do business with.

records.title: First class service. Speedy arrival.
records.text: First class service. Speedy and well packaged. Quality product. Used before and will definitely use again. Highly recommend this seller.

records.title: Best price and fast delivery…
records.text: Best price for a standard colour Patagonia down sweater jacket which tend to cost a lot more than cheaper ‘colourful’ versions.  Delivery was very fast.  Would buy again from LD.

records.title: Great experience
records.text: Great experience - reasonable price and quick delivery. They saved my husband’s Christmas present while other shops could only deliver it after the New Year. The item arrived in perfect condition, not overpacked - I’m happy overall.

records.title: Great price, prompt delivery...
records.text: Bought my wife a Dale Norwegian sweater for Xmas from LD. Expensive but offered at a great price. Purchasing was smooth, delivery tracking good, delivery prompt. But the packing could have been a bit more robust - I wasn't at home for a couple of days when it was delivered and the postie left it wedged behind a water butt, in the endless 2024 rain. Considering the outer packaging was thick paper it survived getting soaked quite well. The inner packaging was a wafer-thin plastic bag. I left instructions to leave it in my greenhouse but I guess the postie didn't want to walk that far. Maybe make the outer packaging a bit less eco-friendly and a bit more product-protective.

records.title: Did have a problem initially with my…
records.text: Did have a problem initially with my order but contacted Customer Services and they remedied it very quickly

records.title: quick delivery but packaging is not so…
records.text: quick delivery but packaging is not so nice, no plastic bag to wrap the down jacket which can be risky if the paper bag breaks

records.title: Rab jacket
records.text: Quick delivery. Item arrived well packaged.Although I think a delivery charge of £15 is too expensive for BT521UB postcode. (Northern Ireland)

records.title: Excellent customer care
records.text: Excellent customer care - thank you. My order arrived short of a pair of socks. On calling the team. I received very helpful advice and was able to sort the problem out over the phone. Within minutes of disconnecting I had an email telling me that my new package was on its way.  Very helpful and thank you

records.title: Excellent quality
records.text: Excellent quality, swift response, but couldn't get the £5.00  off my first order, though that was the offer on the online order form.Hence 4 stars and not 5, though I will mention this when I next visit the shop, in the hope that the online order form can be improved for the sake of others.

records.title: Hassle free return
records.text: Ordered a fleece, got the wrong size, very helpful and straightforward returns process made returning it an absolute breeze.

records.title: Very good
records.text: Very good. I ordered late Friday evening and it arrived the following Thursday. The jacket was new with tags. I got about 30% off which I thought was very good.

records.title: Item was really well packaged but just…
records.text: Item was really well packaged but just disappointed that it took a week for the item to arrive

records.title: Right product
records.text: Right product, packaged in recyclable paper bags, only downside for is the posting and packing charges on such a expensive item.

records.title: Useless - but improved after I tracked someone down
records.text: Useless, I ordered for home delivery and my item was sent for in store pick up. I’m in London and the store is in Manchester! I have tried to phone and no one answers, neither do they answer on instagram! I eventually got a hold of someone and was refunded without a problem.  Thanks for taking the time to reply.  I hope you got your communication sorted.

records.title: Dealt with very professionally
records.text: I originally reviewed this with one star due it being lost and unable to resolve, but this has now been dealt with very well with the seller, so I am happy to revise my rating . In the end it was a Royal Mail issue and, although it took some time, I have been compensated fully. Can't review the product as it never arrived, but the seller has acted very well.

records.title: Excellent stock and really prompt…
records.text: Excellent stock and really prompt service. Would be a 5-star rating if the postage wasn't as expensive.

records.title: Easy to use website
records.text: Easy to use website, easy to find items, straightforward payment.  I didn't like the time pressure of until Midnight, before offer ends, though!  Efficient ordering, although cost of postage very expensive for a small item.  Posted with correct and clear address label and arrived in good condition, although it could have arrived quicker.

records.title: Ordered an Arctetyx Delta hoody
records.text: Ordered an Arctetyx Delta hoody. Easy to order. Quick delivery. Only 4 stars because they sent a medium rather than a large. As it happens I liked the slim fit of the medium so didn't raise an issue. I'm sure they would have rectified the mistake without issue. Would recommend.

records.title: First bag I received was damaged
records.text: First bag I received was damaged,  but they quickly exchanged it!

records.title: Quality gear at decent prices
records.text: I had been looking for Ice Breaker thermals to replace 20yr old “175 everyday” top & bottom that are now in holes. Whilst researching the web I found LD Mountain to be the most competitively priced. The delivery was quick and I was informed about it at most stages. I have returned a pair of leggings due to them being too small so just waiting a refund as they do not exchange at this time.

records.title: Overall a good experience with only…
records.text: Overall a good experience with only reason for not giving 5 stars is returns service slower than many outdoor retailers. Up to 14 working days to process your return is quite slow. Allowing for time for your parcel to reach them, processing time plus time waiting for credit to appear in your bank account means you may be waiting for nearly a month. Appreciate they may process your return quicker but in busier periods you may want to be fairly sure what you are ordering is going to be OK and not a potential return

records.title: Quick delivery but customer pays
records.text: Quick processing and delivery. But, although I spent over £100, I had to pay £5 for delivery. As I had no reason to communicate with the store, I can't comment on customer service.

records.title: Goods received on time as ordered.
records.text: Goods received on time as ordered.Only minor problem was that when I entered my home address for delivery, I was charged £14.99. I live just outside Aberdeen (16 miles). I put in my work address 4 miles outside Aberdeen and the delivery cost was£4.99.

records.title: Delivered on time
records.text: Delivered on time, however, it wasn't packaged (as they were when purchased previously) and worryingly, it smelt as if it had been worn by someone else. It was a birthday gift so I unfortunately couldn't wash it before wrapping. The product was as expected but badly creased and smelly, just a bit worried the recipient will reject it.

records.title: Good price but not quick to send order…
records.text: Good price but not quick to send order and don't reply to emails.

records.title: Company itself no problems
records.text: Company itself no problems, the coat I loved from the chest down, u couldn’t zip it up without the hood up or u get strangled n open, the hood and front open bits jst flop backwards. Looks ridiculous This was on the north face jazzi gtx lavender. Definitely not worth £270+

records.title: Mixed experience but generally a great shop
records.text: Mixed experience this time. Placed two separate orders for a couple of jackets on the same day. The first order was promptly dispatched and arrived quickly. The second item was out of stock but I only found this out when I asked 3 days later what had happened to the order. The refund was then very prompt.Generally, this is a great shop but as others have commented, the processes when things are not in stock could be better.

records.title: Ordered an Arcteryx Delta Hoody at an…
records.text: Ordered an Arcteryx Delta Hoody at an excellent price. Order then sat in processing. I emailed and no response. When I phoned apparently my M black one had gone elsewhere and I should have been messaged about that (nothing received). I was offered a green one but I didn't want that colour. I was then also emailed an explanation.To their credit the order was refunded immediately so all dealt with, but I was still disappointed!

records.title: Regular customer
records.text: Originally visited the store on dean street to try on some products for size. I figured out the best size for me after making use of the in store changing facility. Unfortunately the size I required was not available in store, speaking with a staff member I was advised the warehouse had available stock and that  they would honour the online price of the product as it was discounted via the website. I choose to have the items delivered to store as its free delivery and live close by. The only issue was someone forgot to let me know my order had arrived so I experienced a short delay in receiving my items.

records.title: Product not as described
records.text: Walking shoes arrived on time but not as described. Customer services very helpful and have contacted brand for replacement so hopefully all will be well. 3stars for shoes - LD mountain centre fine to shop with.

records.title: Am concerned as placed an order 8…
records.text: Am concerned as placed an order 8 October which I need delivered early week and have heard nothing since. Have just had an email back saying delays are due to volume of sales and order will be coming. Problem is I need to know when, if it won’t be here in time I need to cancel and get an alternative.

records.title: Likes product but arrived via post with…
records.text: Likes product but arrived via post with security tag still on so then had to visit shop to have this removed.  Staff in shop not really apologetic and no offer to cover postage.

records.title: I was sent the wrong item and it took…
records.text: I was sent the wrong item and it took them a while to get back in touch. The Centre said my original jackets was now out of stock so I either accept a refund or keep what they'd sent and they would reimburse the difference plus an extra 10%. They sorted this out very promptly and I was happy with my purchase but felt I could have got same jacket cheaper from other on line shops. But very polite staff and very helpful once they got back to me.

records.title: Not the best experience
records.text: Not the best experience. My order was cancelled as the item was not in stock despite being available to order. The item still remains showing available on your website. Now I’m receiving ‘we hope you’re happy with your purchase’ emails and please review the item?

records.title: This used to be the best outdoor store…
records.text: This used to be the best outdoor store around, but it’s looking rather like a jumble sale these days. The staff are a mixed bag, some great, others hopeless and indifferent as to whether they help you or not. Still some great brands but everything is all mixed up on the racks and most of it is cheaper on their website.

records.title: inconsistent customer service, still no delivery (eventually resolved happily)
records.text: Unfortunately I’ve had a very frustrating experience with LD. Through no fault of theirs the courier lost my parcel, but the process of liaising with LD to find out if they’re going to dispatch a new one or refund me has taken days, with slow responses and a feeling of lack of interest in a resolution from their support after an initially quick first reply from Graeme. I’m still waiting to find out what to do, with the date of my trip approaching fast and still no backpack.UPDATE: after calling and speaking to Graeme I was sent a replacement overnight as the original had been lost in transit. Frustrating initial experience but a happy eventual outcome.

records.title: Shoes turned up on time
records.text: Shoes turned up on time - what more/less can I expect? But then I get interminable emails asking me to provide feedback and recommending I buy things - eight emails in the last week. Please don't do that!  I have better things to do with my spare time - like go running in my new shoes.

records.title: I ordered a hoodie and it was too…
records.text: I ordered a hoodie and it was too small. I read some of the reviews here and was concerned by the negative comments on the returns process. Although not quick LD Mountain Centre have processed my return and refunded me. My biggest gripe with this company however is the ridiculous delivery cost to northern Ireland. I was first attracted to the proces on Thai site but they more than make up for it with over priced delivery charges. I was charged £14 for a very light hoodie and when I returned it it cost me £3.50. I wasted nearly £20 trying on a hoodie!!! Never again.

records.title: Customer Experience
records.text: Liked, delivery was prompt and website was clear, Disliked, reluctance to engage over the phone, allot of recorded instructions pointing me back to the website, felt very in personal when spending £250 or having £500 invested (including returned item), second issue is the time it takes to process a refund, 14 days seem excessive given Amazon and other typically turn refunds around in three working days. Company feels very formal/process driven, and less concerned about the overall customer experience!

records.title: Great prices and fast delivery for the products which actually arrived ...
records.text: I only received parts of my order due to a stock error in their system. They refunded me for  for the payment made for these items within a few days and the prices on the other articles were great, so it was still worth the purchase.

records.title: Ordered tent no problem But poor communication from seller
records.text: Ordered tent no problem , sent email requesting info about footprint and if not included could they let me know so I could purchase one on same order , no reply recieved , postage wasn’t fast and i was sent a PIN number for dpd and wasn’t able to be in to take delivery , with PIN number driver wont leave with neighbour as oper instructions letter on front door . Basically poor communication from  seller

records.title: Collect in store not as straightforward as it could have been.
records.text: I like LD mountain centre and have purcased quite a few items over the years. The staff are always friendly and happy to help. This was the first order that I placed online and the score of 3 stars is in relation to that experience - I would rate the in store shopping experience as 5 stars.I placed the order online, and selected the option to collect from store. After payment had gone through i received this instruction "For collect in store orders please await confirmation email that your order is ready for collection. "The next day i received an email that said "This is confirmation that order (I have deleted) has now been dispatched for deliveryIf your tracking number ends in 'GB' your order has been shipped with Royal Mail. If your tracking number is a string of numbers only, your order has shipped with DPD."As I had selected store collection I wondered whu i received this, and if it should have saifd the order was ready for collection. I waited a few days and did not receive the collection email so i contacted the customer service team via email to chase the order. I received a reply very quickly that said that the goods were in the store and ready to collect. If the emails that are sent are part of an automation, then I think that a modification needs to be made for Collect in store orders. The order confirmation email says that an email will be sent advising when its ready to collect. Getting the same email as a delivery customer is confusing and a small change to the process will avoid any issues in future.This will not put me off shopping with LD, iI am sure it is just a minor blip in an otherwise excellent shopping experience.

records.title: Wrong item received
records.text: Wrong item received, poor communication from them until I wrote a bad review on here. Just had a email from them to say they are sending correct item out. Upgraded my review to 3 stars

records.title: Disappointing & Poor Service
records.text: Disappointing. Over the course of 3 days I attempted on multiple occasions to contact both the online team and the shop for advice on a product but the connection rang out on every occasion! I finally placed the order on the 7th but was not despatched until the 12th December so the product review request arrived before the products did! Unfortunately my faith in their description was not justified and I will have to return 2 of 3 items (the ones I wanted to query) at additional expense to me. In future if I cannot speak with anyone about a product I will not be buying from them (especially when I have to pay for P&P on a £100 order).

records.title: Product good but high volume of many emails
records.text: Product good and as described. Delivery was fairly slow but within period stated. Packaging adequate. The volume of marketing emails even after trying to unsubscribe is off putting and creates a negative experience of the brand.

records.title: They diden’t send the order until I…
records.text: They diden’t send the order until I emailed them and asked why we diden’t receive any tracking number three weeks after order. Did answer the email after a couple of days and item was sent the same day. Product as described. Ordering jackets for colder weather and expecting the shipping to be a bit slow added to not contacting them earlier and to the dissapointment.

records.title: Am I ever going to receive my order?
records.text: Placed order for a travel bag at a competitive price on 29th November and paid £5.99 for tracked delivery, which was due to be between 3rd-5th Dec. On 3rd Dec I received a tracking number and a message saying that the item had been despatched to Royal Mail for their 24 hour delivery service. Since then the tracking has not updated and item has not been received, so I am now dubious as to whether it is actually in stock and will ever be sent?? I have tried phoning customer services but (as other reviews have said) you just get a recorded message telling you to email them then the line goes dead! I just want to know if/when I will get my bag which is urgently required or whether to try and cancel order and start again with another supplier. I will not use this company again.

records.title: Awful returns process
records.text: I ordered the coat in two sizes to ensure the right fit . When it was time to return one coat I was told it was not free returns and should be organised myself . Despite this being present on the returns policy I don’t think they make this clear enough when purchasing. I have returned the coat today via Royal Mail and due to the price of the coat it cost £13.50 to return.  Better to stick with main supplier with better returns policy. Will not use company again

records.title: Stock online is not representative of…
records.text: Stock online is not representative of in store - wanted to try shoes on and size wasn’t in store, was advised to order online and ‘just come back tomorrow’. No apologies given. Then ordered online for next day delivery as needed quickly for a trip - received email stating out of stock then email stating has been dispatched. Tried to ring to ask what was going on - only able to contact via email. Eventual reply was to ignore automatic dispatch email. Ordered from elsewhere with no issues - excellent product but poor customer service from LD.

records.title: Ordered lace version of climbing shoes…
records.text: Ordered lace version of climbing shoes but received velcro which I could've ordered from bananafingers - cheaper and faster (but they had no lace in stock).Delivery takes ~5 days so I didn't bother with return since I need climbing shoes for regular training

records.title: Let you order stock that is not available.
records.text: I ordered & paid for 2 icebreaker tops, the 2nd I really only ordered to get free postage. Shortly afterwards I received notification that there had been a stock error and the 1st top was not available. I had to go to another provider who supplied an identical top with free postage. Had LD Mountain centre kept accurate records, I would not have made the purchase in the first time.

records.title: Inaccurate Pricing on Website
records.text: The LD Mountain Centre website were advertising a pair of Hanwag Tatra 2 GTX hiking boots for £147.44 plus p&p. I completed all the required online purchase details but when placing the order the price suddenly changed to £211.99 plus p&p. I contacted the store who agreed that it "does appear to be strange and we are unsure why this is the case ... unfortunately, we are unable to change this as all pricing is set through our systems". They did offer free postage (£4.99) but that is little comfort when for no apparent reason the price between basket and checkout has inexplicably increased by £64.55. In summary a poor level of customer service and one frustrated shopper!

records.title: Avoid this company
records.text: As others below, avoid this company. I placed an order, 18 days later I’d heard nothing and then I received an email saying they hadn’t managed to get my order. It seems they advertise products they do not have available to sell at the time of advertising.On the plus side, to be fair, they refunded me quickly following their email.

description: Co-founded by Adam Goldenberg, Don Ressler, & Ginger Ressler in 2013, Fabletics is a global active-lifestyle brand designed with everyone in mind. It’s the ultimate destination for the world’s best women's and men's lifewear and activewear. With millions of five-star-rated styles, ranging in sizes from XXS to 4X and inseams from short to long, there’s something for everybody—and every workout, no matter how you choose to sweat!

records.title: Xmas sale
records.text: Been buying from Fabletics for a while now, always great quality products and good value for money.Me and my partner are definitely converts to the brand.

records.title: This website was really easy to…
records.text: This website was really easy to navigate but I would have preferred the option to add additional information or a note regarding delivery

records.title: Highly recommend
records.text: High quality products which are decently priced when you opt to be a VIP member. Highly recommend.

records.title: I love Fabletics their material style…
records.text: I love Fabletics their material style …. It’s like perfect to enhance my body features and well being Can’t get enough of these clothing

records.title: Brilliant website now lets see how the…
records.text: Brilliant website now lets see how the product is very easy to use

records.title: Thank you for a great customer service
records.text: Thank you for a great customer service. This year due to my twins birth I’ve have been struggling to spend or skip my members credits a few times and Fabletics customer service has kindly helped me to get my credits back. Always very fast and professional! As far as I remember the leggings are amazing, just ordered my next and can’t wait to see them.

records.title: So easy to order.
records.text: It's always easy to find something great on the site, using member credits or paying for your order, both are so simple. There are great offers and it's easy to find exactly what you need.

records.title: Great experience
records.text: So easy to contact. Made an order it came quickly returned some things and got money back, was able to cancel membership with no issue.

records.title: Easy to navigate the website
records.text: Easy to navigate the website. Fantastic  offer and free delivery!

records.title: Easy ordering
records.text: Easy ordering, the best quality leggings around EVER! Wouldn’t wear any other brand, colour stays true with no fading, keeps you pulled in and comfy all day, no see through and great range of styles and colours.  Loads of other stuff to choose from too.  Well worth being a VIP member.  FABULOUS FABletics

records.title: Great outfits, but check your billing address to order!
records.text: These products are amazing - the wash brilliantly, are comfortable when working out, and with the bundles work out great value. I haven't brought another brand since signing up. BUT - their app is awful, despite raising it over and over again I have to contact their customer services every time I want to order something. Thankfully it's on WhatsApp but, to place a simple order comes up with a billing error - despite the customer service team setting my address correctly! Please fix it Fabletics - ironically your own systems are stopping me spending more money with you... :)

records.title: Great brand. Glitch with app that needs fixing
records.text: Always easy to use and find what I want. Would be better if you had more stock in the larger sizes XL up.Do always have a problem with app when it comes to pay. It asks me to check the billing address every time and won't fix. End up going to website to process the order which gets a little annoying and stressful.

records.title: I ❤️ FABLETICS!!
records.text: Good quality stylish sports clothes and they always fit really well, and they are very comfortable, great customer service too.I rarely have any issues with my purchases, if I do it's quickly resolved.The only criticism is that they can be a little expensive, but they are good quality and wash well.

records.title: Easy informative website and class…
records.text: Easy informative website and class products however really frustrating that I couldn't find where to put EXTRA10 code and almost gave up ... i will email or phone asap On checking next day I see that discount was applied automatically

records.title: Great products, convoluted pricing structure
records.text: I really love the products. Eg One short and One pant are fantastic. Decreet branding on them which i love so I have several pairs of both. Delivery was fast and seemless. Definitely take advantage of their introductory discount offer.The only downside is the bizarre pricing structure and so called "VIP membership". Quite odd and feels like they're counting on you to forget to cancel in time sothey can debit &£50.However it is easy to cancel, IF you remember to!

records.title: Quality activewear with quick postage
records.text: Signed up again after moving countries, so am used to skipping the subscription each month. My order arrived very quickly, but the satchel was almost fully opened at the perforated line. Luckily nothing was missing! Maybe look at reinforcing the satchels? Besides that, everything was great quality. First time trying the Motion365+ fabric in the leggings and they feel great!

records.title: I personally love the legs from…
records.text: I personally love the legs from fabletics.  I would definitely check the activity use for lettings as some are better than others.  If you're using the the gym or running like me then make sure you're checking the material. Took a star off as I think the 'VIP' monthly option is unfair.  I have ended my subscription as I often forgot to skip.

records.title: Really good quality but the signing up…
records.text: Really good quality but the signing up is a bit of a con with the company hoping you forget to press skip each month to keep a revenue stream.  Something I’m not comfortable with so as soon as I purchased my daughters leggings I cancelled immediately.  Do that and you have 2 pairs of quality leggings.  I’m guessing if she needs more I’ll just sign up again with a different email then cancel straight away again just for the deal.

records.title: Fabletics is Fab
records.text: Fabletics is Fab!!! However, due to experiencing (on numerous occasions), stock being low or out of stock, is why I'm giving one less star.Other than that I have no issues with Fabletics. The brand is satisfying in styles, colours, looks, sizes etc

records.title: Happy customer
records.text: I have been a member now for several years, I have set up a reminder on my calendar for each month to skip the month which I have only forgotten to do once. I love the products, I am a very different size top and bottom so the fact that outfits can be different sizes is great for me. My only criticism is that if stock is low, you can go right through to checkout and it won't accept payment but doesn't tell you why. I have had occasion to use customer service once and found them very helpful and eager to resolve any issue. As a larger lady, it is great that I can buy supportive gym wear and enjoy wearing it. I have never paid full price for any item and find mostly I can get my gym wear in the sale or as a bundle! I would have given 5* had it not been for the issue with low stocks of items and the checkout.

records.title: Great product/complex pricing structure
records.text: Product quality is excellent, but the pricing structure, VIP membership and benefits is complex to negotiate and can be misleading.For example if you want to use your VIP points for money off - the price reverts to non-VIP price so, say an item is £74 standard and £59 VIP your £30 discount offers you the item at £44 not the expected £29. Also you must be careful not to apply a VIP credit to an item than costs less than you paid for the credit. It's unfortunate because it makes you feel like the company is trying to catch you out. I stick with them because the kit is great - but more transparency would be welcome.

records.title: I always come back
records.text: Great deals and I absolutely love Fabletics products but I had real trouble trying to enter my delivery address as the site would not accept my postcode. Some of best products are always out of stock as well.Having said that, they’re the only brand I just keep coming back to.

records.title: Great leggings
records.text: Great leggings, I wear them everyday. Really comfortable. They are obviously popular because there aren’t always enough stock of the most popular items. Would like to see more patterns.

records.title: Best Mens Joggers , hands down !
records.text: I bought some Mens Joggers , they are the best joggers I have ever worn4 stars because my Wife ordered some Leggins but was nothing specialI think the material they use for men is exceptionally comfortable . I bought 2 more

records.title: Love the clothing
records.text: Love the clothing. Washes well, good fit and the option for long in most leggings is practical. Remember to skip the month if you do not want your card debited or wish to make a purchase. My only gripe would be that offers are often limited. Today’s offer was 50% off one item. I tried to purchase this along with a couple of sale items and as I result it was charging me full price for my first item. The app is terribly slow and you cannot view everything. Stick to the web page. Overall I have had good experiences. Just read the small print and check your bag before you pay.

records.title: Great gear with something new every month
records.text: I love the fabletics range of sports clothes, high quality, long lasting and very fashionable. The shopping experience is very good, maybe a little too inviting to choose more than I really need though!

records.title: Repeat billing address problems
records.text: Web site is fine for ordering, however I always seem to have problems at checkout, keeps on asking for billing address and its not straightforward to see where this is updated or confirmed.

records.title: 2020 member
records.text: I have been a member since 2020 and love the designs and pay monthly and skip option. You get store credit for returns but very difficult to use when there is no store near by and you can't seem to use them online

records.title: my new workout leggings…
records.text: Cannot wait for my new workout leggings to come , I have found it quite difficult to find good quality leggings for the larger person that also have pockets for mobile phone headphones etc . What is dubious of trying this company as didn’t think they would be suitable to me due to my size. I must admit when I first went on the website did think it was a bit annoying to put in all my details inBut once I did, I realised why you asked those questions, so when you click on items that you like they automatically come in a model of matching size.so you can see as close as possible how this would look on you i think it’s amazing and lots of other companies should do this cannot wait to try my new leggings out, And thank you again. I know the quality is going to be better than the ones I’m using at the moment so I don’t think I’m going to have any complaints.

records.title: Best leggings I’ve owned and I’ve owned…
records.text: Best leggings I’ve owned and I’ve owned a lot! I wear Fabletics leggings for every day wear because they are so comfy.

records.title: Tried many different leggings always end up back with Fabletics
records.text: just coming back to you after being disappointed the last time I tried the power hold leggings .. I am still wearing powerhold ones from at least 6/7 years ago and hoping I am just as happy with this order .. definitely the best leggings ever

records.title: Decent on quality; not-so-decent on user experience
records.text: I do like the quality of the items, so I continue to buy. However, the website can be confusing and often freezes or crashes, making the buying experience quite unpleasant at times. Also, sizing information could be clearer. For example, they offer "tall" options states to be fit for individuals 5'7" and over; yet, it is never specified whether the display models in this height range are wearing tall or regular-fit items, making length hard to guess. Trial and error is necessary.

Leggings are good, thick enough not to show everything. Definitely reduced in quality over time as don't last as long and I'd never buy at the £86 RRP, but they're decent none the less and my lack of confidence has got me in a "routine comfortable" choke hold with them🤣Always delivered on time. My only issue is with the VIP membership. Not the fact you get charged £50+ a month because you can skip it and it's easy enough to do. But, when you forget i just don't feel like you get your moneys worth. There's no option to spend half a credit when buying a cheaper item, so you have to either fork out the over £50 member credit on a cheaper item or spend money on top of it. There's continuously "new member deals" which way outweigh any benefits of being a member already. You also can't apply a credit and "top up" with cash for a more expensive item, nor spend 2 credits on a single item. I do like the way the clothes are advertised. They show several different sized models in a true light which is reflective of how these may look on the average human.Customer service is so-so. Nothing to write home about but have solved a few of the past queries.I think all said and done, if I was to find other bottoms I was comfortable wearing out and about, I'd jump ship.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: The new member offer enticed me in but then wouldn't allow me to purchase 2 pairs each of the leggings and kick flares I wanted. There was no mention of ONLY being allowed 2 pairs!

records.title: Great Customer Service. BUT read the VIP membership
records.text: Be careful when signing up to the VIP membership, I’d misinterpreted the information. You can cancel after each order. I’m now stuck with credit for a product I can’t afford or want. It’s a little sneaky how it’s done, however I’ll be reading things fully, it happens to many just looking on google. I don’t know how I missed it.The customer service staff were excellent and friendly when I rang up to query it though. Products okay but definitely not worth the full prices on the website. One pair of pants bobbling on first wash. Again, refunded with no issues by customer service for that faulty item.

records.title: Giving three stars as myself and my…
records.text: Giving three stars as myself and my partner liked the products the quality is great, however we weren’t aware of signing up to a membership so we both got caught by surprise when we got charged £54.99 each. We both contacted customer service and spoke to Jess who was very pleasant and helpful, she issued a refund for both and cancelled our membership. So overall not a great experience but could’ve been worse reading everyone else’s review. I strongly believe if you want an issue resolved you should be kind and polite to customer service they’re not to blame!

records.title: I dislike the ability of the site to…
records.text: I dislike the ability of the site to return one to the previous items viewed and the multiple  listing of one style in each of its color ways at random points in your listing.

records.title: Really nice products.
records.text: Really nice products. Good pricing. Website is super glitchy. Always having to re enter card info due to a problem always saying the billing address needs entering.

records.title: Not a fan of fabletics
records.text: Not a fan of fabletics - The initial deals might seem good, but the monthly plan is crazy expensive for overpriced gymwear. 1 credit (£54.99) = 1 item, a pair of shorts, leggings, a bra top....just seems weirdly inflated pricing.The website is clunky and super slow to use, not enough detailed images so sometime what you actually receive is a surprise.And when you try and cancel they offer you multiple free months, discounts etc and then rudely cut you off. You can do better elsewhere

records.title: Stock needs improving
records.text: Wish they stocked more of the items they know will go OOS more often. As a tall woman I find that the 'Tall' in their bottoms is almost always OOS, and with no knowledge on when it'll be back in stock it leaves me to search through alternatives in order to make do

records.title: Offers not as great as I first thought
records.text: Offers not as great as I first thought. They offered deals of 2 items for £24 so I believed I could get 4 for £48. Appears you can only have one 'deal' and the remaining are full price. Still heard very positive things and was an amazing price. Looking forward to seeing the quality of the products.

records.title: Billing Address Issue Holds up order
records.text: As a VIP I always have an issue completing my order due to billing address. This is really frustrating as I have to waste time trying Incognito and back and forward trying to re key my address in another part of the website. It's very odd that there doesn't seem to be an issue taking my VIP membership payment. It makes actually ordering and using these credits really difficult. Sometimes the delay in getting help from customer services causes the stuff to then to be out of stock. Three stars represents my opinion of customer experience. Shame - as I love the leggings and shorts. Great fit and holds you in so you look more smooth and toned. I'm just not a fan of the VIP element and website/app (Same issues in app, phone and Mac)

records.title: Clothes are all sold out no matter when…
records.text: Clothes are all sold out no matter when I go on to buy, the app is shocking I always have to log in online in order to order. Clothes are always fantastic quality but hate how the time to skip each month has shortened and price increased

records.title: I love the clothing at Fabletics
records.text: I love the clothing at Fabletics - it's invariably been a good fit and comfortable. However, the payments are a bit clunky sometimes - even if I'm using member credits, it wants a billing address, and I have to re-enter my card details to get it to register the billing address as being the same as my home address. Plus this month I didn't get a reminder email, so have been charged for another member credit that I didn't want.

records.title: The clothes are great but I’ve had…
records.text: The clothes are great but I’ve had issues placing orders on the app that has resulted in various items going out of stock because of the amount of time it took for the issue to be “solved”. After speaking to customer service they advised me in a work around so even though I was then able to place an order the problem isn’t fixed on the app, it’s just a work around which isn’t great.

records.title: Your website is very confusing
records.text: Your website is very confusing, you have several options for the same item, it would be better to have the type of item for example "motion365 with pocket" then you click on for the different colours or lengths, instead of having all options on the list, it gets confusing. :)

records.title: Love bottom, but so disappointing.
records.text: I love the products from Fabletics,specially bottoms, but I am really disappointed about I have credit before and I did not have any information my credits were expired.I feel somewhat scammed in the sense that since they deduct money from your account, at least they could send you the products and not keep the money without telling you that they expire after you don't order anything.I think they should send you that information to your email or by text message, they never told me that if I didn't buy anything, they would keep my money.So disappointing!

records.title: Referral link does not work
records.text: Referral link does not workSite has poor UI experience, slow loading, laggy.

records.title: I bought the leggings in around…
records.text: I bought the leggings in around February but they already seem to have got holes in them considering I have only used for 4-5 months ! Generally , my experience has been good but last time it wasn’t as well as I thought it would’ve been. I was disappointed but I’ve been a loyal customer for long time so I’m hoping this time the order will not disappoint me.

records.title: the app is always very slow & frustrating
records.text: the app is always very slow on all  occasions i have used it.  When using VIP credits to checkout the system insists on a credit card to action the sale and goes to your card for authorisation.the website is flawed when it comes to the check out process.Also, be careful when washing bright colours on the joggers and hoodies  as the garments, will leak colour

records.title: Short vs short ?
records.text: Hello, no chance to Review order. I clicked short, I require short 27 inseam on both. Only being shown on the order confirmation that my second inseam is short ( 30) . Would love you to adjust this before shipping please. And hopefully in the future not have two options for short leg with different sizes.

records.title: Hit and Miss Company
records.text: Really nice quality clothes and I will continue to order however I was charged for the membership which I skipped for the month. I have sent emails, WhatsApp messages and have had no response so hopefully leaving this review someone can get back in touch with me

records.title: Clothes are decent quality but VIP…
records.text: Clothes are decent quality but VIP member model is predatory, if you sign up it'll charge you £55 without any reminder before payment. Pricing on the site is also not great showing items with over the top discounts etc to make them seem like a better deal than they are. Navigation of the site is a bit annoying as well: the filtering options say they're filtering by available size but aren't actually.

records.title: Try to buy as non-member process really annoying
records.text: Found the process really annoying.  Was buying a Christmas present someone else had asked for.  The site wanted me to take a quiz.  It's not for me!It also really kept pushing the VIP Membership. I tried using the "Add to Bag as a Non-Member" button on the merchandise I wanted, but a pop-up asking me to sign up as a VIP stopped me.  I tried 'Continue' but it refused to let me proceed unless I gave my email and password, which looked like it was forcing me to become a VIP.I had to look through all their FAQs until I found out that giving them my information did not mean I agreed to become a VIP, and then I would be able to buy at the Non-Member price. I've rarely had such a confusing and time-consuming experience trying to buy online.If it had been for myself, I would have given up and not bought anything.  It is only because the person wanted this gift that I continued trying.  The 2 star rating is based only on my ordering experience, not the products.  The person who wanted the gift finds the actual products themselves to be good.

records.title: Ditch your VIP membership and you’d be a 5 star company!!
records.text: Really nice leggings which I love, but I hate your VIP membership with a passion - I wish you would scrap it! I would 100% have purchased so much more from you if you just sold like a normal online shop and made your discounted VIP prices your actual prices! Would regularly pay £20-£30 for leggings but £70+ is too much for the products you offer. Cancelled my membership in the end because I got sick of skipping it every month or being stung with a £50 bill if I forgot.

records.title: Great clothing, awful app!
records.text: For over 12 months I have been complaining about the issue within the app that I face every time I try to place an order. I love the brand but it’s frustrating having to fight to buy something every time.

records.title: Unable to process my order straight away
records.text: When checking out i found i had to keep coming back to retry since my order did not process a number of times

records.title: Good quality athletic wear
records.text: Good quality athletic wear, however the subscription model is deceitful and a rip off. You can cancel at “anytime” which is 4 days out of the month and if you miss it your stuck with another non refundable bill and “credit” . The prices for non members are hugely inflated which makes members feeling like they are getting a bargain however in reality it’s still over market value. Sizes are fairly small and stock levels are often crap. Would pass if I were you!

records.title: VIP thing a bit of a rip off
records.text: Signed up to the VIP thing when I bought some leggings in store and really wasn't impressed with any of the stuff on line.  Ended up with 2 credits where I'd forgotten to cancel, so have now spent them on stuff I wasn't really keen on just to get rid of them, and then cancelling the membership.  I liked the idea of being able to change the model to see how it might look on you, but they're all tall, so it's still hard to tell.  Plus they all seem to be pear shaped, and as an apple that doesn't help me.  To be honest the small models look good, and the bigger models looked bigger than me (and I asked others if that's how I looked) even when wearing the correct size, and to be honest that put me off as the photos are not flattering!

records.title: Terrible scam but good products
records.text: Terrible scam but good products. Products received we're great but I was not aware I would be charged for the VIP credits which I don't think I consented to. I also don't believe I consented to having store credit instead of refund. I initiated a chat to talk about this and request a refund for my VIP credits. At this point they made it very clear there was no way I could get a refund and basically that's how they make a bit more money. I really don't think this was very good customer service - it's a shame because I love my new leggings and I definitely would have bought again.

description:
Discount Trainers from Huge Brands
Big names don’t need to come with a big price tag. We have a brilliant selection of well-known brands wanted all over the world. What’s more, all our-most wanted styles are offered for our best value. That way, you can get premium names without breaking the bank.

With decades of experience in the business, our specialist buyers search the whole of the UK and Europe for the best discount trainers deals. Our extensive list of associates and contacts in the trade is the envy of our competitors. When it comes to cheap trainers, we really know our stuff.
100% Authentic Bargain Trainers for the Lowest Prices

records.title: Good value .Took the advice from hot deals to size…
records.text: Took the advice from hot deals to size up one size. Normally size ten but i ordered 11 and they fit perfectly. Appear good quality and great value. . Cant comment on waterproofness yet . But boots are comfortable and look well made. Grip on slippery surfaces is good too. Time will tell re durability and being waterproof. Overall good value for the discounted price.

records.title: well chuffed!
records.text: provided with confirmation email immediately. was kept up to date with progress details. arrived when expected. well packed, item in perfect condition. bargain price, great deal, will deffo use again

records.title: Go for it
records.text: Honestly, I was sceptical at first despite the positive reviews. However, so glad I ordered. Everything was so easy and straightforward. The only thing I can’t comment on is customer service as I’ve not needed to contact them about anything.

records.title: Quality branded shoes at bargain prices
records.text: Have ordered on multiple occasions over few years and every time shoes arrived on time, well packaged & products as described. If you are a bargain hunter then look no further, Express Trainer will not disappoint. Small suggestion- on the website please allow for adding multiple filter options at one go? its bit annoying with page getting refreshed withe each selection and having to do the selection dance again

records.title: Quick delivery and most importantly was…
records.text: Quick delivery and most importantly was the great price I paid for my boxer shorts and the quality was a lot better than I thought

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: Fast delivery - arrived before the due date. Great price on clearance items. I have ordered from this site many times in the past and the service is very good with no issues and good quality products.

records.title: Good service throughout.
records.text: Good service throughout.Good quality goods.No cheap gimmicks or promises.

records.title: I Always go to express trainers for my…
records.text: I Always go to express trainers for my footwear needs I find them great on price and quality delivery is usually within 3 days of ordering so I would recommend express to all

records.title: Excellent Comms fast delivery great…
records.text: Excellent Comms fast delivery great price all good thank you.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service very fast dispatch and delivery quality item at better than the rest prices

records.title: Excellent customer service...
records.text: Although the trainers didn't fit and I had to return them, I have no complaints about this company. The trainers were dispatched promptly and arrived as expected. The return and refund were processed smoothly. I only deducted a star because the customer has to pay for return delivery. I do understand why the company has to do this, but it makes it very difficult to buy trainers online unless you are buying a style you have worn before and know will be suitable for you. I have now bought trainers from a shop, after trying on many pairs. It would have taken me months of buying, returning and paying return delivery fees to find the right ones!

records.title: Good
records.text: The purchase itself went very well and I am very happy about the items. I would advise to the company to have a clear advert when it comes to promotions, if it says plus X discount then all itens should have X discount.

records.title: I purchased 2 pairs of trainers at a…
records.text: I purchased 2 pairs of trainers at a great price during Black Friday. Only thing is when they arrived one pair was the wrong colour. It stated the correct colour on the box but inside the box the trainers were different and not the colour specified. I decided to keep them anyway.

records.title: Great trainers
records.text: Great trainers, only negative was they took 8 days to get here. Excellent value for money. Will use Express Trainers again. Received a very nice reply to this review from Express Trainers explaining that because of the Christmas rush and black Monday offers there were delays with the delivery which I understand. I have used this company a few times and they are excellent.

records.title: Mixed feelings. Great price but did not fit.
records.text: The shoes came very quickly and well packaged. The look well made but when l tried them on, disappointingly they felt thin and fairly tight. I’ve always been a smaller size 5 but a 5.5 or maybe even a 6 would have been a better fit. For the cost of sending them back, l may as well give them away. Lesson learnt. Go to a shop to try before buying.

records.title: Order process  good
records.text: Order process  good. Trainers a little small by usual size and poor design at heel of trainer where there is a joing that rubs on heel, charge to return versus cost of trainers means i will keep and try to sell on. Let down by royal mail delivery (edit) who gave delivery time of 13.32 and at 15.00 changed it to after 13.32. Went on to alter delivery details after waiting in to be told it would now be following day. Was actually delivered around 17.00 as we were on our way out after wasting a day waiting.

records.title: on the small size
records.text: Trainers were on the small size also a bit of damage on the inside left heal had to return but great Trainers

records.title: Size 9 are a bit neat
records.text: Size 9 are a bit neatUpdate from express trainers is welcome (we totally agree with your findings on the sizing and hence we have noted this against the listing as an advisory note to further purchases.)

records.title: Arrived on time, very good value for money
records.text: Arrived on time, very well packaged. Fit was a little larger than expected but shoes are very comfortable.

records.title: All good
records.text: All good, prompt service at a very reasonable price.

records.title: All fine
records.text: All fine. Keeps you informed as well as tracked despatch. Item was new and undamaged on arrival. Royal Mail failed a bit by texting the arrival time band wrong (twice) but that is not this firms fault.

records.title: My purchase
records.text: The purchase I received was very good quality and a reasonable price.delivery was quick pleased with the service I received

records.title: Good
records.text: Delivery and communication was good but they failed to highlight that the product I purchased was extremely narrow fitting. I have another pair of Brooks which are also a standard fitting and they are a much wider fitting. Please do not buy these shoes unless you have narrow feet. If I had purchased through Amazon with no delivery and return fee then I would have returned them immediately

records.title: Good product, geat value and excellent service
records.text: The shoes were exactly as described and really great value. I was impressed with the first pair (PDQ's) and bought another pair in a different colour.In both cases, ordering was simple, tracking was available and they arrived bang on schedule.

records.title: Generally good but no update on returns…
records.text: Generally good but no update on returns had to phone.  It was sizing rather than quality. Kept one of the 3 pairs for work.Processing and delivery pretty good.I already knew the process regards refunds,  thanks that the items need to be checked before refund issued. I remarked,  no email re the refund. There was no confirmation email re this otherwise I would not have phoned for update. But I will take another look in future.

records.title: Excellent value
records.text: Excellent value, quick delivery, great products... Shopping experience on the website can be a bit clunky and the search tool isn't very slick could do with improvement.Added: Thanks for your honest reply, that means a lot as a customer, I will definitely be back.

records.title: Overall not bad
records.text: Overall not bad, fast shipping and good price. I am just not happy with the quality of some of the items. The size didn’t match and the item itself looks very cheaply made. I also got a pair of branded trainers that are fine

records.title: Delivered on time
records.text: Delivered on time, no issues

records.title: Happy first time puchase, will return!
records.text: Good Price with discount code and free delivery. Trainers were as described, perfect for school. Delivery was by Royal Mail, prompt and kept up to date by text. Ordered Friday night received Monday morning. Irder confirmation took a fow hours to come through so don't worry it will come through.Only improvement could be searching on the website, it was difficult to search and filter to find the trainers we wanted.

records.title: Missold
records.text: 20 mm “smudge “ mark on the edge of the sole, it was obviously a fault which occurred during the moulding process of the sole.With this obvious fault these where now seconds and should have been sold as such

records.title: Good/Bad review...!!!
records.text: I ordered a pair of trainers, wrong type of trainer sent, wrong colour and wrong size (black female, size 5 delivered, I ordered white size 9 men's). Yet placed in a box stating size 9 white!Delivered to my neighbours addressed as I asked, but then refused to re-deliver back there!In the meantime, I ordered another 2 pairs of footwear, and Express Trainers would not honour my chosen delivery address for whatever reason! Why ask if we want our delivery to another address then???Customer service by phone was good and quick, shame Express Trainers would not honour the correct delivery address chosen!

records.title: Delivery
records.text: Delivery was not great and arrived late Royal mail. Fit is on the small side and for a waterproof shoe it is slippery in the wet.

records.title: Product details and images were not…
records.text: Product details and images were not very clear unfortunately

records.title: I liked the price and free delivery…
records.text: I liked the price and free delivery however the boots were clearly seconds when I received them which it didn’t say when I purchased them, hence 3 stars.

records.title: I bought these to replace ben sherman…
records.text: I bought these to replace ben sherman trainers that have very disappointinglyi fallen apart. These look nice,but im shocked by how incredibly thin they are( not comfortable. Overall very disappointed 😞"Edit"Apologies to express trainers,as my review was of  Ben Sherman trainers,not the boots. The boots are excellent quality and price.

records.title: Wrong size in correctly labelled box
records.text: Received my delivery of trainers, tried them on to find inside different size to the box label. Problem was rectified but took far too long.

records.title: Long wait
records.text: Good communication through Emails and fast reply however I shouldn’t have had to Email in the first place. Says 5-7 day delivery time. Ordered for a wedding 2 weeks before hand and revived shoes 4 days before. Panic was over but could have done will a bigger size but no time to change.It was a push waiting the 6 days plus weekend and bank holiday. This seemed to be a super long wait!

records.title: Delivery date was 2 days past estimate…
records.text: Delivery date was 2 days past estimate was told it was left in our safe place but no safe place was agreed had to hunt to find them

records.title: Unsure if authentic shoe
records.text: Shoe came in white box, box was badly damaged and has no logo, not an authentic Adidas box, label on shoe also tied to lace with by a brown string. Unsure if true authentic shoe as I've had several of ultra boost 20 shoes that come with authentic Adidas box with labels that are tied to shoe with plastic straps.Update: able to send item back with prompt refund

records.title: Sort of got what I expected
records.text: Sort of got whatI expected. Good looking hiking boots on website, amazingly cheap so decided to take a punt. Boots arrived very quickly and appearance matched up to images on website.Wore boots twice walking my dog in local park, predominantly on tarmac, in dry weather.  White staining appeared around toe area and sides of boots have started to come apart. I will continue to use until they eventually fall apart but wouldn’t trust them on a hike across rugged terrain.OK for price paid which was very cheap but quality poor - sort of what I expected.

records.title: Liked the good communications and…
records.text: Liked the good communications and delivery was great. However, sizing was supposed to be eu 8 but no way was this the case as the trainers were way too tight. As I'm 66 years old and have been wearing the same size shoes for 50 years, I don't think my feet have suddenly grown! Did get a prompt refund, so all good.

records.title: Paying for your mistake
records.text: I did not realise until I had worn the shoes a couple of times, that you had despatched the wrong size.I ordered a size 11 which is clearly stated on my supplied invoice, however the size sent was a 12. It appears that I am out of the time zone allowance for exchange or refund so I'm stuck with them even though it was your mistake.

records.title: All okay but quality of the shoes very…
records.text: All okay but quality of the shoes very poor not comfortable and feet aches Reply to express trainers Also read comments from others online and it looks they were not happy either so I believe you need to improve the quality to resort the true in your brand and may be a good to offer partial or full refund and take the shoes back

records.title: I ordered 2 pairs of shoes for me and…
records.text: I ordered 2 pairs of shoes for me and one for my missus,took correct sizes what we actually have. None of them fitted, 2- too small, 1- too big. Had to send back and reorder taking in account the experience of sizes and choosing what will actually fit. Days went by and there still was no refund nor other order dispatched... had to email customer service, few hrs later the refund was sent out and a reply that they have some stock issues so my other order could not be complete,asked them to send what they can and refund what's not on stock. In half hour order was dispatched and refund issued. Very pleased to say customer service  is doing great job. Not the best experience overall, but I had few orders before,and never had any issues, I like this company. My suggestion would be to add shoe sizes in actual CM as well as EU and UK sizes, some other companies does this, and it's easier for customers to understand what will fit and what will not.

records.title: 2 failed attempted deliveries even…
records.text: 2 failed attempted deliveries even though at home at the time. Boxes arrived battered and torn in a big grey bag with 3 pairs inside.Poor delivery and poor packaging...

records.title: Confusing sizes
records.text: Confusing sizes on Altra trainers made that I had to send them back. Unfortunately Express trainers do not pay the return postage. 😩 won’t take the risk again!

records.title: Great prices but small sizes
records.text: Great prices but small sizes. I'm a 9 but bought a 10 and it's still tight

records.title: Beware of odd sizing
records.text: Website was easy to use, the delivery was quick but I was disappointed with the actual product, I ordered a UK size 5 trainer, but when it arrived. It was too small, so I ordered the next size up, when that pair arrived, they were an even smaller fit, although it is free delivery, you have to pay for returns, thus losing £3.99 each time, I wouldn’t order from this company again because the sizing seemed wrong.

records.title: 5 stars, but for the incessant marketing emails.
records.text: My Vibram soled Karrimore sandals are great and arrived in good time (I ordered when I was in India and they had arrived by the time I returned home). Price was the best I could find for these sandals or similar spec from other brands and suppliers.So why only three stars? Because of the incessant marketing emails after buying from express trainers. It seemed like I unsubscribde from one mailing list, only to receive emails from another. I had to call them to stop.If they would only respect marketing preferences it would be a 5 star. Now hopefully they'll stop asking me for reviews as well!

records.title: Tried to buy a pair of 361 trainers…
records.text: Tried to buy a pair of 361 trainers (via Decathlon) for the second time, ordering UK size 10 both occasions. I’ve been sent UK size 9.5 twice now and are predictably too small. The two stars are for the prompt delivery and fairly straightforward returns policy. Still very disappointing though. *I don’t understand how your invoice showing that I ordered size 10 UK, but being sent 9.5 UK is Decathlon’s fault? If you don’t have the size 10 UK just don’t fulfil the order. I’d rather that than being continually let down and have to go through the rigmarole of sending them back and hoping for a replacement of the actual size I ordered. As for phoning you, there was no phone number on the accompanying invoice that I could see. I would’ve loved to have resolved this over the phone. Supply me with a direct number and I’ll happily call you. This was the only way I could see that I would possibly get a response.

records.title: Stoneport trainers cheap Chinese rubbish
records.text: Express trainers were fine, I returned the trainers for a refund minus my postage. I find it difficult to understand why they sell such a cheap awful trainer like stoneport. I bought these as present for my dad, They were advertised as memory foam and they were far from it. Terrible cheap Chinese trainers. Do not buy no matter how cheap

records.title: The shoes were advertised as a size 12…
records.text: The shoes were advertised as a size 12 but were more like asize 9 to 10. The delivery was fine and return was fine but you need to change suppliers who supply true to size .

records.title: Slow shipping
records.text: It took five days ship these boots even though they told Royal Mail they would be shipped after three days.

records.title: Bad experience - size Issues
records.text: Buying shoes on-line and hoping for a correct fit can be a problem. I've bought from Express Trainers before, fortunately without any problem. However on this occasion, I ordered a size 10 and the boot that arrived was clearly a huge size 12, but marked as a size 10. I placed a size 12 insole inside without any problem and returned the boots with photographic evidence showing just how large the boots were relative to normal size 10 boots. The Companies' response was extremely poor. Simply based on "they are marked as a 10 and so we deal with it as though it is a 10" i.e. your problem, you pay for return postage. Not a lot of money, but a lot of hassle and no customer consideration. For the sake of £3.99 postage I will never buy from this company  again.

records.title: very poor quality boots
records.text: very poor quality boots, suppose you get what you pay for when it's only £18. No need to get offended it's a honest review.

records.title: Definitely not an Amazon experience
records.text: Price very good but definitely not an Amazon experience. One shoe arrived stained and both had clearly been tried on. Returns process was blunt, untrusting and unapologetic, only option was to buy another pair separately from return, but they had sold out.

records.title: Looks like not new
records.text: Shoes arrived with damage box and it's looks like not new, and trainers also look to me not new it's like it was on display when people used it for fitting. Just disappointed. Didn't return because they put a invoice with note what you need to pay for returning label doesn't matter if is not even your fault

records.title: Shoes were different sizes
records.text: Shoes were different sizes, even though the label said they were both size 9, and appeared to have been previously returned. Information in the package stated that they did not accept returns except where goods were faulty, which contravenes the distance selling regs. If both shoes had been size 9 I would have been very happy to keep them at that price.

records.title: Poor returned process
records.text: The sales process went well. I received the trainers fairly quickly. The Hush Puppies trainers were of poor quality and I would certainly not recommend them in future.The returns process is costly to the customer and yields with it a long process before a refund is offered yet alone made.I would not recommend eXPress trainers for this very reason.
