records.title: 5 STARS ***** for Outdoor GB for…
records.text: 5 STARS ***** for Outdoor GB for customer service, price and delivery. I had a query about my order, which was corrected, and the reply was friendly, quick and professional. One issue that has nothing to do with Outdoor GB but is a pet hate of mine was the delivery driver leaving the parcel on the doorstep when it was 🌂 when there's a black parcel storage box 3ft away.

records.title: Very competitive price in flash sale
records.text: Very competitive price in flash sale. Quick dispatch by the company but thanks to Royal Mail messed around on delivery. Genuinely surprised anyone is still using RM, so disinterested and unreliable now. The raincoat is excellent, generous length and sizing really good. Many thanks, very pleased, well done Outdoor GB.

records.title: Great service and product
records.text: Ordered two kupilka 21 cups, there was a minor problem with availability for one of the cups, the response from the firm in finding a suitable replacement was outstanding. Very impressed with service and product.

records.title: Very quick response to my live chat…
records.text: Very quick response to my live chat followed by swift confirmation of refund having been processes and email to confirm. Well done. Great Service 😊

records.title: First class service
records.text: First time using OutdoorGB and had a query on my order placed between Christmas and New Year which was resolved really quickly. Thank you!

records.title: The only shop you need
records.text: I have ordered a few items from here, besides the prices being better than any other retailer the speed of the delivery is second to none.Exchanging sizes or returns dealt with smoothly and never an issue.This is my go to place now for hiking gear.

records.title: Excellent service, great jacket
records.text: Excellent service, kept informed of delivery date, received the item I wanted which is an excellent lightweight warm waterproof jacket. Great fit and really keeps you warm even though it isn’t particularly thick.

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: Products & website were great. Most of our order arrived perfectly but we had an issue with the courier delivering the main item. Customer service was great, resolving the issue, keeping us informed & pulling out all the stops to get the item re-delivered in time for Christmas. Thank you to the team!

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service, boot received quickly and at a great price. Brilliant boots.

records.title: Great coat at a great price
records.text: Arrived in 2 days. Saving 20% on the price advertised on the official site enticed me into finally replacing my 10 year old Berghaus.  Great coat, wearing both the fleece and rain coat is probably better suited to Greenland than the UK. The rain coat is a great fit.

records.title: Good large size
records.text: I haven't used my life jacket yet but it looks sturdy and well made, most important for me is it fits over my survival suit coat. In a survival suit you may not go under which means a self inflator may not inflate, so this will do the job I can keep warm and afloat.

records.title: Arrived quickly
records.text: Arrived quickly and shoes as described. Only downside is the £3.95 postage cost to return the item.

records.title: Regatta Leather walking boots
records.text: I bought a pair of Regatta Leather walking boots which were a very good price for the quality of the boots. On top of that, the after sales support I received from Outdoor GB was excellent, resolving the issue to my satisfaction, very quick with their communication throughout.Now enjoying the miles in a robust pair of boots.

records.title: New to Go Outdoors
records.text: New to Go Outdoors, but got some Christmas shopping done. Some good brands on special offer - I was after some Bridgedale socks and found a good selection.Also bought a hoodie but lost a star as there wasn’t any environmental info about this garment - probably my bad for not making a more informed choice!

records.title: I ordered on 11th December
records.text: I ordered on 11th December, the order arrived very quickly, 13th December which was great, but it was damaged, there was very inadequate packaging which meant that the beautiful Klean Kanteen flask was dented and scratched, which is a shame. I contacted the company immediately and they answered a phone (great that there was a telephone contact, the person was very professional and helpful) they got me to send photos of the damaged and further photos of the packaging and then they sent me free returns label. I have posted the goods back the next day and I opted to have a replacement sent, but now it’s 21.December and I have not received it or any further information. So I have no idea if and when I would receive the replacement! It was going to be a Christmas present. Not a big deal, but just a bit annoying.Update: the new replacement did arrive on Xmas eve, so just in time. This time no damage, but still wrapped in bubble wrap and plastic bag, but luckily was not dented. I did receive an email update when it was on the way.

records.title: Good prices
records.text: Good prices, but when I signed up to the newsletter to get a discount it only counted on orders over £50, which wasn't super clear when I signed up

records.title: Interaction spoilt by Amazon delivery driver.
records.text: A great price for a top of the range product. Faulty delivery caused by Amazon driver who could be bothered to go the extra distance and lied, saying I had declined to accept the item. I ever saw the driver.

records.title: Ordered 4 items from Extreme GB
records.text: Ordered 4 items from Extreme GB. The cycling gloves were out of stock, but this was immediately refunded as no other suitable replacement available. Goggles, Ear plugs and overtrousers were delivered as described. Pretty much cheaper here than anywhere else. Apart from the lack of stock excellent service

records.title: The jacket I ordered arrived when it…
records.text: The jacket I ordered arrived when it was supposed to.The information I received via email was helpful, and my delivery arrived in good condition.The jacket was too small and the return/replace procedure was fine until I encountered the Royal Mail site.The customer service dept sorted it out in the end and I was able to complete the rerturn easily.

records.title: Good ordering experience
records.text: Ordering is quite a simple process and delivery time is good, even though I’d seen otherwise on other reports. Even when the item was not in stock it only delayed it by 24 hrs.The jacket I ordered was very good quality and much cheaper than I could get elsewhere. The fleece however was a little lightweight and felt cheap even though it wasn’t.

records.title: Great products-slow delivery!
records.text: The jackets I ordered were exactly as described and the price was a lot cheaper than other suppliers. The only downside was the length of time from order to delivery which was 10 working days and this was rather disappointing. I had to phone to check if the goods had been dispatched.

records.title: Website easy to navigate & order…
records.text: Website easy to navigate & order delivered promptly.  Had to return a couple of branded items as sizing was not quite right (nothing to do with OutdoorGB) and was hugely impressed how easy it was - my regular postman picked up the parcel from my house, bought the label with him and I was kept informed about the parcel's journey back to OutdoorGB.

records.title: Easy website and ordering- Confirmation…
records.text: Easy website and ordering- Confirmation e mail received swiftly however sadly there was no update on delayed delivery- after using the chat function i found it was due to 1 item being out of stock. This was quickly rectified and my other 2 items were shipped the same day, however it may have been better to have updated me and let me have the choice to receive the 2 in stock items soon as no communications regarding this was received.

records.title: Satisfied Customer
records.text: I recently bought a pair of Craghoppers Kiwi Classic trousers from this company. The trousers arrived on time and well packaged in recyclable material. I was able to source what I wanted, unlike with other companies. This was my first purchase from this company. I was completely satisfied and will not hesitate to use them for any future purchase

records.title: Yet another purchase
records.text: Several purchases from OutdoorGB and have never been disappointed. Competitive prices and good service, email, on line chat or landlines.Always helpful.Why would you not use this company? If there is a down side its Royal Mail who are not always that good. 48 hour delivery quite often 72+.

records.title: Service and price from Outdoor GB is…
records.text: Service and price from Outdoor GB is first class as ever.JacketPros - fabric appears substantial, good quality and although Ive only worn it in showers, seems waterproof. Good fit all round.Cons- has only two pockets. An internal pocket should be standard.

records.title: Good value but
records.text: Good valuePrompt delivery.  Unfortunately they didn't fit and had to be returned. I had to pay £3.95 for the privilege which was a pain, (I'd misread the returns policy.)

records.title: First time I have bought from OutdoorGB…
records.text: First time I have bought from OutdoorGB and it will not be the last. Great products and good prices. The communication could have been better so let’s hope the next time it will spot on then I will give them five stars. Highly recommended.

records.title: Very quick delivery
records.text: Very quick delivery, great value. Although you have to pay for postage to exchange items.

records.title: Recommended
records.text: Easy to navigate site, great prices, quick delivery

records.title: Delivery method : Royal Mail inadequate
records.text: The items sent by GB Outdoors are usually brilliant, but using Royal Mail is a disaster. They refuse to leave things when I am not in and insist on collection at their depot which only opens 8am to 10am most days. I work long hours so I am neither there to meet them nor available to attend the depot between 8am and 10am. It will prevent me using GB Outdoors in future as I still have not managed to collect this latest order some 3 days after it arrived..

records.title: Confused old fart
records.text: Great delivery,  as usual,  however I had to return these shoes as too big. There was a pdf attached to the email which had the address on so I assumed that was what I needed as a return label.  It wasn't and there was something else to click. Only complaint is that maybe you shouldn't attach unnecessary pdfs which will just confuse old parts like me😃. Ordinarily I would rate this company at 4or5 out of 5, this is my only gripe.

records.title: Disappointed …
records.text: Bought a BRANT headband as a CHRISTMAS gift but I’m disappointed that the label is sewn through all fabrics making the stitching visible on the right side.   Just hoping it’s returnable after Christmas!!!

records.title: FedEx not great
records.text: Great website but still not had my delivery due to fedex and only delivering on weekdays.  The parcel is small and would fit through my letterbox but it’s not left.  FedEx website you can’t change delivery choices so no idea what will happen to my goods

records.title: Goods not yet arrived
records.text: I ordered on the 7th November and my items have not arrived yet. I have had no e mail update other than the order confirmation . I e mailed yesterday morning to chase but have only received an auto reply. Could you confirm when my items will be received please - Order number was 1909248 UPDATE_ This has now partly arrived- Please see further review submitted today

records.title: T-rex arms
records.text: The item was delivered super fast. The item was packaged well. The width of the item was OK however the arms were made for a t-rex. They were short and provided no cover when you move. Very disappointed with the item as it was one size so you would assume it was going to be proportionate for the width.

records.title: Delayed delivery
records.text: Item was excellent, price was reasonable. Delivery charge and it still took over 10 days and I had to get in touch to chase up. Not impressed with no communication and charging for delivery when it took 2 weeks. Reply to OutdoorGB Order -OGB12531670 it stated 3-5 working days for delivery.

records.title: Slow delivery excellent customer service
records.text: Customer service was great especially Jersey and Charlotte.Unfortunately coat was delayed by a month in arriving due to supplier. So only 3 stars because of that. Outdoor themselves as a company were great and I am sure they had no control over their supplier. However due to the wait time and uncertainty of when it would arrive and outdoor unable to give a timeframe it’s 3 stars. 5 star service and website and product though!

records.title: The jacket is great but found the order…
records.text: The jacket is great but found the order arrangement and delivery very slow. Took 5 days for the order just to be dispatched. Outdoor is competing with Amazon and the like who do next day so I hope they review their dispatch policy. Very good customer service for enquires.

records.title: My first order with OutdoorGB wrong item sent
records.text: My first order with OutdoorGB. Item arrived in a couple of days but not the colour I ordered. Strangely the label on the jacket also didn’t match the colour of the jacket received, so two errors in one order. The colour was actually ok and I chose to keep the jacket. I messaged customer service to advise them of their error, I got a short note back to apologise.

records.title: I was advised coat would be del.on a…
records.text: I was advised coat would be del.on a Monday.  I was away for weekend so that was fine. However Amazon tried to del. On Sun and said I had refused del. And they returned it to supplier.  I phoned on Mon to advise what had happened and was told it woujd be sent out again once they received it.  This did not happen and I was advised later in week I would have to pay for del. If I wanted coat.  They were adamant I had to pay again so very reluctantly I agreed. Coat was subsequently del. By Royal Mail with no problems.

records.title: Decent company. Worthy of your trust
records.text: Had to return the XXL printable softshell jackets as not quite enough room on hips - fitted OK everywhere else. The mens XXL was enormous but loved the green colour.Returned Items using Royal Mail - reasonable cost surprisingly.  Received full reimbursement within OutdoorGB time limit.  Worked without hassle.Decent company - have purchased a Jack Wolfskin from them some years back.

records.title: Okay, but website needs some improvements
records.text: No major issues with the customer service, but they really need to show stock availability better on the website. Even a low stock warning would be helpful. The website is pretty shonky and not fully dynamic, so some elements dont work correctly for mobile. The category tree is dreadful and not logical. A better, more up to date website would improve the customer experience no end

records.title: Delayed delivery
records.text: The order took a week to get dispatched and delivered ten days after ordering!This is the first time so I am afraid you are going downhill!! As you asked for the tracking number: here it is OF316892051GBThanks

records.title: Underwhelmed
records.text: I felt delivery was a bit of a worry. Took longer than the 6-12 days it said when I ordered. Not Royal Mail, so can't blame strikes. I also felt annoyed at having to pay postage on a coat costing over £175 - for some reason excluded from free p&p advertised on website...Also realised, after ordering, price wasn't that competitive 😬 Could have got at least £30 cheaper.End of the day, it arrived in time for Christmas and looks as advertised 👍 Hopefully recipient will be pleased

records.title: From ordering the item
records.text: From ordering the item, Order took a few weeks to be delivered.  I normally love everything Berghaus but wore my new coat for first time today, and it’s described as being all weather. Clearly this is not the case as I was soaked through after going walking and caught in a downpour.

records.title: Customer service could improve
records.text: Ordered a pair of shoes that were delivered promptly. I noticed that the price had dropped by £8 while they were in transit!!I asked them if they could refund or credit this, but they refused.  They did say that I could return them and then reorder!! As long as I paid the shipping. Customer service needs to be a bit more customer friendly.

records.title: advertise unavailable stock
records.text: Decent price but advertise stock they don't have. Comms are slow and they use the small print to excuse the lack of information on order progress. Not customer focused. Delivery took a couple of weeks from order. Luckily not an issue as these walking shoes were a spare pair. Not great if you need them quickly. I'll pay a bit more for quality service and probably won't use again.

records.title: Service from OutdoorGB was good
records.text: Service from OutdoorGB was good, easy ordering and decent delivery.  However, the product (Berghaus ladies fleece jacket) is not great; the material is shedding its pile in areas like where the car seat belt crosses the shoulder.  I don't expect it to last long!

records.title: I'm really disappointed in this…
records.text: I'm really disappointed in this purchase. I wanted a pair of waterproof walking boots. I got a pair of comfortable "dry" weather boots !. They cannot cope with wet long grass . My feet and walking socks get soaked. I thought they came waterproof. Even giving them the benefit of the doubt, I tried high quality waterproof spray, this didn't work either !!!

records.title: Returning unwanted items
records.text: Returning unwanted items . I’ve just returned a Musto jacket for a refund as the item is so big and bulky. They have just sent me a email to say they are sending a smaller size which I don’t want! I’ve found trying to download return forms and label for packages stress full as I’m not great with computers. This company is not making it easy to return items!!!

records.title: I received someone else's order so I…
records.text: I received someone else's order so I saw the other customers personal details, likely someone has my order and my personal details. They are looking into this, have now received my re-sent order promptly.

records.title: don't pay for fast delivery
records.text: Paid for 1 day delivery!  A jokeitems were delivered 4 days later and left on front doorstep of the WRONG HOUSE half a mile away ..wrong postcode and that householder was away.  The goods themselves are fine

records.title: Still waiting for it to arrive.
records.text: Ordering was easy, however still not received the goods, delivered by Amazon, told me a day earlier than it was supposed to be delivered, so wasn’t in. Amazon said they would try and redeliver and still haven’t, can’t login to Amazon with the supplied tracking number.

records.title: Don’t pay extra for postage
records.text: Paid the £7 extra postage for quicker deliver and it took  a week to arrive. Disappointed.

records.title: Not a great experience sadly.
records.text: Sadly my experience with OutdoorGB was not a good one. I tried to purchase something online multiple times with different cards, creating an account etc and the payment simply would not go through. The sales team didn't seem interested in taking my order via email so sadly had no choice but to look elsewhere.

records.title: Poor quality coat
records.text: Poor quality coat, stiching awful on inside pockets. Was offered exchange but already worn before I noticed.OGB12538460

records.title: Silva Map Measurer Path
records.text: Just received a Silva Map Measurer Path which is not fit for purpose.Distance measurement stalls as you move the device along the map.This appears to be because the two black plastic halves of the device are not fully mated together allowing the tracking wheel gear to disengage during tracking.

records.title: Ordered men’s jacket on line
records.text: Ordered men’s jacket on line. Payment was taken. Next day got an email to say it was oos would not be delivered until November. Was available in other colours but more expensive. Disappointed. Good email communication though.

records.title: Hasn't arrived yet!
records.text: Hasn't arrived yet, found out later that Royal Mail had lost my parcel. OutdoorGB have been very helpful and are sending out a replacement.*****

description:
We are a family run business with a young creative team, striving to create a refreshing online-only brand. SwissTimepieces was formed in the North West of England in June 2017 and since launch we have gained many loyal clients, received 5* reviews and grown exponentially. The company was formed by two close friends, whom offer a personable service to each and every client, ensuring you find the perfect item at a competitive price. Our entire team is dedicated to achieving the highest standards of quality and care, hoping to exceed your expectations in every way.

Our company passion driven, we aim to provide luxury pieces which capture the most cherished moments in our lives; from the dream Watch you have worked so hard to achieve, an Engagement ring to create the perfect proposal or Wedding rings to form an everlasting relationship. We take pride in our offerings and hope you find our service exceeds your expectations.

SwissTimepieces is an UK registered company under company no. 10812930. We are also regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and our FCA registration is 817334.

records.title: Stress free watch sale !
records.text: I was skeptical to send my watch to any jeweller to sell, I bit the bullet and chose Swisstimepieces. Besides the watch taking a while to sell which is out of control, the process was easy and stress free! Kept updated through every step, watch collected from home address and money returned very quick in accordance to their system. Can’t fault.

records.title: Exceptional service and very easy to…
records.text: Exceptional service and very easy to deal with. Helped me purchase my dream watch and delivered exactly as promised. Really recommend them highly.

records.title: I have given 5* as the whole process…
records.text: I have given 5* as the whole process was seamless. Correspondence was answered immediately and politely. It was a speedy sale of watch and payment transfer completed after cooling off period. I freely recommend this professional business.

records.title: Forget eBay use Swiss Timepieces
records.text: After weeks of hassle and time wasters trying to sell my watch on eBay I decided to see who could help me sell it, and Swiss Timepieces came up trumps, my watch sold within a week, completely hassle free and I received my payment after fourteen days, superb service, I would recommend them to anyone!

records.title: First Class!! Visited today for the first time and…
records.text: Visited today for the first time and bought a GMT Rootbeer, the watch was perfect and the service that George and Kieran provided was just as good. So knowledgeable and enthusiastic, if I’d have sat there all day all these guys want to do is talk watches - love it guys.Thank you and I’m a future customer for sure. Hope your move to Kendal is successful Graham

records.title: Absolutely five star from start to…
records.text: Absolutely five star from start to finish got way more money than i was offered by any other company will definitely be using again and recommending to anyone that needs to sell a watch! thank you very much Sam and the teamMark

records.title: Good people to know - very focused on the customer
records.text: The guys are very knowledgeable and professional and tuned in client service. They found the rare watch I was seeking and  discovered them to be very honest and straightforward in dealing with them throughout the transaction process.

records.title: I recently traded in my Rolex Datejust
records.text: I recently traded in my Rolex Datejust. I am delighted with my new Rolex. I was well looked after throughout the process which was carried out speedily and efficiently. I will no doubt be back in the future and to be honest I would have no hesitation recommending Swiss Timepieces.

records.title: Good price for watch with excellent service
records.text: Good value watch delivered promptly as promised. Excellent service from individual I spoke to on phone. Delivered well packaged with full documentation. First time user of service not disappointed

records.title: Great service
records.text: I would like to thank Sam and his wonderful team of professionals for the great experience in selling my timepiece.I found SwissTimepieces through Facebook and I am so glad I decided to use their services. I was particularly impressed with the service levels by the team at SwissTimepieces. I look forward to using their services again in the future. Highly recommended.

records.title: Happy with this company
records.text: Very clear up front with service these guy provide.Took around 3 months to sell but it sold which is the main thing. I had to reduce a little below the asking price but nothing massive.I still made more than selling via a company that pays you before the watch is sold, all depends if you need the money or not.I would use these again for selling watches.

records.title: super simple - everything to plan
records.text: wanted to part ex a watch to buy something else.watch was appraised amount agreed, everything went to plan, watch found a new owner within 3 weeks money received as informed. Super simple.Would use again no doubt

records.title: Omega
records.text: Purchased an Omega via the web shop. Transaction was smooth and watch arrived 3 days later which is fine but was advertised as free next day delivery. The watch its self is immaculate and as advertised. All in all a positive experience, only suggestion I have is that maybe a phone call to confirm the order would have gone a long way, especially when you are parting with such large sums of money.

records.title: Fantastic watch in great condition well…
records.text: Fantastic watch in great condition well packaged with full set  and arrived very promptly.  Only issue was I had emailed to ask to collect from store, which hadn’t been relayed properly, leading to some concern as I was on holiday when watch delivered and was worried about its safekeeping.  However was offered £100 compensation.  Overall a good service but I would make “collect from store” something that is specified in the online sales process.

records.title: Very good but could be better
records.text: Quick and easy process, higher quote than anyone else to sell a Rolex. Fast pick up, everything moves quick right at the beginning. Only problem is while it is up for sale there’s no communication at all so you are left in limbo a bit. There should be update process every week via email or something so you are not left wondering what’s going on. Once sold there’s a 14 day wait until you get paid out. Very good service if you are willing to wait and ship your watch off.

records.title: Online valuation
records.text: Bought the online valuation. The email asking for information about the watch didn't come through so I had to chase them and they could reply to my emails but not send a new one to me; don't know what that was about. Once sorted, I received the valuation very quickly. Generally very happy with the service.

records.title: Honest Consumer Experience: Don't do business with swisstimepieces.co.uk unless you want to waste your time and money
records.text: Honest Consumer Experience: Don't do business with swisstimepieces.co.uk unless you want to waste your time and money I am writing this because you should know my experience in dealing with  SwissTimepieces.co.uk, which had an add for a Longines Flagship Heritage Stainless Steel Automatic Mens Watch L47954782 posted on Chrono 24 (the site doesn't sell any products, sellers sell through the site - think ebay). The add was first posted in Octomber on Chrono24. The seller claimed to have the above mentioned watch, and offered fast delivery to my country.I contacted SwissTimepieces.co.uk directly about the watch add. We agreed on the details and the seller sent me a Paypal link to make the transaction. I made the payment for a Longines watch, for 995 british pounds, which the seller claimed to have on sale, in October 2017.After the seller confirmed the payment, the seller said the item would be delivered in 14 days. After some follow-up e-mails, the seller, in an e-mail on the 6th of November 2017, provided a second estimated date for delivery, 4 weeks from then. This delivery date also expired and still no item delivery (not even an estimate date).After some e-mails exchanged, the seller then provided December 2017 as a definitive delivery date. Finally, now very late December, the seller estimates (I highly emphasize "estimates") maybe January 2018 for a delivery date.This is unacceptable behaivour from an authorized English seller of Swiss watches, and for any company. 5 changed delivery dates, and this only after some serious e-mail correspondence from the buyer, is just unacceptable. I have waited a very long time for the item, which has caused me stress and anxiety. I would have never agreed to a "possible" January 2018 delivery, back when I made this transaction, in October 2017.The seller, SwissTimepieces.co.uk, posted the same add in December on Chrono24, claiming to deliver the watch to potential buyers in a few days. When I confronted the swisstimepieces.co.uk about this, they blamed Chrono24 for automated messages or delivery dates calculated automatically. I asked SwissTimepieces.co.uk to call me to talk about these issues. They told me they don't have a phone plan outside the UK. This was a big red flag for me, what business can't afford to call their customers? I just payed them more than a thousand euros. They claim to sell premium Swiss watches. But I digress. I gave the guy the benefit of the doubt, and told the seller I would call him, provided they give me a number to call.This was the second red flag, since SwissTimepieces.co.uk answered back that they don't have a phone line (!!!) and that they do all their "business" by appointement or throught online means.  It was obvious then, for me at least, that I wasn't dealing with a serious seller, who has 1200+ Euros of my hard earned money, and without an estimate on delivery 3 months after I made the order and the payment.I asked SwissTimepieces.co.uk to give me a refund the next day. No answer. So I put the request through Paypal, it escalated to a dispute and the case was forcibly decided in my favor, by Paylpal, and I finally got my money back in January 2018.After this incident, I went through another seller, used Chrono24 Trusted Checkout (which SwissTimepieces.co.uk did not use at that time), and was very pleased with the end result.In conclusion, don't do business with swisstimepieces.co.uk unless you want to waste your time and moneyUPDATE - in regards to the above review I would also like to add the following.Just an few minutes after posting said review,  swisstimepieces.co.uk sent me an e-mail, threating me personaly, asking to remove the review or else they will use my personal data, and call my employer (!), etc. even mentioning the phrase "Do not call my bluff". Of course, my employer, if I have one, has nothing to do with this, if I had any business transaction with said company, it was in my capacity as a consumer. Also, I didn't mention my email in the review, but apparently, they also have no problem in sending me personal messages or threating to call my employer. Wow. I don't think they know if I am employed or not, or who is this supposed employer of mine, but clearly I gave them no such data.I think this is a clear breach of any code of proffesional etiquette.Please take this opportunity to consider doing business with this strictly online "business" .Thank you for reading

description:
Lily Arkwright is an award winning luxury jeweller with showrooms in London & Manchester offering free insured global shipping. We offer the very best quality diamonds and gemstones including lab grown diamond, moissanite & coloured gemstone engagement rings in addition to our stunning jewellery collections.

At Lily Arkwright our mission is to cultivate a sustainable, compassionate and transparent jewellery industry. So you can feel amazing about the jewellery you wear without compromising on quality. We aim to provide a real choice for our clients and have helped tens of thousands of couples find the perfect engagement ring and wedding bands.

Our commitment to excellence is equally matched by our commitment to you, one that’s built on honesty and integrity. We go above and beyond to provide a service level which many retailers simply can’t match and are rated as one of the best companies on Trustpilot.

We understand the importance and significance when purchasing bridal jewellery and only work with the very best quality gemstones and materials. Our lab diamonds are all fully certified and we’re proud Chatham coloured gemstone and Charles & Colvard Moissanite authorised retailers.

Our vibrant collections showcase the most exciting Lily Arkwright jewellery designs and latest bridal fashion, crafted here in the UK. Each and every piece is tested and hallmarked ensuring you receive British craftsmanship and unrivalled quality at an exceptional price point.

records.title: Thank you Lily Arkwright…
records.text: I can’t recommend Lily Arkwright enough. As I was purchasing the engagement ring for my (now) fiancé, I was concerned I was a little out of my depth. Thankfully, from the minute I arrived at the consultation, I was immediately put at ease and taken through all the options available - we discussed in great detail the ring style, band and stone setting.The ring arrived within 10 days and I couldn’t be happier with it.

records.title: Lily Arkwright is a diamond in the rough.
records.text: Lily Arkwright have been great on both occasions. No I did not decide to review two engagements but I did buy a ring set and had to cancel. They were understanding and happy to help. When I ordered again months later they made sure to have my order delivered in time for travels my partner and I had planned. The ring is amazing and exactly what I wanted for her, she has been very excited to wear it and was also super happy I had gone with Lab diamond. You really could never tell the difference if not for the authenticity certificate you receive with it. Excellent service and brilliant craftsmanship. Highly recommend.

records.title: Simply the best
records.text: Honestly, I cannot thank the staff at Lily Arkwright enough for what they did for me. Due to how everything fell into place for me personally, I didn't have a lot of time to get a ring sorted ahead of a last minute holiday booking with my partner, so when the order confirmation came through and said the ring would be ready three weeks after we'd returned, I feared the worst. I rang up and was greeted by a lovely lady named Renai, who is the Senior Jewellery Consultant at Lily Arkwright and she basically moved mountains for me to make sure I could get the ring I wanted sorted before I flew out - which she duly managed. The level of care she provided was off the scale and I cannot thank her enough for what she did. It felt like she took it upon herself personally to fix the situation and it's something I'm so grateful for. The ring arrived a few days before we flew in a totally inconspicuous package and thanks to Renai and the staff at Lily Arkwright, me and my now fiancé were able to have a truly magical moment that we'll remember for the rest of our lives. For those intrigued by the quality of the ring itself, it's astounding. The ring is absolutely beautiful and was a perfect fit, too. I cannot recommend the company - or their staff - highly enough.

records.title: Amazing staff and products.
records.text: I went to the Manchester showroom with my now fiance to chose a ring. The salesperson was amazing and helpful. She went through multiple options to find the perfect ring. When I went to pick it up, I was running late, but they stayed open late for me to collect it. I can't recommend them enough.

records.title: Bespoke Design Package
records.text: My partner and I chose to design our engagement ring using the Bespoke Design Package. While we are happy with the finished ring, there were some aspects of the design service that could be improved upon. We were quite apprehensive about ordering a ring online, and not being able to see the final design before purchase. This was one of the reasons why we decided to go with Lily Arkwright as we liked the idea of having a prototype ring to try on. We did find the design process to be a little inflexible and while we could tweak our design numerous times, we weren't able to make significant modifications to our design (we asked to see our setting without the side stones and were told this wasn't possible as this would be going in a different design direction). The renders were also not overly realistic and we were told the setting and band would appear a lot 'chunkier' in the visuals than in real life. The prototype was also only of the band and setting so it wasn't possible to get a good idea of what the ring would look like when the stones were in place. We were not sent any photos of the finished ring prior to it being posted to us. Unfortunately, once we received the ring we noticed that the band differed from the final design we had agreed upon. We alerted customer service to this issue and were able to post the ring back to be altered. While the customer support team handled this matter efficiently, this delay meant my partner had to postpone his planned proposal.

records.title: Some quality control improvements…
records.text: Some quality control improvements needed. I received what I think was Finnies last omega speedmaster (they have now gone their separate ways). I spoke to Jason to talk about the delivery and taking out links, so I was pleased about the customer service from that point of view. I received the watch and there was a small fly in the ointment - there was scratches to the case back. Considering I got this at a discount and Finnies wouldn’t be able to exchange as it was their last, I kind of accepted this. After being reminded to leave a review, I called up Finnies to voice my frustrations. As mentioned, I wasn’t specifically asking for anything as there was no way to fix it as it wasn’t possible to get an exchange but was disappointed that the watch left their shop with scratches on the case back of what was described as a new (from their safe) watch and not a display item. I was informed that the watch went through a rigorous inspection process (scratches on the case back was missed..) and the person then apologised for the situation.

records.title: Customer service can do better about customer satisfaction.
records.text: I bought an expensive Omega special edition watch for my brother as a gift - he is a Bond fan and likes collecting. I expected the basic items to come with the watch, namely the watch's hang tag with its serial number on it. When I was told I was not getting one, I insisted on it. I was told that Finnies don't keep hang tags and their policy is to not give them out. While I disagree with this having checked with Omega (Swatch Group) colleagues who have all confirmed that the AD should give the customer the hang tag and that the AD does not have any reason to withhold it. I do understand that it is Finnies' policy not to include the tag (although unsure why). When I further insisted on this and expressed my disappointment, I was told that I can return the watch if I like. I was disappointed. However,  I must appreciate Jason from Finnies whose quality of service and helpful attitude has compensated for this. Finnies has been a well-established family-owned business in Aberdeen, and has gained popularity in the UK. It would be nicer if they would warn the customer about what they are walking away with, BEFORE the purchase, so that the customer's expectation is managed. Trust is a delicate thing. Both Finnies and the end-customer can work together to build and benefit from a long-lasting relationship. A little bit of goodwill can go a long way in these tough economic times. Thank you, Finnies for the great watch and gift wrap. They would have got six stars if they would take a little more care about the small things that can make a big difference to the end-consumer. Just my thoughts.

records.title: Really disappointed with my experience…
records.text: Really disappointed with my experience this time with Finnies. Went in to replace a lost pearl earring which my partner had given me 2yrs previously. Initially I walked out with a single earring which was what I wanted however on my second wear two weeks after purchase the pearl came away from the stem. I went in and dealt with Amy who was fantastic and awaited her phone call on the best cause of action. She gave me several options (replace, repair or refund), as I really loved my original earrings wanted the replace option. I went in again to pick up my replacement to be told by a different person that that was not an option and the earring would need to be sent away and repaired under warranty. I was also told i needed to be careful with how i treat them to prevent breakage. Reluctantly I accepted this the repair.  3 weeks later I recieved a message asking me to call finnies to be advised of the repair costs. By this time I was incredibly frustrated and angry as the earring was supposed to be repaired free of charge. After speaking to Finnies over the phone, I recieved a call back to apologise as the wrong information had been given and the earring was repaired and I should go in to view. I was told if I wasn't happy with the repair that I could either choose a replacement or get a refund. When I went in I was told the earring hadn't been repaired and I could choose a replacement. At no point was I told there would I have to pay extra. I said to the lady i wanted the same as what i previously had as i really loved them. After selecting she advised me the full cost of a pair, after a short discussion she then advised I would have to pay the difference between buying the initial replacement pearl earring and the new pair. As I was incredibly annoyed with 4 trips into Finnies with my two children in toe, having to pay for parking each time and dealing with 7 different people I paid the difference and left. I didn't need another pair as I still had one, which Finnies had as they were going to match the repair against it and if it had of been my intention to buy a replacement pair I would of done this on my first trip in and saved myself all the hassle. At least Finnies managed to get another sale however that will be the last one from us.

description:
We make astonishingly comfortable shoes that quite simply look amazing. 



After 20 years creating footwear ranges for international brands, our founder Claire became increasingly frustrated with the idea that comfort and style couldn't exist.

Nine years on and we're now a small but mighty team of specialists, putting our heart and sole into every shoe we create.

Style and comfort are key - all of our shoes, boots and sandals have layers of high-performance memory and recovery foams built in.

We're passionate about responsible manufacturing. Our materials are sourced from accredited suppliers who operate to the highest standards, and manufacturing our shoes in Europe means fewer miles to travel.

We’re also fierce advocates of slow fashion and believe great design is seasonless. The cycle of endless discounting and throwaway fashion has a huge impact on our planet, that’s why our philosophy is 'buy fewer, choose better'.
 A philosophy that means enduring quality is built into every shoe we design, so that you’ll love to wear your favourite pair, again and again.
