records.title: Nice shoes I bought in outlet  sale  but…
records.text: Nice shoes I bought in outlet sale  but send in terrible packaging . Bit disappointed considering I still paid quite a bit of money

records.title: Slightly disappointed
records.text: Ordering and delivery fineFinish on the buckles is shocking for the price Sandals feel comfy but will test when I wear them

records.title: Disappointing Quality
records.text: Have owned a pair of silver coloured Talia for less than a month. They are very comfortable but the silver colour has already rubbed off on the side of the shoe. Been buying similar shoes from Birkenstock and FitFlop for years and this has never happened. I complained to Air & Grace who suggested I buy silver coloured paint to cover the mark on my shoes! Thanks Guys - Not what I expected from a relatively expensive pair of shoes. Won't be buying from you again.

records.title: I ordered the loafers and whilst the…
records.text: I ordered the loafers and whilst the delivery was great and the loafers look nice and feel really soft, they were no where near to fitting! I’m always a size 8 and rarely, if at all have to order a different size. Whilst there are larger sizes available, I’ve found an alternative elsewhere. So a point to consider when ordering is to size up. This may have been mentioned in the info but if it was, I didn’t pick up on it.

records.title: Love the look of these trainers and…
records.text: Love the look of these trainers and they are very comfortable but they really don’t last very well. I’ve had 2 pairs now and for both of them, within a year the sole is very worn and stitching at the bend of the shoe coming away. For the price I’d expect them to last far longer, they’re being worn alongside 2 other pairs of trainers which are still going strong. Wouldn’t buy them again purely based on short life span.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Disappointed - the reviews were all great so ordered my first pair of shoes, some trainers. They look great & feel soft to touch but sadly now have 3 blisters after 2 days of wearing. Not what I was expecting from a quite expensive pair of trainers ☹️

records.title: Blisters and pain, not a fairytale
records.text: Given up after they pestered me on insta for months, and treated myself to a pair of cru trainers. When I tried them they were not the most comfortable but not uncomfortable either. The size was right and soft leather gave a big promise. Three weeks of wear and I’ve still got terrible blisters like I’ve not had in a long time. They are generally uncomfortable and I don’t look forward to putting them on every day. Should have read the reviews here first!

records.title: Uncomfortable & blisters
records.text: So after all the hype I gave in and brought a pair of SADIE trainers and as beautiful as they are, I had to remove them after 3 hours, now I have blisters on both feet. They are not that comfortable.I brought into the promise of "comfort and walking on air" and for £189 that is definitely not the case.I'll stick with sole bliss, far more comfortable

records.title: Shoes didn’t fit well- first time it…
records.text: Shoes didn’t fit well- first time it happened.  The sandals were just too wide and long and the fastening wasn’t very secure feeling.  Not your best design..  but I appreciated the fast return arrangements.

records.title: Not made for walking!
records.text: I really love how these trainers look and feel but after having them for 4 months there is a hole where the sole has worn down. I sent them to customer service to have a look and was told it was due to excessive wear… I’ve literally been doing the school run there and back in them. I wouldn’t expect a cheap pair of trainers to wear like this and certainly not ones I paid £160 for! I can’t even get the sole repaired as it’s all part of the shoe, so all in all I’ve learnt an expensive lesson. If you’re buying a pair of these trainers then make sure you’re not walking too much in them (which kind of defeats the purpose right?!). Terrible quality for this to happen.

records.title: I am a size 6 so ordered a 6
records.text: I am a size 6 so ordered a 6. However they are too big and as they were sale item I can’t return or exchange them. So stuck with a pair of lovely trainers I can’t wear.

records.title: These sandals are just ok… big and…
records.text: These sandals are just ok… big and cumbersome not what I expected…

description: The original Belfast watch company. Worn by great people all over the world.

records.title: A watch for all seasons!
records.text: This is my 5th watch from Hans and his wonderful team. Personal service and support is second to none, and the range of available models ensures I have a watch for every occasion. Thanks Enoksen, and good luck with the new venture!

records.title: A beautifully crafted watch at an…
records.text: A beautifully crafted watch at an amazing price. Wanted my army number engraving on the case back so rang Hans the owner of the company. He was very accommodating and pleasant. Great communication and service. Highly recommended.

records.title: Fantastic experience !!
records.text: Oliver was fantastic to deal with and also has managed to source me another watch I really wanted from the Enoksen range. Highly recommend this company for a beautiful timepiece and excellent customer service

records.title: Mid- century perfection!
records.text: Outstanding- a new design very different from the rest of the Enoksen range, but a superb, elegant watch and extremely wearable.  Of course it also has Enoksen’s great service behind it.

records.title: Amazing quality watch
records.text: Great personal touch, meeting Hans, choosing the watch, communication on when the watch would be ready and the quality of the watch is second to none, love the watch. Many thanks

records.title: Nice looking watch
records.text: Nice looking watch. Ordering process couldn’t be easier and pretty fast delivery. Have worn it every day since and looks/feels like a qualitative watch. It’s my second watch (own a deep dive) from Enoksen and probably not my last…so yes I can recommend

records.title: Love these watches
records.text: Love the watches from Hans (this is my 3rd). It was despatched quickly and arrived not long after. Lovely personal note from Hans in the box too.

records.title: Milanese Bracelet
records.text: Excellent service as usual from Hans and the Enoksen team and the bracelet with the new style clasp is very nice and of exceptional quality.

records.title: Great customer service as always.
records.text: I've purchased several Enoksen watches previously with always great customer service. I had to return a watch and received an instant refund from Hans - thank you. Superb customer service as always - hope to buy again from you soon!

records.title: Watch is excellent.
records.text: Watch is excellent. Strap is, perhaps, a little too long but an alternative is provided free. Not only a hundred quid off the cost but, astonishingly, the watch arrived the day after I ordered it! I now have two Enoksen watches and I love ‘em both.

records.title: This watch is incredible for the money
records.text: This watch is incredible for the money, it really is. I have only had it for a couple of days but the time-keeping seems very good. My one small complaint was that there was a miscommunication regarding my wrist size, so the watch was went out with a full-size strap, rather then one already reduced in size. So I had to sort this out myself. Other than that, my experience with Enoksen, as usual, was very good.

records.title: This website is a true gem
records.text: This website is a true gem. The items are beautifully curated and perfect for finding unique gifts. The customer service was also excellent. I'll definitely be shopping here again.

records.title: Fast delivery, nice watch
records.text: Fast delivery, watch as advertised. Nice product. Second I buy from Enoksen, will keep buying if they produce new models

records.title: Great company
records.text: Great company: good product, kind people, excellent service.What else?

records.title: Great watch
records.text: Great watch ! Really nice looking and quality perception

records.title: Very happy with my Deep Dive
records.text: I'd thought about getting an Enoksen Deep Dive for a while and the Black Friday discount code made it a no-brainer. There was a minor mix-up with the shipping, but it was still with me within the week and comms were great.The watch is exactly what I wanted and I like the total absence of branding. It's a good-looking, functional and robust watch at a very good price compared to competitors. It comes with two straps and a tool for swapping them, and the lume on the dial and bezel is exceptional.

records.title: Solid and well built
records.text: I bought the Dive E02/C (blue dial) with black leather strap.  Service was great and very fast.  I'm happy with the watch and the nato straps go well with it too.  The rotating bezel has a good solid feel to it and the body feels solid and weighty.  The only criticism I have is that the lume is not as impressive as my Seiko SKX. But still, it deserves it's place in my collection.

records.title: Watch E02/A
records.text: Watch E02/AWatch arrived very quickly ( less than 24 hours ) . Good design and good quality. Diameter is ok but it is quite thick. I do have a Tudor watch and less expensive others , it compares favourably with all but the Tudor as one would expect. All things considered it is good value. So why only 4 stars ? It arrived with a very minor flaw in the casing which given the cost of the watch I decided was acceptable. Additionally because the watch wears quite tall on the wrist ( being on a NATO strap adds to this ) it is likely to suffer some scrapes anyway.

records.title: Nice watch
records.text: Nice watch. Seems to keep good time. Luminosity is a bit questionable, and a bit of glare of the glass but overall good first impression and comfortable to wear!

records.title: Very nice watch (the dive E02/A)
records.text: Very nice watch (the dive E02/A). Good value for money and great service. A little bit chunky, and I did not like the straps. The overall style is just right, and with a set of new straps, it looks great.

records.title: Great service and quick delivery
records.text: Great service and quick delivery. Love the watch...wears a little smaller on the wrist than I anticipated but I have paired it with a thick leather  strap. It is most handsome.

records.title: Great customer experience.
records.text: Excellent buying experience with prompt delivery. I was dealt with by Mr Enoksen himself when buying a Deep Dive E01/C - the personal touch, advice and information was first class. The watch itself is great, and there are 3 straps provided with it, 2 of them being the NATO style. Personally though, unfortunately I don’t like any of the nylon webbing straps provided, they cheapen the look of the watch. And I know from personal experience they last about 5 minutes before becoming shabby, frayed and grubby looking. The NATO straps are particularly bad - they’re ugly, cumbersome and overly complicated - can anyone explain the point to them? But anyway, don’t let my bias spoil what is actually a lovely watch, coupled with first class service from Enoksen. I’d certainly have given 5 stars, but for the straps.

records.title: Great product
records.text: Great product. Quiet quick delivery but non information about it. All straps aren't NATO's ones. Box is not very attracting. But, in conclusion, watch is great.

records.title: Love the watch
records.text: Love the watch. Strap broke but was replaced without any probs. Nearly 5 stars

records.title: Quick delivery and a good product only…
records.text: Quick delivery and a good product only longevity to see this go to 5 stars

records.title: The watch world's hidden secret.
records.text: Quick service. Thoughtful packaging.Beautiful watch.

records.title: Service is good products as usual…
records.text: Service is good products as usual perfect

records.title: Good value
records.text: Good value ! Friendly and honest service

records.title: Fast and ackurate
records.text: Fast and ackurate! In time!

records.title: Fantastic watch but lacking quality control
records.text: I bought the "Fly EO3/E". The quality control of the products is somewhat lacking. The first watch I received had a white piece of dust inside it which was very eye catching. The leather strap broke after just being worn for just an hour. That being said, they sent me a new watch and strap immediately. Unfortunately the watch I received also had a flaw. The reflection on the hour hand was irregular. Like there was some kind of stain on it. Nevertheless they accepted the complaint and replaced the hands. In the end I have to say I'm very pleased with the watch. It looks really good. It ran at about +12s per day but after a quick calibration I got it to run at +/- 1s. Some edges on the watch are a bit sharp, it isn't visible when worn though. The level of finishing is good for the price point. In a perfect world I would also like it to be a mm or two thinner. The leather strap looks great but is a little stiff, for some reason it turned black after a while. Maybe because I bathed in salt water with it.Customer service is 5/5 but the quality control is unfortunately only 2/5 making the whole experience a 3/5. If I would have received the watch I have now from te start, I would give it a 5/5 review.

records.title: I am delighted, a query was not responded to so don’t know how that happened?
records.text: I am delighted with the quality of the product but they did not respond to a query I put to them through the website,  concerning fitting the metal strap.

records.title: the watch seem a good product but the…
records.text: the watch seem a good product but the straps are very cheap

records.title: the watches are good but the warranty…
records.text: the watches are good but the warranty service is very bad

records.title: I wouldn't recommend
records.text: Watch was OK.  Returned it as it wasn't OK enough.  Despite the website offering free returns, they had to be prompted to give the details.  Then they claimed that the courier could not collect.  Huh?  It managed to drop it off OK!  Then they took FOREVER to actually process the refund.  Overall, I couldn't recommend them.  I had to wait a long time to be able to post this, as I figured I'd never get my money back after posting a less than glowing review.

records.title: Update.
records.text: I now regret my previous review.  I bought my watch 18 months ago and reviewed it too soon!  The strap has now failed.  It is a dive watch, with a stainless steel strap and a security clasp to prevent the strap from accidentally opening and the watch coming off.  The security clasp has broken and the strap is no longer secure.  The clasp is beautifully engraved with the enoksen name, yet on contacting Enoksen, they tell me that the strap isn't considered part of the watch and they don't guarantee them - even though they proudly stamp their name on it.  So beware, what you might consider to be a watch is actually only part of the watch. Straps aren't included and there is no goodwill from Enoksen.  If I could submit a photo I would, its a small part but critical.  Update.  I have been asked to remove a member of staff's name, so I have.  The company has been in touch subsequently but the damage is done - it doesn't help when they tell me that the item seems to be damaged and that is probably the cause of the failure.  It is not damaged in any way.  I will respond to them, but I have other priorities that I have to deal with.  The whole thing leaves a sour taste.

description: William Wood Watches create British luxury watches made from upcycled firefighting materials in dedication to the Founders late grandfather Willliam Wood, a distinguished British firefighter. Featured in Forbes, GQ, Esquire and The Sunday Times this award winning brand is known for their uniqueness and authenticity with a donation from each sale going to International Firefighting charities.

records.title: The customer service is unmatched
records.text: The customer service is unmatched. My husband is a firefighter and when he first discovered the company he fell in love with their collection. I knew I had to get him one. I was worried about making such a large purchase and having it delivered overseas so I sent a message to customer service asking for further information on the process and safety of my purchase. The founder and owner Jonny Garrett personally responded to answer my questions and then asked me more about the watch I had selected and the occasion of it. When he learned more about the story behind my purchase he thanked my husband for his service and congratulated him on his accomplishments. He even included a complimentary band to make the gift extra special. My husband loves his watch and we both absolutely love this company. We will definitely make more purchases in the future.

records.title: Customer service is next level
records.text: Customer service is next level. I had an issue with the strap on my Valiant watch. The Duraline hose had cracks which had opened up and looked very unsightly. My watch was coming up on 2 years old at this point. My point of contacting was merely to inform them of the issue and allow them to be aware of it. The customer advisor was very apologetic requested my email address and sent me through a discounted voucher for a replacement. I really wasn't expecting that. A fantastic customer service experience for a fantastic brand.

records.title: My partner Kevin was a firefighter
records.text: My partner Kevin was a firefighter, we've been together for 3 years.I asked him what he wanted for Christmas this year, he said a watch.Knowing he was a firefighter I done some research and found William Wood watches. I'm so glad I did.... its such a beautiful watch. I can't wait for Kevin to see it Christmas morning. The packaging was absolutely beautiful too.I would definitely recommend William Wood watches for anyone looking for a watch that's extra special Thank you William Wood Watches

records.title: It is a beautiful watch of exceptional…
records.text: It is a beautiful watch of exceptional quality, and the presentation was perfect!  I look forward to showing my fellow firefighters the design and history of producing the watch and information about your company.

records.title: William Wood Chivalrous watch
records.text: Watch was delivered in timescale expected. Was made aware when watch had been dispatched. This my third William Wood watch and as always it looks stunning and is a quality timepiece. William Wood really do make great watches and I would highly recommend them.

records.title: My experience with William Wood Watches…
records.text: My experience with William Wood Watches was very memorable.  The staff and owner Johnny Garrett provided the most personal customer experience from start to finish.  The watch I ordered is everything I expected and then some. The presentation and packaging of the watch was simply gorgeous and first class.   Thank you I know my son will love his gift

records.title: Stunning in Sapphire (Bronze)
records.text: The website, the reply to a query I sent prior to purchase in itself, reflected the "family" feel to this watch brand. Everything from the box and roll that my bronze (Sapphire) arrived in was full of nice touches like documentation about your watch, that is normally just available on a website. A nod to a heritage feel. As per the watch itself, I have Longines and Omega watches that this watch is equal to in finish. It's simply stunning!

records.title: SIMPLY THE BEST
records.text: Yet again the William Wood team have excelled themselves. The Racing Green Chivalrous has style, it has elegance and it has a story to tell. The service is second to none, as indeed is the presentation. It simply doesn't get better than this.

records.title: Awesome company!
records.text: Tom has been incredibly helpful in assisting me with securing a beautiful watch for my husband for the holidays. I received the Triumph Fuel watch yesterday and aside from how absolutely beautiful the watch is the packaging is next level. I cannot wait to surprise my husband with this piece. I would absolutely recommend William Wood to anyone looking for a great watch! Thanks again Tom!

records.title: The Valiant watch is absolutely beautiful
records.text: The watch is absolutely beautiful, it has surpassed our expectations. It really is both an amazing  work of art with exceptional workmanship. The presentation box is  impressive and luxurious, which is fitting for such a high quality watch.Our son will treasure this for all his life.

records.title: The delivery time is a little long…
records.text: The delivery time is a little long after full payment made, it is like William Wood use the customers money to fund their purchasing department up front long before the assembly work starts. It may be the model for many small companies, but I don't pay for many products in this way, I don't pay the for food and wait for the farmer to plant the crop.

records.title: Viewed the website several times before…
records.text: Viewed the website several times before deciding to purchase .  Johnny was great in chatting me through options and explaining things , and how the company had come about .  The order was swiftly despatched and arrived safely . I was extremely impressed with both the watch and its case .  As I live in france I just wish he had mentioned the ' import duty ' which would be due , but to his credit when I  mentioned this to him , he swiftly offered to pay it .

records.title: Nice watch that some of us preferred…
records.text: Nice watch that some of us preferred for our fire department centennial. Looks good.

records.title: I ordered the watch and paid in full…
records.text: I ordered the watch and paid in full with the order, it still took many months for the watch to arrive, due to supply chain issues they said, but happy to keep hold of my cash…When the watch finally arrived it is nice an supplied in a nice case.

records.title: Beautiful watches
records.text: Beautiful watches, I'm very impressed! perfect watch ❤️ I love it so much.

records.title: I was blown away by the quality of the…
records.text: I was blown away by the quality of the product and the customer service I received. The team was amazing and I was thoroughly impressed.

records.title: Love the watch But....
records.text: Love the watch.  Two of my 4 sons are firefighters....but let's be honest. For the price you pay, it shouldhave a much better movement.

records.title: Beautiful watches
records.text: Beautiful watches! The designs are exquisite and the craftsmanship is top-notch.

records.title: Ssid a date to delivery and it was done
records.text: Ssid a date to delivery and it was doneGreat  service

records.title: My experience with William wood was…Delightful
records.text: My experience with William wood was very good I received my bronze watch quickly and it is very nice it is even starting to patina nicely. The watch is great and keeps good time I keep it in a watch winder so it is always ready to wear. The nice three watch case that came with the watch is great for traveling and the smooth comfortable straps have a quick change system that works great.

records.title: Your Service
records.text: Your Service: Considering the investment, I'd have preferred a slightly more frequent update as to how the Watch (and all its brothers and sisters) were doing through the manufacturing process. Few more pictures and descriptions perhaps even interviews or comments from the artisans creating the Watches. Other than that, the Watch was delivered slightly early - fantastic - and Jonny responded in person when I asked any questions. Thank-you.

records.title: I bought my husband one of these
records.text: I bought my husband one of these, the one with the fuel  face as he is a petrol head. I wanted something which was excellent quality but not at a ridiculous price and this fitted the bill. He is very happy with it, even showing it off to his friends so that is a good sign. Thanks.

records.title: Just ordered my first William Wood…
records.text: Just ordered my first William Wood watch and I’m looking forward to receiving it in September. I thought the website was well laid out and informative, I had to resolve a couple of issues and they were dealt with quickly by email. Very impressed so far, I’ll consider giving the extra star when I see the watch.

records.title: Simple, yet sophisticated
records.text: I am really happy to have William Wood Valiant in my collection. This watch is a true class. Design is simple, but with that vintage touch to it. It is simple, but with that sophisticated look to it. Definitely one of my favorites in my collection.

records.title: Great Experience With This Site
records.text: Great experience with this site. I love their newsletter because they send beautifully cultured emails showcasing high quality watches and time pieces. They keep me “in the know” about what is trending and also offer great deals.

records.title: I just received the Bronze Special…
records.text: I just received the Bronze Special Edition.  William Wood's presentation is spectacular.  Each layer of presentation was a gift in itself.  The included hard watch "roll" is an especially nice touch.  The watch itself is fantastic, rich finish and wonderful detailing.  I especially like what seems to be a slightly extended length in the crown, a nice touch.My only disappointment was with the band.  I was expecting more of a substantial canvas feel to the band.  It lacks this altogether and is essentially a rubber band.  Even Duluth brand's fire hose clothing seems to give a truer approximation of fire hose material.  Overall, very happy with the purchase.

records.title: Great watch
records.text: Great watch, fine details and smooth movement! Only downside and it’s my personal opinion is I would have liked a slightly larger face, say 45 mm. guess it’s what I’m used to but overall very happy!

records.title: Have a few fellow ex fire officer who…
records.text: Have a few fellow ex fire officer who are very happy with their watches. I am hoping that they will produce a larger model say 46 mm.

records.title: Great purchase
records.text: Great purchase, would make a great gift. The watch more than looks good, it has a story, character. I happily wear this watch.

records.title: Not enough communication on progress…
records.text: Not enough communication on progress until I asked - would be good to get invoice via email when bill is paid

records.title: Fake Limited Edition
records.text: I purchased what was advertised/marketed as a limited edition of 200 of the Bronze Ruby.  Mine is #75. While I love the watch, I now have discovered that the Bronze Ruby is not a limited edition but is freely available to purchase on William Wood’s website.  What has happened to truth in advertising?

records.title: Never purchased anything from them and…
records.text: Never purchased anything from them and only leaving a review as it’s a stipulation of entering a prize draw. Make of that what you will…*Edit* apparently William Wood Watches don’t like it when you call them out for what amounts to bribery for reviews, as within minutes of leaving this, I received a request to remove my comments. On the strength of this, I would not recommend purchasing any timepiece from them. Enjoy your 1 star lads…

description: Our expert team of gemologists at our Canary Wharf office are committed to crafting exquisite engagement rings, wedding rings and fine jewellery to the highest quality, tailored especially for you. From diamond engagement rings and wedding bands, to delicate pendants and diamond earrings, our jewellers meticulously and lovingly hand make each piece to last a lifetime.

records.title: Five Star Experience
records.text: Five Star Experience My wife and I recently visited Decoris for a diamond ring. They sat down with us and explained in detailed what was available and the process of buying a diamond. They explained about lab vs natural and the four C’s. Having explained what we’ve seen at other shops ect they told us that some of the shops hadn’t explained in full as to what we’d be getting. We were impressed with their knowledge and honesty, we placed an order on our first visit and received the ring within 4 weeks. Everything was as expected and actually the ring was very impressive. From start to finish our experience was exceptional and we cannot see ourselves searching for any rings in the future other than with Decoris.

records.title: Customer first
records.text: I am extremely happy with my purchase. The rings are beautiful and exactly how I imagined them. The whole process was easy, better than going Hatton Gardens and overpaying for something less. From my initial consultation about styles and budget, the actual purchasing was done very comfortably and I knew I could buy the rings we wanted within my budget as Decoris always accommodate the customers needs, put the customers best interest first, not the other way round. Thank you to Mursalin Bhai for making this process enjoyable.

records.title: Best Jewellery and Consultations
records.text: Would not recommend any other place for jewellery. The best customer service and excellent expertise. Every consultation was helpful and informative. Our consultant was extremely helpful and was very kind. Our rings were done not only quickly but they were stunning. No other place has this level of beauty in their jewellery as well as brilliant customer service. Thank you Decoris Diamonds for your service. It was the smoothest and most enjoyable process and a pleasure amongst the usual headaches during a wedding process. 5 stars for this amazing company!

records.title: Phenomenal service from Decoris Diamonds
records.text: It was a pleasure dealing with the two brother from Decoris Diamonds. The hospitality during the initial consultation was fantastic, and they spent a lot of time explaining each step of the process. Their honesty and transparency was second to none, and they delivered on all their promises. I would highly recommend them to others due to high quality rings they ended up creating for us, at very competitive prices.

records.title: 10/10 Service!!!!!!
records.text: The service from Mursalin and Decoris Diamonds was 10/10, I could not fault them at all. Especially in comparison to the service you get from Hatton Garden jewellers, the service you get from Decoris is far beyond that! They made the whole process from start to finish super easy and simple for us to understand. The quality of their workmanship is far beyond any other jeweller. The men and woman’s ring even came earlier than expected and yet the standard was far beyond anything we could ever imagine! We will definitely be recommended to all our friends and family and will be visiting in the future!

records.title: Amazing service from Decoris
records.text: Amazing service from Decoris. Went to order my 10 years anniversary ring. I received professional and personal level of service in designing and chosing my ring. Highly recommend using Decoris Diamonds for your special occasions. Very easy and unique experience also had my current jewellery cleaned so bonus points for that. Thank you to the brothers and sister for being helpful and attentive.

records.title: Amazing experience
records.text: We absolutely loved the ring made by Decoris, looks top tier and so surreal. Hospitality had been quite amazing too

records.title: I cannot thank Decoris Diamonds enough…
records.text: I cannot thank Decoris Diamonds enough for helping me choose my perfect ring and being so great with their service. 😊The customer service was really very good. Clearly explained the steps and prices.

records.title: Amazing !!!
records.text: Very good, and helpful they are. At first I was a bit worried however I’m very happy with my purchase the staff is very very kind helpful warm to earth. They helped me learn so much about diamonds and was honest throughout the journey not to even mention they have the best diamonds for the values. Will deffo recommend

records.title: Pleasant experience
records.text: Very pleasant experience with Decoris diamonds.Although I thought it would be complicated but Mursalin, made the process very easy as we were shown samples and got to choice what we like and how we want ring want made. Really nice experience.

records.title: Expect a bitter response if you don't go ahead with Decoris
records.text: I'm not one to write a bad review usually but after long consideration, I thought this could benefit some people and since Decoris like to pressurise people with writing reviews, here's mine.We were recommended by family friends. It started off well with the first initial call. I made it clear what our budget was and he said he can source a ring that's around that budget which was great to hear. The call was quite thorough and I told him exactly what I wanted and when I wanted it etc. I assumed he was taking notes. We were NOT looking around at this point since he said they had options for us within our budget.All the rings they offered was above our budget at our visit which was unexpected. They seemed to go very high end straight away. Bear in mind we disclosed the budget before the meeting in order to avoid wasting anyone's time. He told us to go home and think about it which we did. I messaged him for details again because I simply couldn't remember the exact prices and specs of each diamond. Post visit we were in communication with Decoris and the diamond we saw on the day was sold - Fair enough. I mentioned our budget again and his exact words were "sorry can't do anything". He said he can look for something again but we need to have movement with our budget. This is when we started looking around as any normal person would given a ring is a big purchase and it seemed like he wasn't bothered about us anymore so I left the conversation there.He decided to check for an update 10 days after our visit. I politely thanked them for their time and said we went ahead with another ring company. He mentioned that we took all of their time and "used them". I apologised that he felt like that and said the rings he showed me were way over our budget. He wasted his own time by showing us rings that were way above our budget. Despite him arriving late for the appointment and juggling another set of clients which took more time, I still gave him good feedback to family and friends after the consultation. He said I didn't have the decency to follow up with him. Sorry but am I making the sale or are you? As a seller, it's your role to follow up with clients. But 10 days later was simply too late. I don't have to explain why I went with another company.His messages started becoming sour and patronising as the conversation went on. Mentioning the small things like me asking for a pass on the day (which I asked many hours ahead) and the fact I didn't complete the "form". I told him all the details over the phone. I assumed he took notes. The form had sections to add in "links". Sorry brother but how am I going to add in any website links of the rings I like if you don't send me the website? I had to remind him to send me the website to look at prior the visit. He also mentioned the fact that I had a notepad with me to take notes.  He stated that "notepad tells us you're going to take notes so think about it later". This was a weird comment to make since bride notepads are common to use. I don't know if that comment was said to embarrass me.The most disappointing part of all of this is that he contacted the family friend who referred us and back chatted about the experience. There is no need to be discussing client appointments with other people. This is very unprofessional. All they had to say was ‘thank you for the update and we wish you the best’. However, they created a whole drama piece and tried to make us feel as the guilty party and the ones to blame.Post visit conversations proves that I made the right decision to not proceed with them. Be mindful that if you don’t proceed with them, then expect an unprofessional response. I would NOT recommend them after this experience.@Decoris - I suggest you are careful with your response if you want to respond because twisting my words won't work if I have the conversation saved. I won't name and shame the person we dealt with. Hopefully you take this on board and change your attitude.

records.title: Would not recommend this jeweller to anyone

At no point did I lead him to think the sale had been secured, and if he wanted that security, he should seek a deposit from his clients to begin with. It was completely uncalled for and upsetting. At a time when I was just beginning my wedding preps, this tainted a very special experience. However, I remained polite and thanked him for the time he put in. I have now learnt that brother Mursalin broke client privileges by reaching out to a member of my family to tell them about my visit and that the sale was not completed. I'm disgusted by this unacceptable behaviour and outraged. There was absolutely no need to go behind my back and discuss my appt with anyone else, let alone my own family. I have remained extremely patient throughout my interactions with Decoris but this is the last straw. description:
Mr Harold & Son is an exclusive family jewellers, situated in the heart of Glasgow's jewellery quarter, the Argyll Arcade. Established in 1983, Mr Harold & Son is now in it's 4th generation, carrying on the same craftsmanship and quality customer service to the public. As a family business, we are committed to perfecting that personal touch, as we know just how magical that moment of choosing the perfect gift is; for both yourself and your loved ones.

Our boutique has built up a prestigious reputation throughout the decades with our family specialising in exquisite diamond jewellery; our magnificent window display is truly unique in the Argyll Arcade. Our renowned dark green and gold exterior is an image that is unforgettable and over the years we have become a landmark in the City Centre.

We celebrated our 30th anniversary in 2013, and hope to continue the amazing journey in the world of jewellery for many more years to come. With over 17,000 fans on Facebook, social media is proving its importance of staying connected with our customers and fans of our store and website. 

So if you are looking for some inspiration and imagination for that special gift, look no further than Mr Harold & Son, the jewellers of distinction.

records.title: Rude, exploitative and unethical jewellers
records.text: My husband bought me a smoky quartz ring for my 30th birthday present back in September. A week or so ago I noticed the prong on the bottom left of the ring was slightly raised and was catching on things. I decided to take it in to the same shop it was purchased in to get it repaired. I went in with my mum and was told by the owner of the shop herself it would be, and I quote (my mum can attest to this too) "a small fee". Thinking it would be along the lines of £20-30 for such a small bit of work, having paid £40 for a resizing a few doors down, I took my pick up slip, and left.I went to collect my ring today and was told that it was going to cost me "£125, if you're happy with that?". I immediately said no, I wasn't happy to pay that, and queried why bending a prong back into place cost so much. The lady who served me jumped in and explained that £75 had been added on for a clean and polish. A service I had neither been advised of or requested. When I rebutted this she said it's added on 'automatically' and would I be happy to 'just' pay £75 for the clean and polish? Why would I pay for something I didn't want? When did it become okay to do things to peoples possessions without their consent? This is where it started to get even more awkward.She called her manager over (the husband of the lady who served me, and the co-owner of the shop I presume?) who told me that, and again I quote, "something must have happened to the ring" because when it reached the workshop "it was actually the two prongs that needed pressing down".Firstly, when I brought the ring in and it was assessed by your wife, it was only the one prong. So are you admitting my ring was not handled with care whilst in your possession? Or are you suggesting your wife got it wrong?Secondly, if a repair was going to be more extensive and costly than originally anticipated, would it not be prudent to call the customer? Apparently not, as when I kept asking why I hadn't been contacted to obtain permission he replied, "if we had to call every customer about things like that we would be on the phone all day". It seems that it's simply too arduous a task to call customers and ask their consent before going to town on their possessions. There were about five staff members sat in the shop at the time, and none of them looked particularly busy - might I suggest you assign one of them the task of making courtesy calls to customers?Thirdly, throughout this exchange I remained polite. I said multiple times that as I had never met or had a conversation with any of these people, how could I possibly be blaming them personally and that surely they could see a £125 charge was insane. The blonde lady who initially asked me for £125 had an unnerving grimace on her face the entire time I was in the shop (unsure if smiling is how she deals with awkward interactions, or if she was trying to intimidate me). She also kept interrupting me saying "what did you think it was going to cost then?" "we clearly have a different idea over what a reasonable charge is". At this point I told her there was no need to talk to me like that, and that I didn't work in the jewellery trade, so how could I possibly answer that question? All I know is that £125 is not 'a small fee', and that common sense would suggest that a clean and polish for £75 needs consent to go ahead.Finally, when we told the manager that our idea of a 'small fee' for such a small task was between £20-30, he kept saying "we wouldn't make anything if we charged that". Respectfully, your costs are not my concern. What IS concerning however is that your unethical practices are in direct conflict with Section 50 (1) a and (2) b of the Consumer Rights 2015 Act. I suggest you go and have a read.We offered to pay a reasonable fee for the prong repair, but they clearly just wanted us gone at this point and the blonde lady shoved my ring into my hand with a "here's your ring!". The door was wide open the entire time and when we left, we noticed there were a few people who had clearly been listening in to the conversation. Truthfully, I hope our interaction served as a warning to people potentially considering purchasing from you. In response to your reply - that’s funny, because you didn’t say any of this at the time so it very much feels like you’re now trying to save face. Instead, you stood there stuttering making both of us feel like criminals and didn’t once offer any apology for the ‘miscommunication’. You’ve only offered one now because I left a bad review. You ask “what more could we have done?” Perhaps treat me like a human being and apologise? Oh and to add insult to injury, my ring is still bent out of shape and looking at photos of when I received the ring, the prong has always been dodgy and the entire setting of the ring looks misaligned. Not even 24 hours after having it ‘repaired’ and it’s still picking up bits of fluff and snagging.

description:
TOG24 stands for “Truth Over Glory Everyday”. We’re not about the “Glory” side of the outdoors; Planting flags on mountains or skiing down sheer ice walls, we’re about the “True” outdoors that everybody can be involved with; walking with friends to the pub or skiing with the family to a bar.

Based in the Spen Valley town of Heckmondwike, initially produced footwear, branched into sports bags and football kits in the 70's before finally landing on waterproofs and fleeces. As the brand grew in popularity skiwear and casual clothing were added. We manufactured all our clothing in the head office we still own today, however, to ensure we stayed competitive and to keep our doors open, it was with a heavy heart that we began producing overseas. Whatever the product was, it had to fit into our motto...

TOG24 are a product of our location in the Spen Valley, Yorkshire; we try to do things right, we don’t believe in the marketing hype that’s out there and everything we make represents quality and value for your hard earned pound. And while we no longer manufacture here (that stopped in 2010) all our products are still proudly designed in the Spen Valley

TOG24 began with the factory shop in Heckmondwike. Originally carpeted in off cuts of fleece and selling seconds and ends of lines out of cardboard boxes, the store did so well that we stopped trying to sell TOG24 to other people’s shops and set up our own chain of stores. TOG24 now sells from over 60 outlets across Britain and Ireland, (and for the biggest bargains you can still visit us at our original factory shop in Heckmondwike).

records.title: Sale is a scam

The first order was earlier in the year around spring/summer time where the jacket was on sale for £39. I then ordered it again in a ‘Black Friday sale’ for the same price. I kept checking the website throughout the year and the jacket was always on a sale price. I’ve never seen it at the supposed full price of £85. I did contact TOG24 to question when and how long it was at full price for and they’ve not responded to any of my emails.

Returned it the day after.They describe it as "the deep, natural down fill provides an effective insulating layer that ll see you through the coldest snap". No, not really. The fill is almost nothing and in a relatively mild January day (7 deg.) I felt cold. It looks a very cheap jacket, say something you would buy well below 50£, but it's priced 175£! records.title: Poor quality, all the way from China
records.text: I bought a pair of 'Grouse' gloves for my wife. The service and delivery were pretty good. However, the gloves are poor and we were misled regarding the country of manufacture. In particular, the fingers are incredibly short (one fifth of the total length of the glove). My wife has quite short fingers but even hers wouldn't fit in comfortably. However she did try wearing them a couple of times, which apparently invalidates the return option.Even worse was the deception regarding where the gloves came from, advertised as 'designed by our team in Yorkshire' . They  forgot to add that the gloves were actually manufactured on the cheap in China, which we didn't realise till we saw the label inside the glove.As a Yorkshireman myself I find that dishonesty very irritating. We won't be bothering with Tog24 again.

description:
BQ Watches is a market leader in buying and selling some of the finest luxury watches in the world, and we have over 30 years’ experience in the watch, retail and jewellery industries. 

All of the watches that we sell are in pristine condition, and they are always boxed with all relevant paperwork and come with a 24-month guarantee. 

BQ Watches hold continuous stock of all popular Rolex watch models, including the Datejust, Date, Day-Date, Submariner, GMT-Master, Explorer, Milgauss, Daytona and Yacht-Master ranges in a variety of materials, such as stainless steel, gold or platinum. 

While we specialise in pre-owned Rolex watches, we also trade Breitling, Cartier, Hublot, Omega and any other high-quality luxury watch brands. 

We don’t just sell watches, however, as we are proud to provide a wide range of services for both consumers and luxury watch traders. We not only have the benefit of decades in the industry, but we can offer numerous supplementary services, such as watch repairs, servicing, refurbishing and dial changes. We also supply and fit diamond dials and bezels at very competitive trade prices. Please feel free to phone us and make an appointment to visit us in our showroom in Radlett, Hertfordshire.

records.title: Pleasant experience
records.text: Sold the watch for more than I paid for it, but got less than listing price. Only real reason it is 4*. Watch was online for less than a month from listing-purchase. Team were helpful and I didn’t really have to lift a finger at all. Payment into my bank was on the day that they stated. No issues all round!

records.title: Helpful and generally good company
records.text: Helpful, clear and knowledgeable. There was a slight delay which I had to email to find out about. This would be 5 stars had they been proactive in letting me know that 6 weeks would turn into nearly 3 months.

records.title: The Service of my Rolex
records.text: The Service of my Rolex and price appears to be good but the time to complete the service is longer than I would have thought was required. No updates given. I had to phone to get a progress report

records.title: Slow sale, not much communication, except trustpilot review requests...
records.text: So, I sold a watch with BQ (Tudor Black Bay 925). On the upside, it sold! On the downside it took over 12 months.Long story, but tried to sell originally with Watchmaster (Feb '23) who went insolvent. BQ took over (May '23). Sometime during the transfer the watch was damaged, though BQ fixed it for free as a gesture of goodwill.Contact wasn't great with BQ. Lots of requests to call back which didn't happen. Called them to suggest we reduce the price (Autumn 23). The watch itself is advertised primarily on chrono24.Eventually it sold (May 24) to a 'frequent customer' for well below asking price. Not BQs fault exactly, but a general downturn in the market. They did reduce their commission so I got a round figure payment. My payment from them went through fine, as agreed.Since sale, contact has substantially increased! They want trustpilot reviews: Emails, a call, 3 messages, offer of free tickets to an event in the space of a week.It's the first watch I've sold, so not much to benchmark against. Contact was limited, and would have preferred something more active / proactive and a quicker sale. Obviously leaving an expensive watch with a random internet company is a little worrisome, so at least it didn't go 'missing'

records.title: Pretty average transaction if I’m…
records.text: Pretty average transaction if I’m honest. I purchased a very expensive watch and left mine for consignment. After a few months I was WhatsApp’d by the owner asking me details about the watch but not doing his homework about me as a customer. I was looking at buying a Rolex Submariner as well. He was pretty clueless and greedy. So I went elsewhere. To be fair, the rep who I dealt with first (not the manager) I dealt with was excellent. I have since blocked the repetitive messages from the manager/owner and bought a Rolex elsewhere.

records.title: Poor Comms but good client base and my…
records.text: Poor Comms but good client base and my watch sold relatively swiftly for a canny price

records.title: Very disappointed with the…
records.text: Very disappointed with the communication of this company requested a price to part exchange my watchers ,followed the online procedure was replied to and then nothing. Update- I actually quite like the persistence of the managing director as he’s called me three times to resolve this issue, after telling him on the first phone call, I was no longer interested. He then persisted to push the issue with a further two calls. To prove a point that was really pointless. The fact of the matter is he wanted me to change my review due to a misunderstanding when clearly it wasn’t a misunderstanding.  Thank you from a very nice man.

records.title: Could not care less……
records.text: Telephoned this company after sending in a part x on a new mint Rolex, no one bothered to call me and finally the quote was hilarious! I was amazed how low the amount was offered, no problem went back to my regular watch company and bought two fantastic Rolex’s.and excellent service.

records.title: What is a fair price?
records.text: What constitutes a fair price when you are looking to sell a Rolex on the grey market?   I spotted a SkyDweller on BQ Watches' website and decided to try to sell them my 2007 SS white dial Daytona (excellent condition w/ box & papers, case and bracelet recently professionally polished ) in exchange. After being cut off twice, I called them for the third time and was offered £12,000. Daytonas of similar vintage on their site are on offer for £20 - 22k.  Had I sold it, I am confident they would be asking £20 - 22k (perhaps more.)   So a gross profit of £8 - 10k (£8k = 67%  profit, £10k = 83% profit.)  Seems a bit on the high side to me.  Actually, very much on the high side, but then I've very limited experience selling.  Perhaps the take-away is that if you're new to selling on the grey market you need to drastically lower your expectations!  Fair or not, my Daytona is not going anywhere for £12k.

records.title: I would not deal with this company…
records.text: I would not deal with this company again. The lady I dealt with was pushy  and would not give any straight answers. In my last call she was rude. Overall not a nice experienceAlso I received the lowest part exchange quotes compared to other large watch dealers by a long way

records.title: I would have given zero stars if I…
records.text: I would have given zero stars if I could. Tried to get help online chat and waited 15 mins with no response to any of my inputs.Rubbish site. Got bored waiting and went to do something more useful with my life.Found a different far better and responsive site

records.title: My second in person shopping experience with BW will probably be my last..
records.text: My first shopping experience with you was excellent, unfortantluely my last was shocking poor. Over 3 hours in your shop, price on the watch i wanted to exchanged changed 4 times, the price of the watch i wanted to exchange changed 3 times. Couldn’t has had a worse experience. Ive posted this review previously - honestly thought someone might have been in touch to try and make amends or apologies, obviously not.

records.title: It wasn’t a new watch despite being told it was
records.text: I put a very positive review on here last month about my experience with BQ when buying a watch from them. However, I must retract that. The reason being is because subsequently I found out that the ‘brand new, unworn’ watch I was sold was in fact a ‘used and (badly) polished’ watch. I found this out when taking the bracelet to be resized. I am so disappointed that I was told it was new and unworn when it wasn’t. Unfortunately that’s me done with BQ which is a shame as I trusted them.

records.title: Watchmaster Insolvency
records.text: My watch was passed to BQ Watches following the Watchmaster Insolvency. BQ Watches were helpful at first and advised a charge of £300 would be required to make the watch suitable to sell. I asked for everything in writing prior to proceeding with any deal. A contract was subsequently issued which I did not sign and instead requested the watch returned. BQ Watches then advised the watch will be returned once I pay them the cleaning cost which I did not authorise either verbally or in writing. This is still to be resolved and I have not had any communication from BQ watches since I refused to pay for a cleaning charge that I did not agree to.

records.title: WORST CO I HAVE EVER USED
records.text: I sent a watch to be valued  they  said it was a fake  and would retun it , that ok my me but   5 phone calls and 4 emails later still  no  contact with anyone at this  comany  all calls go to a call  centre nothing to do with BQ watches  . all they say  is they will pass on the message , never a reply ,there is  phone no direct to this company  so 3 weeks  no responce  what a useless outfit

records.title: Worst experience of my life
records.text: Been here before and sold a few expensive pieces so thought I would come back with a piece I believed was worth a lot. No other fault but my own for not having this watch checked properly, it turned out to be fake.This is not BQ watches fault whatsoever but the way I was treated was appalling. The owner walked into the waiting room, explained it was fake, muttered a few words and walked out of the front door?! Owner could clearly see I was very upset to have learned I’ve been scammed £30k for a fake watch and didn’t bat an eyelid, just walked off without a goodbye. Disgusting way to treat people, the whole experience was awful.I sold 2 pieces last year to the same shop for £65k+I should have been treated like any other valued customer.Never again will I shop with this company. I have learned a valuable lesson not to buy high item watches without proper authentication, which was my own fault for being so careless.But the way in which I was made to feel thought was horrendous, like I was some sort of scam artist, embarrassed is an understatement.

description:
At QVC , we’re here to help you shop with joy. We’re your daily destination for discovery, on TV, online, on our interactive app and on QVC+, our video on demand service.

We have entertaining stories, fabulous personalities, great demonstrations and, of course, unmissable offers, including our must-see daily deal, Today’s Special Value, and all purchases come with a 60-day money back guarantee. 

Plus, join in the fun with us on social media, where you can connect with presenters and guests, receiving real time answers to any of your questions. With something new to see every day, there’s not a second to waste. Shop with Joy. Shop with QVC.

records.title: I ordered the black & white check …
records.text: I ordered the black & white check  Cozee home soft feel kimono wrap in the sale, it arrived, by my usual Evri delivery man, on time and no problems,The wrap fits perfect is warm light and comfortable and although the sleeves are shorter for the style they are great and suit me while I’m doing the dishes, they don’t get wet.Would definitely recommend.

records.title: Excellent shopping channel and service
records.text: Have been shopping at QVC for many years now after having become house bound due to ill health.  Have gained a great deal of knowledge on various subjects and can say my experience has been excellent.  I have had to return products, speak to customer services - basically have used all their services and can only praise them on a well oiled machine.

records.title: Nothing wrong with QVC
records.text: Nothing wrong with QVC.  Great pitythat they use EvRI for delivery. I findthem to be utterly unreliable & bare facedliars when it comes to delivery/collection. They send messages statingthat they have called &found no one inwhen we purposely waited in for them.Our security cameras don’t lie .Because of the connection I won’t beusing QVC again.

records.title: Risk free shopping at it best!
records.text: I really like shopping with QVC because it delivers on every level, from bringing the customer great products to excellent prices and the easy pay really does make purchasing that much easier. Most of all the try and buy and 60 day return policy is a gift from them to their customers, where else would you get this. The customer service team always so happy to help and always very professional. Thank you QVC!

records.title: 30 plus years with QVC should say it all! The best.
records.text: I’ve been shopping with QVC since it was launched 30 plus years ago. It wasn’t fashionable to buy stuff off television those days but I carried on. Why wouldn’t I? No problem returning even after using the item for any reason. No questions asked. Customer service always helpful. Apart from these QVC sells quality products at great prices. I could never afford great skincare if not for regular beauty TSVs. Also it’s great to watch the demonstration with my favorite presenters. I simply trust and adore QVC and will always be a loyal customer! 30 yrs of shopping with QVC says something! Great company.

records.title: Pleasurable shopping
records.text: Most of my Christmas presents for family have been bought from QVC being disabled l do not go out very much and shopping is a nightmare Everything l ordered from QVC from toiletries to pj's has been excellant all received well! Thankyou QVC

records.title: We like the range of QVC products
records.text: We like the range of products that QVC offer. Also the prices, TSVs, easy method of ordering and paying. Communications are excellent, and stock control is very accurate. Above all it is our main 'go to' for online ordering. Many thanks.

records.title: Pretty in pink
records.text: Ordered the Easy carry laundry hamper for personal use.  Pleasantly surprised as folding items are often fragile but this is substantial with a nice strong handle and will easily take a week's wash for one.

records.title: Items usually arrive quickly
records.text: Over the pre Christmas period I bought quite a few items. Out of the 5 items I bought one item had to be returned. In general I am happy with the quality, value and convenience of QVC and that’s why I still buy from them. When I’ve had to return an item there hasn’t been a problem. However as postage is getting higher I’ll be thinking twice for example it was nearly £8 postage to receive and return a dress which had a hem that was uneven.

records.title: As usual not disappointed with this…
records.text: As usual not disappointed with this Dominique ring.  Very sparkly and great value.  Really pleased you sent this by Evri normally items of jewellery are sent by post which always takes longer to arrive!

records.title: Great handbag and customer services.
records.text: I ordered 2 leather bags recently ,1 arrived but the second parcel was somebody else's cooking gear. Customer services were very helpful on the phone and problem solved hopefully.The first handbag is lovely , nice leather and roomy square shape. Await the reordered bag.

records.title: Great end of year sale
records.text: Great end of year sale. Bagged myself a real designer bargain with added discount working out cheaper than the actual designer site.Only thing is that delivery seems to take ages. I ordered a similar item direct from the designer site 1 day after ordering from QVC and received it within 3 days. It took QVC over a week before my item was delivered.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service. Quick delivery. Easy refunds. Top quality products.My only niggle is postage cost, for every item even when ordering a few items they come in separate bags separate cost!!

records.title: Waiting list order
records.text: My latest order is on a waiting list so cannot give 5 stars. Hopefully it will arrive within 90 days.Usually very quick  from ordering to delivery. But a little disappointed this time as it was a gift.

records.title: I’ve always been more than pleased with…
records.text: I’ve always been more than pleased with items I’ve ordered I particularly like Helen Brennan but the last twiceI ordered a jacket it arrived minus any labels and minus the spare buttons I presumed these products had been returned worn. Which is not what I have come to expect from  qvc. Otherwise the delivery service is excellent.

records.title: The delivery time is awful
records.text: The delivery time is awful, sometimes 3 weeks before parcels arrive and that is after many attempts and calls to find out why it is taking so long. This actually put s me off ordering from QVC which is annoying as the company apart from this is excellent

records.title: New Suppliers…
records.text: I have shopped with QVC for many years but recently almost daily there are the same makes and items. There used to be some great suppliers from across the world ie Indigo Moon Dennis Brasso Mr Max to name but a few but now as I say same old things and I dont view as I used to on a daily basis so something new would be great,

records.title: Great Customer Service
records.text: Shopping on QVC is good as the quality of the items are usually great, but they can be a bit pricey, especially when you have to return items; you have to pay the postage. The items usually arrive within 3 days of the order too, which is excellent.I recommend the Denim and Co denim jacket that comes in loads of amazing colours and has a corset style back panel, giving you a great shape, unlike most stiff boxy denim jackets! IT IS AT A REDUCED PRICE AT THE MOMENT!The Customer service line staff are always friendly, helpful and professional.

records.title: Slim light ladder
records.text: Bought this useful ladder. Nice light blue colour. Reasonable price- reduced but not greatly- it creeks when I climb it I am 63 kg. Also,the nail holding the middle step on the left had a sharp metal bit which injured my finger, I filed it now. Hence 4 stars. I still would recommend.

records.title: Please use a better carrier
records.text: I was helped by a friendly agent who told me how to send my item back via Evri returns Despite doing this and paying the return fee Evri seem to have lost the return ! So another agent is sending me a letter to send to claim my refund.I’m not sure Evri are the best carrier really

records.title: Bedding recently purchased which…
records.text: Bedding recently purchased which arrived in a box. Well packed and no problem with bedding, in fact very pleased with the Cozee Home productsBut obtaining the invoice which was stuck to the box proved difficult

records.title: I purchased 4 magnifiers with little…
records.text: I purchased 4 magnifiers with little lights on, the price was so cheap , there really good , I got them for my mother in law , they help with her crosswords, she’s happy as am I , brilliant for reading little writing too .as usual QVC did well 👍

records.title: All fine with QVC.Stayed in to await changed
records.text: All fine with QVC.Stayed in to await delivery as courier initially gave one time James then changed it but stated it would definitely be with me before 7pm .Received an email from them later stating courier (Joe) failed to deliver as there was no reply!!! There was no delivery attempt made, a dog that barks when she hears gate opening and cameras checked on house....negative.Not happy. Thankfully delivered following day by my usual driver from DPD Peter in time for me to pack present before going away for Christmas.

records.title: The hand bags were much smaller than I…
records.text: The hand bags were much smaller than I was made to think, the ladies showing them said you could carry lots of things in them but they were very small and not able to take as much, if you put something in one pocket you were unable to put things in the other pocket, but as I gave them as a present so couldn't be sent back. Nice leather but more thought to what we need to carry.

records.title: It would have been 5 stars but for the…

records.title: Fantasic Company

Not only the staff on the lines, but the fact if you buy something which requires batteries, they include it. It'd be a 5* review if it wasn't for the fact they use Evri (previously Hermes) as their main couriers.

records.title: Review of experience during 2024!
records.text: Excellent customer service with friendly staff! Refunds not always prompt need to be more efficient.Delivery very quick and friendly with Evri but postage expensive and overpriced on small items.Overall QVC does a  job!

records.title: Just a slight delay with processing…

records.title: In the dark.
records.text: Ordered xmas lights from Xmas in July. They worked well for 3 hours then would not recharge. A replacement st arrived after Xmas and one was missing an on/off switch. records.title: Not happy enough to keep the product
records.text: I purchased 2 of the Fire 10 tablets but on review I am not happy with them.  I was aware that the OS was not fully Android and that not all apps would be available,  For me two of those that I use regularly fell into this category.  Lee mentioned a phone help line and said "more on this later" but never mentioned it again.  I do use the Kindle app but was disappointed to see the the page turning on my tablet was just a slide across whereas on the demo it showed a proper page turning graphic.    I have no idea how to access my library as that is now not part of the menu and I don't find moving around the various menus is intuitive.   All seems designed to get you to purchase more goods from Amazon.  The bottom line is that the tablet is no better than what I already have and I will be returning both tablets.

records.title: I don’t like that all your clothes are just for women mostly
records.text: I don’t like that all your clothes products are for women none for men, well except on underwear as an afterthought.My wife would like to know why the bust sizes are so large on most of your women’s clothing.your not catering for the smaller women. There is only Dannie  Minogue it’s not really good enough is it. Please do better. Davemac

Please stop them using the words fabrication for fabric and colourisation for colours. The p&p is often away over the top too eg £5.99 for a large item and £4.99 for a piece of jewellery. records.title: Nothing wrong with products and…

records.title: I was a bit disappointed on opening the…

records.title: Liz earle perfume and cleanse and polish etc
records.text: Everything else was lovely but really didn't like perfume but because it was a set didn't think wud be able to return just perfume and swop for a different one. Was no 100

records.title: Advance order disappointment
records.text: I purchased an item on an advanced order, which had an expected delivery of 2 weeks. They say its more stock they have in the warehouse!! Two weeks after this date I phoned, to be told they were still waiting for stock. Then received an email the next day saying sorry for any inconvenience. Eventually item turned up another two weeks later. Six weeks from placing the order!!!! Dissatisfied with the wait christmas present. Not even a good will gesture for the inconvenience.

records.title: Horrendous delivery costs and policy, QVC needs to review this
records.text: I ordered several items on the same order, the shipping came to more than £30.00. Why can’t QVC consolidate their delivery charges like most other companies ? I could not use my statutory rights and ask for a refund of my original postage on the two items I decided to return as that would have meant returning the ‘whole order’ apparently even though I paid shipping costs on every item and they were all delivered separately anyway…how can this be fair?  Yes I chose to buy items in the sale but QVC delivery costs are diabolical

records.title: Bought item from your app
records.text: Bought item from your app , arrived quickly but still had a returns label on it stating what was wrong with item not even looked at just sent out again with no consideration. Was able to straighten bent leg on airer to get the foot on .

records.title: Delivery is hit and miss
records.text: Amazon delivers quickly and most of the drivers are great. Unfortunately they have several who never follow delivery instructions. Because of this I have had to retreave several soaking wet parcels, thrown on doorstep ( which is 3 feet from the pathway). Even though the safe place drop is an open shed which is right next to the front door. Many will do this without knocking , to save themselves time. Either your staff are overworked and underpayed and given too little time to deliver properly or  ,they just don't care . Other deliverers are better, so if its fragile or valuable then get the item from a reputable deliverer.

records.title: Most disappointed
records.text: I placed an order 20th December which has still not been delivered.  I phoned QVC ON 27th and 28th Dec and twice I was told parcel would be delivered before Hogmanay. It hasn't and I will be wearing an old outfit tonight. I did mention to first person I talked to pointing out that Evri advised speaking to QVC but again QVC told me I would get my outfit before end of 2024. records.title: Great products  and fast delivery…
records.text: Great products  and fast delivery service.  Purchased Patagonia  Mens R1 fleece and saved 10 percent  as a thankyou after purchasing  2 pair of duvet style Slippers for son and fiancé to warm feet after skiing,  brilliant product and one of favourite  gifts  at only £35.
