records.text: Made an order on line. When I attended the Tiso store in Leith, Edinburgh, I was met on entry by a male customer service attendee who approached me and dealt with my exchange for a larger size with efficiency and the minimum of fuss. Excellent service.

records.title: Excellent
records.text: Excellent, fast, smooth, trouble free delivery less than 2 weeks before Christmas. Ordered Friday evening, arrived Sunday.  Will use again. Thank you

records.title: Didrickson
records.text: Best price for didrickson coat in UK, prompt delivery all good

records.title: Great product & speedy delivery.
records.text: Service was really good; efficient & good communication. I ordered last minute before Christmas & it arrived as promised. My only criticism is the price. Other companies had it for a lot less, but weren’t able to deliver in time.

records.title: I bought an e-voucher
records.text: I bought an e-voucherI think it would be useful for your IT people to actually walk through the process of buying one online. It doesn't seem specific for e-vouchers, requires a street address for the recipient and is generally confusing.

records.title: Good product and service
records.text: Good product and service, with shipping a few days after purchase. The photos of the jacket could have more clearly illustrated the side panels which were a little surprise. Happy with purchase regardless.

records.title: Good customer service
records.text: Good customer service, fast delivery, well packaged by Tisohowever the delivery driver DPD chucked the package into my neighbours garden. it was lucky they noticed it and it wasn't breakable.

records.title: Prompt dispatch; delivery delay
records.text: Efficient and prompt dispatch; 4 stars instead of 5 due to delay in delivery of 2 days when it got to DPD Liverpool.

records.title: Good quality fleece tops bought easily…
records.text: Good quality fleece tops bought easily from TISO website at a very competitive price.  The package was due to be delivered to home address but delivery company said that nobody was in the house and they delivered to a pick-up shop.  Easily collected from the shop - but somebody was in the house at the time of the delivery and a quick check of the blink cameras showed that no delivery was attempted?

records.title: Product was very good at a good price
records.text: Product was very good at a good price, just let down a bit by DPD delivery left on doorstep in the rain instead of  specified safe place.

records.title: The gloves arrived very quickly
records.text: The gloves arrived very quickly. I was impressed with the speed. However, even though the quality was excellent, they were not the right gloves for me, so I returned them and hope to get a refund soon.

records.title: Beanie overall is great but since it’s…
records.text: Beanie overall is great but since it’s reversible i didnt like how it had the labels on the inside because it meant i had to cut it off to use that side

records.title: good quality walking shoes which are to…
records.text: good quality walking shoes which are to replace a previous pair bought from Tiso. Delivery always seems to take longer than scheduled

records.title: Purchased a Gift Voucher
records.text: Purchased a Gift Voucher. You emailed it to me. I couldn’t print it off so phoned you to get a pdf copy. Received it and printed off okay.What I would have liked was a nice little card that I could enclose in an envelope to hand over as a Christmas gift!!

records.title: Great helmet almost perfect!
records.text: Really liked the colour combination of the Smith Engage helmet matt moss/stone on website so ordered. Helmet arrived quickly but the colouring was not quite as per photo. It was still a nice looking and great fitting helmet.I sent an email to Tiso explaining and they apologised for their error along with offer of a discount. I decided to accept. They quickly changed pic on the website. Not perfect but satisfactory outcome.

records.title: Customer service were great but the…
records.text: Customer service were great but the alpine bike team didn’t set up the bike properly, front suspension had no air in it

records.title: Probably one of the most expensive…
records.text: Probably one of the most expensive outdoor shops in Scotland, overall, but with great customer service. If Tiso can get their prices more competitive, then they will be unbeatable.

records.title: Mixed results
records.text: Parcel took about 10 days to arrive, no explanation. Peter Storm jacket is warm, comfortable, fits well, accurately sized, good pockets. Haven't tried it in rain yet, suspect the hood won't be very practical and noted that the inner soft cuffs are longer than the outer cuff so will get wet. The Bridgedale socks are too small although described as fitting up to 6.5 and my feet are smaller than that.

records.title: Good selection of items
records.text: Good selection of items. Variety of quality brands but more expensive than other sites however the only site to have the size we needed. Easy to browse the website and order. Good communication and speedy dispatch of my order. Let down slightly by others as the courier company took longer to deliver than was advertised but not a problem for us and not the fault of Tiso.

records.title: Warmer climate
records.text: before buying i researched because my wife is biking to work now (cost of living we got rid of car).wanting her to be warm we bought marine socks. and ear covers.but wanted a thinner waterproof  glove she would be comfortable in. yes there thin but sorry there is a but. they are not the best for warmth.since having them she has had to wear others that work better.I'm not saying yours are not fit for purpose, there fit for a warmer weather.

records.title: Great shoes; delivery meh...
records.text: The shoes are my regular dog walking shoes, which I usually buy in the sale. They are excellent, as usual.However, despite my request to deliver to greenhouse if I was out, the parcel was left in plain sight on the doorstep.

records.title: Arcteryx Rush ski Jacket that was not a ski Jacket
records.text: Whilst the Arcteryx Rush jacket was not a ski jacket as described within the site having a snow skirt , TISO offered a further 5% discount to compensate for this error. So thanks for the kind offer .

records.title: Easy process and great price but arrived damaged
records.text: Ordered 2 x MucOff wet lube via their website as it was cheaper than other sites (even Wiggle, where I normally buy cycle supplies from). Process was easy and delivery prompt. I’m only removing one star as one of the bottles arrived damaged.

records.title: One order, two errors and four deliveries
records.text: I ordered 12 pairs of high quality walking socks as Christmas presents. They came in four batches, which would have been fine if I had been told this in advance. Two pairs of socks were the wrong colour, annoying but not a big deal. I accepted them as I could not be sure of replacements by Christmas. Nathalie was very helpful in taking my problem on board.

records.title: The training shoes I purchased I bought…
records.text: The training shoes I purchased I bought weee too small so I immediately returned them. Although I received notification they were returned in two days it  was a week before I received notification that it’s could take two weeks for acknowledgement. I had asked for a larger size was received and email that a refund has been issued- what a pain! Would never use them again.

records.title: My advice - review the use of D.P. D.
records.text: I had no problem with the Tiso company itself, or with my order, but they were seriously let down by the delivery company D.P.D.  who declared they had missed me when I was in fact at home throughout the whole time of the delivery slot.  They then gave me 2 different later delivery slots, the second one of which being emailed to me only about an hour before that slot. As a result, I was not at home. The package was reported as having had been "received by Anne"despite the fact that I was not even at home!In fact, to be fair, it had been left in a fairly safe spot outside my house.

records.title: I phoned and was told I couldn’t get…
records.text: I phoned and was told I couldn’t get gift voucher online  I had to go into shop. but going on website found I could get e voucher .

records.title: The green fleece was amaizing
records.text: The green fleece was amaizing , but it came in packaging with Tiso literally all over it so ruined it as a present for 15yr old for Christmas as he new what it was , Anna

records.title: Ditch the Plastic packaging
records.text: Good product. Great service but plastic packaging is still an issue(having a token percentage recycled content is not enough!). Catch up with other companies if you truly want to portray an image of caring for the wild places like the founder of Tiso did!! Might start considering avoiding buying from you unless you change because other companies such as Alpkit and red paddle do paper or cornstarch packaging.

records.title: Service is good but products are not as…
records.text: Service is good but products are not as described. Not Tisos fault, but when trousers described as having a 30" waist measure 32" they are useless. As there is nothing smaller available and size 32 is the new 30, I've been 'sized' out of the market, presumably due to  manufacturers pandering to male vanity and ballooning waistlines. Depressing

records.title: Great purchase and delivery experience... but
records.text: Tiso was great in terms of the transaction and delivery.The rating is for advertising a product as premium with a reduced price. I bought Solomon boots advertised as reduced from RRP £155. I currently have some Solomon boots bought direct from their own website for a similar price to that RRP. The boots from Tiso however are like fake Chinese knock offs. Everything from the insoles, construction, sole tread design and material is cheap by comparison. The boots are ok (though not wet weather tested yet) for the price paid, but definitely not the product that Tiso's website RRP suggests!

records.title: Expensive to return unsuitable items
records.text: Relatively quick delivery but product was not as expected due to change in sizes and had to return at a significant cost to cover insurance - a disincentive to ordering online/requesting an alternative instead of refund. (Other retailers send prepaid returns slips /offer exchange without such high postage charges).

records.title: Could do better
records.text: While passing through Inverness and after visiting the new motorbike clothing shop in Walker Road,we went to Tiso for lunch. Found the staff friendly but  no info re table service or not. So sat for a while waiting....found it was not table service as it is in Perth and Glasgow. Ordered a baguette so expected a baguette, but got what I'd call a hoagie. Soft long roll. Bit disappointed. Edible but boring. Nice coffee.Toilet was o.k.  overall could do better

records.title: Quick delivery and good price
records.text: Quick delivery and good price. However colour of item did not match the picture on the website. I usually wouldn't be too bothered but I specifically wanted bright, highly visible trousers so had chosen to buy from Tiso to get that (everywhere else had only grey and black on offer). Unfortunately the bright yellow on the website picture turned out to be a more mustard (technically cumin) colour in real life.

records.title: Tips great, DHL horrible
records.text: I tried to buy my backpacking gear in shop, but they mostly had family tents and big sleeping bags, so I had to go online. It shipped quickly, but because they use DHL it took almost 2 weeks to get my things as they only deliver during work hours, and don't let you pick it up at a drop of point. Unless you have a friendly neighbour or a safe place, you won't get your things. A sad mark that reflects poorly on a company that did their job well. Otherwise, products were good, offered later payment through Klarna. Would recommend, but pray that they have the things in store, will never buy things online from them again.

records.title: Not a best attitude to customers
records.text: I really like product and quality and all the ethics about it. But I was really disappointed not getting exact colour which I choosed and because it was a present, I didn't have a time to change anything. I found it a bit arrogant and not a great customer service not to be informed about possible surprises:(

records.title: Coat review
records.text: Ordered Didrikson coat…. Unfortunately the chest pockets gapped … only closed with one popper…. Would have been ok if there were zips instead. Had to return…. Would have been good warm waterproof coat… disappointed… return cost £12 too.

records.title: I orderd a pair of boots they arrived…
records.text: I orderd a pair of boots they arrived ,but they were the wrong ones ,even though it showed on the box that they were tge right ones ,sent them back got another and they still wernt the right ones ,eventully 3rd time round got the right ones .

records.title: Underwhelming e-gift voucher
records.text: I bought an online gift voucher for my niece, for her to spend on outdoor gear.  This was basically an e-mail with a code sent to me, which I forwarded to her.  So far so good and there haven't been any problems using it as far as I know.  However, I was disappointed that the voucher wasn't presented in an e-card or any format which made it more like a present.  Compared with online gift vouchers from other retailers/restaurants, it was underwhelming.

records.title: Just OK, not great
records.text: Delivery was quick but it is taking a very long time to receive a refund for my return, which i had to pay for and organise myself.  Not a very customer friendly service.

records.title: Putting the Coyote III to the test
records.text: We purchased the Oex Coyote III 3-person tent as a roomier two-person tent, and used it for the first time this week for six consecutive nights. It stayed waterproof except for the base of the sleeping compartment which got slightly damp. The real test was the final night of camping with winds in the 30s (mph) and gusts up to 44 mph. Twice the wind forced open the zippers on the vestibule entrances, and the guy ropes quickly became slack and had to be re-tightened several times during the night. When we took the tent down, we discovered that most of the metal pegs had started to corrode (after just six days) which was disappointing. The alloy poles, however, definitely held their own in the wind. Overall, the Coyote III tent did quite well, and we now know its limits with wind (nothing more than 30 mph). It was a good purchase for £150 and we plan to get a lot of use out of it, albeit in fairer weather.

records.title: The shoes were delivered promptly ..so…
records.text: The shoes were delivered promptly ..so no complaint about that…however, I had failed to check the returns policy and so had failed to notice I had to pay return postage……hence the three star review. Given that shoes  are particularly difficult to get right without trying them on, I think this is a little unfortunate…especially given so many companies do now offer free returns. I understand this is problematic for smaller businesses and I should have checked beforehand.

records.title: Shoes were bought online
records.text: Shoes were bought online. Fitted quite well on opening.Robust, but a little stiff when walking.Laces tend to slip due to circular cross-section of the lace. May try alternative designs.

records.title: Thin soled poor quality and not…
records.text: Thin soled poor quality and not waterproof. Cold to wear! Disappointed! Not worth the money!

records.title: Order failed to deliver, 9 days without update.
records.text: Still waiting 9 days after ordering, with no advice on whether delayed or not coming. Already lost chance to buy elsewhere during Black Friday week.

records.title: Gift cards are not good
records.text: Great shop. Quality gear. Informative staff. Just bought new boots for dog walks. Let down by the gift card I had being past the year use date. I strongly disagree with gift cards running out of time. The company has the money it is not ok in my opinion to then keep that but not honour it. I don't believe there should be a time limit but if there is then I think the money should be refunded. Not ok just to take my £50 birthday gift!

records.title: shipped me a faulty EVOC backpack
records.text: shipped me a faulty EVOC backpack, customer service not great - missing a part of the waist buckle. email address for customer service not getting thru, so I called next day. Got a different email address, still awaiting reply. I do want the EVOC backpack, so hoped Tiso would be able to send the missing part. Looks like a return/refund coming up....

records.title: Lost / delayed delivery and poor customer service
records.text: I ordered a roof tent which got lost in transit and seemed to be returned by the courier to Tiso. I called Tiso for updates and whilst staff were friendly when I called, I didn’t feel confident or assured that the item would actually ever arrive. Eventually I was notified, with barely more than 90 mins notice, of a delivery slot. Far from ideal during working hours and it was only by luck that someone was available to receive the delivery at that time.

records.title: Poor refund experience
records.text: I had to return something to your company for a refund. I attended your store in Edinburgh and more than 7 days later I am still waiting for a refund back to my account. Very poor given you commit to a five day turn around.

records.title: Ordered online
records.text: Ordered online, seemed to take ages to arrive, compared to Cotswold Outdoor who  always have automatically delivered next day.  Swimming goggles great, had the security tag not been left on the nose bridge.  Facing a 60 mile round trip to get it taken off was not an option.  Had to borrow some cutters from a neighbour and an annoyance at the oversight from the shop.

records.title: Time taken to deliver goods
records.text: Time taken to deliver goods, very poor. Ordered items from Amazon later the same day I placed order with Tiso, Amazon arrived within 24 hours, Tiso took over 6 days!Received updates about delivery from Tiso and DPD which were confusing and unhelpful.

records.title: Ordered a bike
records.text: Ordered a bike, 11 days after despatch it went “missing” at the couriers. Tiso customer services did sort me a refund out, which came through two weeks after the initial purchase.The whole experience was hassle. Tiso customer services were decent though.It’s a shame about the couriers.

records.title: I bought a pair of Scarpa Ranger Activ…
records.text: I bought a pair of Scarpa Ranger Activ boots about a year ago and this summer they started to leak. Tiso sent the boots away for testing and announced they were completely waterproof. However, they are still leaking. I am an experienced hillwalker so am well aware of how to look after boots. Furthermore, Tiso appear to be reluctant to post my two-star review on their website. Such a shame as I have always had a good experience with Tiso in the past.
